# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source: common/scripted_effects/air_cleanliness_natural_source_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - AIR CLEANLINESS NATURAL SOURCE EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Registers small wildfire-smoke and volcanic-ash contributions without a new
# periodic iterator. Event 013 calls the impact helper from STATE scope after
# family and severity are resolved. The host monthly Air Cleanliness pulse
# consumes and decays the capped global reservoir once per date.
#
# Public effects:
# - air_contamination_register_natural_disaster_source
# - air_contamination_prepare_natural_source_monthly
# ============================================================================

# Supported scope: STATE
# Inputs: natural_disaster_current_family and natural_disaster_current_severity
# temporary variables, plus persisted natural_disaster_sequence_id and
# natural_disaster_impact_index on the state.
air_contamination_register_natural_disaster_source = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_family = constant:natural_disaster_family.wildfire }
			check_variable = {
				var = natural_disaster_current_severity
				value = constant:natural_disaster_severity.regional
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.wildfire_regional_bp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.catastrophic } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.wildfire_catastrophic_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.abnormal } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.wildfire_abnormal_bp }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_family = constant:natural_disaster_family.volcanic_eruption } }
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_local_bp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.severe } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_severe_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.regional } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_regional_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.catastrophic } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_catastrophic_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.abnormal } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_abnormal_bp }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_family = constant:natural_disaster_family.ashfall } }
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.ashfall_local_bp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.severe } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.ashfall_severe_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.regional } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.ashfall_regional_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.catastrophic } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.ashfall_catastrophic_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.abnormal } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.ashfall_abnormal_bp }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_family = constant:natural_disaster_family.massive_eruption } }
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_local_bp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.severe } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_severe_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.regional } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_regional_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.catastrophic } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_catastrophic_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_current_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.abnormal } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_abnormal_bp }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = settings_air_cleanliness_disabled
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_contamination_permanent_99
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_natural_source_add_bp > constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_impact_is_duplicate = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = air_contamination_natural_source_sequence_id
				has_variable = air_contamination_natural_source_impact_index
				has_variable = air_contamination_natural_source_family
				check_variable = { air_contamination_natural_source_sequence_id = natural_disaster_sequence_id }
				check_variable = { air_contamination_natural_source_impact_index = natural_disaster_impact_index }
				check_variable = { air_contamination_natural_source_family = natural_disaster_current_family }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_source_impact_is_duplicate = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.one }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { air_natural_source_impact_is_duplicate < constant:air_contamination_natural_source.one } }
			set_variable = { air_contamination_natural_source_sequence_id = natural_disaster_sequence_id }
			set_variable = { air_contamination_natural_source_impact_index = natural_disaster_impact_index }
			set_variable = { air_contamination_natural_source_family = natural_disaster_current_family }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp } }
				set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
			}
			add_to_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp = air_natural_source_add_bp }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp
				min = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero
				max = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.monthly_cap_bp
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE, called when a qualifying ash aftermath card opens.
# The impact writer already covers the physical event. This second receipt
# represents settled ash in exposed streets and roof systems. It is limited to
# ash-heavy families and can write only once for a stored disaster sequence.
air_contamination_register_natural_disaster_aftermath_source = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { natural_disaster_family = constant:natural_disaster_family.ashfall }
			check_variable = {
				var = natural_disaster_severity
				value = constant:natural_disaster_severity.regional
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.ashfall_aftermath_regional_bp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.catastrophic } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.ashfall_aftermath_catastrophic_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.abnormal } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.ashfall_aftermath_abnormal_bp }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { natural_disaster_family = constant:natural_disaster_family.volcanic_eruption }
			check_variable = {
				var = natural_disaster_severity
				value = constant:natural_disaster_severity.severe
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_aftermath_severe_bp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.regional } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_aftermath_regional_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.catastrophic } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_aftermath_catastrophic_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.abnormal } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.volcanic_aftermath_abnormal_bp }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { natural_disaster_family = constant:natural_disaster_family.massive_eruption }
			check_variable = {
				var = natural_disaster_severity
				value = constant:natural_disaster_severity.severe
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_aftermath_severe_bp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.regional } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_aftermath_regional_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.catastrophic } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_aftermath_catastrophic_bp }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_severity = constant:natural_disaster_severity.abnormal } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.massive_eruption_aftermath_abnormal_bp }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = settings_air_cleanliness_disabled
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_contamination_permanent_99
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp > constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
			has_variable = natural_disaster_sequence_id
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_contamination_natural_aftermath_sequence_id }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_contamination_natural_aftermath_sequence_id
						value = natural_disaster_sequence_id
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { air_contamination_natural_aftermath_sequence_id = natural_disaster_sequence_id }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp } }
			set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp = air_natural_aftermath_add_bp }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp
			min = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero
			max = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.monthly_cap_bp
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { air_natural_aftermath_add_bp = 0 }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, called by the existing host monthly pulse.
# Output: air_monthly_natural_bp temporary variable.
air_contamination_prepare_natural_source_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp } }
		set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp
		min = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero
		max = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.monthly_cap_bp
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_natural_source_last_tick_date }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.air_contamination_natural_source_last_tick_date
						value = global.date
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_last_tick_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_bp = global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.monthly_decay_bp }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp
			min = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero
			max = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.monthly_cap_bp
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_natural_source_bp } }
		set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_contamination_permanent_99
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_contamination_permanent_99
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp = constant:air_contamination_natural_source.zero }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { air_monthly_natural_bp = global.air_contamination_natural_source_bp }
}

@air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_delay_days = 2
@air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_window_days = 30
@air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_cooldown_days = 180
@air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_route_days = 180
@air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cooldown_days = 90
@air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_delay_days = 7
@air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_sponsor_cooldown_days = 90
@air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject_recency_days = 180

# Supported scope: any. A schema migration reconstructs only from the bounded
# Air Winter country registry produced by the existing monthly state pass.
air_cleanliness_treaty_initialize_lifecycle = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation } }
		set_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_transaction } }
		set_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_transaction = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction } }
		set_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_schema }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_schema
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.schema_version
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_verification_transactions = yes
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_filter_convoys = yes
		air_cleanliness_treaty_release_cleaning_day_project = yes

		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states
			clr_state_flag = air_winter_relief_route
			clr_state_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_reserved
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_sponsor
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_generation
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_sponsor
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation
		}
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violators
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violation_queue
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active }
			set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_defer_founder_reconcile = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
				air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned
					}
					air_cleanliness_treaty_register_observed_violator = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
						has_used_unconventional_weapons = yes
					}
					clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
					set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned
					air_cleanliness_treaty_register_observed_violator = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
						air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_membership_eligible = yes
					}
					air_cleanliness_treaty_register_member = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member }
					air_cleanliness_treaty_unregister_member = yes
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_defer_founder_reconcile = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero }

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members^num
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				clr_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
				clr_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_news_fired
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder }
					clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
							value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero
							compare = equals
						}
					}
					set_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
				}
				air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_founder = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder }
				clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
			}
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
				air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
				clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
				clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
				clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
				clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_schema = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.schema_version }
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. The Air host calls this before the existing state pass
# so an invalid route cannot reduce the next monthly winter pressure result.
air_cleanliness_treaty_pre_winter_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
				has_global_flag = fallout_active
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
			}
		}
		air_cleanliness_treaty_pause_for_fallout = yes
	}
	else = {
		air_cleanliness_treaty_initialize_lifecycle = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active }
			air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_relief_routes = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. The caller is the existing single monthly global host.
air_cleanliness_treaty_host_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
		}
		air_cleanliness_treaty_initialize_lifecycle = yes
	}
	else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_pause_for_fallout = yes }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_last_host_date }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_last_host_date
						value = global.date
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
		}
		set_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_last_host_date = global.date }

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active }
			air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_registry = yes
			air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_verification_transactions = yes
		}
		else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_inactive_runtime = yes }

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_next_invitation_scan_date }
						check_variable = {
							var = global.date
							value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_next_invitation_scan_date
							compare = greater_than_or_equals
						}
					}
				}
				air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_observed_countries = yes
				if = {
					limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_is_valid = yes }
					event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_founder = {
						air_cleanliness_treaty_issue_invitations = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active } }
			air_cleanliness_treaty_try_form = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Membership, diplomacy, and violation transactions

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Registration is idempotent. Relationship and
# treaty-owned embargo changes happen only at lifecycle edges.
air_cleanliness_treaty_register_member = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
			air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_membership_eligible = yes
			NOT = {
				is_in_array = {
					array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
					value = THIS
				}
			}
		}
		save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
			if = {
				limit = {
					air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
					NOT = { tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member }
				}
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_member
				remove_opinion_modifier = {
					target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member
					modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_member_respect
				}
				add_opinion_modifier = {
					target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member
					modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_member_respect
				}
				event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member = {
					remove_opinion_modifier = {
						target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_member
						modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_member_respect
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = {
						target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_member
						modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_member_respect
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member }
				set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_source = constant:condemnation_embargo_source.air_cleanliness_treaty }
				condemnation_unregister_native_embargo_source = yes
				event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member = {
					set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_member }
					set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_source = constant:condemnation_embargo_source.air_cleanliness_treaty }
					condemnation_unregister_native_embargo_source = yes
				}
			}
		}

		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_ever_member
		clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
		clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
		clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation
		add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members value = THIS }

		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violators
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned
					NOT = { tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member }
				}
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_violator
				event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_joining_member = {
					remove_opinion_modifier = {
						target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_violator
						modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_violator
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = {
						target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_violator
						modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_violator
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_violator } }
						set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_existing_violator }
						set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_source = constant:condemnation_embargo_source.air_cleanliness_treaty }
						condemnation_register_native_embargo_source = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This removes current membership and every treaty-
# owned bilateral edge while retaining historical membership and betrayal flags.
air_cleanliness_treaty_unregister_member = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
				is_in_array = {
					array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
					value = THIS
				}
			}
		}
		save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member } }
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_remaining_member
				remove_opinion_modifier = {
					target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member
					modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_member_respect
				}
				event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member = {
					remove_opinion_modifier = {
						target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_remaining_member
						modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_member_respect
					}
					set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_remaining_member }
					set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_source = constant:condemnation_embargo_source.air_cleanliness_treaty }
					condemnation_unregister_native_embargo_source = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member }
				set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_source = constant:condemnation_embargo_source.air_cleanliness_treaty }
				condemnation_unregister_native_embargo_source = yes
			}
		}

		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violators
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member } }
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_departure_violator
				event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member = {
					remove_opinion_modifier = {
						target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departure_violator
						modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_violator
					}
					set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departure_violator }
					set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_source = constant:condemnation_embargo_source.air_cleanliness_treaty }
					condemnation_unregister_native_embargo_source = yes
				}
			}
		}

		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor }
				air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_cleaning_day_project = yes
			}
			air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transactions_for_country = yes
			air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_filter_convoys_for_country = yes
			air_cleanliness_treaty_revoke_relief_routes_for_country = yes
			while_loop_effect = {
				limit = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
						value = THIS
					}
				}
				remove_from_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members value = THIS }
			}
			clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
			clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
			clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_generation
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_accepted_generation
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_declined_generation
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
				event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_founder = { tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_departing_member }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_defer_founder_reconcile > constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero } } }
			air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_founder = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This edge helper records one existing banned
# country and creates every missing treaty-owned sanction against live members.
air_cleanliness_treaty_register_observed_violator = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned
		}
		save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_observed_violator
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			air_cleanliness_treaty_unregister_member = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_betrayal_memory
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violators
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violators value = THIS }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
				if = {
					limit = {
						air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
						NOT = { tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_observed_violator }
					}
					remove_opinion_modifier = {
						target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_observed_violator
						modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_violator
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = {
						target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_observed_violator
						modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_violator
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_observed_violator } }
						set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_observed_violator }
						set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_source = constant:condemnation_embargo_source.air_cleanliness_treaty }
						condemnation_register_native_embargo_source = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the treaty member that breached a member obligation.
# A short-lived country flag distinguishes inspection refusal from the default
# unconventional-weapon cause without changing the shared consequence path.
air_cleanliness_treaty_handle_violation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
			NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned }
			is_in_array = {
				array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
				value = THIS
			}
		}
		save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_violating_member
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_betrayal_memory
		air_cleanliness_treaty_unregister_member = yes
		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_violating_member = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_register_observed_violator = yes
		}

		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_violating_member = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_refusal_violation_context }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_violation_news_fired }
				}
				set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_violation_news_fired
				news_event = { id = chaosx_contamination.8 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. Array mutation occurs only while iterating separate
# work queues, never while iterating the member registry itself.
air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_registry = {
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violation_queue
	set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_defer_founder_reconcile = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned }
				has_used_unconventional_weapons = yes
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violation_queue value = THIS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes } }
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals value = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violation_queue
		air_cleanliness_treaty_handle_violation = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals
		air_cleanliness_treaty_unregister_member = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violation_queue
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals
	set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_defer_founder_reconcile = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero }
	air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_founder = yes
}

# Supported scope: any. This low-frequency scan repairs legacy flags and adds
# persistent violator memory only among already observed Air Winter countries.
air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_observed_countries = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_banned
			}
			air_cleanliness_treaty_register_observed_violator = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
				air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_membership_eligible = yes
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			air_cleanliness_treaty_register_member = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			air_cleanliness_treaty_unregister_member = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: any
air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_founder = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
			NOT = { air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_is_valid = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder }
			clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate }
			clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
			if = {
				limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_current_country_id = id }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate } }
					set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_selected_country_id = air_cleanliness_treaty_current_country_id }
					save_global_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = air_cleanliness_treaty_current_country_id
							value = air_cleanliness_treaty_selected_country_id
							compare = less_than
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_selected_country_id = air_cleanliness_treaty_current_country_id }
					save_global_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate }
			event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate = {
				save_global_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
				country_event = { id = chaosx_air_treaty.3 }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate
		}
		else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_dissolve = yes }
	}
}

# Supported scope: any
air_cleanliness_treaty_dissolve = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_verification_transactions = yes
	air_cleanliness_treaty_release_cleaning_day_project = yes
	air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_all_relief_routes = yes
	clr_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
	clr_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_news_fired
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder }
		clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
	}
	air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_inactive_runtime = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
		clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
		clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
	}
	clear_variable = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_next_invitation_scan_date
}

# Supported scope: any. Used after explicit system initialization has cleared
# flags but a schema-current bounded array still exists.
air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_inactive_runtime = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_verification_transactions = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members^num
				value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals value = THIS }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals
			air_cleanliness_treaty_unregister_member = yes
		}
		clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_member_removals
	}
	air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_filter_convoys = yes
	air_cleanliness_treaty_release_cleaning_day_project = yes
	air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_all_relief_routes = yes
}

# Supported scope: any
air_cleanliness_treaty_try_form = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active }
			check_variable = {
				var = global.air_contamination_bp
				value = constant:air_contamination_threshold_bp.winter_75
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate }
			clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
			if = {
				limit = { is_air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_current_country_id = id }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate } }
					set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_selected_country_id = air_cleanliness_treaty_current_country_id }
					save_global_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = air_cleanliness_treaty_current_country_id
							value = air_cleanliness_treaty_selected_country_id
							compare = less_than
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_selected_country_id = air_cleanliness_treaty_current_country_id }
					save_global_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate }
			add_to_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
			set_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_active
			set_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_news_fired
			event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate = {
				save_global_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
				air_cleanliness_treaty_register_member = yes
				set_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_formation_news_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation }
				news_event = { id = chaosx_contamination.7 }
				country_event = { id = chaosx_contamination.10 }
				air_cleanliness_treaty_issue_invitations = yes
			}
			clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder_candidate
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the current persistent treaty founder.
air_cleanliness_treaty_issue_invitations = {
	save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_issuer
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
			has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_founder
			event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_founder = { tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_issuer }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
			if = {
				limit = {
					air_cleanliness_treaty_country_can_be_invited = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open }
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_generation }
						NOT = {
							check_variable = {
								var = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_generation
								value = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
								compare = equals
							}
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation }
				set_country_flag = {
					flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
					days = @air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_window_days
				}
				country_event = {
					id = chaosx_contamination.9
					days = @air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_delay_days
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_next_invitation_scan_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = {
			global.air_cleanliness_treaty_next_invitation_scan_date = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.invitation_scan_days
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, called by the delayed invitation event immediate.
air_cleanliness_treaty_open_invitation = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_pending_invitation_is_valid = yes }
		clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
		set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation }
		clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation
	}
}

		air_cleanliness_treaty_register_member = yes
	}
}

	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. ROOT is the current treaty secretariat and FROM is
# the targeted member. Equipment is committed before the travelling phase.
air_cleanliness_treaty_start_verification_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_can_start_verification_mission = yes }
		save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
		FROM = { save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject }
		air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_support_cost }
		air_winter_response_pay_support_equipment = yes
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_convoy_cost }
		air_winter_response_pay_convoys = yes
		set_variable = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction
		}
		set_variable = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
		}
		set_variable = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject
		}
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_mission_active
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cooldown
			days = @air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_sponsor_cooldown_days
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors value = THIS }
		}
		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject = {
			set_variable = {
				air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
			}
			set_variable = {
				air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_transaction = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction
			}
			set_variable = {
				air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation
			}
			set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_reserved
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Clears only the local operational half of a paired
# inspection. Historical memory and timed pacing flags are intentionally kept.
air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = {
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_mission_active
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_awaiting_response
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_pending
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_reserved
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_request_pending
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_pending
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_generation
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_transaction
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_generation
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_outcome
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the exact secretariat that owns the transaction.
# Historical inspection memories and the two timed recency flags are retained.
air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_verification_transaction = {
	save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_cleanup_inspector
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject }
		var:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
						value = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_cleanup_inspector
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
			}
		}
	}
	air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			is_in_array = {
				array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
				value = THIS
			}
		}
		remove_from_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors value = THIS }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, an exact active secretariat transaction owner.
air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transaction = {
	air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_verification_transaction = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Cancel any transaction owned by or targeting this
# country. Array mutation occurs only through the separate cancellation queue.
air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transactions_for_country = {
	save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_departing_country
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active
			NOT = {
				is_in_array = {
					array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
					value = THIS
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations value = THIS }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = yes }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active }
					tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_departing_country
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject
						value = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_departing_country
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations value = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transaction = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
	air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
}

# Supported scope: any. Used by migration, dissolution, inactive cleanup, and
# Fallout pause. Every active owner is copied before its receipt is released.
air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_verification_transactions = {
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
		add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations value = THIS }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transaction = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
}

# Supported scope: any. The existing monthly treaty host calls this bounded
# repair pass after membership and founder reconciliation.
air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_verification_transactions = {
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations value = THIS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_mission_active
					has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_awaiting_response
					has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_pending
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_generation
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome
				}
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_active }
			}
			air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_reserved
					has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_request_pending
					has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_pending
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_transaction
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_generation
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_outcome
				}
				NOT = { air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_reservation_is_valid = yes }
			}
			air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_active_inspectors
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction_is_valid = yes }
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations value = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transaction = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_cancellations
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. ROOT is the secretariat and FROM remains the exact
# decision target at mission expiry.
air_cleanliness_treaty_complete_verification_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_mission_is_valid = yes }
		save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
		FROM = { save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject }
		clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_mission_active
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_awaiting_response
		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject = {
			set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_request_pending
			country_event = { id = chaosx_air_treaty.6 }
		}
	}
	else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transaction = yes }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the inspected member. Input is the temporary enum
# air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response set by event chaosx_air_treaty.6.
air_cleanliness_treaty_record_verification_response = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_request_is_valid = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_valid = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response
					value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.full_access
					compare = equals
				}
				air_cleanliness_treaty_can_grant_full_verification = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_full_access_support_cost
			}
			air_winter_response_pay_support_equipment = yes
			set_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_full_access_train_cost
			}
			air_winter_response_pay_trains = yes
			set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_valid = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response
					value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.records_only
					compare = equals
				}
				air_cleanliness_treaty_can_release_verification_records = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_records_support_cost
			}
			air_winter_response_pay_support_equipment = yes
			set_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.verification_records_train_cost
			}
			air_winter_response_pay_trains = yes
			set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_valid = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response
					value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.refused
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_valid = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_valid
					value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject
			var:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector = {
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
			}
			set_country_flag = {
				flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_recent
				days = @air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject_recency_days
			}
			set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_outcome = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response }
			clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_request_pending
			set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response_pending
			event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector = {
				set_variable = {
					air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response
				}
				clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_awaiting_response
				set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_pending
				country_event = {
					id = chaosx_air_treaty.9
					days = @air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_delay_days
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = {
							var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response
							value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.full_access
							compare = equals
						}
						check_variable = {
							var = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_response
							value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.records_only
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
				country_event = { id = chaosx_air_treaty.8 }
			}
			else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transactions_for_country = yes }
		}
	}
	else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transactions_for_country = yes }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the inspected member. The temporary outcome enum
# is supplied by the completing secretariat transaction.
air_cleanliness_treaty_apply_verification_opinion = {
	save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_subject
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				air_cleanliness_treaty_country_is_live_member = yes
				NOT = { tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_subject }
			}
			remove_opinion_modifier = {
				target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_subject
				modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_access
			}
			remove_opinion_modifier = {
				target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_subject
				modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_records_only
			}
			remove_opinion_modifier = {
				target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_subject
				modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_refused_inspection
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.full_access
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				add_opinion_modifier = {
					target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_subject
					modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_access
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.records_only
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				add_opinion_modifier = {
					target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_subject
					modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_records_only
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.refused
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				add_opinion_modifier = {
					target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_verified_subject
					modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_refused_inspection
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the secretariat receiving chaosx_air_treaty.7.
air_cleanliness_treaty_complete_verification_transaction = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_result_is_valid = yes }
		save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
		var:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_subject = {
			save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject
		}
		set_temp_variable = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome
		}
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_ever_received_verification
		set_variable = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_last_verification_partner = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject
		}
		set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_last_verification_date = global.date }
		set_variable = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_last_verification_outcome = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome
		}
		set_variable = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_last_completed_verification_transaction = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_transaction
		}
		set_variable = {
			air_cleanliness_treaty_last_completed_verification_generation = air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_generation
		}
		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_subject = {
			set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_ever_inspected
			set_variable = {
				air_cleanliness_treaty_last_inspection_partner = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_inspector
			}
			set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_last_inspection_date = global.date }
			set_variable = {
				air_cleanliness_treaty_last_inspection_outcome = air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome
			}
			set_variable = {
				air_cleanliness_treaty_last_completed_inspection_transaction = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_transaction
			}
			set_variable = {
				air_cleanliness_treaty_last_completed_inspection_generation = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_generation
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.full_access
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_ever_opened_inspection
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.records_only
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_ever_restricted_inspection
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.refused
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_ever_refused_inspection
			}
			air_cleanliness_treaty_apply_verification_opinion = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_resolved_verification_outcome
						value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_verification_outcome.refused
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_refusal_violation_context
				air_cleanliness_treaty_handle_violation = yes
				clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_inspection_refusal_violation_context
			}
		}
		air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_verification_transaction = yes
	}
	else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_verification_transaction = yes }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the decision actor.
air_cleanliness_treaty_start_cleaning_day_project = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_can_start_cleaning_day = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor }
			clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.cleaning_day_support_cost }
		air_winter_response_pay_support_equipment = yes
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.cleaning_day_convoy_cost }
		air_winter_response_pay_convoys = yes
		add_to_variable = { global.air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_transaction = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
		set_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_in_progress
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor
		set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_transaction = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_transaction }
		set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation }
		save_global_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. This is safe when the sponsor has been annexed.
air_cleanliness_treaty_release_cleaning_day_project = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor }
		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor = {
			clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_transaction
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_generation
		}
		clear_global_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor
	}
	clr_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_in_progress
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the sponsor whose active project failed validation.
air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_cleaning_day_project = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
		}
		country_event = { id = chaosx_air_treaty.5 }
	}
	air_cleanliness_treaty_release_cleaning_day_project = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the timed decision sponsor.
air_cleanliness_treaty_complete_cleaning_day_project = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_project_is_valid = yes }
		set_variable = {
			global.air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_last_completed_transaction = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_transaction
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_contamination_delta_bp = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.cleaning_day_reduction_bp }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_contamination_delta_bp = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.negative_one }
		set_temp_variable = { air_chaos_reason_increase = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.world_state.air_contamination_rise }
		set_temp_variable = { air_chaos_reason_decrease = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.world_state.air_contamination_fall }
		air_contamination_apply_delta_bp = yes
		air_contamination_apply_state_modifier = yes
		set_global_flag = {
			flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_cooldown
			days = @air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_cooldown_days
		}
		news_event = { id = chaosx_contamination.11 }
		air_cleanliness_treaty_release_cleaning_day_project = yes
	}
	else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_cleaning_day_project = yes }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. ROOT is the donor and FROM is the targeted member.
air_cleanliness_treaty_start_joint_filter_convoy = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_can_send_joint_filter_convoy = yes }
		FROM = {
			save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_recipient
			var:air_winter_response_priority_state = {
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_state
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.filter_convoy_support_cost }
		air_winter_response_pay_support_equipment = yes
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.filter_convoy_convoy_cost }
		air_winter_response_pay_convoys = yes
		set_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_project_active
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors value = THIS }
		}
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cooldown
			days = @air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cooldown_days
		}
		set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_recipient }
		set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_state.id }
		set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation }
		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_state = {
			set_state_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_reserved
			set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_sponsor = ROOT }
			set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_recipient }
			set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation }
		}
		country_event = { id = chaosx_air_treaty.1 }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the donor. Releases only the donor's exact reserved
# state receipt. It never removes an already completed relief route.
air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_filter_convoy_project = {
	save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_cleanup_donor
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state }
		var:air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_reserved
					has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_sponsor
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_sponsor
						value = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_cleanup_donor
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				clr_state_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_reserved
				clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_sponsor
				clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient
				clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation
			}
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_project_active
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			is_in_array = {
				array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors
				value = THIS
			}
		}
		remove_from_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors value = THIS }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Cancel every active donor project owned by this
# country or targeting it. The work queue prevents mutation of the donor array
# while that array is being inspected.
air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_filter_convoys_for_country = {
	save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_departing_country
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_project_active
			NOT = {
				is_in_array = {
					array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors
					value = THIS
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations value = THIS }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = yes }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_project_active }
					tag = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_departing_country
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient
						value = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_departing_country
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations value = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_joint_filter_convoy = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations
}

# Supported scope: any. This is used by schema migration, dissolution, and the
# Fallout pause boundary to release every exact active-project owner.
air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_filter_convoys = {
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors
		add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations value = THIS }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_joint_filter_convoy = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_cancellations
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_donors
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the donor.
air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_joint_filter_convoy = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_project_active }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient }
			var:air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient = {
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_recipient
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state }
			var:air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state = {
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_state
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_recipient
				has_event_target = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_state
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
			}
			country_event = { id = chaosx_air_treaty.4 }
		}
	}
	air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_filter_convoy_project = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. ROOT is the donor and FROM is the decision target.
air_cleanliness_treaty_complete_joint_filter_convoy = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_project_is_valid = yes }
		save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_donor
		FROM = { save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_recipient }
		var:air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_state = {
			save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_state
			air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:air_winter_response_result.mask_exposure_reduction }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = constant:air_winter_response_result.mask_disease_reduction }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:air_winter_response_result.mask_adaptation_gain }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_response_result.clinic_shelter_gain }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_recovery = constant:air_winter_response_result.clinic_recovery_gain }
			set_state_flag = {
				flag = air_winter_relief_route
				days = @air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_route_days
			}
			set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_sponsor = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_donor }
			set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_recipient }
			set_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_generation = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_generation }
			clr_state_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_reserved
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_sponsor
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_recipient
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_filter_convoy_generation
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						is_in_array = {
							array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states
							value = THIS
						}
					}
				}
				add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states value = THIS }
			}
			air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
			air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes
		}
		event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_convoy_recipient = {
			country_event = { id = chaosx_air_treaty.2 }
		}
		air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_filter_convoy_project = yes
	}
