	else = { air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_joint_filter_convoy = yes }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_relief_route = {
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_relief_route
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_sponsor
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_generation
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			is_in_array = {
				array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states
				value = THIS
			}
		}
		remove_from_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states value = THIS }
	}
}

# Supported scope: any
air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_all_relief_routes = {
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states
		add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals value = THIS }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
		air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_relief_route = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states
}

# Supported scope: any. Each route recovers its two country scopes before the
# bilateral war test. Invalid routes are removed through a separate state queue.
air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_relief_routes = {
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states
		set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_route_valid = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_route_ledger_is_valid = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_route_valid = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_sponsor
				has_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient
			}
			var:air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_sponsor = {
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_route_sponsor
			}
			var:air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient = {
				save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_route_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_route_sponsor = {
						has_war_with = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_route_recipient
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { air_cleanliness_treaty_route_valid = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_cleanliness_treaty_route_valid
					value = constant:air_cleanliness_treaty_runtime.zero
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals value = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
		air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_relief_route = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_cleanliness_treaty_revoke_relief_routes_for_country = {
	save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_route_departing_country
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_sponsor
						value = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_route_departing_country
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = air_cleanliness_treaty_relief_recipient
						value = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_route_departing_country
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals value = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
		air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_relief_route = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_route_removals
}

# Supported scope: any. Fallout preserves current and historical treaty memory
# but ends every operational project, route, and invitation without reports.
air_cleanliness_treaty_pause_for_fallout = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
				has_global_flag = fallout_active
				has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
			}
		}
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_verification_transactions = yes
		air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_all_filter_convoys = yes
		air_cleanliness_treaty_release_cleaning_day_project = yes
		air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_all_relief_routes = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
			air_cleanliness_treaty_clear_local_verification_runtime = yes
			clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
			clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
			clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation
		}
		set_global_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_paused_for_fallout
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Non-periodic annex cleanup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY, the annexed country from on_annex FROM.
air_cleanliness_treaty_handle_annexed_country = {
	save_event_target_as = air_cleanliness_treaty_annexed_country
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_member
				is_in_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members value = THIS }
			}
		}
		air_cleanliness_treaty_unregister_member = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_in_array = {
				array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violators
				value = THIS
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_members
			remove_opinion_modifier = {
				target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_annexed_country
				modifier = air_cleanliness_treaty_violator
			}
			set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_target = event_target:air_cleanliness_treaty_annexed_country }
			set_temp_variable = { condemnation_embargo_source = constant:condemnation_embargo_source.air_cleanliness_treaty }
			condemnation_unregister_native_embargo_source = yes
		}
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				is_in_array = {
					array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violators
					value = THIS
				}
			}
			remove_from_array = { array = global.air_cleanliness_treaty_violators value = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_cleaning_day_sponsor }
		air_cleanliness_treaty_release_cleaning_day_project = yes
	}
	air_cleanliness_treaty_revoke_relief_routes_for_country = yes
	air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_verification_transactions_for_country = yes
	air_cleanliness_treaty_cancel_filter_convoys_for_country = yes
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_pending
	clr_country_flag = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_open
	clear_variable = air_cleanliness_treaty_invitation_attempt_generation
	air_cleanliness_treaty_reconcile_founder = yes
}

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source: common/scripted_effects/air_cleanliness_winter_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - AIR CLEANLINESS WINTER SCRIPTED EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Deterministic seven-phase state lifecycle for Air Cleanliness winter damage.
# Host integration owns the existing monthly state iteration and must call:
#   air_winter_begin_monthly_cycle = yes       (COUNTRY/host scope)
#   air_winter_update_state = yes              (once per STATE)
#   air_winter_finalize_monthly_cycle = yes    (COUNTRY/host scope)
# Every normal lifecycle entry point is date-idempotent. This file creates no
# on_action and selects no random states. Its dedicated Fallout shutdown helper
# performs one bounded cleanup sweep after the consequence lock and never calls
# the Fallout request coordinator.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global begin/finalize contract
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY (the existing host country)
air_winter_initialize_global = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_pressure } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_recovery_pressure } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_recovery_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_valid_state_count } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_valid_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_active_state_count } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_active_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_severe_state_count } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_severe_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_terminal_state_count } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_terminal_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_unclassified_state_count } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_unclassified_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_population_exposed } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_population_exposed = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_peak_phase } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_peak_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_id = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_contamination_bp_snapshot } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_contamination_bp_snapshot = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_air_delta_bp_snapshot } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_air_delta_bp_snapshot = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_chemical_states_snapshot } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_chemical_states_snapshot = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_fallout_states_snapshot } } set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_fallout_states_snapshot = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY (the existing host country)
air_winter_begin_monthly_cycle = {
	air_winter_initialize_global = yes
	air_winter_prepare_regional_visual_cycle = yes

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_last_prepare_date }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.air_winter_last_prepare_date
						value = global.date
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}

		set_variable = { global.air_winter_last_prepare_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_id = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		set_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open
		air_winter_event_prepare_candidate_cycle = yes
		air_winter_response_prepare_evacuation_cache_cycle = yes

		set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_contamination_bp_snapshot = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_air_delta_bp_snapshot = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_chemical_states_snapshot = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_fallout_states_snapshot = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_bp }
			set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_contamination_bp_snapshot = global.air_contamination_bp }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_last_delta_bp }
			set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_air_delta_bp_snapshot = global.air_contamination_last_delta_bp }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_chem_states }
			set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_chemical_states_snapshot = global.air_contamination_chem_states }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.air_contamination_fallout_states }
			set_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_fallout_states_snapshot = global.air_contamination_fallout_states }
		}

		set_variable = { global.air_winter_valid_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_active_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_severe_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_terminal_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_unclassified_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_population_exposed = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_peak_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear }

		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_system_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = global.air_winter_cycle_contamination_bp_snapshot }
			divide_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_global.pressure_bp_divisor }

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_fallout_states_snapshot > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_global_fallout_pressure = global.air_winter_cycle_fallout_states_snapshot }
				multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_global_fallout_pressure = constant:air_winter_global.fallout_state_pressure }
				add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = air_winter_global_fallout_pressure }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_chemical_states_snapshot > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_global_chemical_pressure = global.air_winter_cycle_chemical_states_snapshot }
				multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_global_chemical_pressure = constant:air_winter_global.chemical_state_pressure }
				add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = air_winter_global_chemical_pressure }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = air_contamination_threshold_75 }
				add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_global.legacy_winter_severe_pressure }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = air_contamination_threshold_50 }
				add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_global.legacy_winter_mild_pressure }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_contamination_permanent_99 }
				add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_global.terminal_lock_pressure }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = global.air_winter_global_mitigation }
				subtract_from_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = global.air_winter_global_mitigation }
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = global.air_winter_pressure
				min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
				max = constant:air_winter_global.maximum_pressure
			}

			set_variable = { global.air_winter_recovery_pressure = constant:air_winter_global.base_recovery_pressure }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.air_winter_pressure
						value = constant:air_winter_phase_entry.phase_1
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_recovery_pressure = constant:air_winter_global.clear_air_recovery_bonus }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_air_delta_bp_snapshot < constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_negative_air_delta = global.air_winter_cycle_air_delta_bp_snapshot }
				multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_negative_air_delta = constant:air_winter_runtime.negative_one }
				divide_temp_variable = { air_winter_negative_air_delta = constant:air_winter_global.negative_delta_bp_divisor }
				add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_recovery_pressure = air_winter_negative_air_delta }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = global.air_winter_global_recovery_bonus }
				add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_recovery_pressure = global.air_winter_global_recovery_bonus }
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = global.air_winter_recovery_pressure
				min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
				max = constant:air_winter_global.maximum_pressure
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			set_variable = { global.air_winter_recovery_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY (the existing host country)
air_winter_finalize_monthly_cycle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open
			has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
			has_variable = global.air_winter_last_prepare_date
			check_variable = {
				var = global.air_winter_last_prepare_date
				value = global.date
				compare = equals
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_last_finalize_cycle_id }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.air_winter_last_finalize_cycle_id
						value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_last_finalize_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_last_finalize_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_severe_state_share = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.air_winter_valid_state_count > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
			set_variable = { global.air_winter_severe_state_share = global.air_winter_severe_state_count }
			multiply_variable = { global.air_winter_severe_state_share = constant:air_winter_runtime.percentage_base }
			divide_variable = { global.air_winter_severe_state_share = global.air_winter_valid_state_count }
		}

		# The persistent registry is bounded by countries observed in the existing
		# state pass. Each row finalizes once for this cycle or removes stale burden.
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
			air_winter_finalize_country_air_operations = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.air_winter_active_state_count > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
			set_global_flag = air_winter_active
		}
		else = { clr_global_flag = air_winter_active }

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.air_winter_terminal_state_count > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
			set_global_flag = air_winter_terminal_states_present
		}
		else = { clr_global_flag = air_winter_terminal_states_present }

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.air_winter_severe_state_share
					value = constant:air_winter_global.severe_share_entry_percent
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = air_winter_severe
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.air_winter_severe_state_share
					value = constant:air_winter_global.severe_share_exit_percent
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			clr_global_flag = air_winter_severe
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.air_winter_unclassified_state_count > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
			set_global_flag = air_winter_has_unclassified_states
		}
		else = { clr_global_flag = air_winter_has_unclassified_states }

		clr_global_flag = air_winter_reset_states_on_next_cycle
		clr_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# State initialization and presentation classification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: STATE. The authoritative typed state-ID ledger may write
# air_winter_presentation_class directly, then call this validator. A missing or
# invalid value remains visibly unclassified. No geographic fallback is used.
air_winter_refresh_presentation_class = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_presentation_class }
				check_variable = { air_winter_presentation_class < constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
				check_variable = { air_winter_presentation_class > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_unclassified = yes }
		set_state_flag = air_winter_presentation_unclassified
	}
	else = { clr_state_flag = air_winter_presentation_unclassified }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Seeds the climate-class water baseline once. The flag
# prevents a later ledger refresh from overwriting player-earned water security.
air_winter_initialize_presentation_water_profile = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_water_profile_initialized }
			NOT = { air_winter_presentation_is_unclassified = yes }
		}
		if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.boreal_continental } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.temperate_maritime } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.mediterranean } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.desert_arid_plateau } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.tropical_coast_monsoon } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.equatorial_rainforest } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.mountain_highland } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.island_oceanic } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_presentation_water.polar_subpolar } }
		set_state_flag = air_winter_water_profile_initialized
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
# Input: temp variable air_winter_requested_presentation_class (0-9)
air_winter_set_presentation_class = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class < constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum } }
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_presentation_class = air_winter_requested_presentation_class }
		set_variable = { air_winter_presentation_ledger_version = constant:air_winter_presentation_ledger.schema_version }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { air_winter_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
		clear_variable = air_winter_presentation_ledger_version
	}
	air_winter_refresh_presentation_class = yes
	air_winter_initialize_presentation_water_profile = yes
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Reconciles the reviewed typed state-ID ledger only
# when its schema version is missing/stale or the stored enum is invalid. All
# nine memberships are evaluated so a missing or conflicting row resolves to
# the visible unclassified state instead of a geographic fallback.
air_winter_refresh_presentation_class_from_ledger = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_presentation_ledger_version }
				NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_presentation_ledger_version = constant:air_winter_presentation_ledger.schema_version } }
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_presentation_class }
				check_variable = { air_winter_presentation_class < constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
				check_variable = { air_winter_presentation_class > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.maximum }
			}
		}

		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }

		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.boreal_continental
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.boreal_continental }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.temperate_maritime
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.temperate_maritime }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.mediterranean
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.mediterranean }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.desert_arid_plateau
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.desert_arid_plateau }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.tropical_coast_monsoon
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.tropical_coast_monsoon }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.equatorial_rainforest
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.equatorial_rainforest }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.mountain_highland
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.mountain_highland }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.island_oceanic
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.island_oceanic }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_state_of = {
					target = constant:air_winter_presentation_states.polar_subpolar
					state = PREV
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.polar_subpolar }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_presentation_match_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one } } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_requested_presentation_class = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
		}
		air_winter_set_presentation_class = yes
	}
	else = {
		air_winter_refresh_presentation_class = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: any. Each call opens a distinct producer generation so a
# same-date Fallout retry cannot authenticate a stale state receipt.
air_winter_begin_fallout_snapshot_production = {
	# Active-transition retries keep the country air burden cleared. Prelock
	# validation does not remove it before the Fallout request actually commits.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
		air_winter_clear_all_country_air_operations_modifiers = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation } }
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
	set_variable = { global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_schema.version }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_record_original_category = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded } }
		if = { limit = { has_state_category = megalopolis } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.megalopolis } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = metropolis } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.metropolis } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_city } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_city } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = city } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.city } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_town } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_town } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = town } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.town } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = rural } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.rural } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = pastoral } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.pastoral } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_island } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_island } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = small_island } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.small_island } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = tiny_island } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.tiny_island } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = enclave } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.enclave } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = wasteland } set_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.wasteland } set_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_initialize_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_initialized } }
		air_winter_record_original_category = yes
		air_winter_refresh_presentation_class = yes

		set_variable = { air_winter_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear }
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear }
		set_variable = { air_winter_trend = constant:air_winter_trend.stable }
		set_variable = { air_winter_peak_phase_memory = constant:air_winter_phase.clear }
		set_variable = { air_winter_phase_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_recovery = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum }
		set_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_expected_exposure_delta = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:air_winter_default.adaptation }
		set_variable = { air_winter_food_reserve = constant:air_winter_default.food_reserve }
		set_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_default.shelter_capacity }
		set_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_default.reclamation }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_water_security } } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_default.water_security } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_refugee_pressure = constant:air_winter_default.refugee_pressure }
		set_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = constant:air_winter_survival.minimum }
		set_variable = { air_winter_expected_monthly_death_percent = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.infrastructure }
		set_variable = { air_winter_category_damage = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_category_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_response_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_rail_protection_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_airbase_closure_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_population_loss_memory = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }

		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_state_category = pastoral has_state_category = rural } }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_food_reserve = constant:air_winter_default.rural_food_bonus }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_state_category = town has_state_category = large_town } }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_food_reserve = constant:air_winter_default.town_food_bonus }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_default.town_shelter_bonus }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = city }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_food_reserve = constant:air_winter_default.city_food_bonus }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_default.city_shelter_bonus }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_default.urban_reclamation_bonus }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_state_category = large_city has_state_category = metropolis has_state_category = megalopolis } }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_default.dense_city_shelter_bonus }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_default.urban_reclamation_bonus }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { has_state_category = metropolis has_state_category = megalopolis } }
				add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_default.metropolis_shelter_bonus }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { infrastructure < constant:air_winter_pressure.low_infrastructure_level }
			}
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:air_winter_default.infrastructure_adaptation_bonus }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_default.infrastructure_reclamation_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { bunker > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_default.bunker_shelter_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { supply_node > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_default.supply_node_shelter_bonus }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_default.supply_node_reclamation_bonus }
		}
		air_winter_initialize_presentation_water_profile = yes

		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_adaptation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_food_reserve min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_shelter_capacity min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		set_state_flag = air_winter_initialized
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Migration guard for ledgers added after initialization.
air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_phase } } set_variable = { air_winter_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_target_phase } } set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = air_winter_phase } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_trend } } set_variable = { air_winter_trend = constant:air_winter_trend.stable } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_peak_phase_memory } } set_variable = { air_winter_peak_phase_memory = air_winter_phase } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_phase_months } } set_variable = { air_winter_phase_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_recovery_months } } set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_recovery } } set_variable = { air_winter_recovery = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_exposure } } set_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_expected_exposure_delta } } set_variable = { air_winter_expected_exposure_delta = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_adaptation } } set_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:air_winter_default.adaptation } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_food_reserve } } set_variable = { air_winter_food_reserve = constant:air_winter_default.food_reserve } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_shelter_capacity } } set_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_default.shelter_capacity } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_reclamation } } set_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_default.reclamation } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_water_security } } set_variable = { air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_default.water_security } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_refugee_pressure } } set_variable = { air_winter_refugee_pressure = constant:air_winter_default.refugee_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_disease_pressure } } set_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure } } set_variable = { air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_survival_value } } set_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = constant:air_winter_survival.minimum } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_expected_monthly_death_percent } } set_variable = { air_winter_expected_monthly_death_percent = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_local_supply_factor } } set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_building_damage_pressure } } set_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_building_damage_cooldown } } set_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_building_family_cursor } } set_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.infrastructure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_category_damage } } set_variable = { air_winter_category_damage = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_category_cooldown } } set_variable = { air_winter_category_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_response_cooldown } } set_variable = { air_winter_response_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_rail_protection_months } } set_variable = { air_winter_rail_protection_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_airbase_closure_months } } set_variable = { air_winter_airbase_closure_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_population_loss_memory } } set_variable = { air_winter_population_loss_memory = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
	air_winter_initialize_presentation_water_profile = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = air_winter_sampling_stations
			OWNER = { exists = yes }
		}
		OWNER = { set_country_flag = air_winter_atmospheric_office }
	}

	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_phase min = constant:air_winter_phase.clear max = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_target_phase min = constant:air_winter_phase.clear max = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_trend min = constant:air_winter_trend.recovering max = constant:air_winter_trend.worsening }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_peak_phase_memory min = constant:air_winter_phase.clear max = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_phase_months min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_recovery_months min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_expected_exposure_delta min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum_delta max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_recovery min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_adaptation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_food_reserve min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_shelter_capacity min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_water_security min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_refugee_pressure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_disease_pressure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero max = constant:air_winter_pressure.strategic_bombing_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_survival_value min = constant:air_winter_survival.minimum max = constant:air_winter_survival.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_expected_monthly_death_percent min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero max = constant:air_winter_deaths.maximum_monthly_percent }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_local_supply_factor min = constant:air_winter_phase_6_modifier.local_supplies max = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_building_damage_pressure min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero max = constant:air_winter_building_damage.maximum_pressure }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_building_damage_cooldown min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_building_family_cursor min = constant:air_winter_building_family.infrastructure max = constant:air_winter_building_damage.family_count }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_category_damage min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero max = constant:air_winter_category_damage.maximum_progress }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_category_cooldown min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_response_cooldown min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_rail_protection_months min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_airbase_closure_months min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_population_loss_memory min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Fallout calls this only from its existing snapshot
# state pass. Invalid states receive no initialization and no current receipt.
air_winter_prepare_fallout_snapshot_source = {
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_produced
	clear_variable = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version
	clear_variable = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
			air_winter_fallout_snapshot_generation_is_open = yes
		}
		air_winter_record_original_category = yes
		air_winter_initialize_state = yes
		air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_fallout_snapshot_payload_is_canonical = yes }
			set_variable = { air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version }
			set_variable = { air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation }
			set_state_flag = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_produced
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# State pressure, target phase, hysteresis, and transition
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_calculate_state_pressure = {
	set_variable = { air_winter_pressure = global.air_winter_pressure }
	set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_pressure = global.air_winter_recovery_pressure }

	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = nuclear_fallout_state } }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.nuclear_fallout_base }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = nuclear_fallout_intensity }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_local_fallout_pressure = nuclear_fallout_intensity }
			multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_local_fallout_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.nuclear_fallout_per_intensity }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = air_winter_local_fallout_pressure }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = chem_state_contamination } }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.chemical_contamination }
	}

	# The installed engine exposes the last strategic-bombing date directly in
	# state scope. Keep this pressure small and bounded because the Deaths pass
	# already records the civilian losses from the same bombing receipt.
	set_variable = { air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { days_since_last_strategic_bombing < constant:chaos_meter_deaths.strategic_bombing_days_recent }
		set_variable = { air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.strategic_bombing_recent }
		if = {
			limit = { days_since_last_strategic_bombing < constant:chaos_meter_deaths.strategic_bombing_days_warm }
			set_variable = { air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.strategic_bombing_warm }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { days_since_last_strategic_bombing < constant:chaos_meter_deaths.strategic_bombing_days_hot }
			set_variable = { air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.strategic_bombing_hot }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure
		min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		max = constant:air_winter_pressure.strategic_bombing_maximum
	}

	if = { limit = { has_state_category = megalopolis } add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.urban_megalopolis } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = metropolis } add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.urban_metropolis } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_city } add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.urban_large_city } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = city } add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.urban_city } }

	if = {
		limit = { infrastructure < constant:air_winter_pressure.low_infrastructure_level }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.low_infrastructure }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = OWNER } }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.occupation_disruption }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_neighbor_state = { air_winter_was_severe_at_cycle_start = yes } }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.severe_neighbor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_relief_route }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_pressure.relief_route }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_sampling_stations }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_response_result.sampling_pressure_reduction }
	}

	# The reviewed presentation ledger is also the deterministic regional
	# mechanics ledger. It changes severity without inferring climate at runtime.
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_boreal_add }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_maritime_add }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_mediterranean_reduction }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_arid_reduction }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_tropical_reduction }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_equatorial_reduction }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_highland_add }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_oceanic_reduction }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.pressure_polar_add }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_adaptation_resistance = air_winter_adaptation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_adaptation_resistance = constant:air_winter_pressure.adaptation_resistance }
	subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = air_winter_adaptation_resistance }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_resistance = air_winter_food_reserve }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_resistance = constant:air_winter_pressure.food_resistance }
	subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = air_winter_food_resistance }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_resistance = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_resistance = constant:air_winter_pressure.shelter_resistance }
	subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = air_winter_shelter_resistance }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_reclamation_resistance = air_winter_reclamation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_reclamation_resistance = constant:air_winter_pressure.reclamation_resistance }
	subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_pressure = air_winter_reclamation_resistance }

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_winter_pressure_modifier }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_pressure = air_winter_pressure_modifier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_winter_recovery_bonus }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_recovery_pressure = air_winter_recovery_bonus }
	}

	clamp_variable = {
		var = air_winter_pressure
		min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		max = constant:air_winter_global.maximum_pressure
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = air_winter_recovery_pressure
		min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		max = constant:air_winter_global.maximum_pressure
	}
	set_variable = { air_winter_recovery = air_winter_recovery_pressure }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = air_winter_recovery
		min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum
		max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_calculate_target_phase = {
	set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_entry.phase_1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.dimming }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_entry.phase_2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_entry.phase_3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_entry.phase_4 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_entry.phase_5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.ash_winter }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_entry.phase_6 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.terminal_winter }
	}

	# Retention thresholds are lower than entry thresholds. They hold the current
	# phase without allowing pressure to skip more than one actual transition.
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes
			check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_retention.phase_1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { air_winter_target_phase < constant:air_winter_phase.dimming }
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.dimming }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes
			check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_retention.phase_2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { air_winter_target_phase < constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock }
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes
			check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_retention.phase_3 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { air_winter_target_phase < constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze }
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes
			check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_retention.phase_4 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { air_winter_target_phase < constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest }
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes
			check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_retention.phase_5 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { air_winter_target_phase < constant:air_winter_phase.ash_winter }
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.ash_winter }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes
			check_variable = { var = air_winter_pressure value = constant:air_winter_phase_retention.phase_6 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { air_winter_target_phase < constant:air_winter_phase.terminal_winter }
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.terminal_winter }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = air_winter_minimum_phase
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_target_phase
				value = air_winter_minimum_phase
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = air_winter_minimum_phase }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_target_phase min = constant:air_winter_phase.clear max = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum }

	set_variable = { air_winter_trend = constant:air_winter_trend.stable }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_target_phase value = air_winter_phase compare = greater_than } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_trend = constant:air_winter_trend.worsening }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_target_phase value = air_winter_phase compare = less_than } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_trend = constant:air_winter_trend.recovering }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_tick_state_cooldowns = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_cooldown > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_building_damage_cooldown min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_category_cooldown > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_category_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_category_cooldown min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_response_cooldown > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_response_cooldown = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_response_cooldown min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_rail_protection_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_rail_protection_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_rail_protection_state } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_rail_protection_state }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_rail_protection_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_rail_protection_state } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_rail_protection_state }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_airbase_closure_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_airbase_closure_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_airbase_closure_state } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_airbase_closure_state }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_airbase_closure_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_airbase_closure_state } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_airbase_closure_state }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_recent_phase_change_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_recent_phase_change_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_recent_phase_change_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } } }
			clr_state_flag = air_winter_recent_phase_change
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_recent_building_loss_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_recent_building_loss_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_recent_building_loss_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } } }
			clr_state_flag = air_winter_recent_building_loss
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_advance_phase = {
	set_variable = { air_winter_previous_phase = air_winter_phase }
	add_to_variable = { air_winter_phase_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick

	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_trend_is_worsening = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_phase_months
					value = constant:air_winter_transition.minimum_escalation_months
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				has_state_flag = air_winter_emergency_escalation
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_phase = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_phase min = constant:air_winter_phase.clear max = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum }
		set_variable = { air_winter_phase_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick
		clr_state_flag = air_winter_emergency_escalation
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_trend_is_recovering = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_recovery_gap = air_winter_recovery_pressure }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_recovery_gap = air_winter_pressure }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_recovery_gap
					value = constant:air_winter_transition.recovery_margin
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_recovery_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_recovery_months
					value = constant:air_winter_transition.recovery_months_required
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_phase_months
					value = constant:air_winter_transition.minimum_phase_months_for_recovery
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_phase = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_phase min = constant:air_winter_phase.clear max = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum }
			set_variable = { air_winter_phase_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			set_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick
		}
	}
	else = { set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_previous_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear }
			check_variable = { air_winter_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.dimming }
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_peak_phase_memory = air_winter_phase }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase
				value = air_winter_peak_phase_memory
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_peak_phase_memory = air_winter_phase }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick }
		set_state_flag = air_winter_recent_phase_change
		set_variable = { air_winter_recent_phase_change_months = constant:air_winter_transition.recent_phase_change_months }
		set_variable = { air_winter_last_phase_change_date = global.date }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Persistent survival ledgers and phase modifiers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_update_survival_ledgers = {
	# Exposure
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_reclamation = constant:air_winter_ledger.exposure_reclamation_reduction }
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_active = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_delta = air_winter_phase }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_delta = constant:air_winter_ledger.exposure_per_phase }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = nuclear_fallout_state } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_delta = constant:air_winter_ledger.nuclear_exposure }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = chem_state_contamination } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_delta = constant:air_winter_ledger.chemical_exposure }
		}
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_delta = air_winter_exposure_reclamation }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure_delta min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_expected_exposure_delta = air_winter_exposure_delta }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = air_winter_exposure_delta }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_decay = constant:air_winter_ledger.clear_exposure_decay }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposure_decay = air_winter_exposure_reclamation }
		set_variable = { air_winter_expected_exposure_delta = air_winter_exposure_decay }
		multiply_variable = { air_winter_expected_exposure_delta = constant:air_winter_runtime.negative_one }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = air_winter_exposure_decay }
	}

	# Food reserve
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_active = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = air_winter_phase }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_ledger.food_loss_per_phase }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_adaptation = constant:air_winter_ledger.food_adaptation_mitigation }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_reclamation = constant:air_winter_ledger.food_reclamation_mitigation }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_boreal } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_maritime } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_mediterranean } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_arid } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_tropical } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_equatorial } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_highland } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_oceanic } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.food_loss_polar } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = air_winter_food_adaptation }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_food_loss = air_winter_food_reclamation }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = air_winter_food_loss min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_food_reserve = air_winter_food_loss }
	}
	else = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_food_reserve = constant:air_winter_ledger.food_recovery_base } }

	# Shelter capacity
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_severe = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_severity = air_winter_phase }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_severity = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_severity = constant:air_winter_ledger.shelter_loss_per_severe_phase }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_adaptation = constant:air_winter_ledger.shelter_adaptation_mitigation }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_severity = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.shelter_loss_boreal } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_severity = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.shelter_loss_highland } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_severity = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.shelter_loss_polar } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_severity = air_winter_shelter_adaptation }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = air_winter_shelter_severity min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = air_winter_shelter_severity }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_recovery = air_winter_reclamation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_recovery = constant:air_winter_ledger.shelter_reclamation_recovery }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_shelter_recovery = constant:air_winter_ledger.shelter_recovery_base }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = air_winter_shelter_recovery }
	}

	# Water security
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_active = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = air_winter_phase }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_ledger.water_loss_per_phase }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_shelter = constant:air_winter_ledger.water_shelter_mitigation }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_reclamation = constant:air_winter_ledger.water_reclamation_mitigation }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.water_loss_maritime } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.water_loss_mediterranean } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.water_loss_arid } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.water_loss_tropical } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.water_loss_equatorial } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.water_loss_highland } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.water_loss_oceanic } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.water_loss_polar } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = air_winter_water_shelter }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_loss = air_winter_water_reclamation }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = air_winter_water_loss min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_water_security = air_winter_water_loss }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_recovery = air_winter_reclamation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_recovery = constant:air_winter_ledger.water_reclamation_recovery }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_water_recovery = constant:air_winter_ledger.water_recovery_base }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_water_security = air_winter_water_recovery }
	}

	# Adaptation and reclamation
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_active = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_adaptation_gain = air_winter_phase }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_adaptation_gain = constant:air_winter_ledger.adaptation_learning }
		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_trend_is_recovering = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_adaptation_gain = constant:air_winter_ledger.adaptation_recovery_learning }
		}
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation_gain }
	}
	else = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:air_winter_ledger.adaptation_recovery_learning } }

	if = {
		limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_0 = yes air_winter_trend_is_recovering = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_reclamation_gain = air_winter_adaptation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_reclamation_gain = constant:air_winter_ledger.reclamation_adaptation_recovery }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_reclamation_gain = constant:air_winter_ledger.reclamation_recovery_base }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation_gain }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_terminal = yes }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_ledger.reclamation_terminal_loss }
	}

	# Disease pressure
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_severe = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = air_winter_phase }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_ledger.disease_per_severe_phase }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_exposure = air_winter_exposure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_exposure = constant:air_winter_ledger.disease_exposure }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = air_winter_disease_exposure }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_has_low_food = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_ledger.disease_low_food } }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_has_low_shelter = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_ledger.disease_low_shelter } }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.disease_maritime } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.disease_mediterranean } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.disease_arid } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.disease_tropical } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.disease_equatorial } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = constant:air_winter_regional_mechanics.disease_oceanic } }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_adaptation = constant:air_winter_ledger.disease_adaptation_mitigation }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_delta = air_winter_disease_adaptation }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = air_winter_disease_delta min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = air_winter_disease_delta }
	}
	else = {
