		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_decay = air_winter_reclamation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_decay = constant:air_winter_ledger.disease_reclamation_decay }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_disease_decay = constant:air_winter_ledger.disease_decay }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = air_winter_disease_decay }
	}

	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_food_reserve min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_shelter_capacity min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_adaptation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_water_security min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_refugee_pressure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_disease_pressure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_clear_phase_modifiers = {
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_1 } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_2 } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_3 } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_3 } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_4 } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_5 } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_6 } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_6 } }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_apply_phase_modifier = {
	air_winter_clear_phase_modifiers = yes
	set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_phase_1_modifier.local_supplies }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_phase_2_modifier.local_supplies }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_phase_3_modifier.local_supplies }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_phase_4_modifier.local_supplies }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_phase_5_modifier.local_supplies }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_phase_6_modifier.local_supplies }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_phase_6 }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_apply_disease_modifier = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_disease_pressure_state } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_disease_pressure_state }
	}
	set_variable = { air_winter_disease_attrition_factor = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_disease_local_manpower_factor = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_disease_pressure
				value = constant:air_winter_disease_modifier.entry_pressure
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_disease_attrition_factor = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		multiply_variable = { air_winter_disease_attrition_factor = constant:air_winter_disease_modifier.attrition_per_point }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = air_winter_disease_attrition_factor
			min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
			max = constant:air_winter_disease_modifier.maximum_attrition
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_disease_local_manpower_factor = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		multiply_variable = { air_winter_disease_local_manpower_factor = constant:air_winter_disease_modifier.local_manpower_per_point }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = air_winter_disease_local_manpower_factor
			min = constant:air_winter_disease_modifier.maximum_local_manpower_penalty
			max = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_disease_pressure_state }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Produces a stable 0-100 output for map mode and AI.
air_winter_calculate_survival_value = {
	set_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = constant:air_winter_survival.minimum }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_food = air_winter_food_reserve }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_food = constant:air_winter_survival.food_weight }
	add_to_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = air_winter_survival_food }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_shelter = constant:air_winter_survival.shelter_weight }
	add_to_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = air_winter_survival_shelter }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_water = air_winter_water_security }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_water = constant:air_winter_survival.water_weight }
	add_to_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = air_winter_survival_water }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_adaptation = constant:air_winter_survival.adaptation_weight }
	add_to_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = air_winter_survival_adaptation }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_reclamation = constant:air_winter_survival.reclamation_weight }
	add_to_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = air_winter_survival_reclamation }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_recovery = air_winter_recovery }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_recovery = constant:air_winter_survival.recovery_weight }
	add_to_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = air_winter_survival_recovery }

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { infrastructure < constant:air_winter_pressure.low_infrastructure_level } }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = constant:air_winter_survival.infrastructure_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { naval_base > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = constant:air_winter_survival.port_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = OWNER } }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = constant:air_winter_survival.occupation_penalty }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_exposure_penalty = air_winter_exposure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_exposure_penalty = constant:air_winter_survival.exposure_penalty_weight }
	subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = air_winter_survival_exposure_penalty }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_refugee_penalty = air_winter_refugee_pressure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_survival_refugee_penalty = constant:air_winter_survival.refugee_penalty_weight }
	subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_survival_value = air_winter_survival_refugee_penalty }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = air_winter_survival_value
		min = constant:air_winter_survival.minimum
		max = constant:air_winter_survival.maximum
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bounded deterministic building and state-category damage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_try_damage_current_building_family = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.infrastructure }
			infrastructure > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = { damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = [AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE] } }
			AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE = "[?air_winter_building_damage_amount|.2]"
		}
		set_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.civilian_factory }
			industrial_complex > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = { damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = [AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE] } }
			AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE = "[?air_winter_building_damage_amount|.2]"
		}
		set_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.military_factory }
			arms_factory > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = { damage_building = { type = arms_factory damage = [AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE] } }
			AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE = "[?air_winter_building_damage_amount|.2]"
		}
		set_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.air_base }
			air_base > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
			NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_airbase_closure_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = { damage_building = { type = air_base damage = [AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE] } }
			AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE = "[?air_winter_building_damage_amount|.2]"
		}
		set_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.dockyard }
			dockyard > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = { damage_building = { type = dockyard damage = [AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE] } }
			AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE = "[?air_winter_building_damage_amount|.2]"
		}
		set_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.supply_node }
			NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_rail_protection_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase
				value = constant:air_winter_building_damage.critical_supply_phase
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase_months
				value = constant:air_winter_building_damage.critical_supply_phase_months
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			supply_node > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = { damage_building = { type = supply_node damage = [AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE] } }
			AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE = "[?air_winter_building_damage_amount|.2]"
		}
		set_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.railway }
			NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_rail_protection_months > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase
				value = constant:air_winter_building_damage.critical_supply_phase
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase_months
				value = constant:air_winter_building_damage.critical_supply_phase_months
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			rail_way > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = { damage_building = { type = rail_way damage = [AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE] } }
			AIR_WINTER_DAMAGE = "[?air_winter_building_damage_amount|.2]"
		}
		set_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick
	}

	add_to_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor > constant:air_winter_building_damage.family_count } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_building_family_cursor = constant:air_winter_building_family.infrastructure }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_update_building_damage = {
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_pressure_delta = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_pressure_delta = constant:air_winter_building_damage.phase_3_pressure } }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_pressure_delta = constant:air_winter_building_damage.phase_4_pressure } }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_pressure_delta = constant:air_winter_building_damage.phase_5_pressure } }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_pressure_delta = constant:air_winter_building_damage.phase_6_pressure } }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_adaptation = constant:air_winter_building_damage.adaptation_reduction }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_reclamation = constant:air_winter_building_damage.reclamation_reduction }

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			check_variable = { air_winter_building_pressure_delta > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		}
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_pressure_delta = air_winter_building_adaptation }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_pressure_delta = air_winter_building_reclamation }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = air_winter_building_pressure_delta min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_pressure = air_winter_building_pressure_delta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled } }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_recovery = air_winter_building_reclamation }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_recovery = air_winter_building_adaptation }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_pressure = air_winter_building_recovery }
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = air_winter_building_damage_pressure
		min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		max = constant:air_winter_building_damage.maximum_pressure
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			air_winter_building_damage_is_ready = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_amount = constant:air_winter_building_damage.damage_phase_3 }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_amount = constant:air_winter_building_damage.damage_phase_4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_amount = constant:air_winter_building_damage.damage_phase_5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_amount = constant:air_winter_building_damage.damage_phase_6 } }

		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_family_attempts = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { air_winter_building_family_attempts < constant:air_winter_building_damage.family_count }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick }
			}
			air_winter_try_damage_current_building_family = yes
			add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_building_family_attempts = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_building_damage_applied_this_tick }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_pressure = constant:air_winter_building_damage.threshold }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_building_damage_pressure min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			set_variable = { air_winter_building_damage_cooldown = constant:air_winter_building_damage.cooldown_months }
			set_state_flag = air_winter_recent_building_loss
			set_variable = { air_winter_recent_building_loss_months = constant:air_winter_building_damage.recent_loss_months }
			set_variable = { air_winter_last_building_loss_date = global.date }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_degrade_state_category = {
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick
	air_winter_record_original_category = yes
	if = { limit = { has_state_category = megalopolis } set_state_category = metropolis set_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = metropolis } set_state_category = large_city set_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_city } set_state_category = city set_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = city } set_state_category = large_town set_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_town } set_state_category = town set_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = town } set_state_category = rural set_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = rural } set_state_category = pastoral set_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_pastoral_terminal_degradation_is_ready = yes } set_state_category = wasteland set_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }

	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_category_damage = constant:air_winter_category_damage.threshold }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_category_damage min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_category_cooldown = constant:air_winter_category_damage.cooldown_months }
		set_variable = { air_winter_last_category_change_date = global.date }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_update_category_damage = {
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_category_degraded_this_tick
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_progress_delta = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_progress_delta = constant:air_winter_category_damage.phase_4_progress } }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_progress_delta = constant:air_winter_category_damage.phase_5_progress } }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_progress_delta = constant:air_winter_category_damage.phase_6_progress } }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_category_progress_delta > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_adaptation = constant:air_winter_category_damage.adaptation_reduction }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_reclamation = constant:air_winter_category_damage.reclamation_reduction }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_progress_delta = air_winter_category_adaptation }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_category_progress_delta = air_winter_category_reclamation }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = air_winter_category_progress_delta min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_category_damage = air_winter_category_progress_delta }
	}
	else = { subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_category_damage = constant:air_winter_category_damage.recovery_decay } }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = air_winter_category_damage
		min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
		max = constant:air_winter_category_damage.maximum_progress
	}

	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_state_category_can_degrade = yes }
		air_winter_degrade_state_category = yes
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deterministic civilian deaths and global aggregation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_apply_state_population_loss = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_percent = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_expected_monthly_death_percent = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_percent = constant:air_winter_deaths.phase_3_percent } }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_percent = constant:air_winter_deaths.phase_4_percent } }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_percent = constant:air_winter_deaths.phase_5_percent } }
	else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_percent = constant:air_winter_deaths.phase_6_percent } }

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			check_variable = { air_winter_death_percent > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { state_population_k > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_multiplier = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_exposure_multiplier = air_winter_exposure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_exposure_multiplier = constant:air_winter_deaths.exposure_multiplier_per_point }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_multiplier = air_winter_death_exposure_multiplier }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_has_low_food = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_multiplier = constant:air_winter_deaths.low_food_multiplier } }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_has_low_shelter = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_multiplier = constant:air_winter_deaths.low_shelter_multiplier } }
		if = {
			limit = { infrastructure < constant:air_winter_pressure.low_infrastructure_level }
			multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_multiplier = constant:air_winter_deaths.low_infrastructure_multiplier }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = OWNER } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_multiplier = constant:air_winter_deaths.occupation_multiplier }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_adaptation_multiplier = air_winter_adaptation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_adaptation_multiplier = constant:air_winter_deaths.adaptation_reduction_per_point }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_adaptation_remaining = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_adaptation_remaining = air_winter_death_adaptation_multiplier }
		clamp_temp_variable = {
			var = air_winter_death_adaptation_remaining
			min = constant:air_winter_deaths.minimum_multiplier
			max = constant:air_winter_runtime.one
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_multiplier = air_winter_death_adaptation_remaining }
		clamp_temp_variable = {
			var = air_winter_death_multiplier
			min = constant:air_winter_deaths.minimum_multiplier
			max = constant:air_winter_deaths.maximum_multiplier
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_percent = air_winter_death_multiplier }
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_memory_tunnel_school_protection }
			multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_death_percent = constant:air_winter_deaths.tunnel_school_protection_multiplier }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = {
			var = air_winter_death_percent
			min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
			max = constant:air_winter_deaths.maximum_monthly_percent
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_expected_monthly_death_percent = air_winter_death_percent }

		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = state_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = air_winter_death_percent }
		multiply_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = constant:air_winter_deaths.population_scale }
		round_temp_variable = chaos_deaths_change
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_state_population_exact = state_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_state_population_exact = constant:air_winter_deaths.population_scale }
		clamp_temp_variable = {
			var = chaos_deaths_change
			min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
			max = air_winter_state_population_exact
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { chaos_deaths_change > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = settings_chaos_deaths_disabled }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = chaos_deaths_change }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.air_winter_exposure }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_applied = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_result = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_applied > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
				add_to_variable = { air_winter_population_loss_memory = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
			}
		}
	}

	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_is_civilian = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_apply_state_pop = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_target_country = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_has_target_country = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_reason = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_applied = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_result = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_aggregate_state = {
	add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_valid_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_unclassified = yes }
		add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_unclassified_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_active = yes }
		add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_active_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposed_population = state_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_exposed_population = constant:air_winter_deaths.population_scale }
		add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_population_exposed = air_winter_exposed_population }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_severe = yes }
		add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_severe_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_is_terminal = yes }
		add_to_variable = { global.air_winter_terminal_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase
				value = global.air_winter_peak_phase
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_peak_phase = air_winter_phase }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The first state contribution in a cycle resets the
# commutative aggregate. The finalizer also calls this helper, which clears a
# stale row for a country that lost its final controlled air base.
air_winter_prepare_country_air_operations_cycle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_air_operations_cycle_id }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_winter_air_operations_cycle_id
						value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_air_operations_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
		set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_airfield_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_sum = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Only undamaged air-base capacity contributes. Every
# eligible state contributes its final phase once, so traversal order cannot
# change the country result.
air_winter_aggregate_state_air_operations = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_airfield_phase_contribution = air_winter_phase }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_operational_airfield_level = non_damaged_building_level@air_base }
	if = {
		limit = {
			CONTROLLER = { exists = yes }
			check_variable = { air_winter_operational_airfield_level > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		}
		CONTROLLER = {
			air_winter_prepare_country_air_operations_cycle = yes
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_controlled_airfield_state_count = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_sum = air_winter_airfield_phase_contribution }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This receipt makes a repeated finalize for the same
# monthly cycle inert. A country with no current contribution loses the modifier.
air_winter_finalize_country_air_operations = {
	air_winter_prepare_country_air_operations_cycle = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_air_operations_last_finalize_cycle_id }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_winter_air_operations_last_finalize_cycle_id
						value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { air_winter_air_operations_last_finalize_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
		set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_average = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_air_operations_burden = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_air_mission_efficiency = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_air_detection = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_air_accidents_factor = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		set_variable = { air_winter_air_weather_penalty = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				air_winter_system_enabled = yes
				check_variable = { air_winter_controlled_airfield_state_count > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			}
			set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_average = air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_sum }
			divide_variable = { air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_average = air_winter_controlled_airfield_state_count }
			set_variable = { air_winter_air_operations_burden = air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_average }
			divide_variable = { air_winter_air_operations_burden = constant:air_winter_phase.maximum }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = air_winter_air_operations_burden
				min = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero
				max = constant:air_winter_runtime.one
			}

			set_variable = { air_winter_air_mission_efficiency = air_winter_air_operations_burden }
			multiply_variable = { air_winter_air_mission_efficiency = constant:air_winter_air_operations.full_burden_mission_efficiency }
			set_variable = { air_winter_air_detection = air_winter_air_operations_burden }
			multiply_variable = { air_winter_air_detection = constant:air_winter_air_operations.full_burden_detection }
			set_variable = { air_winter_air_accidents_factor = air_winter_air_operations_burden }
			multiply_variable = { air_winter_air_accidents_factor = constant:air_winter_air_operations.full_burden_accidents }
			set_variable = { air_winter_air_weather_penalty = air_winter_air_operations_burden }
			multiply_variable = { air_winter_air_weather_penalty = constant:air_winter_air_operations.full_burden_weather_penalty }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_air_operations_burden > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_air_operations_country } } }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_air_operations_country }
			}
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_air_operations_country } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_air_operations_country }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Used by Fallout's Air-owned snapshot opener and by
# administrative reset without changing the persistent country registry.
air_winter_clear_country_air_operations_modifier = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_air_operations_country } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_air_operations_country }
	}
	clear_variable = air_winter_air_operations_cycle_id
	clear_variable = air_winter_air_operations_last_finalize_cycle_id
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_airfield_state_count
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_sum
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_airfield_phase_average
	clear_variable = air_winter_air_operations_burden
	clear_variable = air_winter_air_mission_efficiency
	clear_variable = air_winter_air_detection
	clear_variable = air_winter_air_accidents_factor
	clear_variable = air_winter_air_weather_penalty
}

# Supported scope: any. Registry membership was produced by the existing state
# pass, so this cleanup performs no country or state world iteration.
air_winter_clear_all_country_air_operations_modifiers = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
		air_winter_clear_country_air_operations_modifier = yes
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public state update and cleanup contract
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The persistent registry is populated only from the
# existing monthly state pass and bounds full administrative reset work to
# countries that have actually owned or controlled an Air Winter state.
air_winter_register_country_for_reset = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = {
				is_in_array = {
					array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
					value = THIS
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_array = {
			array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
			value = THIS
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The caller must have run begin for global.date.
air_winter_update_state = {
	# Presentation is independent of gameplay validity, so the host's existing
	# every_state pass also classifies impassable and otherwise excluded states.
	air_winter_refresh_presentation_class_from_ledger = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = air_winter_reset_states_on_next_cycle
			has_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open
			has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
		}
		air_winter_reset_state = yes
		set_variable = { air_winter_last_update_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
		set_variable = { air_winter_last_update_date = global.date }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OWNER = { air_winter_register_country_for_reset = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { CONTROLLER = { exists = yes } }
			CONTROLLER = { air_winter_register_country_for_reset = yes }
		}
		air_winter_response_reconcile_state_project = yes

		if = {
			limit = {
				air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
				has_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open
				has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_last_update_cycle_id }
						NOT = {
							check_variable = {
								var = air_winter_last_update_cycle_id
								value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
								compare = equals
							}
						}
					}
				}
				air_winter_initialize_state = yes
				air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
				air_winter_event_reconcile_pending_chain = yes
				air_winter_response_reconcile_pending_result = yes
				air_winter_refresh_presentation_class = yes
				if = {
					limit = { air_winter_system_enabled = yes }
					air_winter_tick_state_cooldowns = yes
					air_winter_calculate_state_pressure = yes
					air_winter_calculate_target_phase = yes
					air_winter_advance_phase = yes
					air_winter_update_survival_ledgers = yes
					air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes
					air_winter_update_building_damage = yes
					air_winter_update_category_damage = yes
					air_winter_apply_state_population_loss = yes
					air_winter_apply_phase_modifier = yes
					air_winter_apply_disease_modifier = yes
					air_winter_schedule_phase_event = yes
					clr_state_flag = air_winter_suspended
				}
				else = {
					air_winter_suspend_state = yes
					air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes
				}
				air_winter_aggregate_state = yes
				air_winter_aggregate_state_air_operations = yes
				set_variable = { air_winter_last_update_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
				set_variable = { air_winter_last_update_date = global.date }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = air_winter_initialized
				has_global_flag = air_winter_cycle_open
				has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_id
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_last_update_cycle_id }
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = air_winter_last_update_cycle_id
							value = global.air_winter_cycle_id
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
			}
			air_winter_event_cancel_pending_chain = yes
			air_winter_suspend_state = yes
			set_variable = { air_winter_last_update_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
			set_variable = { air_winter_last_update_date = global.date }
		}
	}
	# Phase, survival, shelter, ownership, and control mutations above are
	# authoritative for this cycle. Reconcile from those final values before
	# admitting an owner to the bounded cache-refresh ledger.
	air_winter_response_reconcile_state_designations = yes
	air_winter_response_register_priority_cache_owner = yes
	air_winter_refresh_regional_visuals = yes
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_clear_runtime_modifiers = {
	air_winter_clear_phase_modifiers = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_disease_pressure_state } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_disease_pressure_state }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_rail_protection_state } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_rail_protection_state }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_airbase_closure_state } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_airbase_closure_state }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Preserves long-term ledgers and category history.
air_winter_suspend_state = {
	air_winter_clear_runtime_modifiers = yes
	set_variable = { air_winter_previous_phase = air_winter_phase }
	set_variable = { air_winter_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear }
	set_variable = { air_winter_target_phase = constant:air_winter_phase.clear }
	set_variable = { air_winter_trend = constant:air_winter_trend.stable }
	set_variable = { air_winter_phase_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_months = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_recovery = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum }
	set_variable = { air_winter_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_strategic_bombing_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_expected_exposure_delta = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_expected_monthly_death_percent = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { air_winter_local_supply_factor = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
	set_state_flag = air_winter_suspended
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Explicit administrative restoration only. The normal
# lifecycle never guesses whether another system owns a later category change.
air_winter_restore_recorded_category = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.megalopolis } } set_state_category = megalopolis }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.metropolis } } set_state_category = metropolis }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_city } } set_state_category = large_city }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.city } } set_state_category = city }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_town } } set_state_category = large_town }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.town } } set_state_category = town }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.rural } } set_state_category = rural }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.pastoral } } set_state_category = pastoral }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_island } } set_state_category = large_island }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.small_island } } set_state_category = small_island }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.tiny_island } } set_state_category = tiny_island }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.enclave } } set_state_category = enclave }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_original_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.wasteland } } set_state_category = wasteland }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Clears only the calling country's Air Winter
# reception and event memory. This helper deliberately performs no iterator.
air_winter_reset_country = {
	air_winter_clear_country_air_operations_modifier = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_winter_response_active_project_state }
		var:air_winter_response_active_project_state = { air_winter_response_cancel_state_project = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_state }
		var:air_winter_response_priority_state = {
			clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
			clear_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = air_winter_reception_states
		clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
		clear_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner
	}
	clear_array = air_winter_reception_states
	clear_variable = air_winter_response_active_project_state
	clear_variable = air_winter_response_priority_state
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_atmospheric_office
	air_winter_response_clear_evacuation_cache = yes
	air_winter_event_clear_country_memory = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY (the existing host country). Registered countries
# are reset through a bounded array. State cleanup is deferred to the next
# existing monthly state pass, so this helper adds no world iterator.
air_winter_reset_global = {
	air_winter_reset_country = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
		# Country scopes remain valid while a tag is absent from the map. Clearing
		# every registered entry prevents stale memory from returning on release.
		air_winter_reset_country = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_winter_registered_countries
	air_winter_destroy_normal_map_proof_entity = yes
	set_global_flag = air_winter_reset_states_on_next_cycle
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_pressure
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_recovery_pressure
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_valid_state_count
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_active_state_count
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_severe_state_count
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_terminal_state_count
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_unclassified_state_count
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_population_exposed
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_peak_phase
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_severe_state_share
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_contamination_bp_snapshot
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_air_delta_bp_snapshot
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_chemical_states_snapshot
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_fallout_states_snapshot
	clear_variable = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source: common/scripted_effects/air_cleanliness_winter_event_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - AIR WINTER EVENT EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Public contract:
#   air_winter_event_prepare_candidate_cycle = yes (COUNTRY/host before pass)
#   air_winter_schedule_phase_event = yes  (STATE during the monthly pass)
#   air_winter_dispatch_phase_events = yes  (COUNTRY/host after the pass)
#   air_winter_event_refresh_state = yes   (STATE after an event choice)
#   air_winter_event_apply_deaths = yes    (STATE with temp death percent)
#
# The scheduler adds no country or state scan. It records candidates during the
# existing monthly state pass, compares typed priority, origin cycle, score,
# and state id, then uses a bounded owner array for post-pass dispatch.
# ============================================================================

# Timed flag durations reject script-constant and variable tokens on some
# engine builds. Keep this literal mirrored with
# constant:air_winter_event_runtime.country_cooldown_days.
@AIR_WINTER_EVENT_COUNTRY_COOLDOWN_DAYS = 46

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Reanchors the event cooldown when a delayed
# result is scheduled after the opening popup has already been displayed.
air_winter_event_refresh_country_cooldown = {
	set_country_flag = {
		flag = air_winter_event_cooldown
		days = @AIR_WINTER_EVENT_COUNTRY_COOLDOWN_DAYS
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The regular country target is preferred because it
# preserves the country that made the original choice.
air_winter_event_bind_pending_chain = {
	set_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = air_winter_event_country }
		set_variable = { air_winter_pending_event_owner = event_target:air_winter_event_country }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { air_winter_pending_event_owner = OWNER } }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_event_reconcile_pending_chain = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					air_winter_event_has_any_phase_1_branch = yes
					NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result }
				}
				air_winter_event_has_malformed_phase_1_branches = yes
				AND = {
					air_winter_event_has_exact_desert_city_branch = yes
					NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result }
				}
				AND = {
					has_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result
					OR = {
						NOT = { air_winter_event_has_pending_chain = yes }
						NOT = { air_winter_event_pending_owner_is_valid = yes }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					has_state_flag = air_winter_furnace_chain_full_shifts
					has_state_flag = air_winter_furnace_chain_shutdown
				}
				air_winter_event_has_invalid_island_refugee_branches = yes
				air_winter_event_has_invalid_desert_city_branches = yes
				air_winter_event_has_invalid_dead_city_branches = yes
			}
		}
		air_winter_event_cancel_pending_chain = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_state_flag = air_winter_desert_city_opening_receipt
				has_variable = air_winter_desert_city_opening_owner
			}
			NOT = { air_winter_event_desert_city_opening_receipt_is_valid = yes }
		}
		air_winter_desert_city_clear_opening_receipt = yes
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = air_winter_desert_city_waterworks_state }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Used only when ownership changed after a visible
# event opened. It never touches a newer owner's delayed chain.
air_winter_event_reject_stale_choice = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = air_winter_event_state
			has_event_target = air_winter_event_country
			event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
				has_state_flag = air_winter_desert_city_opening_receipt
				has_variable = air_winter_desert_city_opening_owner
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_desert_city_opening_owner
					value = event_target:air_winter_event_country
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		event_target:air_winter_event_state = { air_winter_desert_city_clear_opening_receipt = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = air_winter_event_state
			has_event_target = air_winter_event_country
			event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
				has_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result
				has_variable = air_winter_pending_event_owner
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_pending_event_owner
					value = event_target:air_winter_event_country
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		event_target:air_winter_event_state = { air_winter_event_cancel_pending_chain = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
		}
		country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.203 }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. An old Phase 1 opening popup may coexist with a
# newer valid transaction, so this notice path never clears state data.
air_winter_event_reject_stale_opening_choice = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
		}
		country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.203 }
	}
}

	air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
	air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes

	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_event_has_pending_chain = yes
			NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_pending_delayed_result }
		}
		air_winter_event_bind_pending_chain = yes
	}
	air_winter_event_reconcile_pending_chain = yes
}

# Supported scope: STATE
# Input: temporary variable air_winter_event_death_percent
air_winter_event_apply_deaths = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = settings_chaos_deaths_disabled }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_event_death_request = state_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_event_death_request = constant:air_winter_event_deaths.population_scale }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_event_death_request = air_winter_event_death_percent }
		round_temp_variable = air_winter_event_death_request
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = air_winter_event_death_request }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:air_winter_event_deaths.minimum_remaining }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.air_winter_exposure }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_applied = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_result = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.one }
		apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_applied > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero } }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_population_loss_memory = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_event_death_request = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_event_death_percent = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
}

	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_last_departures
	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_receiver_country
}

	air_winter_island_refugee_clear_destination_memory = yes
	air_winter_island_refugee_clear_source_state_memory = yes
}

	clr_country_flag = air_winter_memory_island_refugee_quarantine_station
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_memory_island_refugee_closed_waters
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_memory_island_refugee_rescue_registered
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_memory_island_refugee_rescue_overwhelmed
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_memory_island_refugee_quarantine_completed
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_memory_island_refugee_quarantine_failed
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_memory_island_refugee_exclusion_held
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_memory_island_refugee_exclusion_broke
	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_latest_source_state
	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_latest_source_country
	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_latest_source_region

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This does not clear the country cooldown because a

	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_state
	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_country
	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_region

	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_cycle_id
}

	air_winter_island_refugee_clear_receiver_country_memory = yes
	air_winter_island_refugee_clear_source_country_memory = yes
	air_winter_island_refugee_clear_source_receipt = yes

	clear_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_departures_total

# Supported scope: STATE. Called during the existing monthly state pass. Each
# owner retains only its highest-pressure coastal source, with lower state id
# breaking an exact score tie.
air_winter_island_refugee_collect_source_candidate = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_id = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_candidate_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_pressure_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_is_live = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_id = THIS.id }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_candidate_score = air_winter_phase }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_candidate_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.candidate_phase_weight }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_pressure_score = air_winter_pressure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_pressure_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.candidate_pressure_weight }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_candidate_score = air_winter_island_refugee_source_pressure_score }
		OWNER = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_source_state }
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_source_score }
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_source_cycle_id }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_cycle_id value = global.air_winter_cycle_id compare = equals } }
						check_variable = { var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_candidate_score value = air_winter_island_refugee_source_score compare = greater_than }
						AND = {
							check_variable = { var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_candidate_score value = air_winter_island_refugee_source_score compare = equals }
							check_variable = { var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_id value = air_winter_island_refugee_source_state compare = less_than }
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_state = air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_id }
				set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_score = air_winter_island_refugee_source_candidate_score }
				set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
				set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_region = PREV.air_winter_presentation_class }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						is_in_array = {
							array = global.air_winter_island_refugee_source_countries
							value = THIS
						}
					}
				}
				add_to_array = { array = global.air_winter_island_refugee_source_countries value = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_state_id = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_candidate_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_pressure_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The bounded source-owner array is compared by
# frozen score and state id. The dedicated found output prevents an older
# regular target from being mistaken for the current receiver's source.
air_winter_island_refugee_select_source = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_found = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_selected_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_selected_state = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_pending } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.air_winter_island_refugee_source_countries
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = event_target:air_winter_event_country }
					air_winter_island_refugee_source_receipt_is_current = yes
					OR = {
						check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_found = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
						check_variable = { var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_score value = air_winter_island_refugee_selected_score compare = greater_than }
						AND = {
							check_variable = { var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_score value = air_winter_island_refugee_selected_score compare = equals }
							check_variable = { var = air_winter_island_refugee_source_state value = air_winter_island_refugee_selected_state compare = less_than }
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_found = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_selected_score = air_winter_island_refugee_source_score }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_selected_state = air_winter_island_refugee_source_state }
				save_event_target_as = air_winter_refugee_source_country
				var:air_winter_island_refugee_source_state = { save_event_target_as = air_winter_refugee_source_state }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_found = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		set_country_flag = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_pending
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_state = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_state }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_country = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_region = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country.air_winter_island_refugee_source_region }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_destination_state = air_winter_event_candidate_state }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_family = air_winter_event_candidate_family }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
		air_winter_event_refresh_country_cooldown = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A successful transfer commits the frozen scheduler
# family only after population has moved.
air_winter_island_refugee_commit_offer = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_marker_year = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.first_frost } }
		set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_event_year = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_year }
		var:air_winter_island_refugee_offer_destination_state = { air_winter_event_clear_first_frost_marker = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_offer_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.ordinary_phase } }
		var:air_winter_island_refugee_offer_destination_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = air_winter_first_frost_marker
					has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year
					has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id
					has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_owner
					has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region
					has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_score
					has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id
					has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype
					check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_island_refugees }
					check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none }
					check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
					check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
					check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id value = global.air_winter_cycle_id compare = less_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region value = air_winter_presentation_class compare = equals }
					check_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_score > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
					is_owned_by = PREV
					is_owned_by = var:air_winter_first_frost_origin_owner
				}
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_marker_year = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year }
				air_winter_event_clear_first_frost_marker = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_marker_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_event_year = air_winter_island_refugee_marker_year }
		}
	}
	set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_2
	air_winter_event_refresh_country_cooldown = yes
	air_winter_island_refugee_clear_offer = yes
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_marker_year = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A stale or empty source leaves phase memory and
# seasonal markers untouched so the route can be selected again.
air_winter_island_refugee_rollback_offer = {
	air_winter_island_refugee_clear_offer = yes
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_event_cooldown
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
		}
		country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.203 }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY.
# Inputs: temporary share, cap, and source-pressure relief values.
# Output: temporary air_winter_island_refugee_applied.
air_winter_island_refugee_transfer_population = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_requested = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_applied = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_requested = state_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_requested = constant:air_winter_event_deaths.population_scale }
		multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_requested = air_winter_island_refugee_share }
		round_temp_variable = air_winter_island_refugee_requested
		clamp_temp_variable = {
			var = air_winter_island_refugee_requested
			min = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero
			max = air_winter_island_refugee_cap
		}
	}
	var:air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_state = {
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = air_winter_island_refugee_requested }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:air_winter_event_island_refugee.protected_source_remainder }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.unknown }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_applied = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_result = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
		apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_applied = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_applied > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero } }
		air_winter_island_refugee_clear_receiver_country_memory = yes
		event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country = { air_winter_island_refugee_clear_source_country_memory = yes }
		event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_state = {
			air_winter_island_refugee_clear_source_state_memory = yes
			set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_last_departures = air_winter_island_refugee_applied }
			set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_receiver_country = ROOT }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_refugee_pressure = air_winter_island_refugee_source_pressure_relief }
			air_winter_event_refresh_state = yes
		}
		event_target:air_winter_event_state = {
			air_winter_island_refugee_clear_destination_memory = yes
			add_manpower = var:air_winter_island_refugee_applied
			set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_last_arrivals = air_winter_island_refugee_applied }
			set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_state = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_state }
			set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_country = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country }
			set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_region = ROOT.air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_region }
		}
		add_to_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_arrivals_total = air_winter_island_refugee_applied }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_latest_source_state = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_state }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_latest_source_country = event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country }
		set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_latest_source_region = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_source_region }
		event_target:air_winter_refugee_source_country = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_departures_total = air_winter_island_refugee_applied }
			set_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_receiver_country = ROOT }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_requested = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_share = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_cap = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_pressure_relief = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Dedicated identity rows outrank generic candidates
# within their own phase while retaining the scheduler's phase ordering.
air_winter_event_apply_route_score_bonus = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_island_refugees } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.island_refugee_same_phase_bonus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_arid }
			check_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.desert_city }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.desert_city_same_phase_bonus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_5_dead_city_salvage } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.dead_city_salvage_same_phase_bonus }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The value is frozen when a seasonal observation is
# recorded, so later pressure changes cannot reorder old observations.
air_winter_event_calculate_candidate_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = air_winter_phase }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.candidate_phase_weight }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_pressure_score = air_winter_pressure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_pressure_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.candidate_pressure_weight }
	add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = air_winter_marker_pressure_score }
}

		limit = { cataract_dam_mountain > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }

	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Natural oil receives the exact state resource
# penalty. A synthetic plant receives repairable operational damage.
air_winter_event_apply_refinery_output_disruption = {
	if = {
		limit = { synthetic_refinery > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		damage_building = { type = synthetic_refinery damage = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_EVENT_OUTCOME_REFINERY_OUTPUT_DAMAGE }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_refinery_disruption_days = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.delayed_short_days }
	add_dynamic_modifier = {
		modifier = air_winter_refinery_output_disruption_state
		days = air_winter_refinery_disruption_days
	}

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_furnace_shutdown_days = constant:air_winter_event_outcome.furnace_shutdown_days }

		limit = { air_winter_event_has_operational_factory = yes }
		add_dynamic_modifier = {
			modifier = air_winter_furnace_shutdown_industry_state
			days = air_winter_furnace_shutdown_days
		}
	}
	if = {

		add_dynamic_modifier = {
			modifier = air_winter_furnace_shutdown_coal_state
			days = air_winter_furnace_shutdown_days
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The fixed order damages at most one operational
# surface. Exhausted states retain every non-building failure consequence.
air_winter_event_damage_heavy_industry = {
	if = {
		limit = { non_damaged_building_level = { building = arms_factory level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero } }
		damage_building = { type = arms_factory damage = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_EVENT_OUTCOME_FURNACE_DAMAGE }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { non_damaged_building_level = { building = industrial_complex level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero } }
		damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_EVENT_OUTCOME_FURNACE_DAMAGE }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { non_damaged_building_level = { building = infrastructure level > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero } }
		damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_EVENT_OUTCOME_FURNACE_DAMAGE }
	}
}

	}

		limit = { infrastructure > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
		damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_AIR_WINTER_EVENT_OUTCOME_INFRASTRUCTURE_DAMAGE }
	}
