# Supported scope: STATE. Output is temporary air_winter_selected_event_id.
air_winter_event_select_phase_2_route = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none }
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_event_is_mountain_capital = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_mountain_capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_event_is_engine_island_state = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_island_refugees }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_event_is_desert_city_route = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_arid }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.desert_city }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_response_is_city = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_city }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_coast }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_arid }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_highland }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes
				air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_food }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Output is temporary air_winter_selected_event_id.
air_winter_event_select_unseen_phase_route = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes
			OWNER = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_1_boreal }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_1_maritime }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_1_arid }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_1_tropical }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_1_highland }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes
			OWNER = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_2 } }
		}
		air_winter_event_select_phase_2_route = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes
			OWNER = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_3 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_event_is_reactor_state = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_3_reactor }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_event_is_hydroelectric_state = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_3_dam }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_event_is_oil_or_refinery_state = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_3_refinery }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_event_is_heavy_industry_state = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_3_heavy_industry }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_response_is_transport_state = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_3_transport }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_3_clinics } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes
			OWNER = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_4 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_response_is_city = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_4_city }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_response_is_food_state = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_4_food }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_4_shelter } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes
			OWNER = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_5 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_event_is_dead_city_salvage_candidate = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_5_dead_city_salvage }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_response_is_city = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_5_city }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_has_low_shelter = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_5_abandonment }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_5_archive } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes
			OWNER = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_6 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_6_terminal }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. PREV is the dispatching country. An ordinary phase
# event may be the exact authored route stored by first frost or dark harvest.
# Consume that matching observation once so one physical incident cannot open
# the same event twice under two family labels.
air_winter_event_coalesce_matching_seasonal_marker = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_first_frost_marker_is_valid = yes
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id
				value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_id
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype
				value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_route_subtype
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		OWNER = { set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_event_year = PREV.air_winter_first_frost_origin_year } }
		air_winter_event_clear_first_frost_marker = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_dark_harvest_marker_is_valid = yes
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_event_id
				value = PREV.air_winter_event_candidate_id
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		OWNER = { set_variable = { air_winter_dark_harvest_event_year = PREV.air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_year } }
		air_winter_event_clear_dark_harvest_marker = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Invalid, transferred, partial, or obsolete rows are
# removed lazily during the existing state pass.
air_winter_event_reconcile_seasonal_markers = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_event_cycle_year_is_valid = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { air_winter_first_frost_marker_is_valid = yes } } air_winter_event_clear_first_frost_marker = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { air_winter_dark_harvest_marker_is_valid = yes } } air_winter_event_clear_dark_harvest_marker = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { air_winter_ash_thaw_marker_is_valid = yes } } air_winter_event_clear_ash_thaw_marker = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { air_winter_second_winter_marker_is_valid = yes } } air_winter_event_clear_second_winter_marker = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { air_winter_terminal_season_marker_is_valid = yes } } air_winter_event_clear_terminal_season_marker = yes }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Output is temporary
# air_winter_second_winter_region_due.
air_winter_event_prepare_second_winter_region = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_boreal_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_boreal_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_boreal_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_maritime_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_maritime_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_maritime_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_mediterranean_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_mediterranean_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_mediterranean_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_arid_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_arid_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_arid_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_tropical_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_tropical_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_tropical_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_equatorial_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_equatorial_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_equatorial_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_highland_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_highland_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_highland_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_oceanic_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_oceanic_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_oceanic_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes }
		OWNER = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_polar_last_severe_year } } set_variable = { air_winter_polar_last_severe_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_polar_last_severe_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The validated candidate region selects one of the
# nine fixed regional receipts without meta-generated variable names.
air_winter_event_commit_second_winter_region = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.boreal_continental } } set_variable = { air_winter_boreal_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.temperate_maritime } } set_variable = { air_winter_maritime_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.mediterranean } } set_variable = { air_winter_mediterranean_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.desert_arid_plateau } } set_variable = { air_winter_arid_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.tropical_coast_monsoon } } set_variable = { air_winter_tropical_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.equatorial_rainforest } } set_variable = { air_winter_equatorial_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.mountain_highland } } set_variable = { air_winter_highland_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.island_oceanic } } set_variable = { air_winter_oceanic_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.polar_subpolar } } set_variable = { air_winter_polar_last_severe_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year } }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. All five observations are stored before the owner
# cooldown gate so a transient transition or threshold cannot be lost.
air_winter_event_capture_seasonal_markers = {
	air_winter_event_reconcile_seasonal_markers = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_event_cycle_year_is_valid = yes
			OWNER = { exists = yes }
			NOT = { air_winter_presentation_is_unclassified = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_first_frost_marker }
				has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick
				check_variable = { air_winter_previous_phase < constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.crop_shock compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				OWNER = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_first_frost_event_year }
						check_variable = { var = air_winter_first_frost_event_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.none }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none }
			air_winter_event_select_phase_2_route = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id > constant:air_winter_event_id.none } }
				air_winter_event_calculate_candidate_score = yes
				air_winter_event_apply_route_score_bonus = yes
				set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year }
				set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
				set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_owner = OWNER }
				set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_region = air_winter_presentation_class }
				set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_score = air_winter_marker_score }
				set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id = air_winter_selected_event_id }
				set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype = air_winter_selected_route_subtype }
				set_state_flag = air_winter_first_frost_marker
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_dark_harvest_marker }
				air_winter_is_severe = yes
				air_winter_response_is_food_state = yes
				OWNER = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_dark_harvest_event_year }
						check_variable = { var = air_winter_dark_harvest_event_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than }
					}
				}
			}
			air_winter_event_calculate_candidate_score = yes
			set_variable = { air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year }
			set_variable = { air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
			set_variable = { air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_owner = OWNER }
			set_variable = { air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_region = air_winter_presentation_class }
			set_variable = { air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_score = air_winter_marker_score }
			set_variable = { air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_4_food }
			set_state_flag = air_winter_dark_harvest_marker
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_ash_thaw_marker }
				has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_previous_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_previous_phase value = constant:air_winter_phase.black_harvest compare = less_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = air_winter_previous_phase compare = less_than }
				OWNER = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_ash_thaw_event_year }
						check_variable = { var = air_winter_ash_thaw_event_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than }
					}
				}
			}
			air_winter_event_calculate_candidate_score = yes
			set_variable = { air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year }
			set_variable = { air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
			set_variable = { air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_owner = OWNER }
			set_variable = { air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_region = air_winter_presentation_class }
			set_variable = { air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_score = air_winter_marker_score }
			set_variable = { air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.recovery }
			set_state_flag = air_winter_ash_thaw_marker
		}

		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_is_severe = yes }
			air_winter_event_prepare_second_winter_region = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_second_winter_marker }
					check_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
					OWNER = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_second_winter_event_year }
							check_variable = { var = air_winter_second_winter_event_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than }
						}
					}
				}
				air_winter_event_calculate_candidate_score = yes
				set_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_origin_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year }
				set_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_origin_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
				set_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_origin_owner = OWNER }
				set_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_origin_region = air_winter_presentation_class }
				set_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_origin_score = air_winter_marker_score }
				set_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.second_winter }
				set_state_flag = air_winter_second_winter_marker
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = air_winter_terminal_season_marker }
				air_winter_is_terminal = yes
				has_variable = global.air_winter_cycle_contamination_bp_snapshot
				check_variable = { global.air_winter_cycle_contamination_bp_snapshot > constant:air_winter_monitoring.terminal_contamination_bp }
				OWNER = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_terminal_season_event_year }
						check_variable = { var = air_winter_terminal_season_event_year value = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year compare = less_than }
					}
				}
			}
			air_winter_event_calculate_candidate_score = yes
			set_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year }
			set_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
			set_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_owner = OWNER }
			set_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_region = air_winter_presentation_class }
			set_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_score = air_winter_marker_score }
			set_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_origin_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_6_terminal }
			set_state_flag = air_winter_terminal_season_marker
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_pressure_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Clears the bounded dispatch ledger before the
# existing monthly state pass begins.
air_winter_event_prepare_candidate_cycle = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_winter_island_refugee_source_countries
		air_winter_island_refugee_clear_source_receipt = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_winter_island_refugee_source_countries
	clear_array = global.air_winter_event_candidate_countries
	set_variable = { global.air_winter_event_cycle_year = global.year }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_winter_event_clear_candidate = {
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_state
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_id
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_score
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_cycle_id
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_family
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_priority
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_year
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_region
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id
	clear_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_route_subtype
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Called once from the existing monthly state pass.
# It records one deterministic candidate per owner and never fires directly.
air_winter_schedule_phase_event = {
	# Nested scripted effects write these temporary outputs. Define them in the
	# caller before capture so every helper return has a live destination.
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_pressure_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_region_due = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	air_winter_island_refugee_collect_source_candidate = yes

	# Marker capture is deliberately outside the country cooldown gate.
	air_winter_event_capture_seasonal_markers = yes

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }

	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_event_cycle_year_is_valid = yes
			NOT = { air_winter_presentation_is_unclassified = yes }
			OWNER = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_event_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_pending }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_terminal_season_marker_is_valid = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_event_id }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.terminal_season }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.terminal_season }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_year }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_region }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_cycle_id }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = air_winter_terminal_season_origin_score }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { air_winter_is_active = yes }
				air_winter_event_select_unseen_phase_route = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id > constant:air_winter_event_id.none } }
				air_winter_event_calculate_candidate_score = yes
				air_winter_event_apply_route_score_bonus = yes
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.ordinary_phase }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.ordinary_phase }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = air_winter_presentation_class }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = air_winter_marker_score }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { air_winter_second_winter_marker_is_valid = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = air_winter_second_winter_origin_event_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.second_winter }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.second_winter }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = air_winter_second_winter_origin_year }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = air_winter_second_winter_origin_region }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = air_winter_second_winter_origin_cycle_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = air_winter_second_winter_origin_score }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { air_winter_dark_harvest_marker_is_valid = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_event_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.dark_harvest }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.dark_harvest }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_year }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_region }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_cycle_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = air_winter_dark_harvest_origin_score }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { air_winter_first_frost_marker_is_valid = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = air_winter_first_frost_origin_event_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = air_winter_first_frost_origin_route_subtype }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.first_frost }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.first_frost }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = air_winter_first_frost_origin_year }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = air_winter_first_frost_origin_region }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = air_winter_first_frost_origin_cycle_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = air_winter_first_frost_origin_score }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { air_winter_ash_thaw_marker_is_valid = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_event_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.ash_thaw }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.ash_thaw }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_year }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_region }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_cycle_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = air_winter_ash_thaw_origin_score }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = air_winter_phase_changed_this_tick
					check_variable = { var = air_winter_phase value = air_winter_previous_phase compare = less_than }
					OWNER = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_recovery_event_count }
							check_variable = { air_winter_recovery_event_count < constant:air_winter_event_runtime.recovery_arc_cap }
						}
					}
				}
				air_winter_event_calculate_candidate_score = yes
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.recovery }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.recovery }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.recovery }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = global.air_winter_event_cycle_year }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = air_winter_presentation_class }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.candidate_recovery_base }
				add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = air_winter_marker_pressure_score }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id > constant:air_winter_event_id.none }
				check_variable = { air_winter_selected_family > constant:air_winter_event_family.none }
				check_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority > constant:air_winter_event_priority.none }
				check_variable = { air_winter_selected_year > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
				check_variable = { air_winter_selected_region > constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
				check_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
				check_variable = { air_winter_selected_score > constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none }
					AND = {
						check_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_arid }
						check_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.desert_city }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_state_id = THIS.id }
			OWNER = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_state }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_id }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_score }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_cycle_id }
							NOT = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_event_candidate_cycle_id value = global.air_winter_cycle_id compare = equals } }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_family }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_priority }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_year }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_region }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id }
							NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_route_subtype }
							check_variable = { var = air_winter_selected_priority value = air_winter_event_candidate_priority compare = greater_than }
							AND = {
								check_variable = { var = air_winter_selected_priority value = air_winter_event_candidate_priority compare = equals }
								OR = {
									NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id }
									check_variable = { var = air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id value = air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id compare = less_than }
									AND = {
										check_variable = { var = air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id value = air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id compare = equals }
										OR = {
											NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_score }
											check_variable = { var = air_winter_selected_score value = air_winter_event_candidate_score compare = greater_than }
											AND = {
												check_variable = { var = air_winter_selected_score value = air_winter_event_candidate_score compare = equals }
												OR = {
													NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_event_candidate_state }
													check_variable = { var = air_winter_event_candidate_state_id value = air_winter_event_candidate_state compare = less_than }
												}
											}
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_state = air_winter_event_candidate_state_id }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id = air_winter_selected_event_id }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_score = air_winter_selected_score }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = air_winter_selected_family }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_priority = air_winter_selected_priority }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_year = air_winter_selected_year }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_region = air_winter_selected_region }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_origin_cycle_id = air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id }
					set_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_route_subtype = air_winter_selected_route_subtype }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							is_in_array = {
								array = global.air_winter_event_candidate_countries
								value = THIS
							}
						}
					}
					add_to_array = { array = global.air_winter_event_candidate_countries value = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_event_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_priority = constant:air_winter_event_priority.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_year = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_region = constant:air_winter_presentation_class.unclassified }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_origin_cycle_id = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_selected_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_state_id = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_marker_pressure_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
}
# Supported scope: COUNTRY (the existing host country). Iterates only the
# bounded country array collected during the existing state pass.
air_winter_dispatch_phase_events = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_winter_event_candidate_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_event_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_island_refugee_offer_pending }
				air_winter_event_candidate_is_dispatchable = yes
			}
			save_event_target_as = air_winter_event_country
			var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = { save_event_target_as = air_winter_event_state }

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_island_refugees } }
				air_winter_island_refugee_select_source = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_found = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one } }
					country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.38 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_id = constant:air_winter_event_id.phase_2_arid } }
					var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
						air_winter_desert_city_clear_opening_receipt = yes
						if = {
							limit = {
								PREV = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_route_subtype = constant:air_winter_event_route_subtype.desert_city } }
							}
							set_state_flag = air_winter_desert_city_opening_receipt
							set_variable = { air_winter_desert_city_opening_owner = PREV }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.first_frost } }
					set_variable = { air_winter_first_frost_event_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year }
					var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = { air_winter_event_clear_first_frost_marker = yes }
					set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_2
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.dark_harvest } }
					set_variable = { air_winter_dark_harvest_event_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year }
					var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = { air_winter_event_clear_dark_harvest_marker = yes }
					set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_4
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.ash_thaw } }
					set_variable = { air_winter_ash_thaw_event_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year }
					var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = { air_winter_event_clear_ash_thaw_marker = yes }
					if = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_recovery_event_count }
								check_variable = { air_winter_recovery_event_count < constant:air_winter_event_runtime.recovery_arc_cap }
							}
						}
						add_to_variable = { air_winter_recovery_event_count = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.second_winter } }
					set_variable = { air_winter_second_winter_event_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year }
					air_winter_event_commit_second_winter_region = yes
					var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = { air_winter_event_clear_second_winter_marker = yes }
					set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_4
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.terminal_season } }
					set_variable = { air_winter_terminal_season_event_year = air_winter_event_candidate_year }
					var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = { air_winter_event_clear_terminal_season_marker = yes }
					set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_6
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.recovery } }
					add_to_variable = { air_winter_recovery_event_count = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.one }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_event_candidate_family = constant:air_winter_event_family.ordinary_phase } }
					var:air_winter_event_candidate_state = {
						air_winter_event_coalesce_matching_seasonal_marker = yes
						if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes } OWNER = { set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_1 } }
						else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes } OWNER = { set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_2 } }
						else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes } OWNER = { set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_3 } }
						else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } OWNER = { set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_4 } }
						else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes } OWNER = { set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_5 } }
						else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes } OWNER = { set_country_flag = air_winter_event_seen_phase_6 } }
					}
				}

				air_winter_event_refresh_country_cooldown = yes
				meta_effect = {
					text = { country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.[AIR_WINTER_EVENT_ID] } }
					AIR_WINTER_EVENT_ID = "[?air_winter_event_candidate_id|.0]"
				}
			}
		}
		air_winter_event_clear_candidate = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_winter_event_candidate_countries
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_winter_island_refugee_source_countries
		air_winter_island_refugee_clear_source_receipt = yes
	}
	clear_array = global.air_winter_island_refugee_source_countries
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_source_found = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_selected_score = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_island_refugee_selected_state = constant:air_winter_event_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_winter_response_pay_final_evacuation = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = air_winter_final_evacuation_train_cost }
	air_winter_response_pay_trains = yes
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = air_winter_final_evacuation_convoy_cost }
	air_winter_response_pay_convoys = yes
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = air_winter_final_evacuation_support_cost }
	air_winter_response_pay_support_equipment = yes
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = air_winter_final_evacuation_manpower_cost }
	air_winter_response_pay_manpower = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
air_winter_response_pay_decontamination = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_winter_response_cost.decontamination_support }
	air_winter_response_pay_support_equipment = yes
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_winter_response_cost.decontamination_motorized }
	air_winter_response_pay_motorized_equipment = yes
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_winter_response_cost.decontamination_fuel }
	air_winter_response_pay_fuel = yes
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_payment = constant:air_winter_response_cost.decontamination_command }
	air_winter_response_pay_command = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared state project lifecycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Clears the current population-scaled evacuation
# quote. A quote is rebuilt only for the country's selected priority state and
# its lowest-id valid reception state.
air_winter_response_clear_evacuation_cache = {
	clr_country_flag = air_winter_evacuation_cache_valid
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_source_state
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_state
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_source_population_k
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_population_k
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_pressure
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_cache_cycle_id
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_k
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_people
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_train_cost
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoy_cost
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_manpower_cost
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_stability_cost
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_receiver_pressure_gain
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_receiver_pressure_after
	clear_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_source_pressure_relief
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_population_transfer_k
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_population_transfer_people
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_train_cost
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_convoy_cost
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_support_cost
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_manpower_cost
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_receiver_pressure_gain
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_receiver_pressure_after
	clear_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_source_pressure_relief
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Rebuilds one country quote from the selected source
# population and the designated receiver's current population and pressure.
# Temporary variables deliberately carry arithmetic across the local scopes.
air_winter_response_refresh_state_evacuation_cache = {
	save_event_target_as = air_winter_evacuation_cache_source
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_source_state_id = THIS.id }
	OWNER = {
		save_event_target_as = air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner
		air_winter_response_clear_evacuation_cache = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
			has_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
			has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_response_priority_owner
				value = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner
				compare = equals
			}
			is_owned_by = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner
			is_controlled_by = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner
			check_variable = { state_population_k > constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
			event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner = {
				has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_state
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_response_priority_state
					value = air_winter_evacuation_source_state_id
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}

		set_temp_variable = {
			air_winter_evacuation_selected_receiver_state = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.state_id_selection_sentinel
		}
		event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = air_winter_reception_states
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
						has_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner
						check_variable = {
							var = air_winter_response_reception_owner
							value = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner
							compare = equals
						}
						is_owned_by = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner
						is_controlled_by = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner
						air_winter_response_is_reception_state = yes
						NOT = { state = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_source }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_receiver_candidate_state = THIS.id }
					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = {
								var = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_candidate_state
								value = air_winter_evacuation_selected_receiver_state
								compare = less_than
							}
						}
						set_temp_variable = {
							air_winter_evacuation_selected_receiver_state = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_candidate_state
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_evacuation_selected_receiver_state
					value = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.state_id_selection_sentinel
					compare = less_than
				}
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_source_population_k = state_population_k }

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k = air_winter_evacuation_source_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k = constant:air_winter_response_result.controlled_evacuation_population_share
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_people = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_people = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.population_people_per_k
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_people

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k = air_winter_evacuation_source_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k = constant:air_winter_response_result.final_evacuation_population_share
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_people = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_people = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.population_people_per_k
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_people

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_trains = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k }
			divide_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_trains = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.population_k_per_train
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_trains = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.ceil_rounding_offset
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_trains
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_trains < constant:air_winter_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_trains = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_stability = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k }
			divide_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_stability = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.controlled_stability_population_k_per_percent
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_stability = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.controlled_stability_percent_unit
			}
			clamp_temp_variable = {
				var = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_stability
				min = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.controlled_stability_minimum
				max = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.controlled_stability_maximum
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoys = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k }
			divide_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoys = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.population_k_per_convoy
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoys = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.ceil_rounding_offset
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoys
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoys < constant:air_winter_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoys = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_staff = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_staff = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.administrative_staff_per_population_k
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_staff
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_staff
						value = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.minimum_administrative_staff
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					air_winter_controlled_evacuation_staff = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.minimum_administrative_staff
				}
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_trains = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k }
			divide_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_trains = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.population_k_per_train
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_trains = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.ceil_rounding_offset
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_trains
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_trains < constant:air_winter_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_trains = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_convoys = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k }
			divide_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_convoys = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.population_k_per_convoy
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_convoys = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.ceil_rounding_offset
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_convoys
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_convoys < constant:air_winter_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_convoys = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_support = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k }
			divide_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_support = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.population_k_per_support_equipment
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_support = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.ceil_rounding_offset
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_support
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_support < constant:air_winter_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_support = constant:air_winter_runtime.one }
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_staff = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_staff = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.administrative_staff_per_population_k
			}
			round_temp_variable = air_winter_final_evacuation_staff
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = air_winter_final_evacuation_staff
						value = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.minimum_administrative_staff
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					air_winter_final_evacuation_staff = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.minimum_administrative_staff
				}
			}

			set_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_source_relief = constant:air_winter_response_result.controlled_evacuation_population_share
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_source_relief = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.source_pressure_relief_per_population_share
			}
			set_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_source_relief = constant:air_winter_response_result.final_evacuation_population_share
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_source_relief = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.source_pressure_relief_per_population_share
			}

			event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner = {
				set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_cache_source_state = air_winter_evacuation_source_state_id }
				set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_state = air_winter_evacuation_selected_receiver_state }
				set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_cache_source_population_k = air_winter_evacuation_source_population_k }
				var:air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_state = {
					set_temp_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_receiver_population_k = state_population_k }
					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = {
								var = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_population_k
								value = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.receiver_population_floor_k
								compare = less_than
							}
						}
						set_temp_variable = {
							air_winter_evacuation_receiver_population_k = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.receiver_population_floor_k
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_receiver_pressure = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = air_winter_refugee_pressure }
						set_temp_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_receiver_pressure = air_winter_refugee_pressure }
					}
				}
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_pressure_gain = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k }
			divide_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_pressure_gain = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_pressure_gain = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.receiver_pressure_per_population_ratio
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_pressure_after = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_pressure }
			add_to_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_controlled_evacuation_pressure_after = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_pressure_gain
			}

			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_pressure_gain = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k }
			divide_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_pressure_gain = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_pressure_gain = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.receiver_pressure_per_population_ratio
			}
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_pressure_after = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_pressure }
			add_to_temp_variable = {
				air_winter_final_evacuation_pressure_after = air_winter_final_evacuation_pressure_gain
			}

			event_target:air_winter_evacuation_cache_owner = {
				set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_population_k = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_population_k }
				set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_pressure = air_winter_evacuation_receiver_pressure }
				set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_cache_cycle_id = global.air_winter_cycle_id }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_k = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_k }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_people = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_transfer_people }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_train_cost = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_trains }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoy_cost = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_convoys }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_manpower_cost = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_staff }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_stability_cost = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_stability }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_receiver_pressure_gain = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_pressure_gain }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_receiver_pressure_after = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_pressure_after }
				set_variable = { air_winter_controlled_evacuation_source_pressure_relief = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_source_relief }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_population_transfer_k = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_k }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_population_transfer_people = air_winter_final_evacuation_transfer_people }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_train_cost = air_winter_final_evacuation_trains }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_convoy_cost = air_winter_final_evacuation_convoys }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_support_cost = air_winter_final_evacuation_support }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_manpower_cost = air_winter_final_evacuation_staff }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_receiver_pressure_gain = air_winter_final_evacuation_pressure_gain }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_receiver_pressure_after = air_winter_final_evacuation_pressure_after }
				set_variable = { air_winter_final_evacuation_source_pressure_relief = air_winter_final_evacuation_source_relief }
				set_country_flag = air_winter_evacuation_cache_valid
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Called once when a monthly Air Winter cycle opens.
air_winter_response_prepare_evacuation_cache_cycle = {
	clear_array = global.air_winter_evacuation_cache_countries
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Adds only the current priority owner to the bounded
# cache refresh ledger. This helper performs no country or state iteration.
air_winter_response_register_priority_cache_owner = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_state_is_valid = yes
			has_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
			has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
			is_owned_by = var:air_winter_response_priority_owner
			is_controlled_by = var:air_winter_response_priority_owner
			var:air_winter_response_priority_owner = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active }
			}
		}
		var:air_winter_response_priority_owner = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						is_in_array = {
							array = global.air_winter_evacuation_cache_countries
							value = THIS
						}
					}
				}
				add_to_array = {
					array = global.air_winter_evacuation_cache_countries
					value = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY (the existing monthly host). Refreshes only the
# bounded set of countries that own a selected priority state.
air_winter_response_refresh_evacuation_cache_cycle = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.air_winter_evacuation_cache_countries
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active } }
			save_event_target_as = air_winter_evacuation_refresh_owner
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_state
					var:air_winter_response_priority_state = {
						has_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
						has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
						check_variable = {
							var = air_winter_response_priority_owner
							value = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_refresh_owner
							compare = equals
						}
						is_owned_by = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_refresh_owner
						is_controlled_by = event_target:air_winter_evacuation_refresh_owner
					}
				}
				var:air_winter_response_priority_state = {
					air_winter_response_refresh_state_evacuation_cache = yes
				}
			}
			else = { air_winter_response_clear_evacuation_cache = yes }
		}
	}
	clear_array = global.air_winter_evacuation_cache_countries
}

# Supported scope: STATE. ROOT must be the country starting the targeted card.
air_winter_response_start_state_project = {
	set_state_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
	set_variable = { air_winter_response_project_owner = ROOT }
	ROOT = {
		set_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
		set_variable = { air_winter_response_active_project_state = PREV.id }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the selected source STATE and the
# country's controlled evacuation quote must be valid at decision start.
air_winter_response_start_controlled_evacuation = {
	air_winter_response_pay_controlled_evacuation = yes
	FROM = {
		set_state_flag = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_project
		set_state_flag = air_winter_evacuation_project_quote_locked
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_state = ROOT.air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_state }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_k = ROOT.air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_k }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people = ROOT.air_winter_controlled_evacuation_population_transfer_people }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_gain = ROOT.air_winter_controlled_evacuation_receiver_pressure_gain }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_source_pressure_relief = ROOT.air_winter_controlled_evacuation_source_pressure_relief }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.receiver_pressure_ceiling }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit = ROOT.air_winter_controlled_evacuation_receiver_pressure_gain }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_quote_cycle_id = ROOT.air_winter_evacuation_cache_cycle_id }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_source_population_k = ROOT.air_winter_evacuation_cache_source_population_k }
		air_winter_response_start_state_project = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the selected source STATE and the
# country's final evacuation quote must be valid at decision start.
air_winter_response_start_final_evacuation = {
	air_winter_response_pay_final_evacuation = yes
	FROM = {
		set_state_flag = air_winter_final_evacuation_project
		set_state_flag = air_winter_evacuation_project_quote_locked
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_state = ROOT.air_winter_evacuation_cache_receiver_state }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_k = ROOT.air_winter_final_evacuation_population_transfer_k }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people = ROOT.air_winter_final_evacuation_population_transfer_people }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_gain = ROOT.air_winter_final_evacuation_receiver_pressure_gain }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_source_pressure_relief = ROOT.air_winter_final_evacuation_source_pressure_relief }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit = constant:air_winter_response_evacuation.receiver_pressure_ceiling }
		subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit = ROOT.air_winter_final_evacuation_receiver_pressure_gain }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_quote_cycle_id = ROOT.air_winter_evacuation_cache_cycle_id }
		set_variable = { air_winter_evacuation_project_source_population_k = ROOT.air_winter_evacuation_cache_source_population_k }
		air_winter_response_start_state_project = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Clears both sides of the one-country project lock.
air_winter_response_release_state_project = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_released_state_id = THIS.id }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_winter_response_project_owner }
		var:air_winter_response_project_owner = {
			clr_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
			clear_variable = air_winter_response_active_project_state
		}
	}
	else = {
		OWNER = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
					has_variable = air_winter_response_active_project_state
					check_variable = {
						var = air_winter_response_active_project_state
						value = air_winter_response_released_state_id
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
				clear_variable = air_winter_response_active_project_state
			}
		}
	}
	clear_variable = air_winter_response_project_owner
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_project
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_final_evacuation_project
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_evacuation_project_quote_locked
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_state
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_k
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_gain
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_limit
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_source_pressure_relief
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_quote_cycle_id
	clear_variable = air_winter_evacuation_project_source_population_k
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Repairs cancellation if ownership or control changed
# before the targeted decision engine removed the project.
air_winter_response_reconcile_state_project = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = air_winter_response_project_active
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_response_project_owner }
				NOT = { is_owned_by = var:air_winter_response_project_owner }
				NOT = { is_controlled_by = var:air_winter_response_project_owner }
			}
		}
		air_winter_response_release_state_project = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Keeps priority and reception ledgers aligned with
# present ownership and control, including save recovery after a transfer.
air_winter_response_reconcile_state_designations = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner }
				NOT = { air_winter_state_is_valid = yes }
				NOT = { air_winter_is_active = yes }
				NOT = { is_owned_by = var:air_winter_response_priority_owner }
				NOT = { is_controlled_by = var:air_winter_response_priority_owner }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_designation_state_id = THIS.id }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner }
			var:air_winter_response_priority_owner = {
				air_winter_response_clear_evacuation_cache = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = air_winter_response_priority_state
							value = air_winter_response_designation_state_id
							compare = equals
						}
					}
					clear_variable = air_winter_response_priority_state
				}
			}
		}
		clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
		clear_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner }
				NOT = { air_winter_response_is_reception_state = yes }
				NOT = { is_owned_by = var:air_winter_response_reception_owner }
				NOT = { is_controlled_by = var:air_winter_response_reception_owner }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner }
			var:air_winter_response_reception_owner = {
				air_winter_response_clear_evacuation_cache = yes
				remove_from_array = { array = air_winter_reception_states value = PREV }
			}
		}
		clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
		clear_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner
	}
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_designation_state_id = constant:air_winter_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be an owned and controlled active STATE.
air_winter_response_designate_priority_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_state }
		var:air_winter_response_priority_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
					check_variable = {
						var = air_winter_response_priority_owner
						value = ROOT
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
				clear_variable = air_winter_response_priority_owner
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { air_winter_response_priority_state = FROM.id }
	FROM = {
		set_state_flag = air_winter_response_priority_target
		set_variable = { air_winter_response_priority_owner = ROOT }
		air_winter_response_refresh_state_evacuation_cache = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Pending result metadata exists only while a terminal
# response popup is waiting for a choice.
air_winter_response_clear_pending_result = {
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_pending_abandonment_vote
	clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_pending_decontamination
	clear_variable = air_winter_response_pending_owner
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Ownership transfer invalidates an unresolved result.
air_winter_response_reconcile_pending_result = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_state_flag = air_winter_response_pending_abandonment_vote
				has_state_flag = air_winter_response_pending_decontamination
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_response_pending_owner }
				NOT = { is_owned_by = var:air_winter_response_pending_owner }
				NOT = { is_controlled_by = var:air_winter_response_pending_owner }
			}
		}
		air_winter_response_clear_pending_result = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A stale response never mutates the transferred
# state. Matching metadata is cleared without refunding a completed project.
air_winter_response_reject_stale_choice = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = air_winter_response_state
			event_target:air_winter_response_state = {
				has_variable = air_winter_response_pending_owner
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_response_pending_owner
					value = ROOT
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		event_target:air_winter_response_state = { air_winter_response_clear_pending_result = yes }
	}
	country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.203 }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Input: temporary air_winter_response_project_cooldown.
air_winter_response_finish_state_project = {
	set_variable = { air_winter_response_cooldown = air_winter_response_project_cooldown }
	air_winter_response_release_state_project = yes
	air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
	air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes
}

# Supported scope: STATE
air_winter_response_cancel_state_project = {
	air_winter_response_release_state_project = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the eligible reception STATE.
air_winter_response_designate_reception_state = {
	air_winter_response_pay_designation = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = air_winter_reception_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner
				check_variable = {
					var = air_winter_response_reception_owner
					value = ROOT
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			clr_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
			clear_variable = air_winter_response_reception_owner
		}
	}
	clear_array = air_winter_reception_states
	add_to_array = {
		array = air_winter_reception_states
		value = FROM
	}
	FROM = {
		set_state_flag = air_winter_response_reception_target
		set_variable = { air_winter_response_reception_owner = ROOT }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = air_winter_response_priority_state }
		var:air_winter_response_priority_state = {
			air_winter_response_refresh_state_evacuation_cache = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the source STATE. The project snapshot
# preserves the paid population transfer and receiver even if the monthly quote
# changes while the timed decision is active.
air_winter_response_complete_controlled_evacuation = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_response_controlled_evacuation_project_is_valid = yes }
		FROM = {
			save_event_target_as = air_winter_response_state
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_population_transfer_people = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_receiver_pressure_gain = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_gain }
			air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_population_loss = air_winter_response_population_transfer_people }
			multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_population_loss = constant:air_winter_runtime.negative_one }
			add_manpower = air_winter_response_population_loss
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_refugee_pressure = air_winter_evacuation_project_source_pressure_relief }
			set_state_flag = air_winter_controlled_evacuation_completed
			air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
			air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes
			var:air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_state = {
				air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
				add_manpower = air_winter_response_population_transfer_people
				add_to_variable = { air_winter_refugee_pressure = air_winter_response_receiver_pressure_gain }
				air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
				air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes
			}
			# The offline effect reference records that negative state add_manpower
			# credits the removed population to recruitable manpower. Remove that
			# engine credit at country scope after the balanced state transfer.
			ROOT = { add_manpower = air_winter_response_population_loss }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_project_cooldown = constant:air_winter_response_timing.severe_state_cooldown_months }
			air_winter_response_finish_state_project = yes
		}
	}
	else = { FROM = { air_winter_response_cancel_state_project = yes } }
}
