	add_to_variable = { air_winter_refugee_pressure = constant:air_winter_response_result.bunker_refugee_pressure_gain }
	set_state_flag = air_winter_bunker_sealed
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_project_cooldown = constant:air_winter_response_timing.terminal_state_cooldown_months }
	air_winter_response_finish_state_project = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the source STATE. The paid project
# snapshot is the sole source for the delayed migration result.
air_winter_response_complete_final_evacuation = {
	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_response_final_evacuation_project_is_valid = yes }
		FROM = {
			save_event_target_as = air_winter_response_state
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_population_transfer_people = air_winter_evacuation_project_population_transfer_people }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_receiver_pressure_gain = air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_pressure_gain }
			air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_population_loss = air_winter_response_population_transfer_people }
			multiply_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_population_loss = constant:air_winter_runtime.negative_one }
			add_manpower = air_winter_response_population_loss
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_refugee_pressure = air_winter_evacuation_project_source_pressure_relief }
			set_state_flag = air_winter_final_evacuation_completed
			air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
			air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes
			var:air_winter_evacuation_project_receiver_state = {
				air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
				add_manpower = air_winter_response_population_transfer_people
				add_to_variable = { air_winter_refugee_pressure = air_winter_response_receiver_pressure_gain }
				air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
				air_winter_calculate_survival_value = yes
			}
			# Neutralize the recruitable-manpower credit produced by the source
			# state's negative add_manpower operation.
			ROOT = { add_manpower = air_winter_response_population_loss }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_project_cooldown = constant:air_winter_response_timing.terminal_state_cooldown_months }
			air_winter_response_finish_state_project = yes
		}
	}
	else = { FROM = { air_winter_response_cancel_state_project = yes } }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM must be the source STATE.
air_winter_response_complete_decontamination = {
	FROM = {
		save_event_target_as = air_winter_response_state
		air_winter_normalize_state_ledger = yes
		set_state_flag = air_winter_decontamination_attempted
		set_state_flag = air_winter_response_pending_decontamination
		set_variable = { air_winter_response_pending_owner = ROOT }
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_response_project_cooldown = constant:air_winter_response_timing.terminal_state_cooldown_months }
		air_winter_response_finish_state_project = yes
	}
	country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.202 }
}

# Consolidated source: common/scripted_effects/air_cleanliness_winter_visual_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - AIR WINTER NORMAL-MAP VISUAL LIFECYCLE
# ============================================================================
# The original one-state proof remains as a legacy migration target. The live
# regional route uses five deterministic IDs per state, replaces active slots
# on every existing monthly pulse, and performs no additional world iterator.
#
# Public effect:
# - air_winter_refresh_normal_map_proof_entity
# - air_winter_destroy_normal_map_proof_entity
# - air_winter_prepare_regional_visual_cycle
# - air_winter_refresh_regional_visuals
# - air_winter_destroy_regional_visuals
#
# Scope: synchronized COUNTRY for cycle preparation, STATE for regional slots,
# and any synchronized gameplay scope for legacy proof cleanup.
# Inputs: authoritative state phase, presentation class, recovery trend, peak
# phase memory, fallout memory, food resilience, and visual schema version.
# Side effects: replaces or destroys five deterministic regional entity slots
# per state. Legacy migration may destroy proof entity id 8600064.
# ============================================================================

@AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_ENTITY_ID = 8600064
@AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_STATE = 64
@AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_MIN_ZOOM = 1100
@AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_Z = 2
@AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_SCALE = 2

air_winter_refresh_normal_map_proof_entity = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			@AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_STATE = {
				check_variable = { air_winter_phase > constant:air_winter_phase.clear }
			}
		}
		create_entity = {
			entity = air_winter_normal_map_proof_entity
			id = @AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_ENTITY_ID
			state = @AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_STATE
			z = @AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_Z
			scale = @AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_SCALE
			min_zoom = @AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_MIN_ZOOM
		}
	}
	else = {
		destroy_entity = @AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_ENTITY_ID
	}
}

# Supported scope: any synchronized gameplay scope. Administrative cleanup
# must not depend on state 64 being visited by another monthly pass.
air_winter_destroy_normal_map_proof_entity = {
	destroy_entity = @AIR_WINTER_NORMAL_MAP_PROOF_ENTITY_ID
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY (the synchronized monthly host). The state schema is
# checked independently inside each existing state update.
air_winter_prepare_regional_visual_cycle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.air_winter_visual_schema_version }
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.air_winter_visual_schema_version = constant:air_winter_visual_schema.version } }
			}
		}
		air_winter_destroy_normal_map_proof_entity = yes
		set_variable = { global.air_winter_visual_schema_version = constant:air_winter_visual_schema.version }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Computes stable literal-safe IDs and centralized
# placement values. No generated entity ID is stored in persistent state.
air_winter_visual_prepare_state_ids = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_state_id = THIS.id }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_ground_id = constant:air_winter_visual_entity_id.ground_base }
	add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_ground_id = air_winter_visual_state_id }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_particle_id = constant:air_winter_visual_entity_id.primary_particle_base }
	add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_particle_id = air_winter_visual_state_id }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_particle_id = constant:air_winter_visual_entity_id.secondary_particle_base }
	add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_particle_id = air_winter_visual_state_id }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_dead_vegetation_id = constant:air_winter_visual_entity_id.dead_vegetation_base }
	add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_dead_vegetation_id = air_winter_visual_state_id }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_hydrology_id = constant:air_winter_visual_entity_id.hydrology_base }
	add_to_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_hydrology_id = air_winter_visual_state_id }

	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_ground_z = constant:air_winter_visual_render.ground_z }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_ground_scale = constant:air_winter_visual_render.ground_scale }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_particle_z = constant:air_winter_visual_render.particle_z }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_particle_scale = constant:air_winter_visual_render.particle_scale }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_prop_z = constant:air_winter_visual_render.prop_z }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_prop_scale = constant:air_winter_visual_render.prop_scale }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_minimum_zoom = constant:air_winter_visual_render.minimum_zoom }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Outputs two temporary weather-kind enums. This is the
# reviewed regional matrix. Warm classes keep rain and ash instead of receiving
# universal snow.
air_winter_visual_select_weather = {
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.none }
	set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.none }

	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_boreal = yes }
		if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_mild } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_severe } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_maritime = yes }
		if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.cold_rain_mist_mild } }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.cold_rain_mist_severe } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_mild } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_severe } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_mediterranean = yes }
		if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.cold_rain_mist_mild } }
		else_if = { limit = { NOT = { air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.cold_rain_mist_severe } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_mild } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes }
		if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.ash_dirty_snow_mild } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.ash_dirty_snow_severe } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.ash_dirty_snow_terminal } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { air_winter_presentation_is_tropical = yes air_winter_presentation_is_equatorial = yes } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.cold_rain_mist_mild } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.cold_rain_mist_severe } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_highland = yes }
		if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_mild } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_severe } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_oceanic = yes }
		if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes air_winter_is_phase_2 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.cold_rain_mist_mild } }
		else_if = { limit = { OR = { air_winter_is_phase_3 = yes air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.cold_rain_mist_severe } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_mild } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { air_winter_presentation_is_polar = yes }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_1 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_mild } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.snow_frost_severe } }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { air_winter_presentation_is_arid = yes } }
		if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_4 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.ash_dirty_snow_mild } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_5 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.ash_dirty_snow_severe } }
		else_if = { limit = { air_winter_is_phase_6 = yes } set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.ash_dirty_snow_terminal } }
	}

	# Local fallout contributes mild ash to an otherwise empty secondary slot in
	# phases 1-3 for every regional class. Visible runoff may replace it below.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.none }
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = nuclear_fallout_state }
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase
				value = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.ash_dirty_snow_mild }
	}

	# Recovery runoff occupies the otherwise empty second channel through phase
	# 3. At phases 4-6 the required ash channel remains visible and the regional
	# thaw prop carries the recovery signal.
	if = {
		limit = {
			air_winter_visual_thaw_is_eligible = yes
			check_variable = {
				var = air_winter_phase
				value = constant:air_winter_phase.hard_freeze
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_visual_thaw_is_severe = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.thaw_flood_severe }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind = constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.thaw_flood_mild } }
	}
}

air_winter_visual_create_dead_vegetation = {
	meta_effect = {
		text = { create_entity = { entity = air_winter_class_[CLASS]_dead_vegetation_entity id = [ENTITY_ID] state = [STATE_ID] z = [Z] scale = [SCALE] min_zoom = [MIN_ZOOM] } }
		CLASS = "[?air_winter_presentation_class|.0]"
		ENTITY_ID = "[?air_winter_visual_dead_vegetation_id|.0]"
		STATE_ID = "[?air_winter_visual_state_id|.0]"
		Z = "[?air_winter_visual_prop_z|.0]"
		SCALE = "[?air_winter_visual_prop_scale|.0]"
		MIN_ZOOM = "[?air_winter_visual_minimum_zoom|.0]"

}

# Supported scope: STATE. Called exactly once at the end of the existing
# monthly state update. Desired slots are replaced using stable IDs, and stale
# slots are destroyed without creating a second state scan.
air_winter_refresh_regional_visuals = {
	air_winter_visual_prepare_state_ids = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_visual_schema_version }
				NOT = { check_variable = { air_winter_visual_schema_version = constant:air_winter_visual_schema.version } }
			}
		}
		air_winter_destroy_regional_visuals = yes
		air_winter_visual_prepare_state_ids = yes
		set_variable = { air_winter_visual_schema_version = constant:air_winter_visual_schema.version }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { air_winter_visual_has_active_class_phase = yes }
		air_winter_visual_create_ground = yes
		air_winter_visual_select_weather = yes

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind > constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.none } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_selected_entity_id = air_winter_visual_primary_particle_id }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_selected_weather_kind = air_winter_visual_primary_weather_kind }
			air_winter_visual_create_selected_particle = yes
			set_state_flag = air_winter_visual_primary_particle_present
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_primary_particle_present }
			air_winter_visual_destroy_primary_particle_slot = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind > constant:air_winter_visual_weather_kind.none } }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_selected_entity_id = air_winter_visual_secondary_particle_id }
			set_temp_variable = { air_winter_visual_selected_weather_kind = air_winter_visual_secondary_weather_kind }
			air_winter_visual_create_selected_particle = yes
			set_state_flag = air_winter_visual_secondary_particle_present
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_secondary_particle_present }
			air_winter_visual_destroy_secondary_particle_slot = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_visual_dead_vegetation_is_eligible = yes }
			air_winter_visual_create_dead_vegetation = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_dead_vegetation_present }
			air_winter_visual_destroy_dead_vegetation_slot = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_visual_thaw_is_eligible = yes }
			air_winter_visual_create_thaw_flood = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { air_winter_visual_frozen_water_is_eligible = yes }
			air_winter_visual_create_frozen_water = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_hydrology_present }
			air_winter_visual_destroy_hydrology_slot = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_ground_present } air_winter_visual_destroy_ground_slot = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_primary_particle_present } air_winter_visual_destroy_primary_particle_slot = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_secondary_particle_present } air_winter_visual_destroy_secondary_particle_slot = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_dead_vegetation_present } air_winter_visual_destroy_dead_vegetation_slot = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_visual_hydrology_present } air_winter_visual_destroy_hydrology_slot = yes }
	}

	set_variable = { air_winter_visual_schema_version = constant:air_winter_visual_schema.version }
}

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT MANUAL SCENARIO EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Dormant host-owned substrate for the exact installed-map thermonuclear sweep.
# It is not registered as a public scenario until the scenario id and runtime
# proof blockers recorded in the Fallout plan are resolved.
# ============================================================================

# Dynamic event delay fields use file-scoped literals. Keep these aligned with
# the matching fallout_manual_sweep script constants.
@FALLOUT_MANUAL_BATCH_DELAY_HOURS = 1
@FALLOUT_MANUAL_VERIFIER_DELAY_HOURS = 1
@FALLOUT_MANUAL_COUNTDOWN_DAYS = 7

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
# Input: fallout_manual_failure_code
# A failure after a valid sweep has been admitted keeps the durable Air
# shutdown. Only the pre-admission invalid-intensity branch can fail without
# owning Air Cleanliness.
fallout_manual_fail_sweep = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error } }
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_error_code = fallout_manual_failure_code }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.error }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
		clr_global_flag = fallout_synthetic_strike_batch
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_launch_window
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_request_due
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_manual_reset_runtime_ledger = {
	clear_array = global.fallout_manual_struck_states
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_schema_version = constant:fallout_manual_schema.version }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_generation = global.date }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_next_batch = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.first_batch_index }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_last_completed_batch = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_state_strike_sum = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_total_civilian_deaths = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_error_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.none }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.none }
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_countdown_start_day
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_countdown_end_day
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_selected_intensity
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_count
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_ledger_generation
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_count
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_generation
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_native_sweep_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_request_due
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_request_sent
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_launch_window
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_ledger_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_complete
	every_country = { clr_country_flag = fallout_manual_synthetic_launcher }
	every_state = {
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_native_struck
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_recorded
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_recorded
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_current
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_receipt_invalid
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_overshoot
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_native_strike_count
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_k
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_prestrike_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_first_week_population_reconciled_total_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_first_week_loss_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_k
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_loss_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_after_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_frozen_current_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_target_survivors
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_requested_loss
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
# Input: fallout_manual_selected_intensity_input
fallout_manual_initialize_sweep = {
	fallout_manual_reset_runtime_ledger = yes
	fallout_manual_capture_population_baselines = yes
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_manual_sweep_coordinator
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_intensity_candidate = fallout_manual_selected_intensity_input }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_manual_intensity_candidate
				value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.minimum_intensity
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_manual_intensity_candidate
				value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.maximum_intensity
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_selected_intensity = fallout_manual_intensity_candidate }
		save_global_event_target_as = fallout_manual_sweep_coordinator
		set_country_flag = fallout_manual_synthetic_launcher
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active
		# Reset the one-shot cleanup receipt before the new generation owns Air.
		# The helper below writes it again after the prestrike ledger is frozen.
		# The manual sweep has captured its prestrike population ledger above, so
		# Fallout can now own the durable Air shutdown before native strikes.
		fallout_lock_air_cleanliness_after_fallout_admission = yes
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
		set_global_flag = fallout_synthetic_strike_batch
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.sweeping }
		fallout_manual_schedule_next_batch = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.invalid_intensity }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
# Captures the state population before any native strike callback can mutate the
# map. The generation binds the per-state baseline to this sweep instance.
fallout_manual_capture_population_baselines = {
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_ledger_complete
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_ledger_generation
	every_state = {
		set_variable = { fallout_manual_prestrike_population_k = state_population_k }
		set_variable = { fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people = state_population_k }
		multiply_variable = { fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
		round_variable = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people
		set_variable = { fallout_manual_prestrike_generation = global.fallout_manual_generation }
		set_state_flag = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_recorded
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_count
				value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_struck_states
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_ledger_generation = global.fallout_manual_generation }
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_ledger_complete
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
# Input: fallout_manual_selected_intensity_input
fallout_manual_scenario_begin = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_requested_intensity = fallout_manual_selected_intensity_input }
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { has_country_flag = is_global_host } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = is_global_host
				fallout_manual_sweep_can_begin = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_selected_intensity_input = fallout_manual_requested_intensity }
			fallout_manual_initialize_sweep = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { fallout_manual_sweep_can_begin = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_selected_intensity_input = fallout_manual_requested_intensity }
		fallout_manual_initialize_sweep = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_manual_schedule_next_batch = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active
			has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error }
			fallout_manual_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
			fallout_manual_batch_cursor_is_valid = yes
			check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.sweeping }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled }
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch = global.fallout_manual_next_batch }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation = global.fallout_manual_generation }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_batch_event_id = global.fallout_manual_next_batch }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_batch_event_id = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.batch_event_id_offset }
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
		meta_effect = {
			text = { country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.[EVENT_ID] hours = @FALLOUT_MANUAL_BATCH_DELAY_HOURS } }
			EVENT_ID = "[?fallout_manual_batch_event_id|.0]"
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_manual_schedule_verifier = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active
			has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error }
			fallout_manual_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_manual_next_batch
				value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.total_batches
				compare = equals
			}
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled }
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.verifying }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt = global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation = global.fallout_manual_generation }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_verifier_event_id = global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_verifier_event_id = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.verifier_event_id_offset }
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
		meta_effect = {
			text = { country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.[EVENT_ID] hours = @FALLOUT_MANUAL_VERIFIER_DELAY_HOURS } }
			EVENT_ID = "[?fallout_manual_verifier_event_id|.0]"
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_manual_execute_next_batch = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_manual_event_batch_index
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_generation
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_next_batch
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_last_completed_batch
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count
			fallout_manual_batch_cursor_is_valid = yes
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_manual_event_batch_index
				value = global.fallout_manual_next_batch
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_manual_event_batch_index
				value = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
				value = global.fallout_manual_generation
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_dispatch_batch = global.fallout_manual_next_batch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_issued_before_batch = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_batch_size = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.batch_size }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_generated_batch_index = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_generated_batch_size = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_manual_dispatch_batch
					value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.final_batch_index
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_batch_size = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.last_batch_size }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_issued_before_batch = fallout_manual_dispatch_batch }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_issued_before_batch = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.batch_size }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_last_completed_before_batch = fallout_manual_dispatch_batch }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_last_completed_before_batch = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count
							value = fallout_manual_expected_issued_before_batch
							compare = equals
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = global.fallout_manual_last_completed_batch
							value = fallout_manual_expected_last_completed_before_batch
							compare = equals
						}
					}
					check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count < @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count
						value = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count
						compare = greater_than
					}
					check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count < @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
					check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count > constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_struck_states }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.runtime_ledger_inconsistent }
			fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_launch_window
			meta_effect = {
				text = { fallout_manual_execute_batch_[BATCH_ID] = yes }
				BATCH_ID = "[?fallout_manual_dispatch_batch|.0]"
			}
			clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_launch_window

			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_issued_batch_delta = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_issued_batch_delta = fallout_manual_issued_before_batch }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_manual_generated_batch_index
							value = fallout_manual_dispatch_batch
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.generated_batch_identity_mismatch }
				fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_manual_generated_batch_size
							value = fallout_manual_expected_batch_size
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.generated_batch_size_mismatch }
				fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_manual_issued_batch_delta
							value = fallout_manual_expected_batch_size
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.issued_count_mismatch }
				fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count
						value = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count
						compare = greater_than
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.observed_count_mismatch }
				fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_last_completed_batch = fallout_manual_dispatch_batch }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_next_batch = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
				clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
				if = {
					limit = { fallout_manual_batch_cursor_is_valid = yes }
					fallout_manual_schedule_next_batch = yes
				}
				else = { fallout_manual_schedule_verifier = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.invalid_batch_token }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. FROM is the state supplied by on_nuke_drop.
fallout_manual_on_native_nuke_observed = {
	add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	FROM = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_manual_native_struck } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_manual_native_struck
			set_variable = { fallout_manual_native_strike_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_manual_struck_states value = THIS }
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
		add_to_variable = { fallout_manual_native_strike_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count
				value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.observed_count_mismatch }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
# The verified native-strike consequence resolves an approved final 90 to 95
# percent band from the prestrike state population. It requests only the
# remaining direct delta after native callbacks. The later standard rewrite is
# idempotent because it requests only the remaining grade-specific delta.
fallout_manual_apply_state_aggregate_consequence = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_additional_state_strikes = fallout_manual_native_strike_count }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_additional_state_strikes = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = fallout_manual_additional_state_strikes
		min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
		max = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes
	}

	set_temp_variable = { chaos_state_deaths_percent = fallout_manual_additional_state_strikes }
	multiply_temp_variable = { chaos_state_deaths_percent = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.death_percent_per_additional_strike }
	add_to_temp_variable = { chaos_state_deaths_percent = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.death_percent_base }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = chaos_state_deaths_percent
		min = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.death_percent_base
		max = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.death_percent_max
	}
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_state_deaths_mult = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	chaos_meter_apply_nuclear_state_death_environment_multiplier = yes
	multiply_temp_variable = { chaos_state_deaths_percent = chaos_state_deaths_mult }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = chaos_state_deaths_percent
		min = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.death_percent_base
		max = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.death_percent_max
	}
	# Resolve the direct loss against the captured prestrike baseline. The live
	# population may already be lower because native nuclear hooks ran first.
	# Request only the delta needed to reach the direct survivor target so the
	# aggregate cannot overshoot the approved 90 to 95 percent band.
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people }
	multiply_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = constant:fallout_runtime.percentage_scale }
	multiply_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = chaos_state_deaths_percent }
	round_temp_variable = state_civilian_population_loss_requested
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_direct_target_survivor_population = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_direct_target_survivor_population = state_civilian_population_loss_requested }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_current_population_people = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_current_population_people = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_manual_current_population_people
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_manual_current_population_people }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_manual_direct_target_survivor_population }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = state_civilian_population_loss_requested
		min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
	}
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_runtime.minimum_remaining_population }
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.nuclear_strike }
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
	fallout_manual_record_state_population_loss_provenance = yes

	set_temp_variable = { chaos_fallout_intensity_add = fallout_manual_additional_state_strikes }
	multiply_temp_variable = { chaos_fallout_intensity_add = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.fallout_intensity_per_additional_strike }
	add_to_temp_variable = { chaos_fallout_intensity_add = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.fallout_intensity_base }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = chaos_fallout_intensity_add
		min = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.fallout_intensity_base
		max = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.fallout_intensity_max
	}
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_fallout_duration_days = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.fallout_duration_days }
	chaos_meter_apply_nuclear_fallout_to_state = yes
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = nuclear_fallout_state }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
# Records the observed first-week loss against the generation-authenticated
# prestrike baseline. The aggregate Deaths row uses this observed total after
# native strike callbacks and the exact reconciliation have both run. This
# receipt is also provenance for the later manual rewrite.
fallout_manual_record_state_population_loss_provenance = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baseline_is_current = yes }
		set_variable = { fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people }
		set_variable = { fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people = state_population_k }
		multiply_variable = { fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
		round_variable = fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people = fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people
			min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
		}
		round_variable = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people
		set_variable = { fallout_manual_first_week_population_reconciled_total_people = fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_manual_first_week_population_reconciled_total_people = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people }
		set_variable = { fallout_manual_first_week_loss_generation = global.fallout_manual_generation }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_total_civilian_deaths = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people }
		add_to_variable = { chaos_state_civilian_deaths_total = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = chaos_state_civilian_deaths_total
					value = global.chaos_state_civilian_deaths_map_max
					compare = greater_than
				}
			}
			set_variable = { global.chaos_state_civilian_deaths_map_max = chaos_state_civilian_deaths_total }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_recorded
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Outputs the same temporary percent and request names
# as fallout_calculate_population_loss_intent, but computes the rewrite as the
# additional loss needed to reach the standard 90-95% target from the original
# manual prestrike baseline.
fallout_manual_calculate_population_loss_intent = {
	fallout_calculate_population_loss_intent = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_before_loss = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_target_population_loss = fallout_expected_population_before_loss }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_target_population_loss = constant:fallout_runtime.percentage_scale }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_target_population_loss = fallout_state_loss_percent }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_manual_target_population_loss
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_target_survivor_population = fallout_expected_population_before_loss }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_target_survivor_population = fallout_manual_target_population_loss }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_population_before_loss > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
		clamp_temp_variable = {
			var = fallout_manual_target_survivor_population
			min = constant:fallout_runtime.minimum_remaining_population
			max = fallout_expected_population_before_loss
		}
	}
	else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_target_survivor_population = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
	# The native strike callbacks and the aggregate exact-loss mutation have
	# already changed the live state population. Reconciliation must measure the
	# remaining delta from that live value, never replay the frozen prestrike
	# snapshot as a second loss.
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_current_population_people = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_current_population_people = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_manual_current_population_people
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_requested_loss = fallout_manual_current_population_people }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_requested_loss = fallout_manual_target_survivor_population }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = fallout_expected_population_requested_loss
		min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
	}
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_population_requested_loss
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This is the sole all-state replay before manual
# population mutation. It validates both population units, first-week receipt
# arithmetic, and the 90-95 percent survivor floor from frozen inputs.
fallout_manual_preflight_population_contract = {
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_complete
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_generation
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	every_state = {
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_current
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_receipt_invalid
		clr_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_overshoot
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_k
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_loss_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_after_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_frozen_current_people
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_target_survivors
		clear_variable = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_requested_loss
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_manual_population_baseline_is_current = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_prestrike_people = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_prestrike_people = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_manual_expected_prestrike_people
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_first_week_loss_people = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_first_week_loss_people = fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people }
			clamp_temp_variable = {
				var = fallout_manual_expected_first_week_loss_people
				min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
			}
			round_temp_variable = fallout_manual_expected_first_week_loss_people
			fallout_manual_calculate_population_loss_intent = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people
						value = fallout_manual_expected_prestrike_people
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people
						value = fallout_manual_expected_first_week_loss_people
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_manual_current_population_people
						value = fallout_manual_target_survivor_population
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
				set_variable = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_k = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_k }
				set_variable = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_prestrike_people = fallout_manual_prestrike_population_people }
				set_variable = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_loss_people = fallout_manual_first_week_population_loss_people }
				set_variable = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_first_week_after_people = fallout_manual_first_week_after_population_people }
				set_variable = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_frozen_current_people = fallout_manual_current_population_people }
				set_variable = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_target_survivors = fallout_manual_target_survivor_population }
				set_variable = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_requested_loss = fallout_expected_population_requested_loss }
				set_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_current
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_manual_current_population_people
						value = fallout_manual_target_survivor_population
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
				set_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_overshoot
			}
			else = { set_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_receipt_invalid }
		}
		else = { set_state_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_receipt_invalid }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_count
				value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_struck_states
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_complete
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_manual_apply_aggregate_consequences = {
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_total_civilian_deaths = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.chaos_state_civilian_deaths_map_max } }
		set_variable = { global.chaos_state_civilian_deaths_map_max = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_manual_struck_states
		fallout_manual_apply_state_aggregate_consequence = yes
	}
	force_update_map_mode = { mapmode = deaths_state_map_mode }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.chaos_meter_nuclear_uses } }
		set_variable = { global.chaos_meter_nuclear_uses = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.chaos_meter_nuclear_uses = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes }

	save_event_target_as = chaos_history_actor
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_change = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.chaos_gain }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_history_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.nuke.thermonuclear }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_history_reason_custom = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	add_chaos_meter_value = yes

	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = global.fallout_manual_total_civilian_deaths }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_is_civilian = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_apply_state_pop = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_target_country = THIS }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_has_target_country = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	chaos_meter_register_deaths = yes

	fallout_enforce_permanent_air_contamination = yes

	set_temp_variable = { condemnation_source_type = constant:condemnation_source.nuclear }
	set_temp_variable = { condemnation_base_gain = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.condemnation_base_gain }
	set_temp_variable = { condemnation_visibility_type = constant:condemnation_visibility.public }
	set_temp_variable = { condemnation_severity_type = constant:condemnation_severity.doomsday }
	set_temp_variable = { condemnation_civilian_deaths = global.fallout_manual_total_civilian_deaths }
	set_temp_variable = { condemnation_contamination_value = constant:fallout_manual_aggregate.contamination_value }
	set_temp_variable = { condemnation_context_type = constant:condemnation_context.thermonuclear_strike }
	condemnation_add_source = yes

	set_country_flag = used_unconventional_weapon
	air_cleanliness_treaty_on_unconventional_use = yes
}
