	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
	clr_global_flag = fallout_synthetic_strike_batch
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_launch_window
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
	set_global_flag = fallout_manual_native_sweep_complete
	set_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation = global.fallout_manual_generation }
	set_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.countdown }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_countdown_start_day = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_countdown_end_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_countdown_end_day = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.countdown_days }
	country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.903 days = @FALLOUT_MANUAL_COUNTDOWN_DAYS }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_manual_verify_completed_sweep = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_manual_event_verifier_attempt
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_generation
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
			has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
				value = global.fallout_manual_generation
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_manual_event_verifier_attempt
				value = global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_manual_event_verifier_attempt
				value = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		fallout_manual_verify_completed_sweep_internal = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.invalid_verifier_token }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_manual_verify_completed_sweep_internal = {
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_state_strike_sum = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_recounted_struck_states = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	every_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = fallout_manual_native_struck }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_recounted_struck_states = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_state_strike_sum = fallout_manual_native_strike_count }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count
					value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.issued_count_mismatch }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count
				value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes
				compare = less_than
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count
				value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.verifier_retry_limit
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_manual_schedule_verifier = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count
					value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.observed_count_mismatch }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count
						value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_struck_states
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_manual_recounted_struck_states
						value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_struck_states
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.struck_state_count_mismatch }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_manual_state_strike_sum
					value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.state_strike_sum_mismatch }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { fallout_manual_static_and_observed_counts_match = yes }
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
		fallout_manual_begin_countdown = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_manual_submit_standard_request = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_manual_countdown_callback_is_valid = yes }
		fallout_manual_submit_standard_request_internal = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.invalid_countdown_token }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Called only by the validated countdown wrapper.
fallout_manual_submit_standard_request_internal = {
	set_global_flag = fallout_manual_request_due
	set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.request_due }
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled
	clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_source_input = constant:fallout_request_source.manual_thermonuclear }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_intensity_input = constant:fallout_request_intensity.standard }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.medium } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_intensity_input = constant:fallout_request_intensity.severe }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.high } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_intensity_input = constant:fallout_request_intensity.terminal }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.maximum } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_intensity_input = constant:fallout_request_intensity.maximum }
	}
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled
	clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active
	fallout_request_aftermath = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
			has_global_flag = fallout_request_locked
			has_global_flag = world_end_fallout
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_request_sent
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_request_due
		set_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.request_sent }
		clr_country_flag = fallout_manual_synthetic_launcher
		clear_global_event_target = fallout_manual_sweep_coordinator
	}
	else = {
		set_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.request_rejected }
		fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Countdown callbacks cannot be moved to another
# country without weakening the exact seven-day delay, so this helper is only
# valid while hourly sweep or verifier callbacks are still recoverable.
fallout_manual_rehome_hourly_coordinator = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.sweeping }
				check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.verifying }
			}
		}
		every_country = { clr_country_flag = fallout_manual_synthetic_launcher }
		clear_global_event_target = fallout_manual_sweep_coordinator
		save_global_event_target_as = fallout_manual_sweep_coordinator
		set_country_flag = fallout_manual_synthetic_launcher
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
		clr_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
		clear_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Active manual saves cannot be restarted safely
# after any native strike. Schema and phase inconsistencies therefore fail
# closed while preserving already-issued native effects.
fallout_manual_validate_active_runtime = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_manual_runtime_schema_is_current = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.schema_mismatch }
			fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_manual_selected_intensity_is_valid = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.invalid_intensity }
			fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_manual_prestrike_population_baselines_are_current = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.runtime_ledger_inconsistent }
			fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_generation }
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_status }
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_next_batch }
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_last_completed_batch }
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count }
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count }
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count }
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_state_strike_sum }
						NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}

			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_last_completed_batch = global.fallout_manual_next_batch }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_last_completed_batch = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = global.fallout_manual_last_completed_batch
							value = fallout_manual_expected_last_completed_batch
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}

			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_issued_at_cursor = global.fallout_manual_next_batch }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_issued_at_cursor = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.batch_size }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_manual_next_batch
						value = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.total_batches
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_issued_at_cursor = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count
							value = fallout_manual_expected_issued_at_cursor
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count < @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
						check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count < @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
						check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count < @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
						check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count > constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_province_strikes }
						check_variable = {
							var = global.fallout_manual_observed_strike_count
							value = global.fallout_manual_issued_strike_count
							compare = greater_than
						}
						check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_unique_struck_state_count > constant:fallout_manual_sweep.expected_struck_states }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
							OR = {
								NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation }
								AND = {
									has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
									NOT = {
										check_variable = {
											var = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
											value = global.fallout_manual_generation
											compare = equals
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						AND = {
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled }
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
						}
						AND = {
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
							OR = {
								NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation }
								AND = {
									has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
									NOT = {
										check_variable = {
											var = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
											value = global.fallout_manual_generation
											compare = equals
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						AND = {
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled }
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
						}
						AND = {
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled
							OR = {
								NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation }
								AND = {
									has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation
									NOT = {
										check_variable = {
											var = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation
											value = global.fallout_manual_generation
											compare = equals
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						AND = {
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled }
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.sweeping } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active }
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_synthetic_strike_batch }
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_native_sweep_complete
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled
							NOT = { fallout_manual_batch_cursor_is_valid = yes }
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_launch_window
							AND = {
									has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
									OR = {
										NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch }
										NOT = {
											check_variable = {
												var = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
												value = global.fallout_manual_next_batch
												compare = equals
											}
										}
									}
								}
								AND = {
									NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled }
									has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
								}
							}
						}
						set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.verifying } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active }
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_synthetic_strike_batch }
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_native_sweep_complete
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled
							NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_next_batch = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.total_batches } }
							NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_last_completed_batch = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.final_batch_index } }
							check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count < @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
							check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count > constant:fallout_manual_sweep.verifier_retry_limit }
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_launch_window
							AND = {
									has_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
									OR = {
										NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt }
										NOT = {
											check_variable = {
												var = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
												value = global.fallout_manual_verifier_retry_count
												compare = equals
											}
										}
									}
								}
								AND = {
									NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled }
									has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
								}
							}
						}
						set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.countdown } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
							has_global_flag = fallout_synthetic_strike_batch
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_native_sweep_complete }
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active }
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_event_scheduled }
							NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_countdown_start_day }
							NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_countdown_end_day }
							NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_countdown_generation }
							NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_next_batch = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.total_batches } }
							NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_last_completed_batch = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.final_batch_index } }
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled
							has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_launch_window
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_batch_generation
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_attempt
							has_variable = global.fallout_manual_scheduled_verifier_generation
							}
						}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_countdown_end_day = global.fallout_manual_countdown_start_day }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_expected_countdown_end_day = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.countdown_days }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							check_variable = {
								var = global.fallout_manual_countdown_end_day
								value = fallout_manual_expected_countdown_end_day
								compare = equals
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_manual_runtime_ledger_invalid > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.runtime_ledger_inconsistent }
				fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Called only from the existing host daily pulse.
fallout_manual_reconcile = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_manual_scenario_active
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
				has_global_flag = fallout_synthetic_strike_batch
				has_global_flag = fallout_manual_native_sweep_complete
				has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active
				has_global_flag = fallout_manual_request_sent
				has_country_flag = fallout_manual_synthetic_launcher
			}
		}
		fallout_lock_air_cleanliness_after_fallout_admission = yes
		fallout_manual_validate_active_runtime = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error }
				NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_manual_sweep_coordinator }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.countdown } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.countdown_coordinator_lost }
				fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
			}
			else = { fallout_manual_rehome_hourly_coordinator = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error }
				NOT = {
					event_target:fallout_manual_sweep_coordinator = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = is_global_host
						has_country_flag = fallout_manual_synthetic_launcher
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_status = constant:fallout_manual_status.countdown } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.countdown_coordinator_lost }
				fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
			}
			else = { fallout_manual_rehome_hourly_coordinator = yes }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error }
				has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
				fallout_manual_batch_cursor_is_valid = yes
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_batch_event_scheduled }
			}
			fallout_manual_schedule_next_batch = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error }
				has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_active
				check_variable = { global.fallout_manual_next_batch = constant:fallout_manual_sweep.total_batches }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_verifier_event_scheduled }
			}
			fallout_manual_schedule_verifier = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_manual_sweep_error }
				has_global_flag = fallout_manual_countdown_active
				check_variable = {
					var = global.num_days
					value = global.fallout_manual_countdown_end_day
					compare = greater_than
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_manual_failure_code = constant:fallout_manual_error_code.countdown_overdue }
			fallout_manual_fail_sweep = yes
		}
	}
}

fallout_nzl_event_log_set_payload = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.opening_open_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.opening_open_partial } }

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.opening_guarded_failure } }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.opening_guarded_success } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.opening_local_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.opening_local_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.opening_local_success } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_family = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log.family_domestic } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_open_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_open_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_open_success } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_guarded_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_guarded_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_guarded_success } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_local_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_local_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.domestic_local_success } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_family = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log.family_external } }
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_nzl_external_no_partner_is_current = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_no_partner_open } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_no_partner_guarded } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_no_partner_local } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_open_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_open_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_open_success } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_guarded_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_guarded_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_guarded_success } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_local_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_local_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.external_local_success } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_family = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log.family_late } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_open_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_open_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_open_success } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_guarded_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_guarded_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_guarded_success } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_local_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_local_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_payload = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log_payload.late_local_success } }
		}
	}
}

fallout_nzl_event_log_append_snapshot = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_route = constant:fallout_nzl_route.none }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_humanitarian_route }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_route = constant:fallout_nzl_route.humanitarian }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_isolation_route }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_route = constant:fallout_nzl_route.isolation }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_harbor = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_food = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_trust = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_security = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_prior_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.none }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_harbor = fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_nzl_food_security }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_food = fallout_nzl_food_security }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_nzl_parliament_trust }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_trust = fallout_nzl_parliament_trust }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_nzl_sea_lane_security }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_security = fallout_nzl_sea_lane_security }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_family = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log.family_domestic }
			fallout_nzl_opening_result_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_prior_result = fallout_nzl_opening_result }
	}

	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_sequence_entries value = global.events_log_history_sequence index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_date_entries value = global.date index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_event_id_entries value = events_log_system_event_id index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_payload_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_payload_snapshot index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_country_memory_entries value = constant:fallout_country_memory.new_zealand_lifeboat_state index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_choice_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_choice_snapshot index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_result_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_result_snapshot index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_prior_result_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_prior_result index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_route_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_route index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_actor_entries value = events_log_system_actor index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_has_actor_entries value = events_log_system_has_actor index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_secondary_actor_entries value = events_log_system_secondary_actor index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_has_secondary_actor_entries value = events_log_system_has_secondary_actor index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_harbor_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_harbor index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_food_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_food index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_trust_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_trust index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_security_entries value = fallout_nzl_event_log_security index = 0 }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_generation_entries value = global.fallout_transition_generation index = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_route = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_harbor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_food = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_trust = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_security = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_prior_result = 0 }
}

fallout_nzl_prepare_event_log_card = {
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_memory
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_route
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_harbor
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_food
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_trust
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_security
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_opening_result
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_opening_date
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_domestic_result
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_domestic_date
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_external_result
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_external_date
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_late_result
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_late_date
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_partner
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_partner
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_second_partner
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_second_partner
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_partner_count
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_aggressor
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_aggressor
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_memory = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_route = constant:fallout_nzl_route.none }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_harbor = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_food = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_trust = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_security = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_opening_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.none }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_domestic_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.none }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_external_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.none }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_late_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.none }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_partner_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_partner = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_second_partner = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_aggressor = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_sequence_entries^num
				value = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_event_log_card_has_memory = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_target_generation = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_package_is_current = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_use_current_values = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NZL = { fallout_nzl_lifeboat_package_is_current = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_package_is_current = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_index = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_nzl_card_index
				value = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_generation_entries^num
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_generation_entries^fallout_nzl_card_index
					value = fallout_nzl_card_target_generation
					compare = greater_than
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_target_generation = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_generation_entries^fallout_nzl_card_index }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_nzl_card_package_is_current value = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero compare = greater_than }
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_nzl_event_log_generation_entries^fallout_nzl_card_index
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_use_current_values = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_index = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_index = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_nzl_card_use_current_values value = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero compare = greater_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_target_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_live_harbor = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_card_live_food = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { var = events_log_history_selected_event_id value = constant:fallout_nzl_event_log.opening_history_id compare = equals }

		}

							var = fallout_nzl_history_payload_target_sequence
							value = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero
							compare = greater_than
						}
					}
					if = {

							check_variable = {
								var = global.events_log_history_sequence_entries^fallout_nzl_history_payload_index
								value = fallout_nzl_history_payload_target_sequence
								compare = equals
							}
						}
						set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_history_payload_latest = global.events_log_history_payload_entries^fallout_nzl_history_payload_index }
						set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_history_payload_latest_sequence = fallout_nzl_history_payload_target_sequence }
					}
				}

					set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_history_payload_latest_sequence = global.events_log_history_sequence_entries^fallout_nzl_history_payload_index }
				}

		while_loop_effect = {

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity > constant:fallout_nzl_value.maximum } }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity = constant:fallout_nzl_value.maximum }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity < constant:fallout_nzl_value.minimum } }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity = constant:fallout_nzl_value.minimum }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_food_security > constant:fallout_nzl_value.maximum } }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_food_security = constant:fallout_nzl_value.maximum }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_food_security < constant:fallout_nzl_value.minimum } }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_food_security = constant:fallout_nzl_value.minimum }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_parliament_trust > constant:fallout_nzl_value.maximum } }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_parliament_trust = constant:fallout_nzl_value.maximum }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_sea_lane_security > constant:fallout_nzl_value.maximum } }

			days = fallout_nzl_patrol_window_days
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_sea_road_patrol_window_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_nzl_sea_road_license_serial } }
			set_variable = { fallout_nzl_sea_road_license_serial = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
		}
		add_to_variable = { fallout_nzl_sea_road_license_serial = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = fallout_nzl_quiet_seas_patrol_window } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_nzl_quiet_seas_patrol_window }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_patrol_window_days = 0 }
	}
}

fallout_nzl_close_quiet_seas_patrol_window = {
	clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_sea_road_patrol_window_current
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_sea_road_patrol_window_generation
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = fallout_nzl_quiet_seas_patrol_window }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_nzl_quiet_seas_patrol_window }
	}
}

fallout_nzl_add_sea_road_score = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_isolation_route
			fallout_nzl_sea_road_licensing_is_current = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_nzl_sea_road_patrol_window_is_current = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_sea_road.patrol_window_maintained_score }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_sea_road.patrol_window_lapsed_score }
		}
	}
}

	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_count
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_status
	clear_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_state
	clr_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_valid
	clear_array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries
	clear_variable = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count
}

fallout_nzl_clear_fragmented_transfer_source_receipt = {
	clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
	clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_retired
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state
}

fallout_nzl_record_conflict_dispositions = {

		limit = { fallout_nzl_conflict_dispositions_can_record = yes }
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_samoa_disposition_resolved
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_samoa_disposition = constant:fallout_nzl_conflict_disposition.samoa_state_excluded }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_samoa_disposition_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_aotearoa_overlap_resolved
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_aotearoa_overlap_disposition = constant:fallout_nzl_conflict_disposition.aotearoa_overlap_inactive }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_aotearoa_overlap_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Records one landless source after its sole state
# has moved to NZL. The source row is retired only after the transfer effect
# proves that the former country owns no state. No output country is written.
fallout_nzl_retire_fragmented_transfer_source = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
			has_variable = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation
				value = global.fallout_transition_generation
				compare = equals
			}
			NOT = { any_owned_state = { always = yes } }
			has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_recorded
			has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_allocation_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolved }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.retired_landless }
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_owner = THIS }
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		clear_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country
		set_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolved
		clr_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_allocation_pending
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_retired
		clear_variable = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state
	}
}

# Supported scope: NZL. Transfers one exact reviewed five-state footprint from
# five distinct one-state AI sources. This is a dormant B7 pilot. It writes a
# generation-bound source array, retires each emptied source, and then leaves
# the existing-tag package commit to the established NZL path.
fallout_nzl_commit_fragmented_exact_footprint = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_can_commit = yes }
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_started
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_status = constant:fallout_nzl_allocation_status.transfer_started }
		clear_array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries
		set_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
		284 = {
			save_event_target_as = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_capital
			OWNER = {
				add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
				set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
			}
			transfer_state_to = ROOT
		}
		1079 = {
			OWNER = {
				add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
				set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
			}
			transfer_state_to = ROOT
		}
		723 = {
			OWNER = {
				add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
				set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
			}
			transfer_state_to = ROOT
		}
		1080 = {
			OWNER = {
				add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
				set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
			}
			transfer_state_to = ROOT
		}
		1081 = {
			OWNER = {
				add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
				set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
			}
			transfer_state_to = ROOT
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries
			fallout_nzl_retire_fragmented_transfer_source = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.package_state_count }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count
					value = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.package_state_count
					compare = equals
				}
				fallout_nzl_has_exact_state_package = yes
				all_of_scopes = {
					array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries
					fallout_nzl_transfer_source_row_is_current = yes
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_committed
			set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_status = constant:fallout_nzl_allocation_status.transfer_committed }
			set_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_valid
			set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_state = event_target:fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_capital }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_error
			set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_status = constant:fallout_nzl_allocation_status.transfer_error }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error } }
				set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
				set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.successor_allocation_incomplete }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Converts the already-live NZL tag into the
# reviewed Lifeboat State only when the exact five-state footprint is already
# held by that AI tag. This path does not create a tag or transfer a state.
# The live conflict row is resolved as converted_existing, then the package
# activation helper applies the government, focus tree, forces, and cleanup.
fallout_nzl_commit_existing_tag_assignment = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_nzl_existing_tag_conversion_can_commit = yes }
		fallout_nzl_record_conflict_dispositions = yes
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_nzl_conflict_dispositions_are_current = yes }
			var:fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_state = {
				save_event_target_as = fallout_nzl_assignment_capital
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_capital_state = event_target:fallout_nzl_assignment_capital }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_origin_state = event_target:fallout_nzl_assignment_capital }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_conflict_source_country = THIS }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_conflict_result = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.converted_existing }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_conflict_resolution_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_cleanup_owner = THIS }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_cleanup_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.converted_existing }
			set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_owner = THIS }
			set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = THIS }
			set_country_flag = fallout_existing_tag_conversion_committed
			set_variable = { fallout_existing_tag_conversion_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_allocation_pending

			set_variable = { fallout_country_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_focus_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_archetype_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_regional_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_country_memory_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_government_classifier_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_government_classifier_schema_version = constant:fallout_government_classifier_schema.version }
			set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant }
			set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant }
			set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.oceania_remote_islands }
			set_variable = { fallout_country_memory_id = constant:fallout_country_memory.new_zealand_lifeboat_state }
			set_country_flag = fallout_country_survives
			set_country_flag = fallout_country_classified
			set_country_flag = fallout_country_package_applied
			set_country_flag = fallout_focus_package_applied
			set_country_flag = fallout_archetype_package_applied
			set_country_flag = fallout_regional_package_applied
			set_country_flag = fallout_country_memory_package_applied
			set_country_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_committed

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_successor_assignment_count } }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_assignment_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries value = THIS } } }
				add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries value = THIS }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_successor_assignment_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_capital_states value = event_target:fallout_nzl_assignment_capital } } }
				add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_capital_states value = event_target:fallout_nzl_assignment_capital }
			}
			event_target:fallout_nzl_assignment_capital = {
				set_state_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_capital
				set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_country = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Dormant entry point. Only the B7 existing-tag producer calls it. No on action,
# event, decision, startup effect, scheduler, or public scenario calls it.
fallout_nzl_activate_lifeboat_package = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_nzl_lifeboat_package_can_activate = yes }
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_activation_in_progress
		fallout_nzl_reset_package_runtime = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = fallout_nzl_before_year_ten
			days = @FALLOUT_NZL_YEAR_TEN_DAYS
		}
		fallout_nzl_initialize_values = yes
		fallout_nzl_recruit_package_characters = yes
		retire_country_leader = yes
		promote_character = { character = NZL_fallout_lifeboat_parliament ideology = centrism }
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = democratic
			elections_allowed = no
			name = NZL_fallout_lifeboat_parliament_party
			long_name = NZL_fallout_lifeboat_parliament_party_long
		}
		set_popularities = {
			democratic = constant:fallout_nzl_politics.initial_democratic
			neutrality = constant:fallout_nzl_politics.initial_neutrality
			communism = constant:fallout_nzl_politics.initial_communism
			fascism = constant:fallout_nzl_politics.initial_fascism
		}
		remove_decision = NZL_mangahao_power_scheme
		remove_decision = NZL_waitaki_power_station
		remove_ideas = NZL_railways_board
		remove_ideas = NZL_great_depression
		remove_ideas = NZL_commonwealth_loyalty
		fallout_nzl_remove_lifecycle_ideas = yes
		add_ideas = fallout_nzl_empty_harbors
		add_ideas = fallout_nzl_lifeboat_morality
		add_ideas = fallout_nzl_dairy_rations
		add_ideas = fallout_nzl_improvised_sea_guard
		set_cosmetic_tag = NZL_FALLOUT_LIFEBOAT_STATE
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_capital_state = constant:fallout_nzl_state.wellington } }
			set_capital = { state = 284 remember_old_capital = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_capital_state = constant:fallout_nzl_state.auckland } }
			set_capital = { state = 1079 remember_old_capital = no }
		}
		# Fallout uses one universal survivor tree. This legacy package keeps its
		# country identity and decisions, but it does not load a bespoke tree.
		fallout_generic_focus_activate = yes
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_ai_override
		fallout_nzl_create_starting_force_family = yes
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_lifeboat_package_active
		clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_activation_in_progress
	}
}

fallout_nzl_commit_humanitarian_route = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_nzl_lifeboat_package_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_isolation_route }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_humanitarian_route
		set_variable = { new_zealand_lifeboat_state_opening_route = constant:fallout_nzl_route.humanitarian }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.moderate_gain }
		fallout_nzl_change_parliament_trust = yes
	}
}

	}

fallout_nzl_start_external_transaction = {
	clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_external_event_log_recorded
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_external_event_log_transaction_generation
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = fallout_nzl_external_partner_target }
		event_target:fallout_nzl_external_partner_target = {
			fallout_nzl_clear_partner_response_receipt = yes
		}
	}
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_nzl_external_partner_target
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_external_partner
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_external_partner_candidate_id
	clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_external_no_partner
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_external_no_partner_generation
	every_country = {
		limit = { fallout_nzl_external_partner_candidate_is_valid = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = fallout_nzl_external_partner_candidate_id }
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_nzl_external_partner_candidate_id
							value = PREV.id
							compare = greater_than
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_nzl_external_partner_target
			ROOT = {
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_external_partner_candidate_id = PREV.id }
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_external_partner = PREV.id }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_nzl_external_partner_candidate_id
			has_event_target = fallout_nzl_external_partner_target
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_external_transaction_active
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_external_transaction_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { new_zealand_lifeboat_state_external_partner = fallout_nzl_external_partner }
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_external_no_partner
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_external_no_partner_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		# Preserve the authored no-partner choice and its shared payment,
		# delayed resolver, visible result, and cleanup path. The focus caller
		# only dispatches .139/.140 for a current partner transaction, so this
		# generation-bound dispatch cannot be duplicated by that caller.
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.139 }
		}
		else = { country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.140 } }
	}
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_external_partner_candidate_id
}

fallout_nzl_add_chain_context_score = {
	# The score callers provide fallout_nzl_chain_score and, when applicable,
	# temporary fallout_nzl_prior_result. State control is explicit so a lost
	# port or support region cannot be hidden by the four visible values.
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_state_control_score = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { 284 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_state_control_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.state_control_wellington }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1079 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_state_control_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.state_control_auckland }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 723 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_state_control_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.state_control_canterbury }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1080 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_state_control_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.state_control_marlborough }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1081 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_state_control_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.state_control_otago }
	}
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_state_control_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.state_control_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_state_control_score }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.choice_open_ledger }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.choice_guarded_berths }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.local_compacts } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.choice_local_compacts }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_humanitarian_route }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.humanitarian_route }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_isolation_route }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.isolation_route }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_war = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_humanitarian_route }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.war_pressure_humanitarian }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_isolation_route }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.war_pressure_isolation }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.war_pressure_guarded }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.war_pressure_open }
		}
		else = { add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.war_pressure_local } }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.prior_success }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.prior_partial }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_score.prior_failure }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_state_control_score = 0 }
}

		}
		event_target:fallout_nzl_external_partner_target = {
			event_target:fallout_nzl_external_owner_target = {
				set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_proven_pirate_aggressor
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_pirate_aggressor = PREV.id }

				set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_pirate_war_started
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_pirate_war_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			}
		}
	}
}

fallout_nzl_authorize_bounded_pirate_wargoal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_nzl_lifeboat_package_is_current = yes
			fallout_nzl_pirate_aggressor_is_current = yes
			NOT = { fallout_nzl_pirate_settlement_is_current = yes }
			NOT = { fallout_nzl_pirate_defeat_is_current = yes }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_anti_piracy_decision_open
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:fallout_nzl_pirate_aggressor = {
					NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
					ROOT = { NOT = { has_wargoal_against = PREV } }
				}
			}
			create_wargoal = {
				type = topple_government
				target = var:fallout_nzl_pirate_aggressor
				expire = @FALLOUT_NZL_PIRATE_WARGOAL_EXPIRY_DAYS
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_pirate_wargoal_issued
		}
	}
}

fallout_nzl_pay_opening_choice_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_cost_value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_NZL_COST_POLITICAL_POWER_LOW }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_cost_value = -1 }
		add_political_power = fallout_nzl_cost_value
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.minor_gain }
		fallout_nzl_change_parliament_trust = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_cost_value = constant:fallout_nzl_cost.command_power_low }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_cost_value = -1 }
		add_command_power = fallout_nzl_cost_value
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.minor_gain }
		fallout_nzl_change_sea_lane_security = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.minor_loss }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = -1 }
		fallout_nzl_change_food_security = yes
	}
}

fallout_nzl_calculate_opening_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_parliament_trust }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_sea_lane_security }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_event.triple_divisor }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.none }
	fallout_nzl_add_chain_context_score = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_value.moderate_gain }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths }
			has_war = yes
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_value.major_gain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_nzl_chain_score
				value = constant:fallout_nzl_event.opening_score_failure
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_nzl_chain_score
				value = constant:fallout_nzl_event.opening_score_success
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } }
	set_variable = { new_zealand_lifeboat_state_opening_route = fallout_nzl_chain_result }
}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_opening_result_applied }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.moderate_gain }

		add_stability = constant:fallout_nzl_effect.stability_minor

		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_major_mission_ever_failed
		remove_ideas = fallout_nzl_empty_harbors

	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_opening_result_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
}
