		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.major_loss }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = -1 }
		fallout_nzl_change_parliament_trust = yes
	}
	set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_domestic_result_applied
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_domestic_result_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
}

fallout_nzl_calculate_external_result = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_nzl_external_no_partner_is_current = yes }
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_food_security }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_sea_lane_security }
		divide_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_event.triple_divisor }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.none }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = new_zealand_lifeboat_state_domestic_route }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = new_zealand_lifeboat_state_domestic_route }
		}
		fallout_nzl_add_chain_context_score = yes
		fallout_nzl_add_sea_road_score = yes
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_value.moderate_gain }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_partner_response = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_value.major_gain }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_partner_response = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_value.major_loss }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_nzl_chain_score
					value = constant:fallout_nzl_event.external_score_failure
					compare = less_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_nzl_chain_score
					value = constant:fallout_nzl_event.external_score_success
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } }
	}
}

fallout_nzl_apply_external_result = {
	set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_external_result_applied
	set_variable = { fallout_nzl_external_result_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_nzl_external_transaction_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.major_gain }
		fallout_nzl_change_sea_lane_security = yes
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_external_partner_accepted
		fallout_nzl_record_current_relief_partner = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.moderate_gain }
		fallout_nzl_change_sea_lane_security = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_major_mission_ever_failed
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = constant:fallout_nzl_value.moderate_loss }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_value_delta = -1 }
		fallout_nzl_change_parliament_trust = yes
	}
	set_variable = { new_zealand_lifeboat_state_external_result = fallout_nzl_chain_result }
}

fallout_nzl_calculate_late_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_harbor_capacity }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_food_security }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_parliament_trust }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = fallout_nzl_sea_lane_security }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_event.quad_divisor }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.none }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = new_zealand_lifeboat_state_external_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_prior_result = new_zealand_lifeboat_state_external_result }
	}
	fallout_nzl_add_chain_context_score = yes
	fallout_nzl_add_sea_road_score = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.open_ledger }
			has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_humanitarian_route
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_value.major_gain }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_choice = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_choice.guarded_berths }
			has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_isolation_route
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_value.major_gain }
	}
	else = { add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = constant:fallout_nzl_value.minor_gain } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_nzl_chain_score
				value = constant:fallout_nzl_event.late_score_failure
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.failure }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_nzl_chain_score
				value = constant:fallout_nzl_event.late_score_success
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } }
}

fallout_nzl_apply_late_result = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.success } }
		add_stability = constant:fallout_nzl_effect.stability_major
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_nzl_effect.war_support_moderate
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_result = constant:fallout_nzl_chain_result.partial } }
		add_stability = constant:fallout_nzl_effect.stability_moderate
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_major_mission_ever_failed
		add_stability = constant:fallout_nzl_effect.stability_moderate_loss
	}
	fallout_nzl_record_year_ten_order = yes
}

fallout_nzl_clear_chain_runtime = {
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_chain_choice
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_chain_result
	clear_variable = fallout_nzl_partner_response
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_chain_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_nzl_cost_value = 0 }
}

# Consolidated source: common/scripted_effects/fallout_successor_b7_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT SUCCESSOR B7 VERTICAL SLICE EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# B7 is a dormant, idempotent allocator pilot. It preserves one USA human
# continuation in place, applies a country-specific package receipt, records
# one exact capital, names one deterministic fragmentation candidate, and can
# run the reviewed five-state NZL transfer or one conflict-ledger-gated dynamic
# materialization. It never switches the player or marks the global successor
# matrix complete.
# ============================================================================

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Clears only the B7 fragmentation probe on this
# source. Durable package and assignment receipts are never erased here.
fallout_successor_b7_clear_source_probe = {
	clr_country_flag = fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_named
	clr_country_flag = fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_blocked
	clear_variable = fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_country
	clear_variable = fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_state
	clear_variable = fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_b7_fragmentation_status
}

# Supported scope: USA. This is the only country package written by B7. It is
# intentionally country-specific and loads an additive Fallout focus layer.
fallout_successor_b7_apply_usa_continuity_package = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_successor_b7_usa_continuity_source_is_ready = yes
			NOT = { fallout_successor_b7_usa_package_receipts_are_current = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_country_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_focus_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_archetype_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_regional_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_country_memory_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_government_classifier_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_government_classifier_schema_version = constant:fallout_government_classifier_schema.version }
		set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government }
		set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government }
		set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.north_america }
		set_variable = { fallout_country_memory_id = constant:fallout_country_memory.federal_continuity_zone }
		set_country_flag = fallout_country_survives
		set_country_flag = fallout_country_classified
		set_country_flag = fallout_country_package_applied
		set_country_flag = fallout_focus_package_applied
		set_country_flag = fallout_archetype_package_applied
		set_country_flag = fallout_regional_package_applied
		set_country_flag = fallout_country_memory_package_applied
		add_ideas = fallout_usa_federal_continuity_ledger_idea
		# Fallout uses one universal survivor tree. The continuity package remains
		# an identity receipt only and does not load a bespoke USA tree.
		fallout_generic_focus_activate = yes
		set_country_flag = fallout_b7_usa_package_current
	}
}


# Supported scope: USA. Records the complete row for the in-place human
# continuation. The capital and source are both the frozen player reservation.
fallout_successor_b7_assign_usa_continuity_row = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_successor_b7_transaction_is_current = yes
			fallout_successor_b7_usa_continuity_source_is_ready = yes
			fallout_successor_b7_usa_package_receipts_are_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_committed }
		}
		var:fallout_player_primary_capital_state = {
			save_event_target_as = fallout_b7_usa_capital
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolved
		clr_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_allocation_pending
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.player_reserved }
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_owner = THIS }
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = THIS }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_conflict_source_country = THIS }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_conflict_result = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.player_reserved }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_conflict_resolution_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_cleanup_owner = THIS }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_cleanup_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_capital_state = fallout_player_primary_capital_state }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_origin_state = fallout_player_primary_capital_state }
		set_country_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_committed
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_successor_assignment_count }
			}
			set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_assignment_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries value = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries value = THIS }
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_successor_assignment_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_capital_states value = event_target:fallout_b7_usa_capital } }
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_capital_states value = event_target:fallout_b7_usa_capital }
		}
		event_target:fallout_b7_usa_capital = {
			set_state_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_capital
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_country = ROOT }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_successor_b7_usa_assignment_is_current = yes }
			set_country_flag = fallout_b7_usa_continuity_assigned
			set_country_flag = fallout_b7_usa_human_control_receipt
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_human_control_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_continuity_status = constant:fallout_successor_b7_status.continuity_assigned }
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_continuity_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_b7_usa_continuity_error
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_continuity_status = constant:fallout_successor_b7_status.error }
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_continuity_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Names the lowest-id conflict-free country and the
# lowest-id candidate state. No ownership, release, or focus package is
# attempted when the candidate is missing or unproven.
fallout_successor_b7_probe_fragmentation_candidate = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_successor_b7_transaction_is_current = yes
			fallout_successor_b7_fragmentation_source_is_ready = yes
		}
		fallout_successor_b7_clear_source_probe = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_candidate_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_candidate_id = constant:fallout_snapshot_limit.maximum_database_id }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_candidate_country = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_state_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_state_id = constant:fallout_snapshot_limit.maximum_database_id }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_state = THIS }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_all_possible_country_scopes
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_successor_b7_fragmentation_candidate_is_available = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_candidate_id = THIS.id }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { fallout_b7_candidate_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
							check_variable = {
								var = fallout_b7_candidate_id
								value = fallout_b7_best_candidate_id
								compare = less_than
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_candidate_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_candidate_id = fallout_b7_candidate_id }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_candidate_country = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_successor_candidate_states
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_successor_state_is_candidate = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_state_id = THIS.id }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { fallout_b7_state_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
							check_variable = {
								var = fallout_b7_state_id
								value = fallout_b7_best_state_id
								compare = less_than
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_state_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_state_id = fallout_b7_state_id }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_state = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_b7_candidate_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				check_variable = { fallout_b7_state_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_named
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_country = fallout_b7_best_candidate_country }
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_state = fallout_b7_best_state }
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_fragmentation_status = constant:fallout_successor_b7_status.fragmentation_candidate_named }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_blocked
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_fragmentation_candidate_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_b7_fragmentation_status = constant:fallout_successor_b7_status.fragmentation_blocked }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_candidate_found = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_candidate_id = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_candidate_country = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_state_found = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_state_id = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_b7_best_state = 0 }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The USA continuity layer uses five route-locked
# projects. Each project consumes a real strategic stock and writes a current
# generation memory receipt before changing the capital or country ledger.
fallout_successor_b7_usa_complete_depot_belt_repair = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_successor_b7_usa_project_base_is_valid = yes
			has_country_flag = fallout_usa_supply_corridors_complete
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_usa_depot_belt_repair_complete }
		}
		capital_scope = {
			add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 2 instant_build = yes }
			add_building_construction = { type = rail_way level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_usa_depot_belt_repair_complete
		set_variable = { fallout_usa_depot_belt_repair_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_usa_logistics_memory = constant:fallout_successor_b7_project_memory.depot }
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_successor_b7_project_reward.depot_war_support
	}
}

fallout_successor_b7_usa_complete_radio_sweep = {
	if = {

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Materializes the reviewed New Zealand Lifeboat
# package when no live NZL tag is available. The caller must already own a
# current non-player conflict row. The dynamic output is created only after
# the exact five-state package footprint and every source retirement gate pass.
# This remains a dormant B7 vertical slice and never marks global allocation
# complete.
fallout_successor_b7_materialize_dynamic_nzl = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_successor_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_can_commit = yes }
		save_event_target_as = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_source
		set_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_started
		set_variable = { global.fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		clear_array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries
		set_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
		create_dynamic_country = {
			original_tag = NZL
			copy_tag = NZL
			set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_dynamic_country
			reserve_dynamic_country = yes
			set_variable = { fallout_dynamic_country_materialization_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_dynamic_country_materialization_source_country = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_source }
			save_event_target_as = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output }
			event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output = {
				set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_started
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_status = constant:fallout_successor_b7_status.nzl_dynamic_materialization_started }
			}
			284 = {
				save_event_target_as = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_capital
				OWNER = {
					add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
					add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
					set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_dynamic_transfer_source_state = PREV }
				}
				transfer_state_to = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output
			}
			1079 = {
				OWNER = {
					add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
					add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
					set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_dynamic_transfer_source_state = PREV }
				}
				transfer_state_to = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output
			}
			723 = {
				OWNER = {
					add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
					add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
					set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_dynamic_transfer_source_state = PREV }
				}
				transfer_state_to = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output
			}
			1080 = {
				OWNER = {
					add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
					add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
					set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_dynamic_transfer_source_state = PREV }
				}
				transfer_state_to = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output
			}
			1081 = {
				OWNER = {
					add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries value = THIS }
					add_to_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.one }
					set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_transfer_source_pending
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_transfer_source_state = PREV }
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_dynamic_transfer_source_state = PREV }
				}
				transfer_state_to = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output
			}
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries
				fallout_nzl_retire_fragmented_transfer_source = yes
			}
			event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output = {
				set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.package_state_count }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count
							value = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.package_state_count
							compare = equals
						}
						fallout_nzl_has_exact_state_package = yes
						all_of_scopes = {
							array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries
							fallout_nzl_transfer_source_row_is_current = yes
						}
					}
					set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_committed
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_status = constant:fallout_successor_b7_status.nzl_dynamic_materialization_committed }

				else = {
					set_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_error
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_status = constant:fallout_successor_b7_status.nzl_dynamic_materialization_error }
					set_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_error

						limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error } }

						add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_committed
						fallout_nzl_conflict_disposition_inputs_are_current = yes
					}
				}
				event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output = {
					fallout_nzl_record_conflict_dispositions = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_committed

					set_variable = { fallout_successor_conflict_resolution_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_successor_cleanup_owner = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_source }
					set_variable = { fallout_successor_cleanup_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_country_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_committed
					set_country_flag = fallout_dynamic_country_materialization_committed
					set_variable = { fallout_dynamic_country_materialization_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.created_dynamic }
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_owner = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_source }
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_country_flag = fallout_country_survives
					set_country_flag = fallout_country_classified
					set_country_flag = fallout_country_package_applied
					set_country_flag = fallout_focus_package_applied
					set_country_flag = fallout_archetype_package_applied
					set_country_flag = fallout_regional_package_applied
					set_country_flag = fallout_country_memory_package_applied
					set_variable = { fallout_country_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_focus_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_archetype_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_regional_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_country_memory_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_government_classifier_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_government_classifier_schema_version = constant:fallout_government_classifier_schema.version }
					set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant }
					set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant }
					set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.oceania_remote_islands }
					set_variable = { fallout_country_memory_id = constant:fallout_country_memory.new_zealand_lifeboat_state }
				}
				event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_source = {
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution = constant:fallout_tag_conflict_resolution.created_dynamic }
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolution_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_owner = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_source }
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_cleanup_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_output_country = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output }
					set_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_resolved
					clr_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_allocation_pending

				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_successor_assignment_count } }
					set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_assignment_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries value = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output } } }

					add_to_variable = { global.fallout_successor_assignment_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_capital_states value = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_capital } } }
					add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_capital_states value = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_capital }
				}
				event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_capital = {
					set_state_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_capital
					set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_country = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output }
					set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_successor_assignment_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				}
				set_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_committed
				event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output = {
					set_variable = { fallout_nzl_dynamic_materialization_source = event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_source }
					fallout_nzl_activate_lifeboat_package = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_event_target = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							event_target:fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_output = {

						}

							}
						}

				}
				set_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_error
				set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error

			}

			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.successor_allocation_incomplete }
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
	}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Rewinds a same-generation dormant dynamic NZL
# materialization before a successor transaction is rebuilt. The engine has no
# documented destroy-country effect, so the output is made landless, its
# package runtime is retired, and its dynamic slot is released for recycling.
fallout_successor_b7_cleanup_dynamic_nzl = {
	clr_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_cleanup_ran
	every_country = {
		limit = {

		}
		1081 = {

		}
		clr_country_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_dynamic_country_materialization_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_started
		clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_error
		clr_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_valid
		clr_country_flag = fallout_country_survives
		clr_country_flag = fallout_country_classified
		clr_country_flag = fallout_country_package_applied
		clr_country_flag = fallout_focus_package_applied
		clr_country_flag = fallout_archetype_package_applied
		clr_country_flag = fallout_regional_package_applied
		clr_country_flag = fallout_country_memory_package_applied
		clear_variable = fallout_successor_assignment_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_successor_assignment_count

		clear_variable = fallout_regional_package_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_country_memory_package_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_government_classifier_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_government_classifier_schema_version
		clear_variable = fallout_government_origin_archetype
		clear_variable = fallout_government_archetype
		clear_variable = fallout_government_archetype_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_region_id
		clear_variable = fallout_country_memory_id
		clr_country_flag = fallout_nzl_dynamic_country
		reserve_dynamic_country = no
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_cleanup_ran }
		clear_array = global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_countries
		set_variable = { global.fallout_nzl_transfer_source_count = constant:fallout_nzl_schema.zero }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_started
		clr_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_committed
		clr_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_error
		clear_variable = global.fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_generation
		clr_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_cleanup_ran
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Single Fallout transition coordinator entry point.
# It is deliberately not connected to an on action or a public event.
fallout_successor_b7_run_vertical_slice = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { fallout_successor_b7_vertical_slice_is_current = yes }
			fallout_successor_b7_transition_owner_is_current = yes
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_transition_phase
				value = constant:fallout_transition_phase.survivor_allocation
				compare = equals
			}
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			has_global_flag = fallout_physical_collapse_complete
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete }
					NOT = { fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes }
				}
			fallout_resolve_player_continuation_ledger_before_allocation = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_built }
					NOT = { fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_is_current = yes }
				}
				has_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete
				fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			}
			fallout_build_successor_conflict_ledger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized }
				has_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete
				fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes
				has_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_built
				fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_is_current = yes
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			}
			fallout_begin_successor_allocation_transaction = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_successor_b7_transaction_is_current = yes }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { fallout_successor_b7_usa_continuity_source_is_ready = yes }
						fallout_successor_b7_apply_usa_continuity_package = yes
						fallout_successor_b7_assign_usa_continuity_row = yes
					}
					if = {
						limit = { fallout_successor_b7_fragmentation_source_is_ready = yes }
						fallout_successor_b7_probe_fragmentation_candidate = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					fallout_successor_b7_transaction_is_current = yes
					NZL = {
						OR = {
							fallout_nzl_existing_tag_conversion_can_commit = yes
							fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_can_commit = yes
						}
					}
				}
				NZL = {
					if = {
						limit = { fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_can_commit = yes }
						fallout_nzl_commit_fragmented_exact_footprint = yes
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error } }
						fallout_nzl_commit_existing_tag_assignment = yes
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
							fallout_nzl_existing_tag_conversion_is_current = yes
						}
						fallout_nzl_activate_lifeboat_package = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_built
					fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_is_current = yes
					NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				}
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_countries
					if = {
						limit = {
							fallout_successor_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_can_commit = yes
						}
						fallout_successor_b7_materialize_dynamic_nzl = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
					OR = {
						NOT = { NZL = { has_country_flag = fallout_nzl_fragmented_transfer_started } }
						NZL = { fallout_nzl_existing_tag_conversion_is_current = yes }
						has_global_flag = fallout_b7_nzl_dynamic_materialization_committed
					}
				}
				set_global_flag = fallout_b7_vertical_slice_ran
				set_variable = { global.fallout_b7_vertical_slice_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			}
		}
	}
}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. A committed ledger is immutable and
# this reset becomes a no-op once the ready flag exists.
fallout_reset_uncommitted_survival_ledger = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_ready } }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged
		clr_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_building
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries
			fallout_survival_clear_country_row = yes
		}
		clear_array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries
		clear_array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_generation_entries
		clear_array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_index_entries
		clear_array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states
		clear_array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_generation_entries
		clear_array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_index_entries
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_schema_version
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_generation
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_allocation_schema
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_allocation_generation
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_country_count
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_count
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_state_count
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_count
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged_date
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged_day
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_committed_date
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_committed_day
		every_country = { fallout_survival_clear_country_row = yes }
		every_possible_country = { fallout_survival_clear_country_row = yes }
		every_state = { fallout_survival_clear_state_row = yes }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. This consumes only the exact
# uncommitted identity-build error, then rebuilds the complete identity payload
# through the ordinary staging transaction. A failed retry owns the same sole
# error signature again.
fallout_recover_uncommitted_survival_ledger_identity_transaction = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_survival_ledger_identity_error_is_active = yes }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		fallout_stage_survival_ledger_identity_transaction = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. This identity-first phase freezes
# all-and-only allocated country and state identities plus the producer
# generations required by the reviewed numerical transaction.
fallout_stage_survival_ledger_identity_transaction = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_ready }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_survivor_allocation_applied }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_player_continuation_applied }
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_transition_phase
				value = constant:fallout_transition_phase.survivor_allocation
				compare = equals
			}
			fallout_player_planning_ledger_is_current = yes
			fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_commit_complete }
		}
		fallout_reset_uncommitted_survival_ledger = yes
		set_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_building
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_schema_version = constant:fallout_survival_ledger_schema.version }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_allocation_schema = global.fallout_successor_allocation_schema_version }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_allocation_generation = global.fallout_successor_allocation_generation }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_country_count = global.fallout_successor_assignment_count }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_source_state_count = global.fallout_successor_inventory_state_count }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_build_index = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_successor_assigned_countries
			set_country_flag = fallout_survival_country_identity_staged
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_schema_version = constant:fallout_survival_ledger_schema.version }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_index = fallout_survival_country_build_index }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_allocation_schema = global.fallout_successor_allocation_schema_version }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_allocation_generation = fallout_successor_assignment_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_state_count = num_owned_states }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_region = fallout_region_id }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = fallout_government_archetype }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_memory = fallout_country_memory_id }
			clear_array = fallout_survival_country_resource_id_entries
			for_loop_effect = {
				start = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index
				end = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound
				value = fallout_survival_resource_build_index
				add_to_array = {
					array = fallout_survival_country_resource_id_entries
					value = fallout_survival_resource_build_index
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries value = THIS }
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_generation_entries value = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_index_entries value = fallout_survival_country_build_index }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_build_index = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_build_index = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		every_state = {
			set_state_flag = fallout_survival_state_identity_staged
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_schema_version = constant:fallout_survival_ledger_schema.version }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_index = fallout_survival_state_build_index }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_owner = OWNER }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_snapshot_generation = fallout_pretransition_snapshot_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_schema = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_schema_version }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_generation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_kind = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_grading_generation = fallout_state_grading_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_population_generation = fallout_population_loss_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_rewrite_generation = fallout_state_rewrite_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_supply_generation = fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation }
			clear_array = fallout_survival_state_resource_id_entries
			for_loop_effect = {
				start = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index
				end = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound
				value = fallout_survival_resource_build_index
				add_to_array = {
					array = fallout_survival_state_resource_id_entries
					value = fallout_survival_resource_build_index
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states value = THIS }
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_generation_entries value = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_index_entries value = fallout_survival_state_build_index }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_build_index = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_country_count = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries^num }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_state_count = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states^num }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged_day = global.num_days }
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_survival_ledger_identity_payload_is_current = yes }
			set_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_identity_staged
			clr_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_building
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.survival_ledger_incomplete }
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
	}
}

	clr_country_flag = fallout_survival_cohesion_row_committed
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_cohesion_initial
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_cohesion_current
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_cohesion_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_cohesion_schema_version
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_cohesion_replay_initial
	clear_variable = fallout_orientation_cohesion
	clear_variable = fallout_orientation_state_result_surface_status
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. A row flag remains provisional until
# the global ready flag exists, so an interrupted build clears the whole
# numerical payload and preserves the accepted identity transaction.
fallout_reset_uncommitted_survival_numerical_payload = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_ready } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states
			fallout_survival_clear_state_numerical_row = yes
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries
			fallout_survival_clear_country_numerical_row = yes
		}
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_committed_date
		clear_variable = global.fallout_survival_ledger_committed_day
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Input is fallout_survival_resource_build_index.
# Output is the exact unrounded numerator, denominator, and rounded share.
fallout_survival_calculate_state_resource_expected = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_denominator = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_share = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index > constant:fallout_survival_resource.none } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_denominator = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.denominator }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.food } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.food_reserve }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_rural_identity }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.food_rural }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_port_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.food_port }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.food_reclamation }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_access_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.food_access }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.clean_water } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.water_security }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity }

				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }

				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.medicine_recovery }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.medicine_adaptation }
