				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_salvage_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.scrap_salvage }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_industry_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.scrap_industry }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_material_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.scrap_material }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_access_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.scrap_access }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.fuel } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_fuel_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.fuel_source }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_logistics_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.fuel_logistics }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_industry_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.fuel_industry }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_access_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.fuel_access }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.power } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_power_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.power_source }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_industry_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.power_industry }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_logistics_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.power_logistics }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_access_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.power_access }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.filters } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_industry_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.filters_industry }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.filters_shelter }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.filters_adaptation }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.filters_reclamation }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_access_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.filters_access }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.shelter_capacity } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.shelter_capacity }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_logistics_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.shelter_logistics }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_urban_identity }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.shelter_urban }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.shelter_adaptation }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_access_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.shelter_access }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.recognition } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_communication_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.recognition_communication }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_administrative_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.recognition_administrative }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_urban_identity }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.recognition_urban }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.recognition_recovery }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = fallout_survival_access_signal }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_signal_component = constant:fallout_survival_formula_weight.recognition_access }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator = fallout_survival_signal_component }
			}
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum_numerator }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_share = fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator }
			divide_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_state_share = fallout_survival_expected_state_denominator }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_survival_expected_state_share
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_survival_expected_state_share min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Calculates the opening State Supply Access from the
# post-rewrite non-damaged infrastructure ledger. Not-applicable Air Winter
# rows receive a typed zero and never become orientation targets.
fallout_state_calculate_supply_access_expected = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_expected_supply_access = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced }
			has_variable = fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_infrastructure
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_expected_supply_access = fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_infrastructure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_state_expected_supply_access = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.logistics_per_infrastructure }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_state_expected_supply_access min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Recomputes the native local supply impact from the
# mutable 0 to 100 Supply Access ledger.
fallout_state_recompute_supply_access_factor = {
	set_variable = { fallout_state_supply_impact_factor = constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_base }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_supply_impact_component = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_state_supply_impact_component = constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_per_point }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_impact_factor = fallout_state_supply_impact_component }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_impact_factor min = constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_minimum max = constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_maximum }
	set_variable = { fallout_state_supply_impact_current_receipt = fallout_state_supply_impact_factor }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The ledger owns the modifier lifecycle. No recurring
# iterator is required because opening commit and authenticated mutations call
# this helper directly.
fallout_state_refresh_supply_access_modifier = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_state_supply_access_row_committed
			check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_state_supply_access } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_state_supply_access }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_state_supply_access } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_state_supply_access }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Input is the temporary
# fallout_state_supply_access_delta. This is the sole mutable-current writer.
fallout_state_apply_supply_access_delta = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_state_supply_access_row_is_current = yes }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = fallout_state_supply_access_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
		fallout_state_recompute_supply_access_factor = yes
		fallout_state_refresh_supply_access_modifier = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Produces one provisional row and immediately replays
# it from frozen inputs before writing its row-commit flag.
fallout_survival_stage_state_numerical_row = {
	fallout_survival_clear_state_numerical_row = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
			fallout_physical_collapse_row_is_durable = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced } }
			fallout_survival_calculate_state_common_signals = yes
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index
			end = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound
			value = fallout_survival_resource_build_index
			fallout_survival_calculate_state_resource_expected = yes
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_state_raw_numerator_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_state_raw_denominator_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_state_denominator }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_state_equal_share_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_state_share }
		}
		fallout_state_calculate_supply_access_expected = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_initial = fallout_state_expected_supply_access }
		set_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = fallout_state_expected_supply_access }
		set_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_schema_version = constant:fallout_survival_ledger_schema.version }
		fallout_state_recompute_supply_access_factor = yes
		fallout_survival_replay_state_numerical_row = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This is the exact state-row replay validator. It
# recomputes the complete row independently from the stored numerical arrays.
fallout_survival_replay_state_numerical_row = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_survival_state_numerical_reconciled
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_state_numerical_generation
	clear_array = fallout_survival_state_replay_numerator_entries
	clear_array = fallout_survival_state_replay_denominator_entries
	clear_array = fallout_survival_state_replay_share_entries
	clear_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_replay_initial
	clear_variable = fallout_state_supply_impact_replay_factor
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
			fallout_physical_collapse_row_is_durable = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_state_raw_numerator_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_state_raw_denominator_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_state_equal_share_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced } }
			fallout_survival_calculate_state_common_signals = yes
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index
			end = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound
			value = fallout_survival_resource_build_index
			fallout_survival_calculate_state_resource_expected = yes
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_state_replay_numerator_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_state_replay_denominator_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_state_denominator }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_state_replay_share_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_state_share }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_state_raw_numerator_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_state_numerator compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_state_raw_denominator_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_state_denominator compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_state_equal_share_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_state_share compare = equals } }
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		fallout_state_calculate_supply_access_expected = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_replay_initial = fallout_state_expected_supply_access }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_expected_supply_impact = constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_base }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_expected_supply_impact_component = fallout_state_expected_supply_access }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_state_expected_supply_impact_component = constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_per_point }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_state_expected_supply_impact = fallout_state_expected_supply_impact_component }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_state_expected_supply_impact min = constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_minimum max = constant:fallout_state_supply_access.impact_maximum }
		set_variable = { fallout_state_supply_impact_replay_factor = fallout_state_expected_supply_impact }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_initial value = fallout_state_expected_supply_access compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current value = fallout_state_expected_supply_access compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_impact_factor value = fallout_state_expected_supply_impact compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_schema_version = constant:fallout_survival_ledger_schema.version } }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		}
	}
	else = { add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_variable = { fallout_survival_state_numerical_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_state_flag = fallout_state_supply_access_row_committed
		set_state_flag = fallout_survival_state_numerical_reconciled
		set_state_flag = fallout_survival_state_row_committed
		fallout_state_refresh_supply_access_modifier = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Output is the approved Recognition adjustment.
fallout_survival_calculate_recognition_adjustment = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.quarantine_state }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.continuity_government } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.bunker_authority } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.bunker_authority } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.warlord_command } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.warlord_command } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.food_compact } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.food_compact } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.maritime_remnant } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.scavenger_syndicate } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.scavenger_syndicate } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.nomad_convoy } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.nomad_convoy } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.machine_protocol } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.machine_protocol } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.technate } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.technate } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.mutant_polity } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.mutant_polity } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_source_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.religious_refuge } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value = constant:fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment.religious_refuge } }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Recognition already includes the archetype
# adjustment. This formula must not apply a second archetype adjustment.
fallout_survival_calculate_country_cohesion_expected = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_cohesion = fallout_survival_initial_entries^1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_cohesion = constant:fallout_survival_cohesion.food_weight }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_component = fallout_survival_initial_entries^8 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_component = constant:fallout_survival_cohesion.shelter_weight }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_component = fallout_survival_initial_entries^9 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_component = constant:fallout_survival_cohesion.recognition_weight }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_component }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_cohesion = constant:fallout_survival_cohesion.denominator }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_survival_expected_cohesion
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_survival_expected_cohesion min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input is the temporary
# fallout_survival_cohesion_delta. This is the sole mutable-current writer.
fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_survival_country_cohesion_row_is_current = yes }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_current = fallout_survival_cohesion_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input is fallout_survival_resource_build_index.
# Outputs exact frozen-membership aggregation and the opening value.
fallout_survival_calculate_country_resource_expected = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_aggregation_country_scope = THIS }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_member_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_produced_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_weight_sum = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_weighted_sum = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_hub_score = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index > constant:fallout_survival_resource.none } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states
			if = {
				limit = { var:fallout_survival_state_owner = { tag = var:fallout_survival_aggregation_country_scope } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_member_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_source_air_winter_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_produced_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_population_weight = fallout_population_after_loss_k }
					divide_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_population_weight = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.population_weight_divisor_k }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_survival_state_population_weight min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.population_weight_floor max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.population_weight_cap }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_score = fallout_survival_state_raw_numerator_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index }
					divide_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_score = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.denominator }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_weighted_score = fallout_survival_state_score }
					multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_state_weighted_score = fallout_survival_state_population_weight }
					add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_weight_sum = fallout_survival_state_population_weight }
					add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_weighted_sum = fallout_survival_state_weighted_score }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_state_score > fallout_survival_expected_country_hub_score } }
						set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_hub_score = fallout_survival_state_score }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_denominator = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_initial = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index > constant:fallout_survival_resource.none } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_denominator = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.denominator }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_produced_count > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				check_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_weight_sum > constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_coverage = fallout_survival_expected_country_weighted_sum }
			divide_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_coverage = fallout_survival_expected_country_weight_sum }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_coverage_weight = constant:fallout_survival_country_blend.local_coverage }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_hub_weight = constant:fallout_survival_country_blend.local_hub }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.scrap }
						check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.fuel }
						check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.power }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_coverage_weight = constant:fallout_survival_country_blend.industrial_coverage }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_hub_weight = constant:fallout_survival_country_blend.industrial_hub }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.recognition } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_coverage_weight = constant:fallout_survival_country_blend.recognition_coverage }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_hub_weight = constant:fallout_survival_country_blend.recognition_hub }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator = fallout_survival_expected_country_coverage }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator = fallout_survival_country_coverage_weight }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_hub_component = fallout_survival_expected_country_hub_score }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_country_hub_component = fallout_survival_country_hub_weight }
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator = fallout_survival_country_hub_component }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum_numerator }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_initial = fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator }
			divide_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_initial = fallout_survival_expected_country_denominator }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_survival_expected_country_initial
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.recognition } }
				fallout_survival_calculate_recognition_adjustment = yes
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_expected_country_initial = fallout_survival_recognition_adjustment_value }
			}
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_survival_expected_country_initial min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Produces one provisional aggregate row and then
# replays it before writing its row-commit flag.
fallout_survival_stage_country_numerical_row = {
	fallout_survival_clear_country_numerical_row = yes
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_survival_country_identity_row_is_current = yes }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index
			end = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound
			value = fallout_survival_resource_build_index
			fallout_survival_calculate_country_resource_expected = yes
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_raw_numerator_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_raw_denominator_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_denominator }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_initial_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_initial }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_current_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_initial }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_population_weight_sum_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_weight_sum }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_weighted_score_sum_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_weighted_sum }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_hub_score_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_hub_score }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.food } }
				set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_aggregate_state_count = fallout_survival_expected_country_member_count }
				set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_produced_state_count = fallout_survival_expected_country_produced_count }
			}
		}
		fallout_survival_calculate_country_cohesion_expected = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_initial = fallout_survival_expected_cohesion }
		set_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_current = fallout_survival_expected_cohesion }
		set_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_schema_version = constant:fallout_survival_ledger_schema.version }
		fallout_survival_replay_country_numerical_row = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This is the exact country-row replay validator.
fallout_survival_replay_country_numerical_row = {
	clr_country_flag = fallout_survival_country_numerical_reconciled
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_country_numerical_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_country_replay_state_count
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_country_replay_produced_state_count
	clear_array = fallout_survival_replay_raw_numerator_entries
	clear_array = fallout_survival_replay_raw_denominator_entries
	clear_array = fallout_survival_replay_initial_entries
	clear_array = fallout_survival_replay_population_weight_sum_entries
	clear_array = fallout_survival_replay_weighted_score_sum_entries
	clear_array = fallout_survival_replay_hub_score_entries
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_cohesion_replay_initial
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_survival_country_identity_row_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_raw_numerator_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_raw_denominator_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_initial_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_population_weight_sum_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_weighted_score_sum_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_hub_score_entries^num value = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound compare = equals }
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index
			end = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound
			value = fallout_survival_resource_build_index
			fallout_survival_calculate_country_resource_expected = yes
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_replay_raw_numerator_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_replay_raw_denominator_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_denominator }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_replay_initial_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_initial }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_replay_population_weight_sum_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_weight_sum }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_replay_weighted_score_sum_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_weighted_sum }
			add_to_array = { array = fallout_survival_replay_hub_score_entries value = fallout_survival_expected_country_hub_score }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_raw_numerator_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_country_numerator compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_raw_denominator_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_country_denominator compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_initial_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_country_initial compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_country_initial compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_population_weight_sum_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_country_weight_sum compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_weighted_score_sum_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_country_weighted_sum compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_hub_score_entries^fallout_survival_resource_build_index value = fallout_survival_expected_country_hub_score compare = equals } }
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.food }
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_country_aggregate_state_count value = fallout_survival_expected_country_member_count compare = equals } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_country_produced_state_count value = fallout_survival_expected_country_produced_count compare = equals } }
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_resource_build_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.food } }
				set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_replay_state_count = fallout_survival_expected_country_member_count }
				set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_replay_produced_state_count = fallout_survival_expected_country_produced_count }
			}
		}
		fallout_survival_calculate_country_cohesion_expected = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_replay_initial = fallout_survival_expected_cohesion }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_initial value = fallout_survival_expected_cohesion compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = fallout_survival_expected_cohesion compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_schema_version = constant:fallout_survival_ledger_schema.version } }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		}
	}
	else = { add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_survival_replay_mismatch_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { fallout_survival_country_produced_state_count > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_country_aggregate_state_count value = fallout_survival_country_state_count compare = equals }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_survival_country_numerical_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_result_surface_status = constant:fallout_orientation_surface_status.approved }
		set_country_flag = fallout_survival_cohesion_row_committed
		set_country_flag = fallout_survival_country_numerical_reconciled
		set_country_flag = fallout_survival_country_row_committed
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. Sole numerical producer and sole setter
# of fallout_survival_ledger_ready. The ready flag is the final write.
fallout_commit_survival_ledger_numerical_transaction = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_ready }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_survivor_allocation_applied }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_commit_complete }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_player_continuation_applied }
			check_variable = { var = global.fallout_transition_phase value = constant:fallout_transition_phase.survivor_allocation compare = equals }
			fallout_player_planning_ledger_is_current = yes
			fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes
			fallout_survival_ledger_identity_is_current = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_building
		fallout_reset_uncommitted_survival_numerical_payload = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states
			fallout_survival_stage_state_numerical_row = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_survival_state_numerical_rows_are_precommit_current = yes }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_countries
				fallout_survival_stage_country_numerical_row = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_committed_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_survival_ledger_committed_day = global.num_days }
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_survival_ledger_numerical_precommit_payload_is_current = yes }
			clr_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_building
			set_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_ready
		}
		else = {
			fallout_reset_uncommitted_survival_numerical_payload = yes
			clr_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_building
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.survival_ledger_incomplete }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. Owns only the exact numerical-build
# failure signature and retries through the ordinary coordinator.
fallout_recover_uncommitted_survival_ledger_numerical_transaction = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_survival_ledger_numerical_error_is_active = yes }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		fallout_commit_survival_ledger_numerical_transaction = yes
	}
}

# Congo Green Basin adaptation and cultural-practice chain. A ward keepers, elders, and foreign
# witness must decide how to record a survival practice without turning fictional alteration into a diagnosis.
# The effects own adaptation-policy costs, immutable state and neighbor receipts, deterministic grading,
# Deaths requests, delayed result and callback scheduling, Event Log memory, and idempotent cleanup.
# The Fallout consequence remains a separate system.

fallout_event_908_clear_frozen = {
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_owner
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_controller
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_shelter
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_supply
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_adaptation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_exposure
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_disease
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_state_id
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_owner
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_controller
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_shelter
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_supply
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_disease
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_compact_legitimacy
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_tradition_pressure
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_adaptation_trust
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_witness_confidence
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_outsider_fear
	clear_variable = fallout_event_908_frozen_elder_fatigue
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_target_state_id = 0 }
}
fallout_event_908_initialize_ledgers = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_adaptation_rite_rite_legitimacy_current } } set_variable = { fallout_adaptation_rite_rite_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.initial_rite_legitimacy } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_adaptation_rite_tradition_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_adaptation_rite_tradition_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.initial_tradition_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_adaptation_rite_adaptation_trust } } set_variable = { fallout_adaptation_rite_adaptation_trust = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.initial_adaptation_trust } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_adaptation_rite_witness_confidence_fund } } set_variable = { fallout_adaptation_rite_witness_confidence_fund = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.initial_witness_confidence_fund } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_adaptation_rite_outsider_fear } } set_variable = { fallout_adaptation_rite_outsider_fear = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.initial_outsider_fear } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_adaptation_rite_elder_fatigue } } set_variable = { fallout_adaptation_rite_elder_fatigue = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.initial_elder_fatigue } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_adaptation_rite_rite_cause_memory } } set_variable = { fallout_adaptation_rite_rite_cause_memory = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.initial_rite_cause_memory } }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_adaptation_rite_rite_legitimacy_current min = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_adaptation_rite_tradition_pressure_current min = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_adaptation_rite_adaptation_trust min = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_adaptation_rite_witness_confidence_fund min = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_adaptation_rite_outsider_fear min = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_adaptation_rite_elder_fatigue min = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_adaptation_rite_rite_cause_memory min = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.ledger_maximum }
}
fallout_event_908_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_908_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.civic_rite compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.civic_rite_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.civic_rite_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.civic_rite_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.religious_rite compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.religious_rite_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.religious_rite_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.religious_rite_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.scientific_certification compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.scientific_certification_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.scientific_certification_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.scientific_certification_cohesion }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.reject_ritual_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.reject_ritual_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.reject_ritual_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.reject_ritual_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_908_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
}

fallout_event_908_refund_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_908_cost_paid }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.civic_rite compare = equals } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.civic_rite_food }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.civic_rite_medicine }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.civic_rite_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.religious_rite compare = equals } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.religious_rite_scrap }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.religious_rite_power }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.religious_rite_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.scientific_certification compare = equals } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.scientific_certification_fuel }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.scientific_certification_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.scientific_certification_cohesion }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.reject_ritual_food }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.reject_ritual_medicine }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.reject_ritual_fuel }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_908_cost.reject_ritual_recognition }
		}
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_908_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
}

fallout_event_908_snapshot_registry = {
	fallout_event_908_initialize_ledgers = yes
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_registry_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_registry_owner = ROOT }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.adaptation_rite_candidate_id }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_registry_target = fallout_event_908_target_state_id }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_frozen_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_frozen_compact_legitimacy = fallout_adaptation_rite_rite_legitimacy_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_frozen_tradition_pressure = fallout_adaptation_rite_tradition_pressure_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_frozen_adaptation_trust = fallout_adaptation_rite_adaptation_trust }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_frozen_witness_confidence = fallout_adaptation_rite_witness_confidence_fund }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_frozen_outsider_fear = fallout_adaptation_rite_outsider_fear }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_frozen_elder_fatigue = fallout_adaptation_rite_elder_fatigue }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_state_id = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:fallout_event_908_target_state_id = {
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_owner = OWNER }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_controller = CONTROLLER }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_supply = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_exposure = air_winter_exposure }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		every_neighbor_state = {
			limit = {
				always = yes
				NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				owner = { exists = yes }
				fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_state_id value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = THIS.id value = ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_state_id compare = less_than }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_state_id = THIS.id }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_owner = OWNER }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_controller = CONTROLLER }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_supply = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_event_908_registry_reserved
	}
	var:fallout_event_908_frozen_neighbor_state_id = {
		set_state_flag = fallout_event_908_neighbor_reserved
	}
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_event_908_frozen_supply }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.state_supply_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_event_908_frozen_shelter }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.state_shelter_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_event_908_frozen_adaptation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.state_adaptation_weight }


	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.maximum_viability }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.maximum_viability }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_event_908_frozen_exposure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.state_exposure_relief_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.medicine_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }

	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_event_908_frozen_compact_legitimacy }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.rite_legitimacy_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.maximum_viability }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_event_908_frozen_tradition_pressure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.tradition_pressure_relief_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_event_908_frozen_adaptation_trust }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.adaptation_trust_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.maximum_viability }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = fallout_event_908_frozen_outsider_fear }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.outsider_fear_relief_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = fallout_event_908_component }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_government_archetype value = constant:fallout_government_archetype.mutant_polity compare = equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_viability = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.mutant_government_bonus } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability min = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.maximum_viability }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_event_908_viability
	set_variable = { fallout_event_908_grade = fallout_event_908_viability }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.civic_rite compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability value = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.civic_rite_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability value = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.civic_rite_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.religious_rite compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability value = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.religious_rite_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability value = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.religious_rite_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_908_branch.scientific_certification compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability value = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.scientific_certification_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability value = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.scientific_certification_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability value = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.reject_ritual_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_908_viability value = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.reject_ritual_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_component = 0 }
}

fallout_event_908_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_908_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_death_request = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_908_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_908_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_908_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_908_apply_callback_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_908_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_908_death_request = state_population_k }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_908_callback_cleanup_released

			set_country_flag = fallout_event_534_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_534_chain_committed

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_534_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_534_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_534_callback_cleanup_released

			clear_variable = fallout_event_534_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_534_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_534_registry_target_type

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT ANIMAL FEED EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Dormant first-season food chain. A real pre-transition Air Winter food
# reserve becomes a state-owned feed ledger, then a delayed first-harvest
# callback records whether the chosen policy fed people, preserved breeding
# stock, or divided the reserve by region.

fallout_event_164_apply_failure_deaths = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_state_id > 0 }
			fallout_event_164_feed_registry_is_current = yes
		}
		var:fallout_event_164_result_state_id = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_death_request = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_164_death_request

fallout_event_164_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {

			check_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_164_result_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_164_branch.feed_people } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.people_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.people_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.people_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_164_branch.preserve_breeding } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.breeding_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.breeding_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.breeding_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.division_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.division_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.division_failure } }
			}
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.callback_success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_164_log.callback_partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_164_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_164_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_164_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_history_recorded }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_history_payload = 0 }

fallout_event_164_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_target_feed = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_target_adaptation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_target_reclamation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_164_branch.feed_people } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.people_success_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_target_feed value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.people_partial_feed compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_target_feed value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.people_partial_feed compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_164_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_164_branch.preserve_breeding } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_target_feed value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.breeding_success_feed compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_target_adaptation value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.breeding_success_adaptation compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_target_feed value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.breeding_partial_feed compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.division_success_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_target_reclamation value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.division_success_reclamation compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_target_feed value = constant:fallout_event_164_threshold.division_partial_feed compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
}

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.animal_feed_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
