fallout_event_164_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_164_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_164_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_164_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_164_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_164_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_164_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_164_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_164_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_164_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_callback_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_result_state_id
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_164_feed_state_id }
				var:fallout_event_164_feed_state_id = {
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_164_feed_registry_committed
					clear_variable = fallout_event_164_feed_registry_generation
					clear_variable = fallout_event_164_feed_registry_owner
					clear_variable = fallout_event_164_feed_reserve
				}
			}
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_feed_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_feed_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_164_feed_registry_owner
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_164_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

	var:fallout_event_450_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }

			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_death_request = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_450_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_450_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.study_tracks } check_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_450_log.study_tracks_partial } }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_450_log.leave_corridor_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_450_log.leave_corridor_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_450_log.leave_corridor_failure } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_450_log.callback_success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_450_log.callback_partial } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_450_log.callback_failure } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_450_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_450_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_450_callback_history_recorded }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_history_payload = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }

fallout_event_450_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = fallout_event_450_frozen_safety }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.safety_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_viability = fallout_event_450_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = fallout_event_450_frozen_research }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.research_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_viability = fallout_event_450_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = fallout_event_450_frozen_pack }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.pack_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_viability = fallout_event_450_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = fallout_event_450_frozen_food }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.food_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_viability = fallout_event_450_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = fallout_event_450_frozen_recognition }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.recognition_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_viability = fallout_event_450_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = fallout_event_450_frozen_cohesion }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.cohesion_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_viability = fallout_event_450_component }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability min = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.maximum_viability }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.hunt_pack } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.branch_hunt_success compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_frozen_pack value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.hunt_pack_pressure_cap compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.branch_hunt_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.fence_corridor } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.branch_fence_success compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_frozen_safety value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.fence_safety_floor compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.branch_fence_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.study_tracks } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.branch_study_success compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_frozen_research value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.study_research_cap compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.branch_study_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.branch_leave_success compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.leave_recognition_floor compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_450_viability value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.branch_leave_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_viability = 0 }
}

fallout_event_450_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.hunt_pack } }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.hunt_pack_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.hunt_pack_medicine }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.hunt_pack_recognition }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.fence_corridor } }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.fence_corridor_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.fence_corridor_medicine }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.fence_corridor_recognition }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.study_tracks } }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.study_tracks_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.study_tracks_medicine }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.study_tracks_recognition }
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.leave_corridor_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.leave_corridor_medicine }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_450_cost.leave_corridor_recognition }
	}
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_450_cost_paid
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
}

fallout_event_450_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_450_chain_committed } check_variable = { fallout_event_450_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_450_branch.none } check_variable = { fallout_event_450_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_450_branch.upper_bound } fallout_event_450_target_is_current = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_frozen_food = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_frozen_medicine = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ash_wolves_pack_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_ash_wolves_pack_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.initial_pack_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ash_wolves_safety_current } } set_variable = { fallout_ash_wolves_safety_current = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.initial_safety } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ash_wolves_research_current } } set_variable = { fallout_ash_wolves_research_current = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.initial_research } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ash_wolves_corridor_memory_current } } set_variable = { fallout_ash_wolves_corridor_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.initial_corridor_memory } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ash_wolves_altered_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_ash_wolves_altered_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.initial_altered_pressure } }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_frozen_pack = fallout_ash_wolves_pack_pressure_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_frozen_safety = fallout_ash_wolves_safety_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_frozen_research = fallout_ash_wolves_research_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_450_selected_branch = fallout_event_450_requested_branch }
	fallout_event_450_calculate_outcome = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_450_opening_ticket }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_450_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_450_requested_branch }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.ash_wolves_result }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.ash_wolves_result_ai }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_450_requested_branch }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_450_timing.result_delay_days }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_450_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_450_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_450_opening_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.ash_wolves_cleanup }
	fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_450_opening_event_token }
		fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_outcome = fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_result_day = global.num_days }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_registry_owner = ROOT }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.ash_wolves_candidate_id }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_450_registry_target = fallout_event_450_target_state_id }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_450_chain_committed
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_450_memory_opened
			var:fallout_event_450_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_450_registry_committed }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice } fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes fallout_event_450_clear_frozen = yes }
	}
	else = { fallout_event_450_clear_frozen = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_opening_event_token = 0 }

	else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_government = fascism has_government = communism } check_variable = { var = fallout_ash_wolves_safety_current value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.ai_safety_threshold compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.hunt_pack } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality check_variable = { var = fallout_ash_wolves_altered_pressure_current value = constant:fallout_event_450_threshold.ai_altered_pressure_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_450_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_450_branch.leave_corridor } }
	fallout_event_450_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_450_pay_branch_cost = yes }

fallout_event_554_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_554_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_554_branch.cut_firebreak }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_554_frozen_supply value = constant:fallout_event_554_threshold.ai_cordon_supply compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_554_cost.ai_cordon_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^5 value = constant:fallout_event_554_cost.ai_cordon_fuel compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_554_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_554_branch.military_cordon }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_554_frozen_adaptation value = constant:fallout_event_554_threshold.ai_seal_adaptation compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 value = constant:fallout_event_554_cost.seal_shelter compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_554_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_554_branch.seal_roofs }
	}
	fallout_event_554_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_554_pay_branch_cost = yes }
}

fallout_event_554_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_554_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_554_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_554_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_554_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_554_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_554_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_554_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_554_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_554_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_554_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_554_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_554_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_554_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_554_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_554_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_554_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_554_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_554_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_554_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_554_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_554_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_554_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_554_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_554_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_registry_target
			fallout_event_554_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_554_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_554_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_204_apply_failure_deaths = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_204_result_state_id > 0 }
			fallout_event_204_batch_registry_is_current = yes
		}
		var:fallout_event_204_result_state_id = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_death_request = constant:fallout_event_204_threshold.failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_204_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_204_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_204_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_204_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_204_result_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_204_log.callback_failure }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_204_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_204_branch.destroy_batch } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_204_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_204_log.destroy_success } }

fallout_event_204_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_204_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_204_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_204_branch.destroy_batch } }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_204_cost.destroy_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_204_cost.destroy_scrap }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_204_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_204_branch.plant_batch } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_204_cost.plant_food } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_204_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_204_branch.isolate_plots } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_204_cost.isolate_filters } }
		else = { subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_204_cost.share_recognition } }
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_204_cost_paid
	}
}

		}

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_204_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_204_branch.isolate_plots } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.bad_batch_isolate_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.bad_batch_isolate_result_ai } }

				set_variable = { fallout_event_204_frozen_scrap = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 }

fallout_event_204_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_204_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_204_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_204_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_204_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_204_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_204_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_204_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_204_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_204_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_204_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_204_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_callback_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_result_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_food
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_medicine
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_scrap
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_filters
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_shelter
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_viability
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_cause_memory
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_frozen_provenance
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_204_batch_state_id }
				var:fallout_event_204_batch_state_id = {
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_204_batch_registry_committed
					clear_variable = fallout_event_204_batch_registry_generation
					clear_variable = fallout_event_204_batch_registry_owner
					clear_variable = fallout_event_204_batch_viability
					clear_variable = fallout_event_204_batch_adaptation
				}
			}
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_batch_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_batch_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_204_batch_registry_owner
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_204_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT BLACK START EFFECTS

# Dormant country-level recovery transaction. The chain freezes Power, Scrap,

			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_310_state_death_request

			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes

		}
	}

				set_variable = { fallout_event_310_result_outcome = fallout_event_310_calculated_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_310_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_310_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_310_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_310_registry_owner = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_310_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.black_start_candidate_id }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_310_registry_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_memory_opened
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_schedule_error
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_power
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_scrap
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_cohesion
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_recognition
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_reclamation
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_capacity
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_governance
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_dependency
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_resilience
				clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_exposure
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_schedule_error
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_power
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_scrap
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_reclamation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_capacity
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_governance
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_dependency
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_resilience
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_exposure
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_opening_event_token = 0 }
}

fallout_event_310_choose_branch = {
	fallout_event_310_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_310_pay_branch_cost = yes }
}

fallout_event_310_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.none }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = fallout_black_start_310_governance }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_black_start_310_governance value = constant:fallout_event_310_threshold.ai_central_power compare = less_than }
			}
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.central_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.central_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.centralized_grid }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_310_threshold.ai_cooperative_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.cooperative_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.cooperative_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.cooperative_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.local_cooperatives }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_threshold.ai_military_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.military_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^5 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.military_fuel compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.military_grid }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_310_threshold.ai_foreign_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.foreign_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.foreign_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.foreign_backed }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.central_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.central_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.centralized_grid }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.cooperative_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.cooperative_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.cooperative_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.local_cooperatives }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.military_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^5 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.military_fuel compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.military_grid }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.foreign_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_310_cost.foreign_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_310_branch.foreign_backed }
	}
	fallout_event_310_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_310_pay_branch_cost = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_requested_branch = 0 }
}

fallout_event_310_resolve_result_and_schedule_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_result_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_310_result_outcome }
	fallout_event_resolve_issued_delayed_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_310_apply_result_effects = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		fallout_event_310_record_history = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_310_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_310_result_ticket }
		fallout_event_310_schedule_callback = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_scheduled
			set_variable = { fallout_event_310_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_schedule_error
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_310_result_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_result_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_result_mode = 0 }
}

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_310_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_310_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_310_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_310_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_310_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_310_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_310_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_310_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_310_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_310_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_310_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_power
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_scrap
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_reclamation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_capacity
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_governance
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_dependency
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_resilience
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_frozen_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_310_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_310_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT BORDER INSPECTION CRISIS EFFECTS

# Quarantine border chain. The Rime Ward office must decide how the East Gate
# crossing will accept a foreign inspection demand. The effects own branch costs,
# immutable state and neighbor receipts, deterministic grading,
# Deaths requests, delayed result and callback scheduling, Event Log memory,
# and idempotent cleanup. The Fallout consequence remains a separate system.

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_border_inspection_crisis_cause_memory } } set_variable = { fallout_border_inspection_crisis_cause_memory = constant:fallout_event_726_threshold.initial_cause_memory } }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_border_inspection_crisis_border_guard_capacity min = constant:fallout_event_726_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_726_threshold.ledger_maximum }

fallout_event_726_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_726_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_726_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_726_branch.close_border compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_726_cost.close_border_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_726_cost.close_border_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_726_cost.close_border_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_726_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_726_branch.joint_team compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_726_cost.joint_team_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_726_cost.joint_team_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_726_cost.joint_team_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_726_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_726_branch.exemptions compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_726_cost.exemptions_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_726_cost.exemptions_recognition }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_726_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_726_log.close_border_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {

				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_726_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_726_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_726_log.joint_team_success } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_726_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_726_log.exemptions_failure } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_464_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_464_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_464_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_464_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_464_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_464_callback_cleanup_released }

			clear_variable = fallout_event_464_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_464_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_464_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_464_result_cleanup_ticket

			clear_variable = fallout_event_464_target_state_id

fallout_event_628_initialize_ledgers = {

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_canal_upstream_priority } } set_variable = { fallout_canal_upstream_priority = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.initial_upstream_priority } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_canal_downstream_grievance } } set_variable = { fallout_canal_downstream_grievance = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.initial_downstream_grievance } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_canal_gate_maintenance } } set_variable = { fallout_canal_gate_maintenance = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.initial_gate_maintenance } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_canal_local_council_authority } } set_variable = { fallout_canal_local_council_authority = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.initial_local_council_authority } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_canal_military_control } } set_variable = { fallout_canal_military_control = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.initial_military_control } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_canal_illicit_water_pressure } } set_variable = { fallout_canal_illicit_water_pressure = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.initial_illicit_water_pressure } }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_allocation_trust min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_upstream_priority min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_downstream_grievance min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_gate_maintenance min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_local_council_authority min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_military_control min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }

		}

			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_628_cost.upstream_recognition }
		}

			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_628_cost.guard_fuel }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	fallout_event_628_calculate_grade = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_628_branch.joint_schedule } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_628_grade value = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.joint_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_628_branch.upstream_priority } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_628_grade value = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.upstream_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_628_branch.gate_guard } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_628_grade value = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.guard_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_628_branch.local_water_councils } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_628_grade value = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.council_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }

	else_if = {

				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_628_branch.local_water_councils } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_628_grade value = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.council_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }

			check_variable = { fallout_event_628_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_628_branch.upper_bound }

			fallout_event_628_opening_target_is_current = yes

	else_if = {

		add_to_variable = { fallout_canal_local_council_authority = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.local_council_failure }

	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_allocation_trust min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_gate_maintenance min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_local_council_authority min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_canal_illicit_water_pressure min = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_628_threshold.ledger_maximum }

fallout_event_628_resolve_callback_and_prepare_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_callback_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }

		fallout_event_628_apply_callback_effects = yes

		fallout_event_628_record_history = yes

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_628_callback_ticket }
		fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_callback_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_628_clear_state_reservation = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_628_target_state_id }
		var:fallout_event_628_target_state_id = {
			clr_state_flag = fallout_event_628_registry_reserved
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_joint }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_upstream }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_guard }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_council }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_partial }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_failed }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_reviewed }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_reviewed_partial }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_canal_reviewed_failed }
		}
	}
}

# Called before a Fallout runtime generation is rebuilt. This state-bound row
# cancels an unconsumed opening, refunds a branch that never settled, terminalizes
# issued result or callback receipts, and removes cleanup tombstones before the
# country runtime arrays are cleared.
fallout_event_628_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_628_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_628_target_state_id }
		var:fallout_event_628_target_state_id = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_628_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_628_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = fallout_event_628_registry_generation NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_628_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_628_registry_generation } has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_cost_paid }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_chain_committed NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_result }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_result_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_callback }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_callback_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_cleanup }
			}
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_ai }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_628_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_628_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_628_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_628_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.three }
				fallout_event_628_record_history = yes
				fallout_event_628_clear_state_reservation = yes
				var:fallout_event_628_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_628_registry_committed }
				fallout_event_628_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_628_opening_target_is_current
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_628_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_stale_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_result_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_callback }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_callback_ai }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_stale_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_delayed_result = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_628_stale_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_cleanup }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_chain_committed
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued }
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
						NOT = {
							OR = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_result }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_result_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_callback }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_callback_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_cleanup }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_628_result_cleanup_ticket }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_628_callback_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_stale_ticket = fallout_event_628_callback_cleanup_ticket }
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_628_result_cleanup_ticket } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_stale_ticket = fallout_event_628_result_cleanup_ticket } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_stale_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_628_stale_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_cleanup }
				fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_628_result_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_628_result_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_cleanup }
				fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_628_cancellation_history_recorded } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.three }
			fallout_event_628_record_history = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_human }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_result_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_callback }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_callback_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.canal_schedule_cleanup }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_628_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_628_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_628_target_state_id } var:fallout_event_628_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_628_registry_committed } }
			fallout_event_628_clear_state_reservation = yes
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_628_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_628_chain_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_628_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_628_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_628_choice_history_recorded

fallout_event_733_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_733_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_733_branch.none }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = fallout_cordon_733_youth_trust }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_cordon_733_youth_trust value = constant:fallout_event_733_threshold.ai_reform_youth_trust compare = less_than }
			}
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_733_cost.reform_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_733_cost.reform_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_733_cost.reform_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_733_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_733_branch.reform }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_733_threshold.ai_service_travel_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_733_cost.service_travel_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_733_cost.service_travel_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_733_cost.service_travel_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_733_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_733_branch.service_travel }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_733_threshold.ai_strict_continuation_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }

			limit = {

					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_733_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_733_callback_scheduled } }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_733_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_733_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_733_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_733_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_733_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_733_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_frozen_food
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_frozen_shelter
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_frozen_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_frozen_youth_trust
			clear_variable = fallout_event_733_frozen_movement_law

		else_if = {

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_719_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_719_log.public_service_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_719_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_719_branch.paid_certificate compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_719_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_719_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_719_log.paid_certificate_success } }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_880_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_880_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_880_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_880_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_880_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }

	}
	else_if = {

	}

				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_cohorts_first_ballot_guardian_seats }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_387_cost_paid

			clear_variable = fallout_event_387_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_387_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_387_registry_target_type

	}

			fallout_event_572_target_is_current = yes

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_572_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_reclamation_success } subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_exposure_success } add_to_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_disease_success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_572_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_reclamation_partial } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_exposure_partial } add_to_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_disease_partial } }
		else = { subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_reclamation_failure } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_exposure_failure } add_to_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = constant:fallout_event_572_threshold.callback_disease_failure } damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_572_THRESHOLD_BUILDING_DAMAGE_FAILURE } }
		clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_disease_pressure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }

	}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
