		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_scrap_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_medicine_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_fuel_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_recognition_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_cohesion_partial }
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_stability_partial
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_war_support_partial
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		var:fallout_event_338_target_state_id = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_reclamation_partial } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_supply_partial } } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_contamination_partial } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_338_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_338_timing.callback_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_dead_city_permit_partial days = fallout_event_338_state_modifier_days } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_338_state_modifier_days = 0 } }
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_scrap_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_medicine_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_fuel_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_recognition_failure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_cohesion_failure }
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_stability_failure
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_war_support_failure
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		var:fallout_event_338_target_state_id = { subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_reclamation_failure } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_supply_failure } } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_338_threshold.callback_contamination_failure } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } set_state_flag = fallout_event_338_memory_permit_abandoned set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_338_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_338_timing.callback_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_dead_city_permit_contaminated days = fallout_event_338_state_modifier_days } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_338_state_modifier_days = 0 } }
		fallout_event_338_apply_callback_failure_deaths = yes
	}
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_338_memory_closed
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_485_death_request

			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_485_viability value = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.lock_and_ration_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_485_viability value = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.lock_and_ration_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_viability = 0 }
}

fallout_event_485_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_485_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.run_full_shift } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.run_full_shift_water } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.run_full_shift_power } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.run_full_shift_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.run_full_shift_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_485_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.call_desert_technicians } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.call_desert_technicians_water } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.call_desert_technicians_power } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.call_desert_technicians_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.call_desert_technicians_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_485_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.reserve_clinic_power } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.reserve_clinic_power_water } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.reserve_clinic_power_power } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.reserve_clinic_power_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.reserve_clinic_power_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else = { subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.lock_and_ration_water } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.lock_and_ration_power } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.lock_and_ration_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.lock_and_ration_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_485_cost_paid
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
}

fallout_event_485_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_485_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_485_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_485_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_485_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_485_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_485_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_485_frozen_water = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_485_frozen_power = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_485_frozen_medicine = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_485_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_485_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_485_frozen_adaptation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_485_frozen_reclamation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current } } set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.initial_operation_memory } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current } } set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.initial_desalination_water_reserve } }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_485_frozen_operation_memory = ROOT.fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_485_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_485_selected_branch = fallout_event_485_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_485_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_485_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_485_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_485_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.desalination_night_shift_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.desalination_night_shift_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_485_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_485_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_485_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_485_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_485_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.desalination_night_shift_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_485_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_result_outcome = fallout_event_485_calculated_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_registry_owner = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.desalination_night_shift_candidate_id }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_485_registry_target = fallout_event_485_target_state_id }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_485_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_485_memory_opened
				var:fallout_event_485_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_485_desalination_registry_committed set_variable = { fallout_event_485_desalination_water_reserve = ROOT.fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current } }
			}
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice } fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes fallout_event_485_clear_frozen = yes }
		}
		else = { fallout_event_485_clear_frozen = yes }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_opening_event_token = 0 }
}

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation value = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ai_call_desert_technicians_adaptation compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_485_cost.call_desert_technicians_water compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.call_desert_technicians } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ai_reserve_clinic_power_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ai_reserve_clinic_power_power compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.reserve_clinic_power } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ai_lock_and_ration_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.lock_and_ration } }
	fallout_event_485_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_485_pay_branch_cost = yes }
}

fallout_event_485_apply_result_effects = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current } } set_variable = { fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.initial_operation_memory } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current } } set_variable = { fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.initial_desalination_water_reserve } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_desalination_technical_credit_current } } set_variable = { fallout_desalination_technical_credit_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.initial_desalination_technical_credit } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_485_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_water_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_power_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_medicine_success }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_cohesion_success }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_stability_success
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_war_support_success
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_operation_memory_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_reserve_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_technical_credit_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_cohesion_success }
		var:fallout_event_485_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_reclamation_success }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_adaptation_success }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_exposure_success }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_supply_success } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_485_memory_water_success
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_485_timing.result_modifier_days }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_485_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.run_full_shift } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_desalination_night_shift_early_operation days = fallout_event_485_modifier_days } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_485_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.call_desert_technicians } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_desalination_night_shift_technical_contract days = fallout_event_485_modifier_days } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_485_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_485_branch.reserve_clinic_power } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_desalination_night_shift_public_reserve days = fallout_event_485_modifier_days } }
			else = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_desalination_night_shift_lockdown days = fallout_event_485_modifier_days } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_485_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_water_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_power_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_medicine_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_cohesion_partial }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_stability_partial
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_war_support_partial
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_operation_memory_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_reserve_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_technical_credit_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_cohesion_partial }
		var:fallout_event_485_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_reclamation_partial }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_adaptation_partial }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_exposure_partial }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_supply_partial } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_485_memory_water_partial
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_485_timing.result_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_desalination_night_shift_partial days = fallout_event_485_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_water_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_power_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_medicine_failure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_cohesion_failure }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_stability_failure
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_war_support_failure
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_operation_memory_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_reserve_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_desalination_technical_credit_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_cohesion_failure }
		var:fallout_event_485_target_state_id = {
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_reclamation_failure }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_adaptation_failure }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_exposure_failure }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.result_supply_failure } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@infrastructure value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } } damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_485_THRESHOLD_BUILDING_DAMAGE_FAILURE } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@naval_base value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } } damage_building = { type = naval_base damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_485_THRESHOLD_BUILDING_DAMAGE_FAILURE } }
			else = { damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_485_THRESHOLD_BUILDING_DAMAGE_FAILURE } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_485_memory_water_failed
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_485_timing.result_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_desalination_night_shift_failed days = fallout_event_485_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
		fallout_event_485_apply_failure_deaths = yes
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current min = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current min = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_desalination_technical_credit_current min = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
}

		var:fallout_event_485_target_state_id = {

			set_state_flag = fallout_event_485_memory_shift_review
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_485_timing.callback_modifier_days }

	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_485_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }

		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_power_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_medicine_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_cohesion_partial }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_stability_partial
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_war_support_partial
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_operation_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_operation_memory_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_water_reserve_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_reserve_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_desalination_technical_credit_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_cohesion_partial }
		var:fallout_event_485_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_reclamation_partial }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_adaptation_partial }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_exposure_partial }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_supply_partial } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_485_memory_shift_review_frayed
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_485_timing.callback_modifier_days }

			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_water_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_power_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_medicine_failure }

		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_desalination_technical_credit_current = constant:fallout_event_485_threshold.callback_cohesion_failure }

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_485_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_485_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_485_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_485_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_485_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_485_callback_cleanup_released }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_485_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_485_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_485_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_485_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_485_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_485_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_485_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_485_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_485_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_485_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_485_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_485_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_485_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_485_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_registry_target
			fallout_event_485_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_485_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_485_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_705_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_705_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_705_branch.accept_technocratic_rule compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_705_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_705_log.choice_accept_technocratic_rule } }

			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_705_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_705_log.choice_public_vote } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_705_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_705_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_705_log.accept_technocratic_rule_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_705_branch.build_medical_coalition compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_705_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_705_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_705_log.build_medical_coalition_success } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_705_branch.build_medical_coalition compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_doctors_coup_coalition_cabinet }

	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_705_branch.arrest_medical_leadership compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_doctors_coup_leadership_arrested }

	set_variable = { fallout_event_705_callback_score = fallout_first_red_line_public_health }

	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_705_callback_score = fallout_doctors_coup_civil_legitimacy_fund }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_705_callback_score = fallout_doctors_coup_cause_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_705_callback_score = fallout_first_red_line_grievance }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_705_callback_score = fallout_doctors_coup_medical_fatigue }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_705_callback_score = fallout_doctors_coup_coup_risk }
	var:fallout_event_705_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_705_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_705_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_705_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_705_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_705_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_705_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_705_result_mode = 0 }

fallout_event_705_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_705_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_705_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_705_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_705_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_705_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_705_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_cleanup_released
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_705_result_cleanup_released }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_705_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_705_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_705_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_705_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_705_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_705_registry_reserved clr_state_flag = fallout_event_705_registry_committed } }
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_705_memory_opened
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_705_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_705_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_705_memory_closed } }
			fallout_event_705_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_705_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_705_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_705_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_705_registry_target_type

fallout_event_230_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_230_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_230_branch.admit_families } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_230_cost.family_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_230_cost.family_filters }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_230_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_230_branch.admit_specialists } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_230_cost.specialist_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_230_cost.specialist_shelter }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_230_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_230_branch.public_lottery } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_230_cost.lottery_recognition }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_230_cost.lottery_filters }
		}
		else = { subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_230_cost.refusal_scrap } }
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_230_cost_paid
	}
}

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_food_threshold compare = less_than } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_family_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_food_families } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_food_lottery } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_refusal_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_food_refusal } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 value = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_shelter_threshold compare = less_than } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_family_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_shelter_families } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_specialist_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_shelter_specialists } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_shelter_lottery } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_refusal_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.low_shelter_refusal } }

	var:fallout_event_230_candidate_source_state_id = { if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure value = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.high_source_exposure_threshold compare = greater_than } } set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_230_work_high_source_exposure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_230_work_high_source_exposure }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_family_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.high_source_exposure_families }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_specialist_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.high_source_exposure_specialists }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.high_source_exposure_lottery }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_refusal_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.high_source_exposure_refusal }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_families has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_families_partial has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_families_refused } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_family_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.memory_families }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_specialists has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_specialists_partial has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_specialists_refused } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_specialist_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.memory_specialists }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_lottery has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_lottery_partial has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_lottery_refused } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.memory_lottery }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_refusal_orderly has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_refusal_fractured has_country_flag = fallout_event_230_memory_refusal_violent } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_refusal_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.memory_refusal }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_war = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_family_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.war_families }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_specialist_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.war_specialists }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.war_lottery }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_refusal_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.war_refusal }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.invalid_score }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_230_branch.admit_families }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_230_ai_family_score value = fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score = fallout_event_230_ai_family_score } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_230_ai_specialist_score value = fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score = fallout_event_230_ai_specialist_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_230_branch.admit_specialists } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_score value = fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score = fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_230_branch.public_lottery } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_230_ai_refusal_score value = fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score = fallout_event_230_ai_refusal_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_230_branch.refuse_entry } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score value = constant:fallout_event_230_ai.invalid_score compare = greater_than } }
		fallout_event_230_schedule_result = yes
	}
	else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_230_schedule_error }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_family_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_specialist_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_outcome = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_specialist_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_lottery_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_refusal_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_ai_selected_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_230_requested_branch = 0 }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_230_work_high_source_exposure

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source: common/scripted_effects/fallout_world_end_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT WORLD END EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# One idempotent request coordinator owns Fallout entry, blackout sequencing,
# save reconciliation, generation-bound state receipts, and the rewrite pass.
# Public callers provide temporary request source and intensity variables.
# ============================================================================

# Timed flag duration fields do not accept script-constant tokens reliably.
# Keep this file-scoped literal aligned with
# constant:fallout_transition_timing.recovery_watch_days.
@FALLOUT_TRANSITION_RECOVERY_WATCH_DAYS = 1

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Request intake and validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
# Inputs:
# - fallout_request_source_input
# - fallout_request_intensity_input
# - optional COUNTRY event target fallout_request_actor_input
# - optional event target fallout_request_state_input
fallout_request_aftermath = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_dispatch_source = fallout_request_source_input }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_dispatch_intensity = fallout_request_intensity_input }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_request_dispatch_source > constant:fallout_request_source.none } } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_dispatch_source = constant:fallout_request_source.gradual_air_collapse }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_request_dispatch_intensity > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_dispatch_intensity = constant:fallout_request_intensity.standard }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { has_country_flag = is_global_host } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = is_global_host
				fallout_request_ledger_is_free = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.fallout_request_source = fallout_request_dispatch_source }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_request_intensity = fallout_request_dispatch_intensity }
			fallout_accept_request_envelope = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			fallout_request_ledger_is_free = yes
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_request_source = fallout_request_dispatch_source }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_request_intensity = fallout_request_dispatch_intensity }
		fallout_queue_request_envelope = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_accept_request_envelope = {
	fallout_queue_request_envelope = yes
	save_global_event_target_as = fallout_transition_coordinator
	fallout_validate_pending_request = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This records one request without appointing the
# caller as host. The existing host pulse claims and validates the envelope.
fallout_queue_request_envelope = {
	# Pause Air Cleanliness at the moment a valid request enters the shared
	# coordinator. This closes the host-reconciliation gap before the durable
	# transition lock is written. The temporary ownership flag is cleared again
	# if validation rejects the pending envelope.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled } }
		set_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
		set_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_request_paused
		air_contamination_apply_state_modifier = yes
	}
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_request_actor
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_request_state
	# A new request is admitted only while the ledger is free. Clear any stale
	# coordinator pointer before the host pulse claims this envelope.
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_transition_coordinator
	set_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
	set_variable = { global.fallout_request_date = global.date }
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = fallout_request_actor_input }
		event_target:fallout_request_actor_input = { save_global_event_target_as = fallout_request_actor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = fallout_request_state_input }
		event_target:fallout_request_state_input = { save_global_event_target_as = fallout_request_state }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This clears an uncommitted request without touching
# a completed cause-memory ledger or any active Fallout transition.
fallout_clear_pending_request_envelope = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_request_paused
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_request_locked }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_fallout }
		}
		clr_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_request_paused
		clr_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
		air_contamination_apply_state_modifier = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_request_source_is_strategic_singularity = yes
			has_event_target = fallout_request_actor
		}
		event_target:fallout_request_actor = {
			brilliant_scientist_recover_rejected_singularity_fallout_request = yes
		}
	}
	clr_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
	clear_variable = global.fallout_request_source
	clear_variable = global.fallout_request_intensity
	clear_variable = global.fallout_request_date
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_request_actor
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_request_state
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_transition_coordinator
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY or the existing global host. This is the single
# idempotent post-admission lock for Air Contamination. Request intake keeps
# its temporary pause separate so a rejected envelope can restore the system.
# Once Fallout owns the transition, the world is held at ninety-nine percent
# contamination. Further source deltas stop, while Air Winter remains a live
# consumer of the locked atmosphere after the transition pause ends.
fallout_enforce_permanent_air_contamination = {
	set_global_flag = fallout_air_contamination_permanent_99
	# Request intake uses the disabled marker only as a reversible transaction
	# pause. The permanent lock is a live system state, not a disabled system.
	clr_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled
	clr_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_request_paused
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.permanent_99_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_chem_states = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_bio_states = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_chem_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_bio_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_fallout_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.permanent_fallout_source_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_reservoir_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_natural_source_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_decay_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_last_delta_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	set_variable = { global.air_contamination_last_nuke_bp = constant:fallout_air_contamination_lock.zero_delta_bp }
	air_contamination_refresh_values = yes
	air_contamination_update_threshold_flags = yes
	air_contamination_apply_state_modifier = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY or the existing global host. This is the single
# idempotent post-admission lock. Treaty cleanup remains permanent, but Air
# Winter resumes against the locked atmosphere after transition processing.
fallout_lock_air_cleanliness_after_fallout_admission = {
	fallout_enforce_permanent_air_contamination = yes
	air_cleanliness_treaty_pause_for_fallout = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_validate_pending_request = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
			fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
			fallout_pending_request_is_valid = yes
		}
		fallout_lock_transition = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending }
		fallout_clear_pending_request_envelope = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_evaluate_air_contamination_request = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_disabled }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_air_cleanliness_disabled }
			fallout_consequence_enabled = yes
			check_variable = {
				var = global.air_contamination_bp
				value = constant:air_contamination_threshold_bp.irreversible_100
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_source_input = constant:fallout_request_source.gradual_air_collapse }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_intensity_input = constant:fallout_request_intensity.terminal }
		fallout_request_aftermath = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Dedicated system-owned settings control. The
# shared disabled-scenario array remains the single authoritative toggle ledger.
fallout_toggle_system_scenario_disabled = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { global.disabled_world_end_scenarios = constant:fallout_consequence_id.settings_ledger }
				is_in_array = { global.disabled_world_end_scenarios = constant:world_end_scenario_id.fallout }
			}
		}
		remove_from_array = { global.disabled_world_end_scenarios = constant:fallout_consequence_id.settings_ledger }
		remove_from_array = { global.disabled_world_end_scenarios = constant:world_end_scenario_id.fallout }
		fallout_evaluate_air_contamination_request = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_array = { global.disabled_world_end_scenarios = constant:fallout_consequence_id.settings_ledger }
		add_to_array = { global.disabled_world_end_scenarios = constant:world_end_scenario_id.fallout }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_lock_transition = {
	set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_generation = global.date }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.snapshot }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_schema_version = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version }
	clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version
	clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_air_winter_provenance
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_current_schema_receipts
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_supply_network_receipts
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_survival_inputs
	clr_global_flag = fallout_snapshot_prelock_capture_authorized
	fallout_clear_recoverable_player_snapshot_error = yes
	fallout_clear_recoverable_snapshot_error = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error } }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
	}
	set_global_flag = fallout_snapshot_prelock_capture_authorized
	fallout_rebuild_complete_snapshot_epoch = yes
	clr_global_flag = fallout_snapshot_prelock_capture_authorized
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_snapshot_epoch_is_ready_to_lock = yes }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
		set_global_flag = fallout_request_locked
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
		# The durable 99 percent lock is performed only after the snapshot is
		# ready and the request is locked. This preserves rejection recovery
		# before this boundary and freezes source deltas before blackout scheduling.
		fallout_lock_air_cleanliness_after_fallout_admission = yes
		fallout_stop_old_world_wars_at_admission = yes
		set_global_flag = world_end
		set_global_flag = world_end_fallout
		fallout_retire_legacy_final_silence_runtime = yes
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
		fallout_dispatch_blackout_audio = yes
		fallout_schedule_current_transition_phase = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				fallout_request_source_is_strategic_singularity = yes
				has_event_target = fallout_request_actor
			}
			event_target:fallout_request_actor = {
				brilliant_scientist_finalize_singularity_after_fallout_lock = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { fallout_request_source_is_manual = yes }
		fallout_clear_pending_request_envelope = yes
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dedicated blackout audio
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_dispatch_blackout_audio = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_blackout_audio_generation }
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_blackout_audio_generation
						value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.audio_generation
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_blackout_audio_generation = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.audio_generation }
			fallout_play_blackout_audio = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_blackout_gui_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_play_blackout_audio = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = settings_super_event_audio_volume
			check_variable = { settings_super_event_audio_volume = constant:settings_super_event_audio_volume.x0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		meta_effect = {
			text = { scoped_sound_effect = "fallout_world_end_blackout_sound_[VOLUME_SUFFIX]" }
			VOLUME_SUFFIX = "[GetFalloutWorldEndAudioVolumeToken]"
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save migration and coordinator recovery
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Retires the active Final Silence runtime flags in
# a stale save before the same request coordinator takes ownership. The
# completed cause-memory flag is deliberately preserved for history and
# achievements.
fallout_retire_legacy_final_silence_runtime = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = world_end_final_silence
				has_global_flag = world_end_final_silence_thermonuclear
				has_global_flag = world_end_final_silence_interrupted
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = world_end_final_silence
		clr_global_flag = world_end_final_silence_thermonuclear
		clr_global_flag = world_end_final_silence_interrupted
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_world_end_migrate_save = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = world_end_final_silence
				has_global_flag = world_end_final_silence_thermonuclear
			}
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_fallout }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
		}
		fallout_retire_legacy_final_silence_runtime = yes
		clr_global_flag = world_end
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_source_input = constant:fallout_request_source.final_silence }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_request_intensity_input = constant:fallout_request_intensity.maximum }
		fallout_request_aftermath = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = world_end_final_silence_interrupted
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end_fallout }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
		}
		fallout_retire_legacy_final_silence_runtime = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = world_end_fallout }
		fallout_retire_legacy_final_silence_runtime = yes
		fallout_lock_air_cleanliness_after_fallout_admission = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
				has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			}
			fallout_stop_old_world_wars_at_admission = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_transition_schema_version }
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
					value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = world_end_fallout
				has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_complete }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_snapshot_applied }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started }
				OR = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
						value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.previous_air_winter_provenance_version
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
						value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.previous_live_category_version
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
						value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.previous_market_access_reset_version
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
						value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.previous_supply_network_version
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
						value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.previous_survival_input_version
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_transition_phase
					value = constant:fallout_transition_phase.snapshot
					compare = equals
				}
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
					fallout_recoverable_player_snapshot_error_is_active = yes
					fallout_recoverable_snapshot_error_is_active = yes
				}
			}
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_schema_version = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_air_winter_provenance
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_current_schema_receipts
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_supply_network_receipts
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_survival_inputs
			clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version
			clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_transition_coordinator
			fallout_rebuild_complete_snapshot_epoch = yes
			fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = world_end_fallout
				has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_complete }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized }
				check_variable = {
					var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
					value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.previous_supply_network_version
					compare = equals
				}
				check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase > constant:fallout_transition_phase.snapshot }
				check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase < constant:fallout_transition_phase.player_continuation }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.state_grading }
					AND = {
						check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase > constant:fallout_transition_phase.state_grading }
						fallout_state_grading_rows_are_current = yes
						fallout_destructive_supply_network_live_matches_frozen_snapshot = yes
					}
				}
			}
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_schema_version = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_current_schema_receipts
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_supply_network_receipts
			clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version
			clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_transition_coordinator
			fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = world_end_fallout
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = fallout_active
					has_global_flag = fallout_transition_complete
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_active
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_map_return_applied
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_air_winter_provenance
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_current_schema_receipts
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_supply_network_receipts
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_legacy_completed_without_survival_inputs
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.complete }
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_schema_version = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = world_end_fallout
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_active }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_complete }
				NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_transition_schema_version }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked }
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_request_locked
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.snapshot }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.legacy_schema_state_unproven }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_request_source } }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.legacy_fallout }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_request_intensity } }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_request_intensity = constant:fallout_request_intensity.terminal }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation } }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_generation = global.date }
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_transition_coordinator
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
			fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
			fallout_dispatch_blackout_audio = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = world_end_fallout
				has_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_request_locked
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_transition_coordinator
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
			fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = world_end_fallout
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_request_locked
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.schema_migration_after_destruction }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.legacy_schema_state_unproven }
			}
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_request_source } }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.legacy_fallout }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_request_intensity } }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_request_intensity = constant:fallout_request_intensity.terminal }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation } }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_generation = global.date }
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_transition_coordinator
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
			fallout_dispatch_blackout_audio = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_schema_version = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version }
		}
	}
	fallout_reconcile_supply_network_schema_extension = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Schema 10 physical rows predate the province
# supply-network receipt. Before successor allocation starts, a later active
# phase may safely return to physical collapse and derive the missing receipt.
# Unrelated owned errors and any begun allocation remain untouched.
fallout_reconcile_supply_network_schema_extension = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized }
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_transition_schema_version
				value = constant:fallout_world_end_schema.version
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase > constant:fallout_transition_phase.physical_collapse }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase < constant:fallout_transition_phase.player_continuation }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version }
				NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version
						value = constant:fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema.version
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation
						value = global.fallout_transition_generation
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_physical_collapse_applied
		clr_global_flag = fallout_physical_collapse_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_government_sorting_applied
		clr_global_flag = fallout_government_sorting_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_technology_regression_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_survivor_allocation_applied
		clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version
		clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_built
					has_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_invalid
					has_variable = global.fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_generation
					has_variable = global.fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_schema_version
				}
			}
			fallout_reset_successor_conflict_inventory = yes
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.physical_collapse }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Called from the existing project-coordinator pulse.
# Authority-pointer repair may occur after a same-date host transfer. Manual,
# migration, transition scheduling, and request work remain once per date.
fallout_reconcile_coordinator = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = is_global_host }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
					has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
				}
				NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_transition_coordinator }
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_transition_coordinator
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
					has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
				}
				NOT = {
					event_target:fallout_transition_coordinator = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = is_global_host
					}
				}
			}
			clear_global_event_target = fallout_transition_coordinator
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_transition_coordinator
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_coordinator_last_reconcile_date }
					NOT = {
						check_variable = {
							var = global.fallout_coordinator_last_reconcile_date
							value = global.date
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { global.fallout_coordinator_last_reconcile_date = global.date }
			fallout_manual_reconcile = yes
			fallout_world_end_migrate_save = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
				air_cleanliness_treaty_pause_for_fallout = yes
			}
			fallout_event_scheduler_reconcile = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
				fallout_dispatch_blackout_audio = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
					fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
					NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled }
				}
				fallout_schedule_current_transition_phase = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = fallout_request_pending
					fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
				}
				fallout_validate_pending_request = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_schedule_current_transition_phase = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_event_delay_hours = constant:fallout_transition_timing.beat_hours }
		set_global_flag = {
			flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
			days = @FALLOUT_TRANSITION_RECOVERY_WATCH_DAYS
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.snapshot } }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.1001 hours = fallout_transition_event_delay_hours }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.state_grading } }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.1002 hours = fallout_transition_event_delay_hours }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.population_loss } }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.1003 hours = fallout_transition_event_delay_hours }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.physical_collapse } }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.1004 hours = fallout_transition_event_delay_hours }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.government_sorting } }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.1005 hours = fallout_transition_event_delay_hours }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.survivor_allocation } }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.1006 hours = fallout_transition_event_delay_hours }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.player_continuation } }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.1007 hours = fallout_transition_event_delay_hours }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.map_return } }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.1008 hours = fallout_transition_event_delay_hours }
		}
		else = {
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Snapshot and state grading
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_capture_player_countries = {
	fallout_clear_recoverable_player_snapshot_error = yes
	if = {
