		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_snapshot_complete } }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planning_initialized
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planning_blocked
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_materialization_required
		every_possible_country = {
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_player_country
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_source_anchor_preserved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_source_landless
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_preserved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continues_old_country
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_successor_choice_required
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_country_package_applied
			clr_country_flag = fallout_focus_package_applied
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_country_scope
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_country_id
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_capital_state
			clear_variable = fallout_player_snapshot_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_player_source_anchor_state
			clear_variable = fallout_player_primary_capital_state
			clear_variable = fallout_player_primary_target
			clear_variable = fallout_player_final_target
			clear_variable = fallout_player_commit_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_player_assignment_origin
			clear_variable = fallout_player_assignment_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_country_package_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_focus_package_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_player_continuation_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_player_continuation_status
			clear_variable = fallout_player_error_code
		}
		clear_array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		clear_array = global.fallout_player_primary_targets
		clear_array = global.fallout_player_committed_targets
		set_variable = { global.fallout_player_snapshot_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_player_planned_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_player_committed_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		every_state = {
			clr_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
			clr_state_flag = fallout_player_source_anchor
			clr_state_flag = fallout_player_continuation_reserved
			clr_state_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
			clear_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
			clear_variable = fallout_player_origin_id
			clear_variable = fallout_player_origin_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_player_reservation_origin
			clear_variable = fallout_player_reservation_generation
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				is_ai = no
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_player_country
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_country_scope = THIS }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_country_id = THIS.id }
			set_variable = { fallout_player_snapshot_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.none }
			set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.snapshotted }
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_id = constant:fallout_snapshot_limit.maximum_database_id }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_capital_is_owned = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_capital_exists = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_capital_state
			capital_scope = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_player_capital_state = THIS }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_capital_exists = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				if = {
					limit = { is_owned_by = PREV }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_id = THIS.id }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_scope = THIS }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_capital_is_owned = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_snapshot_capital_exists = constant:fallout_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_capital_state = fallout_snapshot_player_capital_state }
			}
			every_owned_state = {
				set_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
				set_variable = { fallout_player_origin_scope = PREV }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_origin_id = THIS.id }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_origin_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_candidate_state_id = THIS.id }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { fallout_snapshot_capital_is_owned = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_snapshot_candidate_state_id
							value = fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_id
							compare = less_than
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_id = fallout_snapshot_candidate_state_id }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_scope = THIS }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_id
						value = constant:fallout_snapshot_limit.maximum_database_id
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = fallout_player_source_anchor_preserved
				set_variable = { fallout_player_source_anchor_state = fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_scope }
				var:fallout_snapshot_anchor_state_scope = {
					set_state_flag = fallout_player_source_anchor
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = fallout_player_source_landless
			}
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries value = THIS }
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_player_snapshot_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_player_snapshot_ledger_is_current = yes }
			set_global_flag = fallout_player_snapshot_complete
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_snapshot_incomplete }
			fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The current scope is the relation target and the
# saved event target is the source. Inputs are temporary type and value fields.
fallout_record_bilateral_memory = {
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_relation_sources value = event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_relation_targets value = THIS }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_relation_types value = fallout_snapshot_relation_type }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_relation_values value = fallout_snapshot_relation_value }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Captures the live category independently from Air
# Winter's historical restoration baseline.
fallout_capture_pretransition_state_category = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded
	clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_state_category
	if = { limit = { has_state_category = megalopolis } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.megalopolis } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = metropolis } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.metropolis } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_city } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_city } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = city } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.city } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_town } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_town } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = town } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.town } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = rural } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.rural } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = pastoral } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.pastoral } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = large_island } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_island } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = small_island } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.small_island } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = tiny_island } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.tiny_island } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = enclave } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.enclave } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
	else_if = { limit = { has_state_category = wasteland } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.wasteland } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_take_world_snapshot = {
	fallout_clear_recoverable_snapshot_error = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_world_snapshot_complete } }
		every_possible_country = {
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_country
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_had_war
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_was_in_faction
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_was_subject
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_was_government_in_exile
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_democratic
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_communism
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_fascism
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_neutrality
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_had_purchase_contract
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_machine_continuity
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_machine_command_network
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_machine_emp_survival
			clr_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_religious_refuge_identity
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_country_scope
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_snapshot_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_overlord
		}
		clear_array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries
		clear_array = global.fallout_pretransition_relation_sources
		clear_array = global.fallout_pretransition_relation_targets
		clear_array = global.fallout_pretransition_relation_types
		clear_array = global.fallout_pretransition_relation_values
		every_country = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_country
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_country_scope = THIS }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_snapshot_generation = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation }
			add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries value = THIS }
			if = { limit = { has_war = yes } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_had_war }
			if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_was_in_faction }
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_was_subject
				set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_overlord = OVERLORD }
			}
			if = { limit = { is_government_in_exile = yes } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_was_government_in_exile }
			if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_democratic }
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_communism }
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_fascism }
			else = { set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_government_neutrality }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = brilliant_scientist_kruger_continuity_machine } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_machine_continuity }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = brilliant_scientist_singularity_live_command_network } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_machine_command_network }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_machine_emp_survival_verified } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_machine_emp_survival }
			if = { limit = { is_holy_realm_country = yes } set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_religious_refuge_identity }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			save_event_target_as = fallout_snapshot_relation_source
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_source_id = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_value = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_in_faction = yes
					NOT = { is_faction_leader = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.faction }
				faction_leader = { fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.subject }
				overlord = { fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { any_purchase_contract = { always = yes } }
				set_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_had_purchase_contract
			}
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_target_id = THIS.id }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_snapshot_relation_source_id
							value = fallout_snapshot_relation_target_id
							compare = less_than
						}
						event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source = { has_war_with = PREV }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.war }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_snapshot_relation_source_id
							value = fallout_snapshot_relation_target_id
							compare = less_than
						}
						OR = {
							civilwar_target = event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source
							event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source = { civilwar_target = PREV }
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.civil_war }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source = { has_guaranteed = PREV } }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.guarantee }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source = { has_military_access_to = PREV } }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.military_access }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_snapshot_relation_source_id
							value = fallout_snapshot_relation_target_id
							compare = less_than
						}
						event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = PREV }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.non_aggression_pact }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source = { is_embargoing = PREV } }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.embargo }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source = {
							has_collaboration = {
								target = PREV
								value > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.collaboration }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_volunteers_amount_from = {
							tag = event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source
							count > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.volunteers }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_snapshot_relation_source_id
							value = fallout_snapshot_relation_target_id
							compare = less_than
						}
						event_target:fallout_snapshot_relation_source = { has_market_access_with = PREV }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_snapshot_relation_type = constant:fallout_diplomacy_memory_type.market_access }
					fallout_record_bilateral_memory = yes
				}
			}
		}
		every_state = {
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_capital
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_player_owned_state
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_chemical_contamination
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_biological_contamination
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_direct_manual_target
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_coastal
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_provenance_recorded
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_greenhouse_provenance_recorded
			clr_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_state_category_recorded
			clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_intent_committed
			clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_node_collapse_settled
			clr_state_flag = fallout_rail_way_collapse_settled
			clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_evaluated
			clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_reconciled
			clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_applied
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_snapshot_supply_node
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_snapshot_rail_way
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_before_supply_node
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_before_rail_way
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_requested_supply_node
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_requested_rail_way
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_after_supply_node
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_after_rail_way
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_observed_supply_node
			clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_observed_rail_way
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_capital_country
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_player_owner
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_nuclear_fallout_intensity = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_schema_version
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_original_category
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_greenhouse_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_pretransition_state_category
			air_winter_record_original_category = yes
			air_winter_prepare_fallout_snapshot_source = yes
			fallout_capture_pretransition_state_category = yes
			set_variable = { fallout_original_owner_scope = OWNER }
			set_variable = { fallout_original_controller_scope = CONTROLLER }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_snapshot_generation = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_population_k = state_population_k }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_infrastructure = building_level@infrastructure }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_industrial_complex = building_level@industrial_complex }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_arms_factory = building_level@arms_factory }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_base = building_level@air_base }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_dockyard = building_level@dockyard }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_supply_node = building_level@supply_node }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_rail_way = building_level@rail_way }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_damaged_infrastructure = damaged_building_level@infrastructure }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_damaged_industrial_complex = damaged_building_level@industrial_complex }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_damaged_arms_factory = damaged_building_level@arms_factory }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_damaged_air_base = damaged_building_level@air_base }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_damaged_dockyard = damaged_building_level@dockyard }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_damaged_supply_node = damaged_building_level@supply_node }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_damaged_rail_way = damaged_building_level@rail_way }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_infrastructure = non_damaged_building_level@infrastructure }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_industrial_complex = non_damaged_building_level@industrial_complex }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_arms_factory = non_damaged_building_level@arms_factory }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_air_base = non_damaged_building_level@air_base }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_dockyard = non_damaged_building_level@dockyard }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_supply_node = non_damaged_building_level@supply_node }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_rail_way = non_damaged_building_level@rail_way }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_naval_base = non_damaged_building_level@naval_base }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_radar_station = non_damaged_building_level@radar_station }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_synthetic_refinery = non_damaged_building_level@synthetic_refinery }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_fuel_silo = non_damaged_building_level@fuel_silo }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_dam = non_damaged_building_level@dam }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_dam_mountain = non_damaged_building_level@dam_mountain }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_cataract_dam_mountain = non_damaged_building_level@cataract_dam_mountain }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_nuclear_reactor = non_damaged_building_level@nuclear_reactor }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_nuclear_reactor_heavy_water = non_damaged_building_level@nuclear_reactor_heavy_water }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_non_damaged_commercial_nuclear_reactor = non_damaged_building_level@commercial_nuclear_reactor }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_resource_oil = resource@oil }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_resource_aluminium = resource@aluminium }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_resource_rubber = resource@rubber }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_resource_tungsten = resource@tungsten }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_resource_chromium = resource@chromium }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_resource_steel = resource@steel }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_resource_coal = resource@coal }
			set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_days_since_bombing = days_since_last_strategic_bombing }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = nuclear_fallout_intensity } set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_nuclear_fallout_intensity = nuclear_fallout_intensity } }
			if = {
				limit = { air_winter_state_is_valid = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_receipt_is_current = yes }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.produced }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_schema_version = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_generation = air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase = air_winter_phase }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure = air_winter_exposure }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery = air_winter_recovery }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve = air_winter_food_reserve }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security = air_winter_water_security }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_original_category = air_winter_original_category }
					if = {
						limit = { has_state_flag = air_winter_greenhouse_refuge }
						set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_greenhouse_generation = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation }
						set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_greenhouse_provenance_recorded
					}
					set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_provenance_recorded
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_state_flag = air_winter_original_category_recorded
						has_variable = air_winter_original_category
						has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_schema_version
						has_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_generation
					}
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_kind = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_source_kind.not_applicable }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_schema_version = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_schema_version }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_source_generation = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.phase }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.exposure }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_recovery = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.recovery }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.adaptation }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.food_reserve }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.shelter_capacity }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.reclamation }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_water_security = constant:air_winter_fallout_snapshot_not_applicable.water_security }
					set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_original_category = air_winter_original_category }
					set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_provenance_recorded
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_capital = yes }
				set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_capital
				set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_capital_country = OWNER }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OWNER = { is_ai = no } }
				set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_player_owned_state
				set_variable = { fallout_pretransition_player_owner = OWNER }
			}
			if = { limit = { fallout_state_is_direct_manual_target = yes } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_direct_manual_target }
			if = { limit = { is_coastal = yes } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_coastal }
			if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = chem_state_contamination } } set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_chemical_contamination }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_state_flag = bioweapon_contaminated
						has_state_flag = bio_agent_1_active
						has_state_flag = bio_agent_2_active
						has_state_flag = bio_agent_3_active
						has_state_flag = bio_agent_4_active
					}
				}
				set_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_biological_contamination
			}
			set_state_flag = fallout_original_owner_recorded
			set_state_flag = fallout_original_controller_recorded
			# Air Winter fields above are frozen before pending branches are
			# cancelled. Delayed results can no longer mutate the snapshot.
			air_winter_event_cancel_pending_chain = yes
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source = global.fallout_request_source }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_intensity = global.fallout_request_intensity }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_chaos_meter_value = global.chaos_meter_value }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_air_contamination_bp = global.air_contamination_bp }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_date = global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_date }
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_world_snapshot_capture_rows_are_current = yes }
			set_global_flag = fallout_world_snapshot_complete
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.snapshot_incomplete }
			fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Verifies that the original live country-tag set
# still exists before map return. This never deletes a tag and does not require
# the original border or owner to survive.
fallout_verify_pretransition_tags_preserved = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_tag_preservation_complete }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_tag_preservation_generation
						value = global.fallout_transition_generation
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = fallout_tag_preservation_complete
		clear_variable = global.fallout_tag_preservation_generation
		clear_variable = global.fallout_tag_preservation_expected_count
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_pretransition_tag_rows_exist = yes }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_tag_preservation_expected_count = global.fallout_pretransition_countries^num }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_tag_preservation_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			every_country = {
				limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries value = THIS } }
				set_country_flag = fallout_tag_preservation_receipt
				set_variable = { fallout_tag_preservation_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_tag_preservation_complete
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.tag_preservation_failed }
			fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Player and world rows are always rebuilt in one
# effect-chain epoch. No caller may retry only one half of the frozen ledger.
fallout_rebuild_complete_snapshot_epoch = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_snapshot_epoch_rebuild_is_allowed = yes }
		fallout_clear_recoverable_player_snapshot_error = yes
		fallout_clear_recoverable_snapshot_error = yes
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_snapshot_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_world_snapshot_complete
		set_variable = { global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_snapshot_epoch_date = global.date }
		clear_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_schema_version
		clear_variable = global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_generation
		air_winter_begin_fallout_snapshot_production = yes
		if = {
			limit = { air_winter_fallout_snapshot_generation_is_open = yes }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_schema_version = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_schema_version }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_air_winter_ledger_generation = global.air_winter_fallout_snapshot_producer_generation }
		}
		fallout_capture_player_countries = yes
		fallout_take_world_snapshot = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.snapshot_incomplete }
		fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Output is the temporary variable
# fallout_expected_grade_score, calculated only from frozen snapshot inputs.
fallout_calculate_expected_grade_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_grade_request_component = global.fallout_pretransition_request_intensity }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_grade_request_component = constant:fallout_grade_weight.request_intensity }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = fallout_grade_request_component }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.final_silence } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.final_silence } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.chemical_saturation } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.chemical_saturation } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.biological_follow_through } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.biological_follow_through } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.mixed_terminal } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.mixed_terminal } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.strategic_singularity } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.strategic_singularity } }

	if = { limit = { has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_direct_manual_target } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.manual_native_strike } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_pretransition_nuclear_fallout_intensity
			check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_nuclear_fallout_intensity > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.nuclear_fallout_base }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_grade_nuclear_component = fallout_pretransition_nuclear_fallout_intensity }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_grade_nuclear_component = constant:fallout_grade_weight.nuclear_fallout_intensity }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = fallout_grade_nuclear_component }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_grade_winter_component = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_phase }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_grade_winter_component = constant:fallout_grade_weight.air_winter_phase }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = fallout_grade_winter_component }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_chemical_contamination } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.chemical_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_biological_contamination } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.biological_state } }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.city } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.city } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_city } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.large_city } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.metropolis } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.metropolis } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.megalopolis } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.megalopolis } }
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.enclave }
				check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.tiny_island }
				check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.small_island }
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.remote_category_relief }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_grade_factory_count = fallout_pretransition_industrial_complex }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_grade_factory_count = fallout_pretransition_arms_factory }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_grade_factory_count value = constant:fallout_grade_trigger.industrial_center_factories compare = greater_than } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.industrial_center }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_grade_factory_count value = constant:fallout_grade_trigger.major_industrial_center_factories compare = greater_than } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.major_industrial_center }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation > constant:fallout_grade_trigger.high_adaptation } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.high_adaptation_relief } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity > constant:fallout_grade_trigger.high_shelter } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_grade_score = constant:fallout_grade_weight.high_shelter_relief } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_expected_grade_score min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.maximum_score }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
fallout_grade_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_state_graded } }
		fallout_calculate_expected_grade_score = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_grade_score = fallout_expected_grade_score }

		set_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.remote_refuge }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_grade_score value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.vitrified_zone compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.vitrified_zone }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_grade_score value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.wasteland compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.wasteland }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_grade_score value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.dead_city compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_grade_score value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.ash_zone compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.ash_zone }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_grade_score value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.scarred_province compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.scarred_province }
		}

		set_variable = { fallout_state_subtype = constant:fallout_state_subtype.none }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.biological_follow_through }
					check_variable = { global.fallout_pretransition_request_source = constant:fallout_request_source.mixed_terminal }
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_grade_score
					value = constant:fallout_grade_threshold.altered_biosphere
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_state_subtype = constant:fallout_state_subtype.altered_biosphere }
			set_state_flag = fallout_altered_biosphere
		}
		fallout_calculate_state_survival_value = yes
		set_state_flag = fallout_state_graded
		set_variable = { fallout_state_grade_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { fallout_state_grading_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		fallout_reconcile_state_grading_receipt = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Output is the temporary variable
# fallout_expected_survival_value, calculated only from frozen snapshot inputs
# and the already reconciled grade.
fallout_calculate_expected_state_survival_value = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.maximum }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_grade_penalty = fallout_state_grade }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_grade_penalty = constant:fallout_survival_value.grade_penalty }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_grade_penalty }

	if = { limit = { has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_direct_manual_target } subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.manual_strike_penalty } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_pretransition_nuclear_fallout_intensity check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_nuclear_fallout_intensity > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.nuclear_fallout_penalty } }
	if = { limit = { has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_chemical_contamination } subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.chemical_penalty } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_biological_contamination }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.biological_penalty }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_winter_penalty = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_winter_penalty = constant:fallout_survival_value.winter_exposure_factor }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_winter_penalty }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_adaptation_bonus = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_adaptation_bonus = constant:fallout_survival_value.adaptation_factor }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_adaptation_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_shelter_bonus = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_shelter_bonus = constant:fallout_survival_value.shelter_factor }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_shelter_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_food_bonus = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_food_reserve }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_food_bonus = constant:fallout_survival_value.food_factor }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_food_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_reclamation_bonus = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_reclamation_bonus = constant:fallout_survival_value.reclamation_factor }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_reclamation_bonus }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_coastal } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.coastal_bonus } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_supply_node > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.supply_node_bonus }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_infrastructure_bonus = fallout_pretransition_infrastructure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_infrastructure_bonus = constant:fallout_survival_value.infrastructure_per_level }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_infrastructure_bonus }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_railway_bonus = fallout_pretransition_rail_way }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_railway_bonus = constant:fallout_survival_value.railway_per_level }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_railway_bonus }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_damaged_factory_penalty = fallout_pretransition_damaged_industrial_complex }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_damaged_factory_penalty = fallout_pretransition_damaged_arms_factory }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_damaged_factory_penalty = constant:fallout_survival_value.damaged_factory_penalty }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = fallout_survival_damaged_factory_penalty }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_population_k > constant:fallout_survival_value.very_high_population_threshold_k } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.very_high_population_penalty }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_population_k > constant:fallout_survival_value.high_population_threshold_k } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.high_population_penalty }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:fallout_original_controller_scope = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_had_war } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_survival_value = constant:fallout_survival_value.active_war_penalty }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = fallout_expected_survival_value
		min = constant:fallout_survival_value.minimum
		max = constant:fallout_survival_value.maximum
	}
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_survival_value
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This 0 to 100 ledger is intentionally independent
# from the damage grade and is used by continuation and successor selection.
fallout_calculate_state_survival_value = {
	fallout_calculate_expected_state_survival_value = yes
	set_variable = { fallout_survival_value = fallout_expected_survival_value }
	set_variable = { fallout_survival_value_date = global.date }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Safe before destruction. A bad grading row is fully
# rebuilt from its frozen source instead of calling a writer blocked by flags.
fallout_reset_state_grading_receipt_for_retry = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_state_graded
	clr_state_flag = fallout_altered_biosphere
	clr_state_flag = fallout_grade_score_reconciled
	clr_state_flag = fallout_survival_value_reconciled
	clear_variable = fallout_grade_score
	clear_variable = fallout_state_grade
	clear_variable = fallout_state_grade_date
	clear_variable = fallout_state_grading_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_state_subtype
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_value
	clear_variable = fallout_survival_value_date
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Recompute both derived values from the frozen row.
fallout_reconcile_state_grading_receipt = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_grade_score_reconciled
	clr_state_flag = fallout_survival_value_reconciled
	fallout_calculate_expected_grade_score = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_grade_score
			check_variable = { var = fallout_grade_score value = fallout_expected_grade_score compare = equals }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_grade_score_reconciled
	}
	fallout_calculate_expected_state_survival_value = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_survival_value
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_value value = fallout_expected_survival_value compare = equals }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_survival_value_reconciled
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Population, buildings, supply, and category conversion
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: STATE. Outputs are the temporary grade percentage and
# rounded request derived from frozen population.
fallout_calculate_population_loss_intent = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_loss_percent = constant:fallout_population_loss_percent.remote_refuge }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.scarred_province } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_loss_percent = constant:fallout_population_loss_percent.scarred_province } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.ash_zone } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_loss_percent = constant:fallout_population_loss_percent.ash_zone } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_loss_percent = constant:fallout_population_loss_percent.dead_city } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.wasteland } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_loss_percent = constant:fallout_population_loss_percent.wasteland } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.vitrified_zone } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_loss_percent = constant:fallout_population_loss_percent.vitrified_zone } }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_before_loss = fallout_pretransition_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_before_loss = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_population_before_loss
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_requested_loss = fallout_expected_population_before_loss }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_requested_loss = constant:fallout_runtime.percentage_scale }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_requested_loss = fallout_state_loss_percent }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_population_requested_loss
}

# Supported scope: STATE
fallout_apply_state_population_loss = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_state_graded
			NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_mutation_issued }
			NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_evaluated }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_manual_population_baseline_is_current = yes }
			fallout_manual_calculate_population_loss_intent = yes
		}
		else = { fallout_calculate_population_loss_intent = yes }
		clr_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_reconciled
		clr_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_deaths_evaluated
		clr_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_applied
		clr_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_zero
		set_variable = { fallout_population_loss_percent_applied = fallout_state_loss_percent }
		set_variable = { fallout_population_loss_requested_memory = fallout_expected_population_requested_loss }
		set_variable = { fallout_population_before_loss_k = state_population_k }
		set_variable = { fallout_population_before_loss_people = fallout_population_before_loss_k }
		multiply_variable = { fallout_population_before_loss_people = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
		round_variable = fallout_population_before_loss_people
		set_variable = { fallout_population_available_before_loss = fallout_population_before_loss_people }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_population_available_before_loss = constant:fallout_runtime.minimum_remaining_population }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = fallout_population_available_before_loss
			min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
		}
		round_variable = fallout_population_available_before_loss
		set_variable = { fallout_population_expected_loss = fallout_population_loss_requested_memory }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = fallout_population_expected_loss
			min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
			max = fallout_population_available_before_loss
		}
		round_variable = fallout_population_expected_loss
		clear_variable = fallout_population_loss_memory
		clear_variable = fallout_population_after_loss_people
		clear_variable = fallout_population_after_loss_k
		clear_variable = fallout_population_reconciled_loss
		clear_variable = fallout_population_before_loss_people_replay
		clear_variable = fallout_population_reconciled_total_people
		clear_variable = fallout_population_deaths_accounting_status
		clear_variable = fallout_population_deaths_total_before
		clear_variable = fallout_population_deaths_total_after
		clear_variable = fallout_population_deaths_total_delta
		clear_variable = fallout_population_deaths_sequence_before
		clear_variable = fallout_population_deaths_sequence_after
		clear_variable = fallout_population_deaths_sequence_delta
		clear_variable = fallout_population_state_deaths_before
		clear_variable = fallout_population_state_deaths_after
		clear_variable = fallout_population_state_deaths_delta
		set_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_mutation_issued
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_population_expected_loss > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started
			set_temp_variable = { state_population_transaction_loss = fallout_population_expected_loss }
			set_temp_variable = { state_population_transaction_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			apply_state_population_loss_without_recruitable_manpower_gain = yes
		}
		fallout_reconcile_population_loss_receipt = yes

		set_temp_variable = { state_population_transaction_loss = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { state_population_transaction_contract_supplied = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.unknown }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_is_civilian = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_apply_state_pop = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_record_state_ledger = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_target_country = OWNER }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_has_target_country = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_loss_percent = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This never applies population loss. It reconciles the
# one issued mutation from its live baseline, then registers only the exact
# observed delta through Deaths with state population application disabled.
fallout_reconcile_population_loss_receipt = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_reconciled
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_manual_population_baseline_is_current = yes }
		fallout_manual_calculate_population_loss_intent = yes
	}
	else = { fallout_calculate_population_loss_intent = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_available_from_live_baseline = fallout_population_before_loss_people }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_available_from_live_baseline = constant:fallout_runtime.minimum_remaining_population }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_expected_population_available_from_live_baseline min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_population_available_from_live_baseline
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_population_commit_from_live_baseline = fallout_expected_population_requested_loss }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = fallout_expected_population_commit_from_live_baseline
		min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
		max = fallout_expected_population_available_from_live_baseline
	}
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_population_commit_from_live_baseline
	set_variable = { fallout_population_after_loss_people = state_population_k }
	set_variable = { fallout_population_after_loss_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_variable = { fallout_population_after_loss_people = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
	round_variable = fallout_population_after_loss_people
	set_variable = { fallout_population_before_loss_people_replay = fallout_population_before_loss_k }
	multiply_variable = { fallout_population_before_loss_people_replay = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
	round_variable = fallout_population_before_loss_people_replay
	set_variable = { fallout_population_reconciled_loss = fallout_population_before_loss_people }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_population_reconciled_loss = fallout_population_after_loss_people }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_population_reconciled_loss min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	round_variable = fallout_population_reconciled_loss
	set_variable = { fallout_population_reconciled_total_people = fallout_population_after_loss_people }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_population_reconciled_total_people = fallout_population_reconciled_loss }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_mutation_issued
			check_variable = { var = fallout_population_loss_percent_applied value = fallout_state_loss_percent compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_population_loss_requested_memory value = fallout_expected_population_requested_loss compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_population_available_before_loss value = fallout_expected_population_available_from_live_baseline compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_population_expected_loss value = fallout_expected_population_commit_from_live_baseline compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_population_reconciled_loss value = fallout_expected_population_commit_from_live_baseline compare = equals }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_deaths_evaluated } }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_loss_memory = fallout_population_reconciled_loss }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = chaos_state_civilian_deaths_total } }
				set_variable = { chaos_state_civilian_deaths_total = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_total_before = global.chaos_meter_deaths_total }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_sequence_before = global.chaos_meter_deaths_sequence }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_state_deaths_before = chaos_state_civilian_deaths_total }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_accounting_status = constant:fallout_deaths_accounting_status.zero_loss }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_population_loss_memory > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
				set_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_accounting_status = constant:fallout_deaths_accounting_status.registered }
				set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = fallout_population_loss_memory }
				set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
				set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_is_civilian = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_apply_state_pop = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
				set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_record_state_ledger = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_target_country = var:fallout_original_owner_scope }
				set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_has_target_country = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				chaos_meter_register_deaths = yes
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_total_after = global.chaos_meter_deaths_total }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_total_delta = fallout_population_deaths_total_after }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_total_delta = fallout_population_deaths_total_before }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_sequence_after = global.chaos_meter_deaths_sequence }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_sequence_delta = fallout_population_deaths_sequence_after }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_population_deaths_sequence_delta = fallout_population_deaths_sequence_before }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_state_deaths_after = chaos_state_civilian_deaths_total }
			set_variable = { fallout_population_state_deaths_delta = fallout_population_state_deaths_after }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_population_state_deaths_delta = fallout_population_state_deaths_before }
			set_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_deaths_evaluated
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_population_deaths_accounting_receipt_is_durable = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_population_loss_memory > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
				set_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_applied
				clr_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_zero
			}
			else = {
				clr_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_applied
				set_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_zero
			}
			set_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_evaluated
			set_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_reconciled
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.unknown }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_is_civilian = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_apply_state_pop = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_record_state_ledger = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_target_country = OWNER }
	set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_has_target_country = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Output is the temporary damage fraction selected by
# the reconciled deterministic grade.
fallout_calculate_building_damage_fraction = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_fraction = constant:fallout_building_damage.remote_refuge }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.scarred_province } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_fraction = constant:fallout_building_damage.scarred_province } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.ash_zone } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_fraction = constant:fallout_building_damage.ash_zone } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_fraction = constant:fallout_building_damage.dead_city } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.wasteland } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_fraction = constant:fallout_building_damage.wasteland } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.vitrified_zone } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_fraction = constant:fallout_building_damage.vitrified_zone } }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The historical damage identifiers now record exact,
# permanent state-building level removal. Province buildings are handled by the
# separate selector-backed supply-network transaction.
fallout_apply_building_damage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_state_graded
			NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_mutation_issued }
		}
		fallout_calculate_building_damage_fraction = yes
		clr_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_reconciled
		clr_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_applied
		clear_variable = fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_infrastructure
		clear_variable = fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_industrial_complex
		clear_variable = fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_arms_factory
		clear_variable = fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_air_base
		clear_variable = fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_dockyard
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_before_infrastructure = building_level@infrastructure }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_before_industrial_complex = building_level@industrial_complex }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_before_arms_factory = building_level@arms_factory }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_before_air_base = building_level@air_base }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_before_dockyard = building_level@dockyard }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_available_infrastructure = fallout_building_damage_before_infrastructure }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_available_industrial_complex = fallout_building_damage_before_industrial_complex }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_available_arms_factory = fallout_building_damage_before_arms_factory }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_available_air_base = fallout_building_damage_before_air_base }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_available_dockyard = fallout_building_damage_before_dockyard }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_available_infrastructure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
		round_temp_variable = fallout_building_damage_levels
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_levels min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_infrastructure }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_infrastructure = fallout_building_damage_levels }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_available_industrial_complex }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
		round_temp_variable = fallout_building_damage_levels
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_levels min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_industrial_complex }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_industrial_complex = fallout_building_damage_levels }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_available_arms_factory }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
		round_temp_variable = fallout_building_damage_levels
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_levels min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_arms_factory }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_arms_factory = fallout_building_damage_levels }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_available_air_base }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
		round_temp_variable = fallout_building_damage_levels
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_levels min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_air_base }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_air_base = fallout_building_damage_levels }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_available_dockyard }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
		round_temp_variable = fallout_building_damage_levels
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_levels min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_dockyard }
		set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_dockyard = fallout_building_damage_levels }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_total = fallout_building_damage_requested_infrastructure }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_total = fallout_building_damage_requested_industrial_complex }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_total = fallout_building_damage_requested_arms_factory }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_total = fallout_building_damage_requested_air_base }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_total = fallout_building_damage_requested_dockyard }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_total > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_mutation_issued
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_infrastructure > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_requested_infrastructure }
			remove_building = { type = infrastructure level = fallout_building_damage_levels }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_industrial_complex > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_requested_industrial_complex }
			remove_building = { type = industrial_complex level = fallout_building_damage_levels }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_arms_factory > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_requested_arms_factory }
			remove_building = { type = arms_factory level = fallout_building_damage_levels }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_air_base > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_requested_air_base }
			remove_building = { type = air_base level = fallout_building_damage_levels }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_building_damage_requested_dockyard > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels = fallout_building_damage_requested_dockyard }
			remove_building = { type = dockyard level = fallout_building_damage_levels }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_evaluated
		fallout_reconcile_building_damage_receipt = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This never removes another level. It supports delayed
# engine visibility by observing the one issued permanent-loss transaction.
fallout_reconcile_building_damage_receipt = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_reconciled
	fallout_calculate_building_damage_fraction = yes
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_requested = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_observed = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_infrastructure = fallout_building_damage_available_infrastructure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_infrastructure = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_building_damage_infrastructure
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_expected_building_damage_infrastructure min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_infrastructure }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_infrastructure = building_level@infrastructure }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_infrastructure = non_damaged_building_level@infrastructure }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_infrastructure = fallout_building_damage_before_infrastructure }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_infrastructure = fallout_building_damage_after_infrastructure }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_infrastructure min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_requested = fallout_building_damage_requested_infrastructure }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_observed = fallout_building_damage_observed_infrastructure }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_industrial_complex = fallout_building_damage_available_industrial_complex }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_industrial_complex = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_building_damage_industrial_complex
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_expected_building_damage_industrial_complex min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_industrial_complex }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_industrial_complex = building_level@industrial_complex }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_industrial_complex = non_damaged_building_level@industrial_complex }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_industrial_complex = fallout_building_damage_before_industrial_complex }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_industrial_complex = fallout_building_damage_after_industrial_complex }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_industrial_complex min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_requested = fallout_building_damage_requested_industrial_complex }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_observed = fallout_building_damage_observed_industrial_complex }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_arms_factory = fallout_building_damage_available_arms_factory }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_arms_factory = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_building_damage_arms_factory
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_expected_building_damage_arms_factory min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_arms_factory }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_arms_factory = building_level@arms_factory }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_arms_factory = non_damaged_building_level@arms_factory }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_arms_factory = fallout_building_damage_before_arms_factory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_arms_factory = fallout_building_damage_after_arms_factory }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_arms_factory min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_requested = fallout_building_damage_requested_arms_factory }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_observed = fallout_building_damage_observed_arms_factory }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_air_base = fallout_building_damage_available_air_base }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_air_base = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_building_damage_air_base
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_expected_building_damage_air_base min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_air_base }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_air_base = building_level@air_base }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_air_base = non_damaged_building_level@air_base }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_air_base = fallout_building_damage_before_air_base }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_air_base = fallout_building_damage_after_air_base }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_air_base min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_requested = fallout_building_damage_requested_air_base }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_observed = fallout_building_damage_observed_air_base }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_dockyard = fallout_building_damage_available_dockyard }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_building_damage_dockyard = fallout_building_damage_fraction }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_expected_building_damage_dockyard
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_expected_building_damage_dockyard min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO max = fallout_building_damage_available_dockyard }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_dockyard = building_level@dockyard }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_after_non_damaged_dockyard = non_damaged_building_level@dockyard }
	set_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_dockyard = fallout_building_damage_before_dockyard }
