	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_building_damage_observed_dockyard = fallout_building_damage_after_dockyard }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_dockyard min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_requested = fallout_building_damage_requested_dockyard }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_observed = fallout_building_damage_observed_dockyard }

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_mutation_issued
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_requested_infrastructure value = fallout_expected_building_damage_infrastructure compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_infrastructure value = fallout_expected_building_damage_infrastructure compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_requested_industrial_complex value = fallout_expected_building_damage_industrial_complex compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_industrial_complex value = fallout_expected_building_damage_industrial_complex compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_requested_arms_factory value = fallout_expected_building_damage_arms_factory compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_arms_factory value = fallout_expected_building_damage_arms_factory compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_requested_air_base value = fallout_expected_building_damage_air_base compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_air_base value = fallout_expected_building_damage_air_base compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_requested_dockyard value = fallout_expected_building_damage_dockyard compare = equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_building_damage_observed_dockyard value = fallout_expected_building_damage_dockyard compare = equals }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_evaluated
		set_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_reconciled
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_building_damage_levels_requested > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_applied
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started
		}
		else = { clr_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_applied }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Dead-city and higher grades remove every province
# supply node and railway through the documented all-provinces selector. The
# row intent is immutable. Each family settles only after its exact zero target
# is visible. Retrying set-to-zero after an interrupted attempt is idempotent.
fallout_apply_supply_network_collapse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_state_grading_row_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_intent_committed }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_before_supply_node = building_level@supply_node }
		set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_before_rail_way = building_level@rail_way }
		set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_snapshot_supply_node = fallout_pretransition_supply_node }
		set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_snapshot_rail_way = fallout_pretransition_rail_way }
		clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_node_collapse_settled
		clr_state_flag = fallout_rail_way_collapse_settled
		clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_evaluated
		clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_reconciled
		clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_applied
		set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version = constant:fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema.version }
		set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_requested_supply_node = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_requested_rail_way = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_state_grade
					value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_requested_supply_node = fallout_supply_network_before_supply_node }
			set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_requested_rail_way = fallout_supply_network_before_rail_way }
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_after_supply_node
		clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_after_rail_way
		clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_observed_supply_node
		clear_variable = fallout_supply_network_observed_rail_way
		set_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_intent_committed
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_intent_committed
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_state_grade
				value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			NOT = { fallout_state_supply_node_surface_is_zero = yes }
		}
		clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_node_collapse_settled
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_intent_committed
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_state_grade
				value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			NOT = { fallout_state_rail_way_surface_is_zero = yes }
		}
		clr_state_flag = fallout_rail_way_collapse_settled
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_intent_committed
			NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_supply_node_collapse_settled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				fallout_state_grading_row_is_current = yes
				check_variable = { fallout_state_grade < constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city }
			}
			set_state_flag = fallout_supply_node_collapse_settled
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				fallout_state_grading_row_is_current = yes
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_state_grade
					value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_state_supply_node_surface_is_zero = yes } }
				set_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started
				set_building_level = {
					type = supply_node
					level = 0
					province = {
						all_provinces = yes
						limit_to_border = no
						level > 0
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_state_supply_node_surface_is_zero = yes }
				set_state_flag = fallout_supply_node_collapse_settled
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_intent_committed
			NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_rail_way_collapse_settled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				fallout_state_grading_row_is_current = yes
				check_variable = { fallout_state_grade < constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city }
			}
			set_state_flag = fallout_rail_way_collapse_settled
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				fallout_state_grading_row_is_current = yes
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_state_grade
					value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_state_rail_way_surface_is_zero = yes } }
				set_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started
				set_building_level = {
					type = rail_way
					level = 0
					province = {
						all_provinces = yes
						limit_to_border = no
						level > 0
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_state_rail_way_surface_is_zero = yes }
				set_state_flag = fallout_rail_way_collapse_settled
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_intent_committed
			has_state_flag = fallout_supply_node_collapse_settled
			has_state_flag = fallout_rail_way_collapse_settled
		}
		fallout_reconcile_supply_network_collapse_receipt = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This records the settled idempotent network result.
# It never calls either engine mutation.
fallout_reconcile_supply_network_collapse_receipt = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_evaluated
	clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_reconciled
	clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_applied
	set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_after_supply_node = building_level@supply_node }
	set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_after_rail_way = building_level@rail_way }
	set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_observed_supply_node = fallout_supply_network_before_supply_node }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_supply_network_observed_supply_node = fallout_supply_network_after_supply_node }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_supply_network_observed_supply_node min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { fallout_supply_network_observed_rail_way = fallout_supply_network_before_rail_way }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_supply_network_observed_rail_way = fallout_supply_network_after_rail_way }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_supply_network_observed_rail_way min = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_state_supply_network_collapse_payload_is_exact = yes }
		set_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_evaluated
		set_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_reconciled
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_state_grade
					value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_supply_network_before_supply_node > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
					check_variable = { fallout_supply_network_before_rail_way > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
				}
			}
			set_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_applied
		}
		else = { clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_network_collapse_applied }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
fallout_apply_state_grade_modifier = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_evaluated } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.scarred_province } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_1_state }
			set_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_applied
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.ash_zone } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_2_state }
			set_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_applied
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_3_state }
			set_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_applied
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.wasteland } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_4_state }
			set_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_applied
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_state_grade = constant:fallout_state_grade.vitrified_zone } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_5_state }
			set_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_applied
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_state_subtype
					value = constant:fallout_state_subtype.altered_biosphere
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_altered_biosphere_state }
			set_state_flag = fallout_altered_biosphere_modifier_applied
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_evaluated
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Dynamic modifiers are safe to rebuild because the
# effect first removes every Fallout-owned grade surface.
fallout_reset_state_grade_modifier_receipt_for_retry = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_evaluated
	clr_state_flag = fallout_grade_modifier_applied
	clr_state_flag = fallout_altered_biosphere_modifier_applied
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_1_state }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_2_state }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_3_state }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_4_state }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_5_state }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_grade_6_state }
	remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_altered_biosphere_state }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. Output is the temporary category enum selected from
# the frozen live category and reconciled Fallout grade.
fallout_calculate_expected_state_category = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = fallout_pretransition_state_category }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_state_grade
				value = constant:fallout_state_grade.wasteland
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.wasteland }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_state_grade
				value = constant:fallout_state_grade.ash_zone
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.megalopolis } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.metropolis } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.metropolis } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_city } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_city } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.city } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.city } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_town } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_town } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.town } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.town } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.rural } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.rural } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.pastoral } }
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The category token is static, so the calculated enum
# selects one explicit engine effect.
fallout_apply_expected_state_category = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.wasteland } } set_state_category = wasteland }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.enclave } } set_state_category = enclave }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.tiny_island } } set_state_category = tiny_island }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.small_island } } set_state_category = small_island }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.pastoral } } set_state_category = pastoral }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.rural } } set_state_category = rural }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.town } } set_state_category = town }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_town } } set_state_category = large_town }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.city } } set_state_category = city }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_city } } set_state_category = large_city }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.metropolis } } set_state_category = metropolis }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.megalopolis } } set_state_category = megalopolis }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_expected_state_category = constant:air_winter_state_category.large_island } } set_state_category = large_island }
}

# Supported scope: STATE
fallout_convert_state_category = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_mutation_issued } }
		fallout_calculate_expected_state_category = yes
		clr_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_applied
		clr_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_target_reconciled
		set_variable = { fallout_category_conversion_target = fallout_expected_state_category }
		set_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_mutation_issued
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_category_conversion_target
						value = fallout_pretransition_state_category
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started
			fallout_apply_expected_state_category = yes
			set_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_applied
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_state_grade
					value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_state_flag = fallout_supply_collapsed
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_evaluated
		fallout_reconcile_state_category_receipt = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE. This never applies another category effect. It
# recomputes and reconciles the stored target, then observes the live result.
fallout_reconcile_state_category_receipt = {
	clr_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_target_reconciled
	fallout_calculate_expected_state_category = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_mutation_issued
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_category_conversion_target
				value = fallout_expected_state_category
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_target_reconciled
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_category_conversion_target
					value = fallout_pretransition_state_category
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			clr_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_applied
		}
		else = {
			set_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_applied
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_state_grade
				value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_supply_collapsed
	}
	else = { clr_state_flag = fallout_supply_collapsed }
	set_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_evaluated
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input is the temporary variable
# fallout_transition_error_to_register. The first owned failure retains the
# global code and count until its exact recovery contract clears it.
fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error } }
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = fallout_transition_error_to_register }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Clear only the exact pre-destruction snapshot
# failure before rebuilding the frozen ledger.
fallout_clear_recoverable_snapshot_error = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_snapshot_error_is_active = yes }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	}
}

		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The blackout owns an immediate war-stop receipt so
# no old combat can continue while the later diplomacy transaction completes.
# The later full reset still owns subjects, access, trade, intelligence, and
# its exhaustive postconditions.
fallout_stop_old_world_wars_at_admission = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_wars_stopped_at_admission }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_transition_wars_stopped_at_admission_generation
						value = global.fallout_transition_generation
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = white_peace_suppress_standard_chaos_on_peace
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_government_in_exile = yes }
			end_exile = THIS
		}
		every_country = {
			every_other_country = {
				limit = {
					has_volunteers_amount_from = {
						tag = PREV
						count > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
					}
				}
				PREV = { recall_volunteers_from = PREV }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { civilwar_target = PREV }
				remove_civil_war_target = PREV
				if = {
					limit = { has_war_with = PREV }
					white_peace = PREV
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			every_enemy_country = { white_peace = PREV }
		}
		clr_global_flag = white_peace_suppress_standard_chaos_on_peace
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_wars_stopped_at_admission
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_wars_stopped_at_admission_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This is a one-time coordinator transaction. It is
# safe to retry after a peace conference or a partially applied save.
fallout_reset_old_world_diplomacy = {
	fallout_clear_recoverable_peace_conference_error = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_truce_reset_days = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_diplomacy_validation_failed
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_diplomacy_reset_applied
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_wars_stopped_complete
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_wars_stopped_generation
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_old_world_diplomacy_proven_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_exiles_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_volunteers_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_civil_wars_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_wars_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_truces_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_subjects_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_factions_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_guarantees_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_military_access_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_non_aggression_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_collaboration_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_purchase_contracts_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_embargoes_reset_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_docking_rights_reset_applied
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_docking_rights_reset_verified
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_docking_rights_reset_generation
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_docking_rights_verification_generation
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_applied
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_verified
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_market_access_reset_generation
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_market_access_verification_generation
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_applied
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_verified
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_generation
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_resource_rights_verification_generation
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_lend_lease_reset_verified
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_lend_lease_verification_generation
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_trade_routes_reset_verified
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_intelligence_reset_verified
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_expeditionaries_reset_verified
	clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_expeditionaries_verification_generation
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_blocked
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_blocked
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_expeditionaries_reset_blocked
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_docking_rights_validation_blocked
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_lend_lease_reset_blocked
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_trade_routes_reset_blocked
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_intelligence_reset_blocked
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_unprovable_diplomacy_surface
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { is_in_peace_conference = yes } }
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_peace_conference_reset_blocked
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.peace_conference_active }
		fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
	}
	else = {
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_peace_conference_reset_blocked
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_diplomacy_reset_applied
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_destructive_started
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_government_in_exile = yes }
			end_exile = THIS
		}
		every_country = {
			every_other_country = {
				limit = {
					has_volunteers_amount_from = {
						tag = PREV
						count > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
					}
				}
				PREV = { recall_volunteers_from = PREV }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			every_purchase_contract = { cancel_purchase_contract = yes }
		}
		every_country = {
			every_other_country = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_collaboration = {
							target = PREV
							value > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
						}
					}
					set_collaboration = {
						target = PREV
						value = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = white_peace_suppress_standard_chaos_on_peace
		every_country = {
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { civilwar_target = PREV }
				remove_civil_war_target = PREV
				if = {
					limit = { has_war_with = PREV }
					white_peace = PREV
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			every_enemy_country = { white_peace = PREV }
		}
		clr_global_flag = white_peace_suppress_standard_chaos_on_peace
		# White peace can create a truce. Clear every old-world truce
		# after war settlement, then require the official readback below.
		every_country = {
			every_other_country = {
				limit = { has_truce_with = PREV }
				meta_effect = {
					text = {
						set_truce = {
							target = PREV
							days = [FALLOUT_TRUCE_RESET_DAYS]
						}
					}
					FALLOUT_TRUCE_RESET_DAYS = "[?fallout_truce_reset_days|.0]"
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				overlord = { end_puppet = PREV }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
			dismantle_faction = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			every_other_country = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_guaranteed = PREV }
					diplomatic_relation = {
						country = PREV
						relation = guarantee
						active = no
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_military_access_to = PREV }
					diplomatic_relation = {
						country = PREV
						relation = military_access
						active = no
					}
				}
				diplomatic_relation = {
					country = PREV
					relation = docking_rights
					active = no
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_market_access_with = PREV }
					diplomatic_relation = {
						country = PREV
						relation = market_access_rights
						active = no
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = PREV }
					diplomatic_relation = {
						country = PREV
						relation = non_aggression_pact
						active = no
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_embargoing = PREV }
					diplomatic_relation = {
						country = PREV
						relation = embargo
						active = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# Docking rights have no documented readback trigger. The official
		# diplomatic relation effect defines active = no as cancellation, and
		# the ordered pair sweep applies that inverse in both directions for
		# every live country pair. Bind the exhaustive application receipt to
		# this transition generation instead of inventing a detector.
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_docking_rights_reset_applied
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_docking_rights_reset_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_docking_rights_reset_verified
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_docking_rights_verification_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_docking_rights_validation_blocked
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_applied
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_market_access_reset_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		# Resource rights are stored on the receiving country for a state. Sweep
		# every live country-state pair so ownership and control changes do not
		# leave an old-world extraction grant behind.
		every_state = {
			every_country = {
				remove_resource_rights = PREV
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_applied
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }

		if = {
			limit = { fallout_old_world_diplomacy_proven_surfaces_are_clean = yes }
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_exiles_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_volunteers_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_civil_wars_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_wars_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_truces_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_subjects_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_factions_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_guarantees_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_military_access_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_non_aggression_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_collaboration_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_purchase_contracts_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_embargoes_reset_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_old_world_diplomacy_proven_complete
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_wars_stopped_complete
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_wars_stopped_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_diplomacy_validation_failed
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.old_world_diplomacy_incomplete }
			fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_country = {
						any_other_country = { has_market_access_with = PREV }
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_verified
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_market_access_verification_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_blocked
		}
		else = {
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_verified
			clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_market_access_verification_generation
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_market_access_reset_blocked
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_state = {
						any_country = { has_resources_rights = { state = PREV } }
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_verified
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_resource_rights_verification_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_blocked
		}
		else = {
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_verified
			clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_resource_rights_verification_generation
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_resource_rights_reset_blocked
		}

		# The engine exposes an exact ordered-country-pair detector for outgoing
		# lend lease, but no documented scripted inverse. A clean world can be
		# proven. Any active lease remains blocked rather than being approximated.
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_country = {
						any_other_country = { is_lend_leasing = PREV }
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_lend_lease_reset_verified
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_lend_lease_verification_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_lend_lease_reset_blocked
		}
		else = {
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_lend_lease_reset_verified
			clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_lend_lease_verification_generation
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_lend_lease_reset_blocked
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					any_country = {
						any_other_country = {
							received_expeditionary_forces = {
								sender = PREV
								value > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_expeditionaries_reset_verified
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_expeditionaries_verification_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_expeditionaries_reset_blocked
		}
		else = {
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_expeditionaries_reset_verified
			clear_variable = global.fallout_transition_expeditionaries_verification_generation
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_expeditionaries_reset_blocked
		}

		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_trade_routes_reset_blocked
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_intelligence_reset_blocked
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_unprovable_diplomacy_surface
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.unprovable_diplomacy_surface }
		fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
}

# Supported scope: STATE. The frozen original owner receives deterministic
# origin signal counts even if current ownership changes before classification.
fallout_record_state_government_origin_signals = {

	}

		limit = { fallout_state_supports_bunker_origin = yes }

		var:fallout_original_owner_scope = { add_to_variable = { fallout_archetype_maritime_state_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one } }

		var:fallout_original_owner_scope = { add_to_variable = { fallout_archetype_quarantine_state_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one } }

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Selection uses a fixed specificity order and an
# evidence-bound continuity branch. It records identity only. Politics,
# packages, focuses, leaders, units, and AI remain allocation-owned surfaces.
fallout_classify_country_government = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_country
			NOT = { fallout_country_government_classification_is_current = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_government_classifier_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_government_classifier_schema_version = constant:fallout_government_classifier_schema.version }

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_archetype_hostable_state_count > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_country_survives
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_machine_protocol_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.machine_protocol }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_has_machine_protocol_claim = yes }
				set_country_flag = fallout_government_archetype_unresolved
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_mutant_polity_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.mutant_polity }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_religious_refuge_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.religious_refuge }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_quarantine_state_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.quarantine_state }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_bunker_authority_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.bunker_authority }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_warlord_command_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.warlord_command }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_technate_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.technate }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_food_compact_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.food_compact }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_maritime_remnant_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_scavenger_syndicate_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.scavenger_syndicate }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_nomad_convoy_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.nomad_convoy }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { fallout_country_is_continuity_government_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government }
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = fallout_government_archetype_unresolved
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = fallout_government_origin_archetype
					NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_government_origin_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government } }
				}
				set_country_flag = fallout_emergency_government
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_dead_tag_memory
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_variable = fallout_government_origin_archetype
					has_country_flag = fallout_dead_tag_memory
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_country_classified
		}
	}
}

}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A future allocator must call this once while the
# pre-allocation inventory is still fully current and before its first mutation.
fallout_begin_successor_allocation_transaction = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_ready }
			fallout_physical_collapse_rows_are_durable = yes
			has_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete
			fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes
			has_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_built
			fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_is_current = yes
		}
		fallout_reset_successor_allocation_ledger = yes
		set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_allocation_source_inventory_generation = global.fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_generation }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_allocation_source_inventory_schema = constant:fallout_successor_inventory_schema.version }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_allocation_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_allocation_schema_version = constant:fallout_successor_allocation_schema.version }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_assignment_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_global_flag = fallout_successor_preallocation_consumed
		set_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The completion flag is written only after every
# post-allocation row, package layer, capital, source, conflict, and cleanup
# record passes the current-generation proof.
fallout_finalize_successor_allocation_transaction = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_successor_allocation_ledger_postconditions_are_met = yes }
		set_global_flag = fallout_successor_assignment_ledger_built
		set_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_complete
	}
}
