	}
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_country_has_live_event_package_ownership = yes }
		set_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_event_package_owned
	}
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { is_capital = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_counter = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_counter = constant:fallout_runtime.one } }
			set_variable = { PREV.fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_state = THIS }
			if = {
				limit = { CONTROLLER = { exists = yes } }
				set_variable = { PREV.fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_controller = CONTROLLER }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_count = fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_counter }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_state
			has_variable = fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_controller
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_live_tag_conflict_capital_valid
	}
}

# Supported scope: STATE
fallout_record_successor_state_inventory_row = {
	set_state_flag = fallout_successor_state_inventory_recorded
	set_variable = { fallout_successor_state_inventory_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	if = {
		limit = { OWNER = { exists = yes } }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_state_inventory_owner = OWNER }
		if = {
			limit = { OWNER = { is_ai = no } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_successor_state_inventory_owner_human
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OWNER = { fallout_country_has_live_event_package_ownership = yes } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_successor_state_inventory_owner_event_package
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { CONTROLLER = { exists = yes } }
		set_variable = { fallout_successor_state_inventory_controller = CONTROLLER }
		if = {
			limit = { CONTROLLER = { is_ai = no } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_successor_state_inventory_controller_human
		}
		if = {
			limit = { CONTROLLER = { fallout_country_has_live_event_package_ownership = yes } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_successor_state_inventory_controller_event_package
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_state_can_host_government = yes }
		set_state_flag = fallout_successor_state_inventory_hostable
	}
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_state_has_current_player_reservation = yes }
		set_state_flag = fallout_successor_state_inventory_player_reserved
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_player_reserved_states value = THIS }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_player_reserved_state_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_successor_state_is_candidate = yes }
		set_state_flag = fallout_successor_candidate_queued
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_successor_candidate_states value = THIS }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_successor_candidate_state_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.fallout_successor_inventory_state_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Preserve an earlier transition error instead of
# replacing a more specific failure with an inventory symptom.
fallout_mark_successor_inventory_invalid = {
	set_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_invalid
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error } }
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.successor_inventory_invalid }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A clean rebuild may recover the single inventory
# error. Other transition errors keep their original code and count.
fallout_clear_recoverable_successor_inventory_error = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_successor_inventory_error_is_active = yes }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. This creates a frozen, generation-bound inventory.
# It does not assign successor tags, packages, archetypes, or focus content.
fallout_build_successor_conflict_ledger = {
	fallout_clear_recoverable_successor_inventory_error = yes
	fallout_reset_successor_conflict_inventory = yes
	set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_schema_version = constant:fallout_successor_inventory_schema.version }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_all_possible_country_scope_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_candidate_state_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_player_reserved_state_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_successor_inventory_state_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_countries value = THIS }
		fallout_record_live_tag_conflict_row = yes
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_live_tag_conflict_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	every_collection_element = {
		input = { input = game:all_possible_countries }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_all_possible_country_scopes value = THIS }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_all_possible_country_scope_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	every_state = {
		fallout_record_successor_state_inventory_row = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_is_current = yes }
		set_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_built
	}
	else = {
		fallout_mark_successor_inventory_invalid = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Reserve every state that belonged to this human at
# snapshot time before the general successor inventory is frozen.
fallout_reserve_player_origin_states = {
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
			has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
			has_variable = fallout_player_origin_generation
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_player_origin_generation
				value = global.fallout_transition_generation
				compare = equals
			}
			var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_player_continuation_reserved
		set_variable = { fallout_player_reservation_origin = PREV }
		set_variable = { fallout_player_reservation_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The former capital wins when it is still hostable.
# Otherwise the highest survival value wins with the lowest state id as the
# deterministic final tie breaker.
fallout_select_player_primary_capital = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_capital_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_best_survival = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_best_state_id = constant:fallout_snapshot_limit.maximum_database_id }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_pretransition_capital_state }
		var:fallout_pretransition_capital_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
					has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
					var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
					fallout_state_can_host_government = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_primary_capital_scope = THIS }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_capital_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_player_capital_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
				has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
				has_variable = fallout_player_origin_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_player_origin_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
				var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
				fallout_state_can_host_government = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_candidate_survival = fallout_survival_value }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_candidate_state_id = THIS.id }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_player_candidate_survival
							value = fallout_player_best_survival
							compare = greater_than
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { fallout_player_candidate_survival = fallout_player_best_survival }
							check_variable = {
								var = fallout_player_candidate_state_id
								value = fallout_player_best_state_id
								compare = less_than
							}
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_best_survival = fallout_player_candidate_survival }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_best_state_id = fallout_player_candidate_state_id }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_primary_capital_scope = THIS }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_capital_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_player_capital_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one } }
		set_country_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
		set_variable = { fallout_player_primary_capital_state = fallout_player_primary_capital_scope }
		var:fallout_player_primary_capital_scope = {
			set_state_flag = fallout_player_continuation_reserved
			set_state_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
			set_variable = { fallout_player_reservation_origin = PREV }
			set_variable = { fallout_player_reservation_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Clears only retryable player-commit errors. Other
# transition failures retain ownership of the global error ledger.
fallout_clear_recoverable_player_commit_errors = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_player_commit_error_is_active = yes }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_commit_incomplete }
					check_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_assignment_collision }
					check_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_tag_switch_failed }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
			clear_variable = fallout_player_error_code
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.committed }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned
					has_country_flag = fallout_player_continues_old_country
				}
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.primary_reserved }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.materialized }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_successor_choice_required }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.choice_pending }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.snapshotted }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Pass one claims every structurally addressable
# existing and proposed target before strict validation. No player switch
# occurs unless every snapshotted human has one ready and unique target.
fallout_preflight_player_commit_targets = {
	clr_global_flag = fallout_player_commit_preflight_complete
	every_country = {
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_existing_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_ready_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_invalid_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_collision_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }

	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = fallout_player_final_target
					has_variable = fallout_player_commit_generation
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_player_commit_generation
						value = global.fallout_transition_generation
						compare = equals
					}
					var:fallout_player_final_target = { exists = yes }
				}
				var:fallout_player_final_target = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed }
						set_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target
						set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_collision_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
					}
					else = { set_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_player_continuation_commit_is_valid = yes }
				add_to_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_existing_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_invalid_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.error }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_commit_incomplete }
			}
		}
	}

	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = fallout_player_primary_target
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_player_snapshot_generation
						value = global.fallout_transition_generation
						compare = equals
					}
					var:fallout_player_primary_target = { exists = yes }
				}
				var:fallout_player_primary_target = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed }
						set_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target
						set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_collision_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
					}
					else = { set_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_player_primary_target_is_commit_ready = yes }
				add_to_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_ready_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_invalid_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.error }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_commit_incomplete }
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed
						has_variable = fallout_player_final_target
						var:fallout_player_final_target = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target }
					}
					AND = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
						has_variable = fallout_player_primary_target
						var:fallout_player_primary_target = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target }
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
			set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.error }
			set_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_assignment_collision }
		}
	}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_total_count = fallout_player_preflight_existing_count }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_total_count = fallout_player_preflight_ready_count }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_invalid_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_collision_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_player_preflight_total_count
				value = global.fallout_player_snapshot_count
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_player_commit_preflight_complete
	}
	else = {
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_player_preflight_collision_found > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_assignment_collision }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_commit_incomplete }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Pass two is called only after the global preflight.
# It records the durable origin ledger before an optional player tag switch and
# commits only after the target is proven human controlled.
fallout_commit_current_player_primary_target = {
	set_variable = { fallout_player_final_target = fallout_player_primary_target }
	set_variable = { fallout_player_commit_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.choice_submitted }
	var:fallout_player_primary_target = {
		set_variable = { fallout_player_assignment_origin = PREV }
		set_variable = { fallout_player_assignment_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { tag = PREV } }
			change_tag_from = PREV
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:fallout_player_final_target = {
				is_ai = no
				has_variable = fallout_player_assignment_origin
				has_variable = fallout_player_assignment_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_player_assignment_origin
					value = PREV
					compare = equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_player_assignment_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		var:fallout_player_final_target = { set_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_committed }
		set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
		clear_variable = fallout_player_error_code
		set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.committed }
	}
	else = {
		var:fallout_player_final_target = {
			clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_committed
			clear_variable = fallout_player_assignment_origin
			clear_variable = fallout_player_assignment_generation
		}
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed
		clear_variable = fallout_player_final_target
		clear_variable = fallout_player_commit_generation
		set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
		set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.error }
		set_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_tag_switch_failed }
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_tag_switch_failed }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_commit_ready_player_continuations = {
	fallout_clear_recoverable_player_commit_errors = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error } }
		fallout_preflight_player_commit_targets = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_commit_preflight_complete }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed } }
				fallout_commit_current_player_primary_target = yes
			}
		}
	}
	clr_global_flag = fallout_player_commit_preflight_complete
	every_country = {
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Rebuilds committed targets from persisted player
# records and proves that no two players claim the same final country.
fallout_rebuild_player_commit_ledger = {
	clear_array = global.fallout_player_committed_targets
	set_variable = { global.fallout_player_committed_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_commit_complete
	clr_global_flag = fallout_player_assignment_uniqueness_verified
	every_country = {
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_invalid_commit_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_assignment_collision_found = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }

	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed
				has_variable = fallout_player_final_target
				has_variable = fallout_player_commit_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = fallout_player_commit_generation
					value = global.fallout_transition_generation
					compare = equals
				}
				var:fallout_player_final_target = { exists = yes }
			}
			var:fallout_player_final_target = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed }
					set_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_assignment_collision_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				}
				else = { set_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed }
			}
		}
	}

	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_player_continuation_commit_is_valid = yes }
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
						check_variable = {
							var = fallout_player_error_code
							value = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_commit_incomplete
							compare = equals
						}
					}
					clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
					clear_variable = fallout_player_error_code
					set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.committed }
				}
				var:fallout_player_final_target = { add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_player_committed_targets value = THIS } }
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_player_committed_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_player_invalid_commit_found = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
				set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.error }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_commit_incomplete }
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed
				has_variable = fallout_player_final_target
				var:fallout_player_final_target = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target }
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
			set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.error }
			set_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_assignment_collision }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_claimed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_player_assignment_collision_target
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_player_assignment_collision_found > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_assignment_collision }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_player_invalid_commit_found > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				check_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_commit_incomplete }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_player_snapshot_count
				value = global.fallout_player_committed_count
				compare = equals
			}
			all_of_scopes = {
				array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
				fallout_player_continuation_commit_is_valid = yes
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_commit_complete
		set_global_flag = fallout_player_assignment_uniqueness_verified
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Rebuild the planning array from durable source rows
# so retries cannot duplicate targets or inflate the planned count.
fallout_rebuild_player_planning_ledger = {
	clear_array = global.fallout_player_primary_targets
	set_variable = { global.fallout_player_planned_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
	clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_ledger_complete
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_player_planning_row_is_current = yes }
			var:fallout_player_primary_target = {
				add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_player_primary_targets value = THIS }
			}
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_player_planned_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_player_planning_rows_are_current = yes }
		set_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_ledger_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planning_blocked
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_materialization_required
	}
	else = {
		set_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planning_blocked
		set_global_flag = fallout_player_materialization_required
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Called only by the guarded public resolver before
# the successor allocation transaction consumes the reservation ledger.
fallout_resolve_player_continuation_ledger_before_allocation = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_player_reservation_error_is_active = yes }
		fallout_clear_recoverable_player_reservation_error = yes
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planning_initialized
	}
	else = { fallout_clear_recoverable_player_reservation_error = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planning_initialized } }
		clear_array = global.fallout_player_primary_targets
		clear_array = global.fallout_player_committed_targets
		set_variable = { global.fallout_player_planned_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_player_committed_count = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_ledger_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planning_blocked
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_materialization_required
		every_state = {
			clr_state_flag = fallout_player_continuation_reserved
			clr_state_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
			clear_variable = fallout_player_reservation_origin
			clear_variable = fallout_player_reservation_generation
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
			fallout_reserve_player_origin_states = yes
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_player_persisted_assignment_can_rebuild_reservation = yes }
				set_country_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
				set_variable = { fallout_player_primary_target = fallout_player_final_target }
				var:fallout_player_final_target = {
					capital_scope = {
						set_state_flag = fallout_player_continuation_reserved
						set_state_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
						set_variable = { fallout_player_reservation_origin = PREV.PREV }
						set_variable = { fallout_player_reservation_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
						set_variable = { PREV.PREV.fallout_player_primary_capital_state = THIS }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed
					fallout_player_continuation_commit_is_valid = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned
				var:fallout_player_final_target = {
					add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_player_committed_targets value = THIS }
					capital_scope = {
						set_state_flag = fallout_player_continuation_reserved
						set_state_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
						set_variable = { fallout_player_reservation_origin = PREV.PREV }
						set_variable = { fallout_player_reservation_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.fallout_player_committed_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
				set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_error
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.error }
				set_variable = { fallout_player_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_commit_incomplete }
				clr_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_commit_complete
				clr_global_flag = fallout_player_assignment_uniqueness_verified
			}
			else = {
				clr_country_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
				clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_preserved
				clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continues_old_country
				clr_country_flag = fallout_player_successor_choice_required
				clr_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned
				clear_variable = fallout_player_primary_capital_state
				clear_variable = fallout_player_primary_target
				clear_variable = fallout_player_continuation_branch
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.snapshotted }
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planning_initialized
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_pretransition_player_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
				fallout_player_source_has_survivable_origin_state = yes
				has_country_flag = fallout_player_source_anchor_preserved
			}
			fallout_select_player_primary_capital = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
				has_country_flag = fallout_player_primary_capital_reserved
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_preserved
			set_country_flag = fallout_player_continues_old_country
			set_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned
			set_variable = { fallout_player_primary_target = THIS }
			set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.surviving_tag }
			set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.primary_reserved }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_planned }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_player_continuation_committed }
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_player_successor_choice_required
			set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_status = constant:fallout_player_continuation_status.choice_pending }
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_state = {
						has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
						has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
						var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
						has_variable = fallout_state_subtype
						check_variable = { fallout_state_subtype = constant:fallout_state_subtype.altered_biosphere }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.altered_transformation }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					any_state = {
						has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
						has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
						var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
						has_state_flag = fallout_pretransition_coastal
						check_variable = { fallout_pretransition_dockyard > @CR_SC_FALLOUT_RUNTIME_ZERO }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.refuge_government }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					any_state = {
						has_state_flag = fallout_player_origin_state
						has_variable = fallout_player_origin_scope
						var:fallout_player_origin_scope = { tag = PREV.PREV }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.fragmented_tag }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { fallout_player_continuation_branch = constant:fallout_player_continuation_branch.emergency_council }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes }
		set_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete
	}
	else = {
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_reservation_incomplete }
		fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
	}
	fallout_rebuild_player_planning_ledger = yes
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_register_changed_player_reservation_after_allocation = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_player_reservation_error_is_active = yes }
		fallout_clear_recoverable_player_reservation_error = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_reservation_changed_after_allocation }
	fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Consumed reservation inputs are immutable. A
# changed row after allocation begins owns an exact fail-closed error instead
# of rebuilding player targets or state reservations.
fallout_resolve_player_continuation_ledger = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete }
					NOT = { fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes }
				}
			}
			fallout_register_changed_player_reservation_after_allocation = yes
		}
	}
	else = { fallout_resolve_player_continuation_ledger_before_allocation = yes }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Blackout phase effects
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_advance_transition_phase = {
	set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = fallout_transition_next_phase }
	add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_schema_migration_blocked }
			check_variable = {
				var = global.fallout_transition_phase
				value = constant:fallout_transition_phase.complete
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		fallout_schedule_current_transition_phase = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_apply_transition_phase_snapshot = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_player_snapshot_complete
			NOT = { fallout_player_snapshot_ledger_is_current = yes }
		}
		clr_global_flag = fallout_player_snapshot_complete
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_world_snapshot_complete
			NOT = { fallout_world_snapshot_rows_are_current = yes }
		}
		clr_global_flag = fallout_world_snapshot_complete
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_recoverable_player_snapshot_error_is_active = yes
				fallout_recoverable_snapshot_error_is_active = yes
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_snapshot_complete }
				NOT = { fallout_player_snapshot_ledger_is_current = yes }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_world_snapshot_complete }
				NOT = { fallout_world_snapshot_rows_are_current = yes }
			}
		}
		fallout_rebuild_complete_snapshot_epoch = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			has_global_flag = fallout_player_snapshot_complete
			fallout_player_snapshot_ledger_is_current = yes
			has_global_flag = fallout_world_snapshot_complete
			fallout_world_snapshot_rows_are_current = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_snapshot_applied
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_next_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.state_grading }
		fallout_advance_transition_phase = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_apply_transition_phase_state_grading = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_recoverable_state_grading_error_is_active = yes
			}
		}
		fallout_clear_recoverable_state_grading_error = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_state_grading_complete
				NOT = { fallout_state_grading_rows_are_current = yes }
			}
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_state_grading_applied
			clr_global_flag = fallout_state_grading_complete
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_state_grading_rows_are_current = yes } }
			every_state = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_state_grading_row_is_current = yes } }
				fallout_reset_state_grading_receipt_for_retry = yes
				fallout_grade_state = yes
				fallout_reconcile_state_grading_receipt = yes
				if = {
					limit = { fallout_state_grading_components_are_current = yes }
					set_variable = { fallout_state_grading_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				fallout_world_snapshot_rows_are_current = yes
				fallout_state_grading_rows_are_current = yes
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_state_grading_applied
			set_global_flag = fallout_state_grading_complete
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.state_grading_incomplete }
			fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_state_grading_applied
			has_global_flag = fallout_state_grading_complete
			fallout_world_snapshot_rows_are_current = yes
			fallout_state_grading_rows_are_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_next_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.population_loss }
		fallout_advance_transition_phase = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_apply_transition_phase_population_loss = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_recoverable_population_loss_error_is_active = yes
			}
		}
		fallout_clear_recoverable_population_loss_error = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_population_loss_complete
				NOT = { fallout_population_loss_rows_are_current = yes }
			}
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_population_loss_applied
			clr_global_flag = fallout_population_loss_complete
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_population_loss_rows_are_current = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_manual_population_reconciliation_is_required = yes }
				fallout_manual_preflight_population_contract = yes
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { fallout_manual_population_contract_preflight_is_current = yes } }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.manual_population_contract_unproven }
					fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				NOT = { fallout_population_loss_rows_are_current = yes }
			}
			every_state = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_population_loss_row_is_current = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_population_loss_mutation_issued } }
					fallout_apply_state_population_loss = yes
				}
				else = { fallout_reconcile_population_loss_receipt = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { fallout_population_loss_components_are_current = yes }
					set_variable = { fallout_population_loss_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_population_loss_rows_are_current = yes }
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_population_loss_applied
			set_global_flag = fallout_population_loss_complete
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.population_loss_incomplete }
			fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_population_loss_applied
			has_global_flag = fallout_population_loss_complete
			fallout_population_loss_rows_are_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_next_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.physical_collapse }
		fallout_advance_transition_phase = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_apply_transition_phase_physical_collapse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_recoverable_physical_collapse_error_is_active = yes
			}
		}
		fallout_clear_recoverable_physical_collapse_error = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = fallout_physical_collapse_complete
				NOT = { fallout_physical_collapse_rows_are_current = yes }
			}
			clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_physical_collapse_applied
			clr_global_flag = fallout_physical_collapse_complete
			clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version
			clear_variable = global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_physical_collapse_rows_are_current = yes } }
			every_state = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_physical_collapse_row_is_current = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_building_damage_mutation_issued } }
					fallout_apply_building_damage = yes
				}
				else = { fallout_reconcile_building_damage_receipt = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { fallout_state_supply_network_collapse_receipt_is_current = yes } }
					fallout_apply_supply_network_collapse = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = fallout_category_conversion_mutation_issued } }
					fallout_convert_state_category = yes
				}
				else = { fallout_reconcile_state_category_receipt = yes }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { fallout_state_grade_modifier_receipt_is_current = yes }
							NOT = { fallout_state_subtype_modifier_receipt_is_current = yes }
						}
					}
					fallout_reset_state_grade_modifier_receipt_for_retry = yes
					fallout_apply_state_grade_modifier = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { fallout_physical_collapse_components_are_current = yes }
					set_variable = { fallout_state_rewrite_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_physical_collapse_rows_are_current = yes }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema_version = constant:fallout_supply_network_collapse_schema.version }
			set_variable = { global.fallout_supply_network_collapse_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_physical_collapse_rows_are_durable = yes }
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_physical_collapse_applied
			set_global_flag = fallout_physical_collapse_complete
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.physical_collapse_incomplete }
			fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_physical_collapse_applied
			has_global_flag = fallout_physical_collapse_complete
			fallout_physical_collapse_rows_are_durable = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_next_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.government_sorting }
		fallout_advance_transition_phase = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_apply_transition_phase_government_sorting = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_recoverable_peace_conference_error_is_active = yes
			}
		}
		fallout_reset_old_world_diplomacy = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_government_sorting_applied }
			fallout_old_world_diplomacy_full_reset_is_verified = yes
		}
		random_faction_cleanup_after_world_end = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries
			fallout_prepare_country_government_classification = yes
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = fallout_original_owner_scope
				var:fallout_original_owner_scope = { has_country_flag = fallout_pretransition_country }
			}
			fallout_record_state_government_origin_signals = yes
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries
			fallout_classify_country_government = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_technology_regression_complete } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries
				fallout_regress_country_technology = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_all_live_country_technology_rows_are_current = yes }
				set_global_flag = fallout_technology_regression_complete
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.technology_regression_incomplete }
				fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				any_of_scopes = {
					array = global.fallout_pretransition_countries
					has_country_flag = fallout_government_archetype_unresolved
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.government_archetype_unresolved }
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			fallout_government_sorting_is_current = yes
			has_global_flag = fallout_technology_regression_complete
			fallout_all_live_country_technology_rows_are_current = yes
		}
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_government_sorting_applied
			set_global_flag = fallout_government_sorting_complete
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_government_sorting_applied
			has_global_flag = fallout_government_sorting_complete
			fallout_government_sorting_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_next_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.survivor_allocation }
		fallout_advance_transition_phase = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_apply_transition_phase_survivor_allocation = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_survival_ledger_identity_error_is_active = yes }
		fallout_recover_uncommitted_survival_ledger_identity_transaction = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_recoverable_survival_ledger_numerical_error_is_active = yes }
		fallout_recover_uncommitted_survival_ledger_numerical_transaction = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete }
				NOT = { fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes }
			}
		}
		fallout_register_changed_player_reservation_after_allocation = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_recoverable_player_reservation_error_is_active = yes
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete }
				NOT = { fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes }
			}
		}
		fallout_resolve_player_continuation_ledger = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_recoverable_successor_inventory_error_is_active = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_allocation_initialized }
			has_global_flag = fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_complete
			fallout_player_allocation_reservation_ledger_is_current = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_built }
				NOT = { fallout_successor_conflict_ledger_is_current = yes }
			}
		}
		fallout_build_successor_conflict_ledger = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			fallout_player_planning_ledger_is_current = yes
			fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_ready }
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_initialization_status = constant:fallout_event_initialization_status.survival_ledger_pending }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_survival_ledger_identity_is_current = yes } }
			fallout_stage_survival_ledger_identity_transaction = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_survival_ledger_identity_is_current = yes
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_survival_ledger_ready }
			}
			fallout_commit_survival_ledger_numerical_transaction = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			fallout_player_planning_ledger_is_current = yes
			fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes
			fallout_survival_ledger_transition_barrier_is_current = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_survivor_allocation_applied
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_survivor_allocation_applied
			fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes
			fallout_survival_ledger_transition_barrier_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_next_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.player_continuation }
		fallout_advance_transition_phase = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_apply_transition_phase_player_continuation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			NOT = { fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes }
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.successor_allocation_incomplete }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes
			NOT = { fallout_survival_ledger_transition_barrier_is_current = yes }
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.survival_ledger_incomplete }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				fallout_recoverable_player_commit_error_is_active = yes
			}
			fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes
			fallout_survival_ledger_transition_barrier_is_current = yes
		}
		fallout_clear_recoverable_player_commit_errors = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_ledger_complete } }
			set_global_flag = fallout_transition_error
			set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_code = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.player_reservation_changed_after_allocation }
			add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_error_count = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
				has_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_ledger_complete
			}
			fallout_commit_ready_player_continuations = yes
			fallout_rebuild_player_commit_ledger = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_error }
			fallout_successor_allocation_is_current = yes
			fallout_survival_ledger_transition_barrier_is_current = yes
			has_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_ledger_complete
			has_global_flag = fallout_player_continuation_commit_complete
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_player_continuation_applied
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_next_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.map_return }
		fallout_advance_transition_phase = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY
fallout_apply_transition_phase_map_return = {
	fallout_clear_recoverable_map_postcondition_error = yes
	fallout_verify_pretransition_tags_preserved = yes
	fallout_apply_fracture_contract = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_map_return_applied }
			fallout_map_return_postconditions_are_met = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_map_return_applied
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_map_return_blocked
		set_global_flag = fallout_active
		every_country = {
			fallout_generic_focus_assign_region = yes
			fallout_generic_focus_activate = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_complete
		set_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_initialization_pending
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_initialization_status = constant:fallout_event_initialization_status.map_return_pending }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_start_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_timeline_start_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_cause_memory_source = global.fallout_request_source }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_cause_memory_intensity = global.fallout_request_intensity }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_cause_memory_date = global.fallout_request_date }
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = fallout_request_actor }
			event_target:fallout_request_actor = { save_global_event_target_as = fallout_cause_actor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = fallout_request_state }
			event_target:fallout_request_state = { save_global_event_target_as = fallout_cause_state }
		}
		clear_global_event_target = fallout_request_actor
		clear_global_event_target = fallout_request_state
		clear_variable = global.fallout_request_source
		clear_variable = global.fallout_request_intensity
		clear_variable = global.fallout_request_date
		clr_global_flag = fallout_request_locked
		set_variable = { global.fallout_transition_phase = constant:fallout_transition_phase.complete }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_phase_event_scheduled
		clr_global_flag = fallout_transition_active
		clear_global_event_target = fallout_transition_coordinator
	}
	else = {
		set_global_flag = fallout_transition_map_return_blocked
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.map_postcondition_failed }
		fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_transition_dirty = constant:fallout_runtime.one }
		fallout_mark_blackout_gui_dirty = yes
	}
}

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source: common/scripted_effects/fallout_generic_focus_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# Runtime helpers for the single post-Fallout focus tree. The activation gate
# is generation-bound so a repeated transition request cannot load the tree
# twice or carry its route variables into a later Fallout generation.
# ============================================================================

fallout_generic_focus_initialize_values = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_generic_authority } } set_variable = { fallout_generic_authority = constant:fallout_generic_focus.initial_authority } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_generic_cohesion } } set_variable = { fallout_generic_cohesion = constant:fallout_generic_focus.initial_cohesion } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_generic_frontier_pressure } } set_variable = { fallout_generic_frontier_pressure = constant:fallout_generic_focus.initial_frontier_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_generic_regional_influence } } set_variable = { fallout_generic_regional_influence = constant:fallout_generic_focus.initial_regional_influence } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_generic_memory } } set_variable = { fallout_generic_memory = constant:fallout_generic_focus.initial_memory } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_generic_route_id } } set_variable = { fallout_generic_route_id = constant:fallout_generic_focus.minimum } }
	set_variable = { fallout_generic_focus_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_generic_authority min = constant:fallout_generic_focus.minimum max = constant:fallout_generic_focus.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_generic_cohesion min = constant:fallout_generic_focus.minimum max = constant:fallout_generic_focus.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_generic_frontier_pressure min = constant:fallout_generic_focus.minimum max = constant:fallout_generic_focus.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_generic_regional_influence min = constant:fallout_generic_focus.minimum max = constant:fallout_generic_focus.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_generic_memory min = constant:fallout_generic_focus.minimum max = constant:fallout_generic_focus.maximum }
}

fallout_generic_focus_assign_region = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = fallout_region_id }
				check_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.none }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = north_america } }
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.north_america }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = south_america } }
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.latin_america_caribbean }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = europe } }
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.europe }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = middle_east } }
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.middle_east_north_africa }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = africa } }
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.sub_saharan_africa }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = asia } }
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.east_asia }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = australia } }
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.oceania_remote_islands }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { fallout_region_id = constant:fallout_region.eurasian_interior }
		}
	}
}

	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_generic_cohesion min = constant:fallout_generic_focus.minimum max = constant:fallout_generic_focus.maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_generic_memory min = constant:fallout_generic_focus.minimum max = constant:fallout_generic_focus.maximum }
}

fallout_generic_focus_claim_frontier = {
	every_owned_state = {
		every_neighbor_state = {
			limit = {
				always = yes
				NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				owner = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
			}
			add_claim_by = ROOT
		}
	}

fallout_generic_focus_issue_border_ultimatum = {
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_generic_frontier_owner
	random_owned_state = {
		every_neighbor_state = {
			limit = {
				always = yes
				NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				owner = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
			}
			owner = { save_global_event_target_as = fallout_generic_frontier_owner }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = fallout_generic_frontier_owner }
		create_wargoal = {
			type = annex_everything
			target = event_target:fallout_generic_frontier_owner
			expire = constant:fallout_generic_focus.wargoal_expiry_days
		}
	}
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_generic_frontier_owner
}

	}

		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		set_country_flag = fallout_generic_focus_tree_loaded
		fallout_generic_focus_initialize_values = yes
	}
}

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_296_viability value = constant:fallout_event_296_threshold.leave_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_296_frozen_shelter value = constant:fallout_event_296_threshold.leave_partial_shelter compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_viability_component = 0 }
}

fallout_event_296_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_296_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_296_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_296_branch.veteran_home } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.veteran_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.veteran_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.veteran_scrap }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_296_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_296_branch.research_clinic } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.research_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.research_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.research_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_296_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_296_branch.memorial_hall } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.memorial_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.memorial_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.memorial_recognition }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.leave_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.leave_shelter }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.leave_scrap }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_296_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

fallout_event_296_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_296_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_296_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_296_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_296_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_296_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_296_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_medicine = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_shelter = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_generation = fallout_generation_change_count }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_ward_296_capacity } set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_capacity = fallout_ward_296_capacity } }
		else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_capacity = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_ward_296_research } set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_research = fallout_ward_296_research } }
		else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_research = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_ward_296_trust } set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_trust = fallout_ward_296_trust } }
		else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_trust = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_ward_296_exposure } set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_exposure = fallout_ward_296_exposure } }
		else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_296_frozen_exposure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		fallout_event_296_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_296_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_296_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_296_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.empty_ward_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.empty_ward_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_296_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_296_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_296_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_296_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_296_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.empty_ward_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_296_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_callback_cleanup_ticket
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_selected_branch = fallout_event_296_requested_branch }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_result_outcome = fallout_event_296_calculated_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_registry_owner = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.empty_ward_candidate_id }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_296_registry_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_296_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_296_memory_opened
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_296_schedule_error
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_medicine
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_shelter
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_cohesion
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_recognition
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_generation
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_capacity
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_research
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_trust
				clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_exposure
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_296_schedule_error
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_medicine
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_shelter
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_capacity
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_research
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_trust
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_exposure
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_opening_event_token = 0 }
}

fallout_event_296_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_296_branch.none }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ward_296_trust }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_ward_296_trust value = constant:fallout_event_296_threshold.ai_veteran_trust compare = less_than }
			}
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.veteran_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.veteran_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.veteran_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_296_branch.veteran_home }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ward_296_research }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_ward_296_research value = constant:fallout_event_296_threshold.ai_research_level compare = less_than }
			}
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.research_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.research_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.research_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_296_branch.research_clinic }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_296_threshold.ai_memorial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.memorial_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.memorial_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.memorial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_296_branch.memorial_hall }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 value = constant:fallout_event_296_threshold.ai_leave_shelter compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.leave_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.leave_shelter compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_296_cost.leave_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_296_branch.leave_ward }
	}
	fallout_event_296_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_296_pay_branch_cost = yes }
