fallout_event_296_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_296_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_296_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_296_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_296_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_296_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_296_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_296_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_296_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_296_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_296_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_296_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_296_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_medicine
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_shelter
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_capacity
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_research
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_trust
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_frozen_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_296_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_296_cleanup_ticket = 0 }

fallout_event_796_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_796_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.engineer_vote compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.engineer_vote_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.engineer_vote_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.engineer_vote_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.public_council compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.public_council_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.public_council_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.public_council_cohesion }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.military_oversight compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.military_oversight_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.military_oversight_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.military_oversight_medicine }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.universal_vote_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.universal_vote_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_796_cost.universal_vote_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_796_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

}

	fallout_event_796_initialize_ledgers = yes

	set_variable = { fallout_event_796_registry_owner = ROOT }

	set_variable = { fallout_event_796_registry_target = fallout_event_796_target_state_id }

	set_variable = { fallout_event_796_frozen_technician_capacity = fallout_engineer_franchise_technician_capacity }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_796_frozen_scrap_reserve = fallout_engineer_franchise_scrap_reserve }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_796_frozen_neighbor_state_id = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:fallout_event_796_target_state_id = {
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_owner = OWNER }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_controller = CONTROLLER }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_supply = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_exposure = air_winter_exposure }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		every_neighbor_state = {
			limit = {
				always = yes
				NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				owner = { exists = yes }
				fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_neighbor_state_id value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = THIS.id value = ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_neighbor_state_id compare = less_than }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_frozen_neighbor_state_id = THIS.id }

fallout_event_796_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_796_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_796_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_796_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.engineer_vote compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.choice_engineer_vote } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.public_council compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.choice_public_council } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.military_oversight compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.choice_military_oversight } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.choice_universal_vote } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.engineer_vote compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.engineer_vote_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.engineer_vote_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.engineer_vote_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.public_council compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.public_council_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.public_council_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.public_council_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.military_oversight compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.military_oversight_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.military_oversight_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.military_oversight_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.universal_vote_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.universal_vote_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.universal_vote_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_796_log.callback_success } }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_796_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_796_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_796_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_796_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }

				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_engineer_franchise_register_failure }

				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_engineer_franchise_engineer_vote }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.public_council compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_engineer_franchise_public_council }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_796_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_796_branch.military_oversight compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_engineer_franchise_military_oversight }
			}
			else = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_engineer_franchise_universal_vote } }
		}
	}

fallout_event_796_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_engineer_franchise_engineering_legitimacy_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_engineer_franchise_public_trust }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_engineer_franchise_power_budget }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_engineer_franchise_grid_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_engineer_franchise_class_pressure_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_engineer_franchise_technician_capacity }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_engineer_franchise_scrap_reserve }
	var:fallout_event_796_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_796_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_796_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_796_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_796_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_796_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_796_callback_score
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. Builds one generation-bound candidate
# registry row set per Fallout country. State targets are selected by the
# lowest valid native state id, and a missing native source omits that row.
fallout_event_build_pilot_candidate_registries = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_event_registry_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_registry_member
				fallout_event_registry_country_row_is_current = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_candidate_registry_reviewed }
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_candidate_registry_generation }
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_candidate_registry_generation value = fallout_event_runtime_generation compare = equals } }
				}
			}
			fallout_event_clear_candidate_rows_for_rebuild = yes

			# The country-level food row is always available after the numerical
			# registry is current. Its chain carries no invented state target.
			fallout_event_initialize_pilot_candidate_row = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.food_candidate_id }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.food_transaction_key }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_cooldown_family = constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.food_security }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_human_token = constant:fallout_event_id.last_inventory_human }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_ai_token = constant:fallout_event_id.last_inventory_ai }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_resource_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.food }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_route = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.food_route }
			fallout_event_append_pilot_candidate_row = yes

			# Names for the Missing is admitted only after a country has recorded a
			# material civilian death count and its recognition ledger still shows an
			# incomplete census. The row has no state target or invented actor.
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_event_269_country_is_current = yes }
				fallout_event_initialize_pilot_candidate_row = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.names_missing_candidate_id }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.names_missing_transaction_key }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_class = constant:fallout_event_class.crisis_incident }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_cooldown_family = constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.cause_memory }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_human_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_human }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_ai_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_ai }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.first_winter_year }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_269_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_candidate_severity = chaos_meter_deaths_country_civilian_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_candidate_severity = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.deaths_to_severity }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_candidate_severity min = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero max = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.maximum_candidate_severity }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_mechanic_pressure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_severity = fallout_event_269_candidate_severity }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_state_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_state_value_source = constant:fallout_survival_resource.recognition }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_mechanic_pressure_source = constant:fallout_event_pressure_source_type.survival_resource }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_severity_source = constant:fallout_event_pressure_source_type.survival_resource }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_resource_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.recognition }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_required_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.recognition }

					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_target = fallout_event_859_candidate_state_id }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_route = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.repair_charter_route }
					fallout_event_append_pilot_candidate_row = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_state_candidate_id = 0 }
				clear_variable = fallout_event_859_candidate_state_id
			}
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_candidate_state_id
			# Power as Citizenship follows a closed Repair Charter district.
			# It selects the lowest native host so public service, engineer state,
			# grid empire, and machine transition branches resolve against one authenticated regional state.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = fallout_government_archetype
					OR = {
						check_variable = { var = fallout_government_archetype value = constant:fallout_government_archetype.technate compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_government_archetype value = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government compare = equals }
					}
					has_variable = fallout_country_memory_id
					check_variable = { var = fallout_country_memory_id value = constant:fallout_country_memory.manchurian_reactor_keeps compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = fallout_region_id value = constant:fallout_region.east_asia compare = equals }
					has_country_flag = fallout_event_366_memory_closed
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_failure
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_open_charter_memory
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_open_charter_contested
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_licensed_houses_memory
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_licensed_houses_contested
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_council_charter_memory
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_council_charter_contested
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_perimeter_corps_memory
						has_country_flag = fallout_repair_charter_perimeter_corps_contested
					}
				}
				fallout_event_866_initialize_ledgers = yes
				set_variable = { fallout_event_866_candidate_state_id = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				every_owned_state = {
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_state_candidate_id = THIS.id }
					if = {
						limit = {
							fallout_event_pilot_power_citizenship_state_is_current = yes
							OR = {
								check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_866_candidate_state_id = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
								check_variable = { var = fallout_event_pilot_state_candidate_id value = ROOT.fallout_event_866_candidate_state_id compare = less_than }
							}
						}
						set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_866_candidate_state_id = fallout_event_pilot_state_candidate_id }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { fallout_event_866_country_is_current = yes }
					fallout_event_initialize_pilot_candidate_row = yes
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.power_citizenship_candidate_id }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.power_citizenship_transaction_key }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_class = constant:fallout_event_class.major_arc }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_primary_family = constant:fallout_event_primary_family.diplomacy_trade_war_settlement }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_cooldown_family = constant:fallout_event_cooldown_family.technical }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_human_token = constant:fallout_event_id.power_citizenship_human }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_ai_token = constant:fallout_event_id.power_citizenship_ai }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_phase_mode = constant:fallout_event_review_phase_mode.preferred }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.new_states }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_secondary_phase = constant:fallout_event_phase.open_continuation }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_crisis_mode = constant:fallout_event_crisis_break_mode.eligible }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_866_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_severity = fallout_power_citizenship_engineer_authority_current }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_severity_source = constant:fallout_event_pressure_source_type.event_owned }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_mechanic_pressure = fallout_power_citizenship_citizenship_legitimacy }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_mechanic_pressure_source = constant:fallout_event_pressure_source_type.event_owned }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_state_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_state_value_source = constant:fallout_event_pressure_source_type.survival_resource }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_air_winter_phase = air_winter_phase }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_government_match = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_winter_match = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_crisis_resource_match = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_route_match = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_required_archetype = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_required_winter = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_resource_index = constant:fallout_survival_resource.power }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_required_resource = constant:fallout_event_866_threshold.minimum_country_power }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_required_route = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_target = fallout_event_866_candidate_state_id }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_route = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.power_citizenship_route }
					fallout_event_append_pilot_candidate_row = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_pilot_state_candidate_id = 0 }
				clear_variable = fallout_event_866_candidate_state_id
			}
			clear_variable = fallout_event_866_candidate_state_id
			set_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_registry_day = global.num_days }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_candidate_registry_reviewed
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { fallout_event_candidate_registry_is_reviewed = yes } }
				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_candidate_registry_reviewed
				clear_variable = fallout_event_candidate_registry_generation
				clear_variable = fallout_event_candidate_registry_day
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. This dormant pass pairs the two lowest
# current Refugee Train rows through the existing registry index ledger. It
# writes no tags, no diplomacy relation, and no scheduler activation flag.
# Every side must already have a reviewed candidate row before either partner
# index is written, so a missing or stale country leaves both rows unpaired.
fallout_event_pair_refugee_train_candidate_rows = {
	set_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_event_registry_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				fallout_event_candidate_registry_is_reviewed = yes
				any_of = {
					array = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries
					value = fallout_event_refugee_pair_candidate_id
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_refugee_pair_candidate_id value = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.refugee_train_candidate_id compare = equals }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index } }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index = fallout_event_registry_index }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_registry_index value = global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index compare = less_than }
				}
				set_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index = global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index }
				set_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index = fallout_event_registry_index }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_registry_index value = global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index compare = less_than }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index = fallout_event_registry_index }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
			check_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
		}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_index = global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_index = global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_refugee_pair_mutation_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:global.fallout_event_registry_countries^fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_index = {
		for_each_loop = {
			array = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries
			value = fallout_event_refugee_candidate_id
			index = fallout_event_refugee_candidate_row_index
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_refugee_candidate_id value = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.refugee_train_candidate_id compare = equals } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_refugee_candidate_row_index = fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_index }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_refugee_pair_mutation_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	var:global.fallout_event_registry_countries^fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_index = {
		for_each_loop = {
			array = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries
			value = fallout_event_refugee_candidate_id
			index = fallout_event_refugee_candidate_row_index
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_refugee_candidate_id value = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.refugee_train_candidate_id compare = equals } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_partner_registry_index_entries^fallout_event_refugee_candidate_row_index = fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_index }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_refugee_pair_mutation_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_refugee_pair_mutation_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_registry_index }
	}
	}
	clear_variable = global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_first_registry_index
	clear_variable = global.fallout_event_refugee_pair_second_registry_index
}
