	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	fallout_event_load_current_bilateral_pair = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_dispatch_is_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_dispatch_clear_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_ticket_has_issued_dispatch = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_dispatch_is_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					fallout_event_issued_bilateral_response_is_current = yes
					check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token value = fallout_event_requested_event_token compare = equals }
					OR = {
						AND = {
							check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_opening_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.reserved }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_role_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_role.initiator }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.response_pending }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
						}
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.resolved }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cancelled }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_dispatch_is_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_dispatch_clear_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = {
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_ticket_has_issued_dispatch = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_dispatch_is_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_current_status = fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_previous_outcome = fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_previous_cancellation = fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index }
		event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_partner_previous_status = fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_partner_previous_outcome = fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_partner_previous_cancellation = fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_is_valid = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_dispatch_is_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_current_status value = fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index value = fallout_event_requested_outcome compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index value = fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason compare = equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_dispatch_is_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_current_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.reserved }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.response_pending }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_current_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.response_pending }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.resolved }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome > constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome < constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
					}
					AND = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_current_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.reserved }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_current_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.response_pending }
						}
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cancelled }
						OR = {
							check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
						}
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason > constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason < constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.upper_bound }
					}
					AND = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_current_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.resolved }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_current_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cancelled }
						}
						check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cleanup_pending }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index value = fallout_event_requested_outcome compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index value = fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason compare = equals }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_is_valid = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_transition_is_valid = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = {
				set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = fallout_event_requested_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason }
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = fallout_event_requested_outcome }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason }
			event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = {
				set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status }
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_commit_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_validation_index = fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index }
			if = {
				limit = { fallout_event_bilateral_row_at_index_has_current_reciprocal = yes }
				event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = {
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_validation_index = fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index }
					if = {
						limit = { fallout_event_bilateral_row_at_index_has_current_reciprocal = yes }
						set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_commit_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_commit_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.resolved }
							check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cancelled }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready
							check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.bilateral_response }
							check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket value = fallout_event_requested_ticket compare = equals }
							OR = {
								fallout_event_dispatch_issue_receipt_is_absent = yes
								check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_dispatch_clear_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
							}
						}
						fallout_event_clear_dispatch_envelope = yes
					}
					event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = {
						if = {
							limit = {
									has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_ready
									check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.bilateral_response }
									check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_ticket value = fallout_event_requested_ticket compare = equals }
									fallout_event_dispatch_issue_receipt_is_absent = yes
								}
							fallout_event_clear_dispatch_envelope = yes
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cancelled } }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_cancelled_ticket = fallout_event_requested_ticket }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_cancellation_source_to_record = constant:fallout_event_transaction_source.bilateral }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_cancellation_reason_to_record = fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason }
					fallout_event_record_cancellation = yes
					event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = { fallout_event_record_cancellation = yes }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cleanup_pending } }
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_pending
					event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_pending }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
			else = {
				event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = {
					set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = fallout_event_bilateral_partner_previous_outcome }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = fallout_event_bilateral_partner_previous_cancellation }
				}
				set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = fallout_event_bilateral_origin_previous_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = fallout_event_bilateral_origin_previous_cancellation }
				event_target:fallout_event_bilateral_loaded_partner = {
					set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = fallout_event_bilateral_partner_previous_status }
				}
				set_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = fallout_event_bilateral_current_status }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.bilateral_reciprocal_mismatch }
				fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Input: requested ticket. This public route accepts only an unissued pair.
fallout_event_mark_bilateral_response_pending = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_unissued = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_has_issued_dispatch = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	fallout_event_load_unissued_bilateral_pair = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_unissued = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.response_pending }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
		fallout_event_update_bilateral_pair_internal = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The opening consumer may advance only the issued
# initiator row from reserved to response_pending. The exact opening token and
# reciprocal pair remain authenticated by the shared bilateral terminalizer.
fallout_event_mark_issued_bilateral_opening_response_pending = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_registry_country_row_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_issued_bilateral_response_is_current = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.refugee_train_bilateral_opening_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.refugee_train_bilateral_opening_ai }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.response_pending }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_opening_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		fallout_event_update_bilateral_pair_internal = yes
	}
}

# Inputs: requested ticket and non-zero outcome. This public route accepts only
# an unissued pair.
fallout_event_resolve_bilateral_transaction = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_unissued = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_has_issued_dispatch = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	fallout_event_load_unissued_bilateral_pair = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_unissued = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
		fallout_event_update_bilateral_pair_internal = yes
	}
}

# Inputs: requested ticket, cancelled outcome, and cancellation reason. This
# public route accepts only an unissued pair.
fallout_event_cancel_bilateral_transaction = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_unissued = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_has_issued_dispatch = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }

		fallout_event_update_bilateral_pair_internal = yes
	}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Inputs: expected event token and non-zero outcome.
# This atomically resolves both reciprocal rows and consumes the exact issued
# response envelope only after the pair commit proves current.
fallout_event_resolve_issued_bilateral_response = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_registry_country_row_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_issued_bilateral_response_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token value = fallout_event_requested_event_token compare = equals }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome > constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome < constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.resolved }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		fallout_event_update_bilateral_pair_internal = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Inputs: expected event token, aborted outcome, and
# cancellation reason. A current reciprocal pair is cancelled atomically. If
# the reciprocal proof is already lost, only the authenticated local tombstone
# is terminalized.
fallout_event_cancel_issued_bilateral_response = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_registry_country_row_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_issued_bilateral_response_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token value = fallout_event_requested_event_token compare = equals }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason > constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason < constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.upper_bound }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		fallout_event_load_current_bilateral_pair = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cancelled }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			fallout_event_update_bilateral_pair_internal = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
			fallout_event_find_bilateral_ticket_index = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_orphan_cancellation_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				fallout_event_cancel_local_bilateral_row_internal = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Input: requested ticket. Outcome and reason are copied from the exact
# reciprocal terminal receipt before both unissued rows enter cleanup.
fallout_event_prepare_bilateral_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_transition_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_unissued = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_has_issued_dispatch = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_partner_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	fallout_event_load_unissued_bilateral_pair = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_pair_is_unissued = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.resolved }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cancelled }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cleanup_pending }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_status = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cleanup_pending }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = fallout_event_bilateral_cancellation_reason_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index }
		fallout_event_update_bilateral_pair_internal = yes
	}
}

# Inputs: requested ticket and exact cleanup token. Each country releases its
# own unissued row only after its content-owned cleanup is complete.
fallout_event_release_bilateral_transaction = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_cleanup_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_ticket_has_issued_dispatch = yes } }
		fallout_event_release_bilateral_transaction_internal = yes
	}
}

# Internal local cleanup remover. The issued wrapper is the only caller allowed
# to provide cleanup authorization and an expected event token.
fallout_event_release_bilateral_transaction_internal = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_release_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_dispatch_clear_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_event_requested_bilateral_ticket_has_issued_dispatch = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_release_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_cleanup_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				fallout_event_issued_bilateral_cleanup_is_current = yes
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token value = fallout_event_requested_event_token compare = equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_release_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_dispatch_clear_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_index = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_release_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			fallout_event_registry_country_row_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_bilateral_receipts_are_current = yes
			check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		fallout_event_find_bilateral_ticket_index = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_row_found = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_status_entries^fallout_event_transaction_row_index = constant:fallout_event_bilateral_status.cleanup_pending }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_token_entries^fallout_event_transaction_row_index value = fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token compare = equals }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_validation_index = fallout_event_transaction_row_index }
				fallout_event_bilateral_row_at_index_is_structurally_current = yes
			}
			fallout_event_remove_bilateral_row_at_index = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = fallout_event_bilateral_ticket_entries value = fallout_event_requested_ticket } } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_cleanup_dispatch_clear_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
					fallout_event_clear_dispatch_envelope = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Input: expected cleanup event token. The wrapper
# derives the exact ticket and cleanup token, removes the local row, and consumes
# the issued cleanup envelope in one effect chain.
fallout_event_release_issued_bilateral_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_registry_country_row_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_issued_bilateral_cleanup_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token value = fallout_event_requested_event_token compare = equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_issued_cleanup_authorized = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		fallout_event_release_bilateral_transaction_internal = yes
	}
}

	clear_variable = fallout_orientation_resource_registry_country_memory
	clear_variable = fallout_orientation_resource_registry_region
	clear_variable = fallout_orientation_resource_registry_archetype
	clear_variable = fallout_orientation_resource_registry_support_resource

	clear_variable = fallout_orientation_resource_registry_diagnostic_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_orientation_resource_registry_diagnostic_day

	}
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_resource_registry_diagnostic_day = global.num_days }
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_resource_mapping_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_orientation_resource_mapping_is_current = yes }
		fallout_orientation_clear_resource_registry_diagnostic = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_resource_mapping_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
	}
	else = {
		fallout_orientation_reset_resource_mapping = yes
		fallout_orientation_clear_resource_registry_diagnostic = yes

				if = {
					limit = { fallout_orientation_resource_mapping_is_current = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_resource_mapping_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
				}
				else = {
					fallout_orientation_reset_resource_mapping = yes
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_resource_registry_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_resource_registry_diagnostic.payload_invalid }
					fallout_orientation_record_resource_registry_diagnostic = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_resource_registry_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_resource_registry_diagnostic.identity_mismatch }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { fallout_orientation_country_memory_has_pilot_resource_mapping = yes } }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_resource_registry_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_resource_registry_diagnostic.unsupported_country_memory }
				}
				fallout_orientation_reset_resource_mapping = yes
				fallout_orientation_record_resource_registry_diagnostic = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_resource_registry_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_resource_registry_diagnostic.allocation_not_current }
			fallout_orientation_record_resource_registry_diagnostic = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Copies only a fully authenticated pilot package into
# the temporary resource request. A missing package writes an explicit empty
# support resource so caller data cannot bypass the reviewed evidence receipt.

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_resource_request_loaded = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }

	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_resource_registry_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_resource_registry_diagnostic.package_not_current }

			limit = { NOT = { fallout_orientation_resource_mapping_is_current = yes } }

		}
		fallout_orientation_record_resource_registry_diagnostic = yes
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Copies an authenticated installed package into the
# temporary request fields consumed by the character component. A two-candidate
# package writes an explicit empty third slot so stale temporary data cannot leak.
fallout_orientation_load_candidate_request = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_candidate_request_loaded = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	fallout_orientation_prepare_candidate_mapping = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_id = constant:fallout_orientation_candidate_id.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_id = constant:fallout_orientation_candidate_id.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_id = constant:fallout_orientation_candidate_id.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_type = constant:fallout_orientation_candidate_type.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_type = constant:fallout_orientation_candidate_type.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_type = constant:fallout_orientation_candidate_type.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_region = constant:fallout_region.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_region = constant:fallout_region.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_region = constant:fallout_region.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.none }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_is_usable = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_id = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_1_id }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_id = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_2_id }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_type = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_1_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_type = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_2_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_region = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_1_region }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_region = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_2_region }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_archetype = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_1_archetype }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_archetype = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_2_archetype }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_candidate_package_count = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.three } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_id = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_3_id }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_type = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_3_type }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_region = fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_slot_3_region }

	else = {

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Freezes the strongest, weakest, and immediate-crisis
# resource identities from the committed current resource array. Exact ties keep
# the lowest stable resource id.
fallout_orientation_freeze_resource_extrema = {
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_primary_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.food }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_primary_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_weakest_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.food }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_weakest_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.food }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = constant:fallout_survival_resource.clean_water
		end = constant:fallout_survival_resource.upper_bound
		value = fallout_orientation_resource_scan_index
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^fallout_orientation_resource_scan_index > fallout_orientation_frozen_primary_value } }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_primary_resource = fallout_orientation_resource_scan_index }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_primary_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^fallout_orientation_resource_scan_index }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^fallout_orientation_resource_scan_index < fallout_orientation_frozen_weakest_value } }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_weakest_resource = fallout_orientation_resource_scan_index }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_weakest_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^fallout_orientation_resource_scan_index }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 < fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value } }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.clean_water }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 < fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value } }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.medicine }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 < fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value } }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.filters }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Sums the current living population of this country
# by traversing the committed stable Fallout state array. No world iterator is
# opened, and later demographic change is observed from the live state value.
fallout_orientation_freeze_live_country_population = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_population_country_scope = THIS }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_country_population_total = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = var:fallout_orientation_population_country_scope
				fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_population_current = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_population_current = constant:fallout_runtime.population_scale }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_state_population_current
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_country_population_total = fallout_orientation_state_population_current }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_country_population = fallout_orientation_country_population_total }
}

fallout_orientation_record_diagnostic = {
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_diagnostic = fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_diagnostic_generation = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_diagnostic_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_diagnostic_day = global.num_days }
}

		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_slot_2_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.none }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_slot_3_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.none }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.character_or_institution } }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_count = fallout_orientation_candidate_package_count }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_slot_1_id = fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_id }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_slot_2_id = fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_id }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_slot_3_id = fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_id }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_slot_1_type = fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_1_type }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_slot_2_type = fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_2_type }

			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_candidate_slot_3_archetype = fallout_orientation_requested_candidate_slot_3_archetype }
		}
		fallout_orientation_freeze_resource_extrema = yes
		fallout_orientation_freeze_live_country_population = yes
		var:fallout_successor_assignment_capital_state = {
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orientation_state_target = THIS }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orientation_frozen_target_state_grade = fallout_state_grade }

			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orientation_frozen_source_population = fallout_orientation_target_population_current }
		}

			limit = { has_event_target = fallout_orientation_requested_receiving_state }
			event_target:fallout_orientation_requested_receiving_state = {
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orientation_receiving_state_target = THIS }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		set_country_flag = fallout_orientation_transaction_pending
	}

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.input_invalid }

		}

			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { fallout_survival_country_identity_row_is_current = yes }
					NOT = { fallout_survival_country_resource_row_is_durable = yes }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.survival_ledger_not_current }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = global.fallout_cause_memory_source }
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.fallout_cause_memory_source > constant:fallout_request_source.none } }
					check_variable = { global.fallout_cause_memory_source > constant:fallout_request_source.strategic_singularity }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.cause_memory_missing }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_orientation_regional_row_surface_is_approved = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.regional_row_missing }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_orientation_archetype_row_surface_is_approved = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.archetype_row_missing }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { fallout_orientation_memory_row_surface_is_approved = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.memory_row_missing }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					var:fallout_successor_assignment_capital_state = {
						exists = yes
						is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT
						fallout_successor_assignment_capital_row_is_current = yes
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.state_target_missing }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.national_orientation }
				NOT = { fallout_orientation_requested_national_has_affordable_branch = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.branch_unaffordable }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.immediate_resource_crisis }
				NOT = { fallout_orientation_requested_resource_has_affordable_branch = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.branch_unaffordable }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.government_archetype }
				NOT = { fallout_orientation_requested_government_has_affordable_branch = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.branch_unaffordable }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.character_or_institution }
				NOT = { fallout_orientation_candidate_registry_is_sufficient = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.candidate_registry_insufficient }
		}
		fallout_orientation_record_diagnostic = yes
	}
}

fallout_orientation_issue_next = {
	fallout_orientation_reconcile_stale_generation = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_orientation_transaction_is_current = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_orientation_event_issued
				check_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				check_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_component = fallout_orientation_transaction_component }
				check_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_stage = fallout_orientation_transaction_stage }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.root }
					check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.result }
					check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.cleanup }
					check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.closure }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.root } }
				set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.result } }
				set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days = fallout_orientation_due_day }
				subtract_from_variable = { fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days = global.num_days }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days value = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero compare = less_than } } set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.cleanup } }
				set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.closure } }
				set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
			}
			fallout_orientation_select_event_token = yes
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_component = fallout_orientation_transaction_component }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_mode = fallout_orientation_transaction_mode }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_stage = fallout_orientation_transaction_stage }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_branch = fallout_orientation_transaction_branch }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_event_token = fallout_orientation_selected_event_token }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_due_day = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.result } }
				set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_due_day = fallout_orientation_due_day }
			}
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_issued_date = global.date }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
			fallout_orientation_dispatch_selected_event = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_orientation_event_issued
		}
	}
}

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_selected_event_token = constant:fallout_orientation_event_id.character_ai_result } } country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.81 days = fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_selected_event_token = constant:fallout_orientation_event_id.closure_human } } country_event = { id = chaosx.fallout.82 days = fallout_orientation_issue_delay_days } }

}

fallout_orientation_choose_branch = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_orientation_root_event_is_authenticated = yes
			has_variable = fallout_orientation_requested_branch
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch < constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.upper_bound }
			fallout_orientation_branch_is_affordable = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = fallout_orientation_requested_branch }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_branch = fallout_orientation_requested_branch }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_stage = constant:fallout_orientation_stage.result }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_status = constant:fallout_orientation_status.result_scheduled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.national_orientation } }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_result_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_delay.national_orientation_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.capital_condition } }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_result_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_delay.capital_condition_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.immediate_resource_crisis } }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_result_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_delay.immediate_resource_crisis_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.government_archetype } }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_result_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_delay.government_archetype_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.character_or_institution } }
			set_variable = { fallout_orientation_result_delay_days = constant:fallout_orientation_delay.character_or_institution_days }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_orientation_due_day = fallout_orientation_result_delay_days }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.national_orientation } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.household_workplace } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_household_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_household_water } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_household_filters } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.district_settlement } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_district_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_district_shelter } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_district_scrap } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.emergency_command } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_command_fuel } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_command_filters } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.national_command_scrap } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.capital_condition } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.seal_heat_civic } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_seal_filters } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_seal_fuel } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_seal_scrap } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.disperse_stores_offices } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_disperse_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_disperse_scrap } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_disperse_power } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.evacuate_poisoned_core } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_evacuation_fuel } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_evacuation_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.capital_evacuation_shelter } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.immediate_resource_crisis } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_resource_branch.ration } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.resource_ration_cohesion } fallout_orientation_apply_cohesion_loss = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_resource_branch.requisition } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.resource_requisition_recognition } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.resource_requisition_cohesion } fallout_orientation_apply_cohesion_loss = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_resource_branch.tailored } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.resource_tailored_scrap } if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_tailored_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.power } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.resource_tailored_support } } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_tailored_resource = constant:fallout_survival_resource.fuel } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.resource_tailored_support } } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.government_archetype } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_government_branch.consolidate } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.government_consolidate_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.government_consolidate_fuel } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_government_branch.division } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.government_division_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.government_division_shelter } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_government_branch.rival } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.government_rival_scrap } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.government_rival_fuel } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.character_or_institution } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_character_branch.relief_administration } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.character_relief_medicine } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.character_relief_food } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_character_branch.security_extraction } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.character_security_fuel } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.character_security_scrap } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_character_branch.regional_institution } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.character_institution_power } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.character_institution_shelter } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_orientation_cost.character_institution_scrap } }
			fallout_orientation_select_branch_candidate = yes
		}
		fallout_orientation_clear_issued_receipt = yes
		fallout_orientation_issue_next = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { fallout_orientation_component_can_choose = yes }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.branch_unaffordable }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_diagnostic_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_diagnostic_day = global.num_days }
	}
}

fallout_orientation_calculate_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = constant:fallout_orientation_score.base }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_primary_value }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.national_orientation } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.household_workplace } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_food } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.district_settlement } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_shelter } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.emergency_command } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_fuel } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.capital_condition } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.seal_heat_civic } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_filters } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.disperse_stores_offices } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_food } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.evacuate_poisoned_core } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_fuel } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.immediate_resource_crisis } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.government_archetype } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_government_branch.consolidate } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_food } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_government_branch.division } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_shelter } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_government_branch.rival } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_scrap } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.character_or_institution } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_character_branch.relief_administration } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_medicine } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_character_branch.security_extraction } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_fuel } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_character_branch.regional_institution } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_power } }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary = fallout_orientation_score_primary_value }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_score_primary_value value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.resource_high compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = constant:fallout_orientation_score.resource_high_bonus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_score_primary_value value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.resource_mid compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = constant:fallout_orientation_score.resource_mid_bonus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_primary_value < constant:fallout_orientation_score.resource_low } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_penalty = constant:fallout_orientation_score.resource_low_penalty }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = fallout_orientation_score_penalty }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_archetype_match = constant:fallout_orientation_score.match_flag } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = constant:fallout_orientation_score.archetype_match_bonus } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_regional_match = constant:fallout_orientation_score.match_flag } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = constant:fallout_orientation_score.regional_match_bonus } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_recognition value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.recognition_high compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = constant:fallout_orientation_score.recognition_high_bonus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_recognition < constant:fallout_orientation_score.recognition_low } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_penalty = constant:fallout_orientation_score.recognition_low_penalty }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = fallout_orientation_score_penalty }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_exposure_deduction_value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.clamp_minimum }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_frozen_target_exposure value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.exposure_band_1 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_exposure_deduction_value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.exposure_deduction_1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_frozen_target_exposure value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.exposure_band_2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_exposure_deduction_value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.exposure_deduction_2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_frozen_target_exposure value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.exposure_band_3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_exposure_deduction_value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.exposure_deduction_3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_frozen_target_exposure value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.exposure_band_4 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_exposure_deduction_value = constant:fallout_orientation_score.exposure_deduction_4 } }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = fallout_orientation_score_exposure_deduction_value }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_support_score = fallout_orientation_frozen_target_recovery }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_support_score = fallout_orientation_frozen_target_adaptation }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_support_score min = constant:fallout_orientation_score.support_minimum max = constant:fallout_orientation_score.support_maximum }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_support_score = constant:fallout_orientation_score.recovery_adaptation_factor }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_support_score
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_support_score min = constant:fallout_orientation_score.support_minimum max = constant:fallout_orientation_score.support_score_maximum }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = fallout_orientation_support_score }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_unresolved_crisis > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_calculated_score = constant:fallout_orientation_score.unresolved_crisis_penalty } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_calculated_score min = constant:fallout_orientation_score.clamp_minimum max = constant:fallout_orientation_score.clamp_maximum }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_calculated_score
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_score = fallout_orientation_calculated_score }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_support = fallout_orientation_support_score }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_score_exposure_deduction = fallout_orientation_score_exposure_deduction_value }
}

	fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
