fallout_orientation_record_country_deaths = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_count = fallout_orientation_frozen_country_population }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_count = fallout_orientation_death_fraction }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_death_count
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_request = fallout_orientation_death_count }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_remaining = fallout_orientation_death_request }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_applied_total = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_country_scope = THIS }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.fallout_survival_ledger_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_remaining > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
				is_owned_by = var:fallout_orientation_death_country_scope
				fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_orientation_death_remaining }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = var:fallout_orientation_death_country_scope }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_applied_total = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_remaining = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_count = fallout_orientation_death_applied_total }
	fallout_orientation_record_exact_country_deaths = yes
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_requested = fallout_orientation_death_request }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_applied = fallout_orientation_death_applied_total }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_day = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
}

fallout_orientation_record_exact_country_deaths = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_count > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = fallout_orientation_death_count }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_is_civilian = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_apply_state_pop = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_record_state_ledger = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_target_country = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_has_target_country = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		chaos_meter_register_deaths = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_requested = fallout_orientation_death_count }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_applied = fallout_orientation_death_count }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_current_result_deaths_applied = fallout_orientation_death_count }
	}
}

fallout_orientation_record_state_deaths = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_death_request = fallout_orientation_frozen_target_population }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_death_request = fallout_orientation_death_fraction }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_state_death_request
	var:fallout_orientation_state_target = {
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = ROOT.fallout_orientation_state_death_request }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.minimum_remaining_people }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orientation_deaths_requested = ROOT.fallout_orientation_state_death_request }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orientation_deaths_applied = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orientation_current_result_deaths_applied = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_day = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
}

fallout_orientation_apply_national_result = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.household_workplace } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_household_success_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_household_success_cohesion }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_household_partial_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_household_partial_cohesion }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_household_failure_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_household_failure_cohesion }
			fallout_orientation_apply_cohesion_loss = yes
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_household_failure_food }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_recognition < constant:fallout_orientation_deaths.national_authority_recognition_threshold } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_fraction = constant:fallout_orientation_deaths.national_authority } fallout_orientation_record_country_deaths = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.district_settlement } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_district_success_recognition } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_district_success_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_district_partial_recognition } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_district_partial_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_district_failure_recognition } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_district_failure_cohesion } fallout_orientation_apply_cohesion_loss = yes subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_district_failure_shelter } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.emergency_command } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_command_success_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_command_success_cohesion }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_modifier_days = constant:fallout_orientation_duration.command_authority_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_orientation_command_authority days = fallout_orientation_modifier_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_command_partial_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_command_partial_cohesion }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_modifier_days = constant:fallout_orientation_duration.contested_command_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_orientation_contested_command days = fallout_orientation_modifier_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_command_failure_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.national_command_failure_cohesion }
			fallout_orientation_apply_cohesion_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_modifier_days = constant:fallout_orientation_duration.command_resistance_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_orientation_command_resistance days = fallout_orientation_modifier_days }
		}
	}
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
}

fallout_orientation_reset_state_deltas = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_recovery_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_adaptation_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_reclamation_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_supply_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The assigned capital is authenticated before any
# state field changes. Recovery is written to both the durable bonus and live
# value. Supply uses the sole clamp-owning state-ledger helper.
fallout_orientation_apply_authenticated_state_deltas = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_orientation_state_target_is_current = yes }
		var:fallout_orientation_state_target = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_shelter_capacity min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = air_winter_recovery_bonus } }
				set_variable = { air_winter_recovery_bonus = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
			}
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_recovery_bonus = fallout_orientation_state_recovery_delta }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_recovery = fallout_orientation_state_recovery_delta }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_recovery_bonus min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_recovery min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = fallout_orientation_state_adaptation_delta }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_adaptation min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = fallout_orientation_state_reclamation_delta }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_delta = fallout_orientation_state_supply_delta }
			fallout_state_apply_supply_access_delta = yes
		}
	}
}

fallout_orientation_apply_capital_result = {
	fallout_orientation_reset_state_deltas = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.seal_heat_civic } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_seal_success_exposure }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_seal_success_shelter }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_recovery_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_seal_success_recovery }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_seal_partial_exposure }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_seal_partial_shelter }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_recovery_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_seal_partial_recovery }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_seal_failure_exposure }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_seal_failure_shelter }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
			var:fallout_orientation_state_target = {
				if = {
					limit = { infrastructure > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
					damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_ORIENTATION_RUNTIME_BUILDING_DAMAGE }
				}
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_fraction = constant:fallout_orientation_deaths.capital_seal } fallout_orientation_record_state_deaths = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.disperse_stores_offices } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_disperse_success_shelter }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_adaptation_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_disperse_success_adaptation }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_supply_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_disperse_success_supply }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_disperse_partial_shelter }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_adaptation_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_disperse_partial_adaptation }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_supply_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_disperse_partial_supply }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_disperse_failure_shelter }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_shelter_delta = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_supply_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_disperse_failure_supply }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_supply_delta = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_fraction = constant:fallout_orientation_deaths.capital_disperse } fallout_orientation_record_state_deaths = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_capital_branch.evacuate_poisoned_core } }
		fallout_orientation_apply_capital_evacuation = yes
	}
	fallout_orientation_apply_authenticated_state_deltas = yes
}

fallout_orientation_apply_capital_evacuation = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_intended = fallout_orientation_frozen_source_population }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_intended = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_evacuation_success_share }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_migration_intended
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement = fallout_orientation_migration_intended }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement = fallout_orientation_frozen_source_population } multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_evacuation_partial_share } round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_migration_movement }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement = fallout_orientation_frozen_source_population }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_evacuation_failure_share }
		round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_migration_movement
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths = fallout_orientation_migration_intended }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_evacuation_failure_death_share }
		round_temp_variable = fallout_orientation_migration_deaths
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_total_request = fallout_orientation_migration_movement }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_total_request = fallout_orientation_migration_deaths }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_requested = fallout_orientation_migration_total_request }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_total_request > fallout_orientation_frozen_receiving_capacity } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_total_request = fallout_orientation_frozen_receiving_capacity } set_country_flag = fallout_orientation_capacity_clamped }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement = fallout_orientation_migration_total_request }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths > fallout_orientation_migration_total_request } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths = fallout_orientation_migration_total_request } }
	var:fallout_orientation_state_target = {
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = ROOT.fallout_orientation_migration_total_request }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.minimum_remaining_people }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
		set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orientation_migration_applied = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_total_applied = fallout_orientation_migration_applied }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths > fallout_orientation_migration_total_applied } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths = fallout_orientation_migration_total_applied } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement = fallout_orientation_migration_total_applied }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement = fallout_orientation_migration_deaths }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_applied = fallout_orientation_migration_total_applied }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_moved = fallout_orientation_migration_movement }
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths_applied = fallout_orientation_migration_deaths }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_movement > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero } } var:fallout_orientation_receiving_state_target = { add_manpower = var:ROOT.fallout_orientation_migration_movement } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_migration_deaths > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_count = fallout_orientation_migration_deaths } fallout_orientation_record_exact_country_deaths = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_evacuation_success_exposure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_evacuation_partial_exposure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_runtime.negative_one }

	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_state_exposure_delta = constant:fallout_orientation_result.capital_evacuation_failure_exposure }
	}

fallout_orientation_resolve_component = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_should_record = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_orientation_history_generation } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_should_record = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation } } }

	}

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_should_record = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }

			else_if = { limit = { fallout_orientation_score_is_partial = yes } set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { fallout_orientation_score_is_failure = yes } set_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.national_orientation } } fallout_orientation_apply_national_result = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.capital_condition } } fallout_orientation_apply_capital_result = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.immediate_resource_crisis } } fallout_orientation_apply_resource_result = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.government_archetype } } fallout_orientation_apply_government_result = yes }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.character_or_institution } } fallout_orientation_apply_character_result = yes }
			set_country_flag = fallout_orientation_result_applied

			fallout_orientation_finish_component = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_orientation_transaction_pending
			NOT = { fallout_orientation_state_target_is_current = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_diagnostic = constant:fallout_orientation_diagnostic.state_ledger_not_current }
		fallout_orientation_record_diagnostic = yes
	}

fallout_orientation_ai_apply_survival_weight = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight = constant:fallout_orientation_ai_weight.tertiary }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.branch_minimum } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight = constant:fallout_orientation_ai_weight.primary } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.two } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight = constant:fallout_orientation_ai_weight.secondary } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_crisis_value }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.national_orientation } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.household_workplace } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_food }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_clean_water < fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_clean_water } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_filters < fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_filters } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.district_settlement } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_food }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_shelter < fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_shelter } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_scrap < fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_scrap } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.emergency_command } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_fuel }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_filters < fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_filters } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_scrap < fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value = fallout_orientation_frozen_resource_scrap } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value < constant:fallout_orientation_score.resource_low } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight = constant:fallout_orientation_ai_weight.strong_factor }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_branch_need_value < constant:fallout_orientation_score.resource_mid } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight = constant:fallout_orientation_ai_weight.weak_factor }
	}
	else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.immediate_resource_crisis }
			fallout_orientation_resource_mapping_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_requested_branch value = fallout_orientation_resource_registry_ai_preferred_branch compare = equals }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight = constant:fallout_orientation_ai_weight.cell_preference_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component = constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.government_archetype }
			fallout_orientation_government_mapping_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_orientation_requested_branch value = fallout_orientation_government_registry_ai_preferred_branch compare = equals }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight = constant:fallout_orientation_ai_weight.cell_preference_bonus }
	}
}

fallout_orientation_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_found = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_score = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_event_token = fallout_orientation_issued_event_token }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.branch_minimum }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_orientation_branch_is_affordable = yes }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.branch_minimum }
		fallout_orientation_calculate_score = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score = fallout_orientation_score }
		fallout_orientation_ai_apply_survival_weight = yes
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score = fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_score = fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.branch_minimum }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_found = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.two }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_orientation_branch_is_affordable = yes }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.two }
		fallout_orientation_calculate_score = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score = fallout_orientation_score }
		fallout_orientation_ai_apply_survival_weight = yes
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score = fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_found = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero } check_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score > fallout_orientation_ai_best_score } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_score = fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.two } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_found = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one } }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_requested_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.three }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_orientation_branch_is_affordable = yes }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.three }
		fallout_orientation_calculate_score = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score = fallout_orientation_score }
		fallout_orientation_ai_apply_survival_weight = yes
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score = fallout_orientation_ai_need_weight }
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_found = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero } check_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score > fallout_orientation_ai_best_score } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_score = fallout_orientation_ai_projected_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.three } set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_found = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one } }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch = constant:fallout_orientation_national_branch.none }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_orientation_ai_best_found = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one } }

		fallout_orientation_choose_branch = yes
	}
}

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT LIVING-WORLD RELEASE AUDIT EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Overview:
# - Records one generation-bound human review receipt for the 660-block floor.
# - Records separate engine-sensitive handoff flags without claiming runtime
#   proof that has not been supplied.
# - Never sets either scheduler activation flag.
# - Never runs automatically from a periodic on_action.
# ============================================================================

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. Input:
# fallout_event_release_rejection_reason_to_record.
fallout_event_record_release_audit_rejection = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
		}
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_release_audit_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.fallout_event_release_audit_generation = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.zero }
	}
	set_variable = { global.fallout_event_release_audit_schema_version = constant:fallout_event_release_audit_schema.version }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_event_release_audit_status = constant:fallout_event_release_audit_status.rejected }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_event_release_audit_reason = fallout_event_release_rejection_reason_to_record }
	set_variable = { global.fallout_event_release_audit_day = global.num_days }
	clr_global_flag = fallout_event_release_audit_accepted
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY coordinator. Inputs are temporary review receipts:
# fallout_event_release_reviewed_block_count, fallout_event_release_manual_sweep_reviewed,
# fallout_event_release_blackout_reviewed, fallout_event_release_host_authority_reviewed,
# fallout_event_release_save_recovery_reviewed, and
# fallout_event_release_multiplayer_reviewed. This effect stores evidence only.
fallout_event_record_release_floor_review = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_release_review_submission_valid = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_release_review_submission_skip = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
			has_global_flag = fallout_active
			has_global_flag = fallout_transition_complete
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_transition_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_activation_approved }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_active }
			has_variable = fallout_event_release_reviewed_block_count
			check_variable = {
				var = fallout_event_release_reviewed_block_count
				value = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.minimum_reviewed_blocks
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
			has_variable = fallout_event_release_manual_sweep_reviewed
			has_variable = fallout_event_release_blackout_reviewed
			has_variable = fallout_event_release_host_authority_reviewed
			has_variable = fallout_event_release_save_recovery_reviewed
			has_variable = fallout_event_release_multiplayer_reviewed
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_release_manual_sweep_reviewed = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.one }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_release_manual_sweep_reviewed = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.zero }
			}
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_release_blackout_reviewed = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.one }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_release_blackout_reviewed = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.zero }
			}
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_release_host_authority_reviewed = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.one }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_release_host_authority_reviewed = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.zero }
			}
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_release_save_recovery_reviewed = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.one }

	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_activation_approved
					has_global_flag = fallout_event_scheduler_active
				}
			}

		}
		else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_release_rejection_reason_to_record = constant:fallout_event_release_rejection_reason.invalid_scope }
		if = {
			limit = {
				fallout_current_country_is_coordinator = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_release_reviewed_block_count }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_release_reviewed_block_count = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.zero }
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_event_release_reviewed_block_count
						value = constant:fallout_event_release_floor.minimum_reviewed_blocks
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_release_rejection_reason_to_record = constant:fallout_event_release_rejection_reason.reviewed_floor_missing }
		}
		fallout_event_record_release_audit_rejection = yes
		}
	}
}

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_831_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_831_log.public_inquiry_failure } }

fallout_event_691_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_691_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_691_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_691_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_691_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_691_branch.release_compensate compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.choice_release } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_691_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_691_branch.maintain_cordon compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.choice_cordon } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_691_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_691_branch.ward_tribunal compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.choice_tribunal } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.choice_rotate } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_691_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_691_branch.release_compensate compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.release_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.release_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.release_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_691_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_691_branch.maintain_cordon compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.cordon_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.cordon_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.cordon_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_691_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_691_branch.ward_tribunal compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.tribunal_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.tribunal_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.tribunal_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.rotate_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.rotate_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.rotate_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.callback_success } }

			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_691_log.callback_failure } }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_691_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_691_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_691_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_691_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }

fallout_event_478_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = fallout_event_478_frozen_food }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.food_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_viability = fallout_event_478_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = fallout_event_478_frozen_adaptation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.adaptation_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_viability = fallout_event_478_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = fallout_event_478_frozen_reclamation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.reclamation_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_viability = fallout_event_478_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = fallout_event_478_frozen_seed_memory }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.seed_memory_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_viability = fallout_event_478_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = fallout_event_478_frozen_cohesion }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.cohesion_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_viability = fallout_event_478_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = fallout_event_478_frozen_recognition }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.recognition_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_viability = fallout_event_478_component }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability min = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.maximum_viability }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_478_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_478_branch.emergency_replant } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability value = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.emergency_replant_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability value = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.emergency_replant_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_478_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_478_branch.import_seed } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability value = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.import_seed_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability value = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.import_seed_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_478_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_478_branch.underground_reserve } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability value = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.underground_reserve_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability value = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.underground_reserve_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability value = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.accept_shortage_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_478_viability value = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.accept_shortage_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_viability = 0 }
}

fallout_event_478_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_478_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_478_branch.emergency_replant } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.emergency_replant_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.emergency_replant_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.emergency_replant_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_478_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_478_branch.import_seed } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.import_seed_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.import_seed_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.import_seed_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_478_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_478_branch.underground_reserve } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.underground_reserve_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.underground_reserve_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.underground_reserve_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else = { subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.accept_shortage_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.accept_shortage_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_478_cost.accept_shortage_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_478_cost_paid
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Capture the major ticket before the delayed result
# is reserved. Ordinary callers do not create or retain this variable.
fallout_event_478_open_major_arc_stages = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.major_arc_stage } }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Advance through conflict and choice after the
# major opening envelope has been consumed.
fallout_event_478_advance_arc_opening_to_choice = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.conflict }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.choice }
			fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The delayed result is the fourth authored arc
# position after the opening, conflict, and choice stages.
fallout_event_478_advance_arc_to_delayed_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.delayed_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_478_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The callback occupies consequence and callback
# stages before delayed cleanup is released.
fallout_event_478_advance_arc_to_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.consequence }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_478_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.callback }
			fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Cleanup advances the authored arc to its terminal
# stage and releases the exact identity and cleanup token.
fallout_event_478_close_major_arc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.cleanup }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_478_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.false_spring_losses_candidate_id }
			fallout_event_release_major_arc = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A failed delayed-row reservation cancels and
# releases the major identity instead of leaving an opening slot orphaned.
fallout_event_478_cancel_major_arc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
		fallout_event_cancel_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.false_spring_losses_candidate_id }
			fallout_event_release_major_arc = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket
	}
}

fallout_event_478_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
				fallout_event_issued_major_arc_stage_is_current = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_478_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_478_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_478_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_478_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_478_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_478_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		fallout_event_478_open_major_arc_stages = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_478_frozen_food = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_478_frozen_medicine = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_478_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_478_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_478_frozen_adaptation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_478_frozen_reclamation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_frost_memory_current } } set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_frost_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.initial_seed_memory } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_seed_reserve_current } } set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_seed_reserve_current = constant:fallout_event_478_threshold.initial_seed_reserve } }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_478_frozen_seed_memory = ROOT.fallout_frost_memory_current }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_478_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_478_selected_branch = fallout_event_478_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_478_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_478_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_478_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_478_requested_branch }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = fallout_event_478_major_arc_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.false_spring_losses_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.false_spring_losses_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_478_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_478_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_478_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_478_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_478_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.false_spring_losses_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_478_opening_event_token }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.major_arc_stage } }
				fallout_event_consume_issued_major_arc_stage = yes
			}
			else = {
				fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				fallout_event_478_advance_arc_opening_to_choice = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_result_outcome = fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_result_day = global.num_days }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_registry_owner = ROOT }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.false_spring_losses_candidate_id }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_478_registry_target = fallout_event_478_target_state_id }
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_478_chain_committed
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_478_memory_opened
					var:fallout_event_478_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_478_false_spring_registry_committed set_variable = { fallout_event_478_seed_reserve = ROOT.fallout_seed_reserve_current } }
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
					fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
					fallout_event_478_cancel_major_arc = yes
					fallout_event_478_clear_frozen = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				fallout_event_478_cancel_major_arc = yes
				fallout_event_478_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			fallout_event_478_cancel_major_arc = yes
			fallout_event_478_clear_frozen = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_opening_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_478_arc_stage_transition_accepted = 0 }
}

fallout_event_478_choose_branch = {
	fallout_event_478_schedule_result = yes

fallout_event_256_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_256_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_256_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_256_branch.quarantine_dormitory } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.quarantine_filters }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.quarantine_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.quarantine_food }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_256_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_256_branch.disperse_bunks } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.disperse_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.disperse_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_256_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_256_branch.treat_in_public } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.public_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.public_shelter }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.public_recognition }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.conceal_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_256_cost.conceal_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_256_cost_paid
	}
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_256_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_256_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_256_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_256_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_256_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_256_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		fallout_event_256_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_256_opening_target = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_quarantine_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_quarantine_result_ai }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_256_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_256_branch.disperse_bunks } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_disperse_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_disperse_result_ai } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_256_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_256_branch.treat_in_public } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_public_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_public_result_ai } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_256_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_256_branch.conceal_fever } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_conceal_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_conceal_result_ai } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_256_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_256_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_256_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_256_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = fallout_event_256_opening_target_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = fallout_event_256_opening_target }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.fever_dormitory_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_256_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_256_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }

				set_variable = { fallout_event_256_state_id = fallout_event_256_opening_target }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_256_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_256_registry_owner = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_256_viability = fallout_event_256_target_viability }
				var:fallout_event_256_opening_target = {
					set_state_flag = fallout_event_256_fever_registry_committed
					set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_256_registry_generation = ROOT.fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_256_registry_owner = ROOT }
					set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_256_viability = ROOT.fallout_event_256_target_viability }
					set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_256_frozen_shelter = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity }

					set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_256_frozen_reclamation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
					set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_256_frozen_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
				}
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_256_chain_committed
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_256_schedule_error
			}
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_256_schedule_error }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_256_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_256_target_viability = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_256_opening_target = 0 }

	}
	else = {

			}

		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_217_target_viability value = constant:fallout_event_217_threshold.household_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_217_target_filters value = constant:fallout_event_217_threshold.household_partial_filters compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_217_target_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_217_threshold.household_partial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}

		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_217_calculated_viability = fallout_event_217_target_viability }
