fallout_event_217_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_217_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_217_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_217_branch.seal_lower_levels } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_217_cost.seal_filters }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_217_cost.seal_medicine }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_217_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_217_branch.rotate_surface_teams } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_217_cost.rotate_filters }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_217_cost.rotate_food }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_217_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_217_branch.open_emergency_vents } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_217_cost.vent_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_217_cost.vent_recognition }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_217_cost.household_filters }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_217_cost.household_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_217_cost_paid
	}
}

			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_852_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_852_log.choice_military_secrecy } }

				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_852_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_852_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_852_log.proprietary_standard_success } }

fallout_event_852_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_first_regional_standard_open_access_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_first_regional_standard_compact_trust }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_first_regional_standard_measure_compatibility }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_first_regional_standard_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_first_regional_standard_proprietary_pressure_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_first_regional_standard_radio_compatibility }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_first_regional_standard_trade_confidence }
	var:fallout_event_852_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_852_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_852_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_852_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_852_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_852_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_852_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_852_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_852_callback_score

		fallout_event_852_calculate_callback_outcome = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_852_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_852_result_ticket }
		fallout_event_852_schedule_callback = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_852_callback_scheduled
			set_variable = { fallout_event_852_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
		}
		else = {

			set_country_flag = fallout_event_852_callback_schedule_error
		}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_852_result_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_852_result_mode = 0 }
}

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_282_log.callback_partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_282_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_282_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_history_stage = 0 }
}

fallout_event_282_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.cohesion_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability = fallout_event_282_viability_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = fallout_event_282_frozen_medicine }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.medicine_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability = fallout_event_282_viability_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = fallout_event_282_frozen_shelter }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.shelter_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability = fallout_event_282_viability_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_death_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.deaths_score_cap }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_death_component = fallout_event_282_frozen_deaths }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_death_component value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_death_component = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_death_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.deaths_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_death_component = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.deaths_score_cap }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability = fallout_event_282_death_component }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_event_282_viability
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability min = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.maximum_viability }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_282_branch.public_celebration } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.public_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.public_success_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.public_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.public_partial_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_282_branch.private_protection } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.private_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_frozen_medicine value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.private_success_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.private_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_frozen_medicine value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.private_partial_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_282_branch.demographic_campaign } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.campaign_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.campaign_success_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.campaign_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.campaign_partial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.elders_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.elders_success_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_viability value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.elders_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_282_threshold.elders_partial_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_viability_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_death_component = 0 }
}

fallout_event_282_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_282_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_282_branch.public_celebration } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.public_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.public_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.public_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_282_branch.private_protection } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.private_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.private_shelter }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.private_scrap }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_282_branch.demographic_campaign } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.campaign_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.campaign_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.campaign_recognition }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.elders_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.elders_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.elders_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

fallout_event_282_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_282_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_282_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_282_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_282_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_282_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_282_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_282_frozen_deaths = chaos_meter_deaths_country_civilian_total }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_282_frozen_medicine = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_282_frozen_shelter = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_282_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_282_intelligence_exposure } set_variable = { fallout_event_282_frozen_exposure = fallout_event_282_intelligence_exposure } }
		else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_282_frozen_exposure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		fallout_event_282_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_282_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_282_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_282_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.first_safe_birth_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.first_safe_birth_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_282_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_282_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_282_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_282_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_282_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.first_safe_birth_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_282_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				clear_variable = fallout_event_282_callback_cleanup_ticket
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_selected_branch = fallout_event_282_requested_branch }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_result_outcome = fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_registry_owner = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.first_safe_birth_candidate_id }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_282_registry_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_memory_opened
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_schedule_error
				clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_deaths
				clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion
				clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_medicine
				clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_shelter
				clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_recognition
				clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_exposure
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_schedule_error
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_deaths
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_medicine
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_shelter
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_exposure
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_282_opening_event_token = 0 }
}

			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_282_cost.public_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_282_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_282_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_282_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_282_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_282_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_282_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_282_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_282_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_282_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_deaths
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_medicine
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_shelter
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_frozen_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_282_result_outcome

		}

fallout_event_317_apply_failure_deaths = {
	every_owned_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_317_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_317_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_317_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_317_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_317_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_317_log.factory_failure } }
			}

fallout_event_317_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_317_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_317_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_317_branch.capital_first } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.capital_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.capital_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.capital_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_317_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_317_branch.clinics_first } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.clinic_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.clinic_medicine }

			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_317_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_317_branch.factories_first } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.factory_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.factory_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.factory_food }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.perimeter_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_317_cost.perimeter_fuel }

	}
}

fallout_event_317_resolve_result_and_schedule_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_result_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_317_result_outcome }
	fallout_event_resolve_issued_delayed_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_317_apply_result_effects = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		fallout_event_317_record_history = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_317_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_317_result_ticket }
		fallout_event_317_schedule_callback = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_scheduled
			set_variable = { fallout_event_317_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_schedule_error
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_317_result_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_result_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_result_mode = 0 }
}

fallout_event_317_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_317_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_317_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_317_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_317_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_317_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_317_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_317_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_317_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_317_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_317_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_317_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_317_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_317_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_power
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_capacity
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_governance
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_reclamation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_city_identity
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_civic
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_production
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_security
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_frozen_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_317_result_cleanup_ticket

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT THE FIRST UNMASKED DAY EFFECTS

# This chain uses a state-owned exposure-day receipt. The measured opening,
# clinic confidence, and shelter memory are fictional Fallout survival
# content. The effects never claim that ordinary radiation creates real-world
# biological or atmospheric outcomes.

fallout_event_471_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_471_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_death_request = constant:fallout_event_471_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_471_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_471_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_471_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_471_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_471_result_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_471_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_471_branch.open_schoolyard } check_variable = { fallout_event_471_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_471_log.open_schoolyard_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_471_branch.open_schoolyard } check_variable = { fallout_event_471_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_471_log.open_schoolyard_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_471_branch.open_schoolyard } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_471_log.open_schoolyard_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_471_branch.masked_work_shift } check_variable = { fallout_event_471_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_471_log.masked_work_shift_success } }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_471_branch.daylight_medical_trial } check_variable = { fallout_event_471_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_471_log.daylight_medical_trial_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_471_branch.daylight_medical_trial } check_variable = { fallout_event_471_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_471_log.daylight_medical_trial_partial } }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_471_log.sealed_until_clear_success } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_471_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_471_log.callback_partial } }

		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_471_callback_history_recorded }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_history_should_record = 0 }

fallout_event_471_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_component = fallout_event_471_frozen_mask_stock }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_component = constant:fallout_event_471_threshold.mask_stock_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_471_component = constant:fallout_event_471_threshold.weight_divisor }

fallout_event_100_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_100_result_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {

			check_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_100_branch.publish_strict_rations } }

				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.public_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.public_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_100_branch.hide_shortage_protect_caches } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.household_success } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.household_failure } }

				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.requisition_success }
			}
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.requisition_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.requisition_failure } }
		}
		else_if = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.callback_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_100_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_100_log.callback_partial } }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_history_recorded }

	}

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_100_threshold.food_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_100_threshold.recognition_household_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_100_threshold.food_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_100_branch.hide_shortage_protect_caches }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_100_threshold.food_partial compare = less_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_100_branch.requisition_private_stores }

		limit = {

				has_government = democratic
				has_government = communism
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_100_branch.publish_strict_rations }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_100_threshold.recognition_success compare = less_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_100_branch.hide_shortage_protect_caches }
	}
	else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_100_branch.publish_strict_rations } }
	fallout_event_100_schedule_result = yes
}

		fallout_event_100_record_history = yes
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_100_ration_law_chain_open
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_100_first_hunger_mission_open

fallout_event_100_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_100_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_100_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_100_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_100_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_100_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_100_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_100_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_100_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_scheduled
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_100_result_cleanup_released
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_cleanup_released
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_100_result_cleanup_released
						NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_scheduled }
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_100_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_100_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_100_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_100_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_100_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_100_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_100_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_100_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT INDEPENDENCE WAVE FRACTURE CONTRACT
# ============================================================================
# This file owns the release-gated border fracture. It uses reserved
# Independence Wave country definitions only as graphical and map-color
# templates. It never loads their focus trees. The live conflict ledger is
# built before a template can be copied, and the original country tags are
# preserved by the separate map-return receipt.
# ============================================================================

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Builds a live safe and blocked template ledger for
# this Fallout generation. A template already present as a live tag is blocked.
fallout_build_fracture_conflict_ledger = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_complete }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = global.fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_generation
						value = global.fallout_transition_generation
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool
		clear_array = global.fallout_fracture_safe_templates
		clear_array = global.fallout_fracture_blocked_templates
		set_variable = { global.fallout_fracture_template_count = constant:fallout_fracture_contract.zero }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_fracture_safe_template_count = constant:fallout_fracture_contract.zero }
		set_variable = { global.fallout_fracture_blocked_template_count = constant:fallout_fracture_contract.zero }
		clr_global_flag = fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_complete
		clr_global_flag = fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_blocked
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = ACX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = AFX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = AGX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = AJX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = ARX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = ASX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = ATX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = ICX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = AXX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = BAX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = BFX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = BHX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = BJX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = BKX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = BWX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = CIX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = CJX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = CKX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = CLX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = COX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = CPX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = CUX }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_template_pool value = CVX }

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Called on a reserved template scope.
fallout_fracture_record_template_status = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_blocked_templates value = THIS }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_fracture_blocked_template_count = constant:fallout_technology_regression.basic_floor_infantry }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_safe_templates value = THIS }
		add_to_variable = { global.fallout_fracture_safe_template_count = constant:fallout_technology_regression.basic_floor_infantry }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Selects a random severely scarred source and one
# non-capital state. The random draw is deliberately after the seven-day
# blackout work and is generation/date-seeded by the engine.
fallout_fracture_select_source_and_state = {
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_fracture_source
	clear_global_event_target = fallout_fracture_state
	random_country = {
		limit = { fallout_fracture_source_is_eligible = yes }
		save_global_event_target_as = fallout_fracture_source
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_capital = yes }
				OR = {
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_state_grade
						value = constant:fallout_state_grade.dead_city
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = fallout_state_grade
						value = constant:fallout_state_grade.wasteland
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = fallout_fracture_state
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Shared output setup. The helper is called only
# after a concrete reserved tag has been copied.
fallout_fracture_finalize_dynamic_output = {
	event_target:fallout_fracture_output = {
		transfer_state = event_target:fallout_fracture_state
		add_state_core = event_target:fallout_fracture_state
		set_capital = {
			state = event_target:fallout_fracture_state
			remember_old_capital = no
		}
		set_popularities = {
			democratic = 0
			fascism = 0
			communism = 0
			neutrality = 100
		}
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = neutrality
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_fracture_dynamic_country
		set_country_flag = fallout_country_survives
		set_country_flag = fallout_country_classified
		set_country_flag = fallout_country_package_applied
		set_country_flag = fallout_focus_package_applied
		set_country_flag = fallout_archetype_package_applied
		set_country_flag = fallout_regional_package_applied
		set_country_flag = fallout_country_memory_package_applied
		set_variable = { fallout_country_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_focus_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_archetype_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_regional_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_country_memory_package_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_fracture_output_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		fallout_regress_country_technology = yes
	}
	event_target:fallout_fracture_state = {
		set_state_flag = fallout_fracture_state_transferred
		set_variable = { fallout_fracture_output_country = event_target:fallout_fracture_output }
		set_variable = { fallout_fracture_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	}
	event_target:fallout_fracture_source = {
		set_country_flag = fallout_fracture_source_split
		set_variable = { fallout_fracture_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	}
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_output_countries value = event_target:fallout_fracture_output }
	add_to_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_output_states value = event_target:fallout_fracture_state }
	add_to_variable = { global.fallout_fracture_output_count = constant:fallout_technology_regression.basic_floor_infantry }
}

# Each branch is deliberately explicit because create_dynamic_country requires
# a literal source template token. No branch loads the source focus tree.
fallout_fracture_materialize_ACX = {
	if = { limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.fallout_fracture_safe_templates value = ACX } NOT = { ACX = { exists = yes } } } event_target:fallout_fracture_source = { create_dynamic_country = { original_tag = ACX copy_tag = ACX reserve_dynamic_country = yes save_global_event_target_as = fallout_fracture_output } } }
	if = { limit = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output } fallout_fracture_finalize_dynamic_output = yes }
}

fallout_fracture_materialize_one_dynamic_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_source has_event_target = fallout_fracture_state }
		clear_global_event_target = fallout_fracture_output
		random_list = {
			100 = { fallout_fracture_materialize_ACX = yes }
			100 = { fallout_fracture_materialize_AFX = yes }
			100 = { fallout_fracture_materialize_AGX = yes }
			100 = { fallout_fracture_materialize_AJX = yes }
			100 = { fallout_fracture_materialize_ARX = yes }
			100 = { fallout_fracture_materialize_ASX = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output } } fallout_fracture_materialize_ACX = yes }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output } } fallout_fracture_materialize_AFX = yes }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output } } fallout_fracture_materialize_AGX = yes }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output } } fallout_fracture_materialize_AJX = yes }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output } } fallout_fracture_materialize_ARX = yes }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output } } fallout_fracture_materialize_ASX = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Release-gated entry point used by the map-return
# transaction. A missing proof gate records a blocker rather than silently
# falling back to static borders.
fallout_apply_fracture_contract = {
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_fracture_release_is_enabled = yes }
		fallout_build_fracture_conflict_ledger = yes
		if = {
			limit = { fallout_fracture_conflict_ledger_is_current = yes }
			fallout_fracture_select_source_and_state = yes
			fallout_fracture_materialize_one_dynamic_country = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = fallout_fracture_output }
				set_global_flag = fallout_fracture_transition_applied
				set_variable = { global.fallout_fracture_transition_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			}
			else = {
				set_global_flag = fallout_fracture_transition_blocked
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.fracture_conflict_ledger_incomplete }
				fallout_register_transition_error_if_unowned = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_transition_error_to_register = constant:fallout_transition_error_code.none }
			}
		}
	}
	else = { set_global_flag = fallout_fracture_transition_unproven }
}

# West African Port Confederacies chain. The port council must decide whether to approach,
# shadow, avoid, or publicly signal an unidentified convoy. The effects own branch costs,
# immutable state and neighbor receipts, deterministic grading,
# Deaths requests, delayed result and callback scheduling, Event Log memory,
# and idempotent cleanup. The Fallout consequence remains a separate system.

fallout_event_775_clear_frozen = {
	clear_variable = fallout_event_775_frozen_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_775_frozen_owner
	clear_variable = fallout_event_775_frozen_controller

	clear_variable = fallout_event_775_frozen_neighbor_shelter

fallout_event_775_initialize_ledgers = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ghost_convoy_port_legitimacy_current } } set_variable = { fallout_ghost_convoy_port_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.initial_port_legitimacy } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ghost_convoy_piracy_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_ghost_convoy_piracy_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.initial_piracy_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ghost_convoy_rescue_duty } } set_variable = { fallout_ghost_convoy_rescue_duty = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.initial_rescue_duty } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ghost_convoy_prize_law_fund } } set_variable = { fallout_ghost_convoy_prize_law_fund = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.initial_prize_law_fund } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ghost_convoy_refugee_berth_pressure } } set_variable = { fallout_ghost_convoy_refugee_berth_pressure = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.initial_refugee_berth_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ghost_convoy_fleet_fatigue } } set_variable = { fallout_ghost_convoy_fleet_fatigue = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.initial_fleet_fatigue } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_ghost_convoy_cause_memory } } set_variable = { fallout_ghost_convoy_cause_memory = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.initial_cause_memory } }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_ghost_convoy_port_legitimacy_current min = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_ghost_convoy_piracy_pressure_current min = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_ghost_convoy_rescue_duty min = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_ghost_convoy_prize_law_fund min = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_ghost_convoy_refugee_berth_pressure min = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_ghost_convoy_fleet_fatigue min = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_ghost_convoy_cause_memory min = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.ledger_maximum }
}
fallout_event_775_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_775_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.approach compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.approach_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.approach_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.approach_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.shadow compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.shadow_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.shadow_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.shadow_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.avoid compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.avoid_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.avoid_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.avoid_cohesion }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.signal_publicly_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.signal_publicly_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.signal_publicly_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_775_cost.signal_publicly_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_775_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
}

fallout_event_775_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_775_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_775_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_775_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.approach compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.choice_approach } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.shadow compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.choice_shadow } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.avoid compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.choice_avoid } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.choice_signal_publicly } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.approach compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.approach_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.approach_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.approach_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.shadow compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.shadow_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.shadow_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.shadow_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.avoid compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.avoid_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.avoid_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.avoid_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.signal_publicly_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.signal_publicly_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.signal_publicly_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.callback_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.callback_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_775_log.callback_failure } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_775_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_775_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = fallout_event_775_target_state_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_775_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_775_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_775_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_775_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
}

			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_775_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_state_flag = fallout_event_775_neighbor_result_success }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_775_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial compare = equals } } set_state_flag = fallout_event_775_neighbor_result_partial }
			else = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_775_neighbor_result_failure }
		}
		var:fallout_event_775_frozen_neighbor_owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_775_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_ghost_convoy_register_failure }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.approach compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_ghost_convoy_approach }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.shadow compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_ghost_convoy_shadow }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_775_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_775_branch.avoid compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_ghost_convoy_avoid }
			}
			else = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_ghost_convoy_signal_publicly } }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_775_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_ghost_convoy_port_legitimacy_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }

	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_ghost_convoy_rescue_duty }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_ghost_convoy_prize_law_fund }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_ghost_convoy_cause_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_ghost_convoy_piracy_pressure_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_ghost_convoy_refugee_berth_pressure }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_ghost_convoy_fleet_fatigue }
	var:fallout_event_775_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_775_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_775_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_775_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_775_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_775_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_775_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_775_callback_score
}

		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_663_cost.joint_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_663_cost.joint_fuel }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_663_cost.joint_scrap }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_663_cost.joint_recognition }

	else_if = {

		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_663_cost.open_food }

			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
