# Called before a Fallout runtime generation is rebuilt. This state-bound row
# cancels an unconsumed opening, refunds a branch that never settled, terminalizes
# issued result or callback receipts, and removes cleanup tombstones before the
# country runtime arrays are cleared.
fallout_event_663_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_663_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_663_target_state_id }
		var:fallout_event_663_target_state_id = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_663_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_663_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = fallout_event_663_registry_generation NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_663_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_663_registry_generation } has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_cost_paid }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_chain_committed NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_663_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_result }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_result_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_callback }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_callback_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_cleanup }
			}
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_ai }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_663_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_663_state_is_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_663_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_663_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_663_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			fallout_event_663_cancel_opening_receipt = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_663_opening_target_is_current
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_663_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_effects_committed } } fallout_event_663_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_stale_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_result_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_callback }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_callback_ai }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_stale_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_delayed_result = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_663_stale_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_cleanup }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_chain_committed
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued }
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
						NOT = {
							OR = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_result }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_result_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_callback }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_callback_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_cleanup }

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_663_stale_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket } }

				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }

				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }

				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_cleanup }

				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_cancellation_history_recorded } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.three }
			fallout_event_663_record_history = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {

					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.great_lakes_lock_winter_result_ai }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_scheduled

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_memory_opened
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_effects_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_effects_committed

fallout_event_663_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_663_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_663_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_663_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_663_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_663_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_effects_committed } } fallout_event_663_refund_branch_cost = yes }
			fallout_event_663_release_state_reservation = yes
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_memory_opened
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_effects_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_callback_effects_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_663_result_memory_recorded
			clear_variable = fallout_event_663_callback_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_663_result_cleanup_ticket
			fallout_event_663_clear_frozen = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_663_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_824_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_824_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.neighbors_equal compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.neighbors_equal_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.neighbors_equal_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.neighbors_equal_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.favored_clients compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.favored_clients_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.favored_clients_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.favored_clients_cohesion }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.domestic_first compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.domestic_first_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.domestic_first_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.domestic_first_medicine }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.military_network_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.military_network_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_824_cost.military_network_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
}

fallout_event_824_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_824_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_824_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_824_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.neighbors_equal compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.choice_neighbors_equal } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.favored_clients compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.choice_favored_clients } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.domestic_first compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.choice_domestic_first } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.choice_military_network } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.neighbors_equal compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.neighbors_equal_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.neighbors_equal_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.neighbors_equal_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.favored_clients compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.favored_clients_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.favored_clients_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.favored_clients_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.domestic_first compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.domestic_first_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.domestic_first_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.domestic_first_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.military_network_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.military_network_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.military_network_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.callback_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.callback_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_824_log.callback_failure } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_824_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_824_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = fallout_event_824_target_state_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
}

fallout_event_824_schedule_result = {

	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_824_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_requested_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.none compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_requested_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.upper_bound compare = less_than }
			fallout_event_824_country_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_824_opening_target_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_824_requested_branch_is_affordable = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_824_selected_branch = fallout_event_824_requested_branch }

		fallout_event_824_calculate_grade = yes

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_824_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_824_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_824_selected_branch }

		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_824_timing.result_delay_days }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_824_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.grid_vote_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_824_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_memory_opened
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_pending
				var:fallout_event_824_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_824_registry_committed }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				fallout_event_824_record_history = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_history_stage = 0 }

				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }

				fallout_event_824_refund_branch_cost = yes

			fallout_event_824_clear_frozen = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_schedule_error
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_opening_mode = 0 }

fallout_event_824_apply_neighbor_diplomacy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_event_824_frozen_neighbor_state_id
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_frozen_neighbor_state_id value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than }
		}
		var:fallout_event_824_frozen_neighbor_state_id = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_824_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_state_flag = fallout_event_824_neighbor_result_success }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_824_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial compare = equals } } set_state_flag = fallout_event_824_neighbor_result_partial }
			else = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_824_neighbor_result_failure }
		}
		var:fallout_event_824_frozen_neighbor_owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_824_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_grid_vote_grid_failure }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.neighbors_equal compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_grid_vote_neighbors_equal }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.favored_clients compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_grid_vote_favored_clients }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_824_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_824_branch.domestic_first compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_grid_vote_domestic_first }
			}
			else = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_grid_vote_military_network } }
		}

fallout_event_824_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_grid_vote_grid_legitimacy_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_grid_vote_export_trust }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_grid_vote_grid_reserve }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_grid_vote_grid_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_grid_vote_dependency_pressure_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_grid_vote_client_capacity }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_grid_vote_diplomatic_power }
	var:fallout_event_824_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_824_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_824_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_824_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_824_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_824_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_824_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_824_callback_score
}

fallout_event_824_resolve_result_and_schedule_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_824_result_outcome }
	fallout_event_resolve_issued_delayed_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_824_apply_result_effects = yes
		fallout_event_824_calculate_callback_outcome = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_824_result_ticket }
		fallout_event_824_schedule_callback = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_callback_scheduled
			set_variable = { fallout_event_824_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_824_result_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_824_callback_schedule_error
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_824_result_mode = 0 }
}

fallout_event_782_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.port_republic compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.choice_port_republic } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.inland_alliance compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.choice_inland_alliance } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.military_occupation compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.choice_military_occupation } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.choice_evacuate } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.port_republic compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.port_republic_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.port_republic_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.port_republic_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.inland_alliance compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.inland_alliance_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.inland_alliance_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.inland_alliance_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.military_occupation compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.military_occupation_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.military_occupation_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.military_occupation_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.evacuate_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.evacuate_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.evacuate_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.callback_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.callback_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_782_log.callback_failure } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_782_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }

		var:fallout_event_782_frozen_neighbor_owner = {

				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_harbor_without_city_register_failure }
			}

				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.port_republic compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_harbor_without_city_port_republic }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.inland_alliance compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_harbor_without_city_inland_alliance }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.military_occupation compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_harbor_without_city_military_occupation }
			}
			else = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_harbor_without_city_evacuate } }
		}
	}

		set_country_flag = fallout_harbor_without_city_register_failed

	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.port_republic compare = equals } }

		}
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_harbor_without_city_port_republic_contested }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.inland_alliance compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_harbor_without_city_inland_alliance_memory }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_harbor_without_city_inland_alliance_contested }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_782_branch.military_occupation compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_harbor_without_city_political_memory }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_harbor_without_city_political_contested }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_harbor_without_city_evacuate_memory }

fallout_event_782_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_harbor_without_city_authority_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_harbor_without_city_garrison_trust }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_harbor_without_city_claim_pressure_fund }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_harbor_without_city_cause_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_harbor_without_city_inland_grievance_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_harbor_without_city_evacuee_capacity }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_harbor_without_city_port_food_reserve }
	var:fallout_event_782_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_782_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_782_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_782_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_782_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_782_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_782_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_782_callback_score
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_result_mode = 0 }
}

fallout_event_782_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_782_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_782_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_782_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_782_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_782_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_782_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_cleanup_released
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_result_cleanup_released }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_782_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_782_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_782_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_782_registry_reserved clr_state_flag = fallout_event_782_registry_committed } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_782_frozen_neighbor_state_id } var:fallout_event_782_frozen_neighbor_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_782_neighbor_reserved } }
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_782_callback_cleanup_released

fallout_event_747_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_747_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_747_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_747_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_747_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_747_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_747_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_747_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_747_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_747_state_death_request = 0 }

	}

fallout_event_747_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_747_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_747_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_747_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_747_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_747_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_747_selected_branch = fallout_event_747_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_747_snapshot_registry = yes
		fallout_event_747_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_747_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_747_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.health_without_borders_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.health_without_borders_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_747_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_747_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_747_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.health_without_borders_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			fallout_event_747_pay_branch_cost = yes
			set_variable = { fallout_event_747_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_747_result_outcome = fallout_event_747_calculated_outcome }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_747_result_grade = fallout_event_747_grade }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_747_result_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_747_result_day = global.num_days }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_747_chain_committed
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_747_chain_pending
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_747_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			fallout_event_747_record_history = yes
		}
		else = {
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			fallout_event_747_clear_state_reservation = yes
			var:fallout_event_747_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_747_registry_committed }

fallout_event_747_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_747_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.health_without_borders_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.health_without_borders_ai }
			}
		}
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_747_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_747_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_747_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_747_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_747_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_747_log.cancelled_stage }
				fallout_event_747_record_history = yes
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_747_refund_branch_cost = yes }
				fallout_event_747_clear_state_reservation = yes
				var:fallout_event_747_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_747_registry_committed }
				fallout_event_747_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
	}
	clear_variable = fallout_event_747_opening_target_is_current
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_generation NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_747_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_generation } has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_cost_paid }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_747_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		fallout_event_747_clear_state_reservation = yes
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_747_target_state_id } var:fallout_event_747_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_747_registry_committed } }
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_chain_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_chain_pending
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_callback_scheduled
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_cost_paid
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_choice_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_result_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_callback_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_cancellation_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_target_invalidated
		fallout_event_747_clear_frozen = yes
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_owner
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_candidate_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_target_type
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_target
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_target_state_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_selected_branch
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_result_outcome
		clear_variable = fallout_event_747_callback_outcome

fallout_event_747_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_747_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_747_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_747_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_747_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_747_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_747_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_747_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_747_memory_closed
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_747_target_state_id NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_target_invalidated } }
				var:fallout_event_747_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_747_memory_closed }
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_chain_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_callback_cleanup_released
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_747_target_state_id }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_747_target_invalidated } var:fallout_event_747_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_747_registry_committed } }
				else = { var:fallout_event_747_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_747_registry_committed } }
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_747_target_invalidated
			fallout_event_747_clear_state_reservation = yes
			fallout_event_747_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_callback_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_747_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}

fallout_event_677_apply_failure_deaths = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_failure_death_percent = constant:fallout_event_677_threshold.protected_issue_failure_death_percent }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_677_branch.equal_measure } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_failure_death_percent = constant:fallout_event_677_threshold.equal_measure_failure_death_percent }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_677_branch.field_requisition } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_failure_death_percent = constant:fallout_event_677_threshold.field_requisition_failure_death_percent }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_677_branch.rear_echelon_stand_down } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_failure_death_percent = constant:fallout_event_677_threshold.rear_echelon_stand_down_failure_death_percent }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_677_result_state_id > 0 }
			fallout_event_677_ration_registry_is_current = yes
		}
		var:fallout_event_677_result_state_id = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_death_request = fallout_event_677_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_677_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_677_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_677_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_failure_death_percent = 0 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_677_result_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_677_callback_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_677_log.cancelled_stage }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_677_cancellation_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_677_log.callback_failure }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }

fallout_event_677_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_677_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_677_branch.protected_issue } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.protected_issue_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.protected_issue_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.protected_issue_recognition }
			add_command_power = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.protected_issue_command_power_negative
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_677_branch.equal_measure } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.equal_measure_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.equal_measure_recognition }
			add_command_power = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.equal_measure_command_power_negative
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_677_branch.field_requisition } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.field_requisition_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.field_requisition_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.field_requisition_recognition }
			add_command_power = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.field_requisition_command_power_negative
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_677_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_677_branch.rear_echelon_stand_down } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.rear_echelon_stand_down_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.rear_echelon_stand_down_medicine }
			army_experience = constant:fallout_event_677_cost.rear_echelon_stand_down_army_experience_negative
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_677_cost_paid
	}
}

	var:fallout_event_492_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }

			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_492_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_492_death_request = constant:fallout_event_492_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_492_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_492_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_492_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_492_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_838_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_838_log.choice_strict_technocracy } }
		}
		else_if = {

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_838_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_838_log.universal_rights_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_838_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_838_branch.service_tiers compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_838_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_838_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_838_log.service_tiers_success } }

	set_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_score = fallout_laboratory_citizenship_citizenship_legitimacy_current }

	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_score = fallout_laboratory_citizenship_education_capacity }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_score = fallout_laboratory_citizenship_citizenship_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_score = fallout_laboratory_citizenship_class_pressure_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_score = fallout_laboratory_citizenship_apprentice_capacity }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_score = fallout_laboratory_citizenship_civic_confidence }
	var:fallout_event_838_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_838_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_838_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_838_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_838_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_838_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_838_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

		fallout_event_838_calculate_callback_outcome = yes

			set_country_flag = fallout_event_838_callback_scheduled
			set_variable = { fallout_event_838_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_838_result_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_838_callback_schedule_error
		}

fallout_event_243_select_partner = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_243_partner_id = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_243_partner_score = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_243_partner_power = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_243_partner_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	every_neighbor_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			fallout_survival_country_identity_row_is_current = yes
			fallout_survival_country_resource_row_is_durable = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_243_partner.minimum_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			any_owned_state = {
				check_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation value = constant:fallout_event_243_partner.minimum_reclamation compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		every_owned_state = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation value = ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_reclamation compare = greater_than } }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_reclamation = air_winter_reclamation }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_score = ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_reclamation }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_partner_id = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
					check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_score value = ROOT.fallout_event_243_partner_score compare = greater_than }
					AND = {
						check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_score value = ROOT.fallout_event_243_partner_score compare = equals }
						check_variable = { var = THIS.id value = ROOT.fallout_event_243_partner_id compare = less_than }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_partner_id = THIS.id }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_partner_score = ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_score }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_partner_power = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_partner_reclamation = ROOT.fallout_event_243_neighbor_reclamation }
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_243_neighbor_reclamation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_243_neighbor_score
	}
	clear_variable = fallout_event_243_neighbor_reclamation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_243_neighbor_score
}

fallout_event_243_apply_factory_commitment = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.cannibalize_industrial_line }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_243_factory_removal_applied }
		}
		var:fallout_event_243_transformer_state_id = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_selected_building_type = constant:fallout_event_243_building_type.civilian }
					check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@industrial_complex value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than }
				}
				remove_building = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_factory_removal_applied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_selected_building_type = constant:fallout_event_243_building_type.military }
					check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@arms_factory value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than }
				}
				remove_building = { type = arms_factory level = 1 }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_factory_removal_applied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_243_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_243_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.cannibalize_industrial_line } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_243_cost.industry_power }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.protect_hospital_power } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_243_cost.hospital_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_243_cost.hospital_medicine }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.decentralize_microgrids } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_243_cost.microgrid_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_243_cost.microgrid_scrap }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_243_cost.neighbor_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_243_cost.neighbor_recognition }
		}
		fallout_event_243_apply_factory_commitment = yes
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_243_cost_paid
	}
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
}

fallout_event_243_apply_failure_deaths_and_damage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_243_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_243_deaths_applied }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_243_deaths_applied_count = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		var:fallout_event_243_transformer_state_id = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_243_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_243_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.cannibalize_industrial_line } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_243_death_request = constant:fallout_event_243_threshold.industry_failure_death_percent }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.protect_hospital_power } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_243_death_request = constant:fallout_event_243_threshold.hospital_failure_death_percent }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.decentralize_microgrids } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_243_death_request = constant:fallout_event_243_threshold.microgrid_failure_death_percent }
			}
			else = { multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_243_death_request = constant:fallout_event_243_threshold.neighbor_failure_death_percent } }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_243_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_243_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_243_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_deaths_applied_count = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_243_failure_damage_applied value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@infrastructure value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.cannibalize_industrial_line }
						check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.decentralize_microgrids }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_243_branch.cannibalize_industrial_line } }
					damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_243_RESULT_INDUSTRY_FAILURE_BUILDING_DAMAGE }
				}
				else = { damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_243_RESULT_MICROGRID_FAILURE_BUILDING_DAMAGE } }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_243_failure_damage_applied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_243_deaths_applied_count > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_death_count = fallout_event_243_deaths_applied_count }
			fallout_orientation_record_exact_country_deaths = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_243_deaths_applied
	}
}

# Manchurian Reactor Keeps chain. The power board must decide whether hospital
# wards, food depots, repair halls, or the perimeter receives the next live circuit. The effects own branch costs,
# immutable state and neighbor receipts, deterministic grading,
# Deaths requests, delayed result and callback scheduling, Event Log memory,
# and idempotent cleanup. The Fallout consequence remains a separate system.

fallout_event_803_clear_frozen = {
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_owner
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_controller
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_shelter
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_supply
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_adaptation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_exposure
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_disease
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_state_id
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_owner
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_controller
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_shelter
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_supply
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_disease

	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_frozen_sector_trust
