fallout_event_803_initialize_ledgers = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_load_shedding_load_legitimacy_current } } set_variable = { fallout_load_shedding_load_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.initial_load_legitimacy } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_load_shedding_sector_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_load_shedding_sector_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.initial_sector_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_load_shedding_sector_trust } } set_variable = { fallout_load_shedding_sector_trust = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.initial_sector_trust } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_load_shedding_power_reserve } } set_variable = { fallout_load_shedding_power_reserve = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.initial_power_reserve } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_load_shedding_technician_capacity } } set_variable = { fallout_load_shedding_technician_capacity = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.initial_technician_capacity } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_load_shedding_scrap_reserve } } set_variable = { fallout_load_shedding_scrap_reserve = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.initial_scrap_reserve } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_load_shedding_grid_memory } } set_variable = { fallout_load_shedding_grid_memory = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.initial_grid_memory } }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_load_shedding_load_legitimacy_current min = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_load_shedding_sector_pressure_current min = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_load_shedding_sector_trust min = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_load_shedding_power_reserve min = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_load_shedding_technician_capacity min = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_load_shedding_scrap_reserve min = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_load_shedding_grid_memory min = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.ledger_maximum }
}
fallout_event_803_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_803_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.hospital_priority compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.hospital_priority_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.hospital_priority_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.hospital_priority_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.food_priority compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.food_priority_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.food_priority_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.food_priority_cohesion }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.industry_priority compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.industry_priority_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.industry_priority_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.industry_priority_medicine }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.defense_priority_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.defense_priority_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_803_cost.defense_priority_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_803_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
}

fallout_event_803_snapshot_registry = {
	fallout_event_803_initialize_ledgers = yes
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_registry_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_registry_owner = ROOT }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.load_shedding_candidate_id }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_registry_target = fallout_event_803_target_state_id }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_frozen_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_frozen_load_legitimacy = fallout_load_shedding_load_legitimacy_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_frozen_sector_pressure = fallout_load_shedding_sector_pressure_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_frozen_sector_trust = fallout_load_shedding_sector_trust }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_frozen_power_reserve = fallout_load_shedding_power_reserve }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_frozen_technician_capacity = fallout_load_shedding_technician_capacity }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_frozen_scrap_reserve = fallout_load_shedding_scrap_reserve }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_state_id = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:fallout_event_803_target_state_id = {
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_owner = OWNER }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_controller = CONTROLLER }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_supply = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_exposure = air_winter_exposure }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		every_neighbor_state = {
			limit = {
				always = yes
				NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				owner = { exists = yes }
				fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_state_id value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = THIS.id value = ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_state_id compare = less_than }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_state_id = THIS.id }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_owner = OWNER }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_controller = CONTROLLER }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_supply = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_event_803_registry_reserved
	}
	var:fallout_event_803_frozen_neighbor_state_id = {
		set_state_flag = fallout_event_803_neighbor_reserved
	}
}

fallout_event_803_calculate_grade = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_component = fallout_event_803_frozen_supply }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_component = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.state_supply_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_component = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_viability = fallout_event_803_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_component = fallout_event_803_frozen_shelter }

fallout_event_803_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_803_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_803_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_803_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.hospital_priority compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.choice_hospital_priority } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.food_priority compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.choice_food_priority } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.industry_priority compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.choice_industry_priority } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.choice_defense_priority } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.hospital_priority compare = equals } }

				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.hospital_priority_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.hospital_priority_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.food_priority compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.food_priority_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.food_priority_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.food_priority_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_803_branch.industry_priority compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.industry_priority_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.industry_priority_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.industry_priority_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.defense_priority_success } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_803_log.defense_priority_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {

		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_803_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_803_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_803_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_803_callback_history_recorded }

fallout_event_803_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_load_shedding_load_legitimacy_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_load_shedding_sector_trust }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_load_shedding_power_reserve }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_load_shedding_grid_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_load_shedding_sector_pressure_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_load_shedding_technician_capacity }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_load_shedding_scrap_reserve }
	var:fallout_event_803_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_803_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_803_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_803_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_803_callback_score
}

fallout_event_803_resolve_result_and_schedule_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_803_result_outcome }
	fallout_event_resolve_issued_delayed_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_803_apply_result_effects = yes
		fallout_event_803_calculate_callback_outcome = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_803_result_ticket }
		fallout_event_803_schedule_callback = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_803_callback_scheduled
			set_variable = { fallout_event_803_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_803_result_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_803_callback_schedule_error
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_803_result_mode = 0 }
}

fallout_event_845_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_845_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_845_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_845_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_845_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_845_branch.follow_recommendation compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.choice_follow_recommendation } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_845_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_845_branch.sandbox_test compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.choice_sandbox_test } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_845_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_845_branch.human_review compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.choice_human_review } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.choice_advisory_status } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_845_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_845_branch.follow_recommendation compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.follow_recommendation_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.follow_recommendation_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.follow_recommendation_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_845_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_845_branch.sandbox_test compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.sandbox_test_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.sandbox_test_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.sandbox_test_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_845_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_845_branch.human_review compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.human_review_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.human_review_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.human_review_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_845_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_845_log.advisory_status_success } }

					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_845_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_845_callback_scheduled } }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_845_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_845_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_845_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_845_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_845_memory_opened
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_845_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_845_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_845_memory_closed } }
			fallout_event_845_clear_frozen = yes

		var:fallout_event_345_target_state_id = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_reclamation_partial } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_supply_partial } } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_exposure_partial } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_345_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_345_timing.callback_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_manual_protocol_partial days = fallout_event_345_state_modifier_days } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_345_state_modifier_days = 0 } }
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_power_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_scrap_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_medicine_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_recognition_failure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_cohesion_failure }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_stability_failure
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_war_support_failure
		var:fallout_event_345_target_state_id = { subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_reclamation_failure } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_supply_failure } } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_345_threshold.callback_exposure_failure } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } set_state_flag = fallout_event_345_memory_protocol_abandoned set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_345_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_345_timing.callback_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_manual_protocol_unsafe days = fallout_event_345_state_modifier_days } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_345_state_modifier_days = 0 } }
		fallout_event_345_apply_callback_failure_deaths = yes
	}
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_345_memory_closed
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
}

fallout_event_506_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_506_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_506_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_506_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_506_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_506_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_506_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_506_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_506_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_506_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_506_callback_cleanup_released }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_506_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_506_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_506_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_506_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_506_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_506_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_506_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_506_chain_committed

	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_component = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_grade = fallout_event_614_component }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_614_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.surface_council } }

				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_614_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.military_integration } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_grade value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.military_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_614_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.evacuate_lower_districts } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_grade value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.evacuation_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}

	}
	else_if = {

				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_614_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.surface_council } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_grade value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.surface_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_614_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.tunnel_autonomy } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_grade value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.tunnel_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_614_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.military_integration } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_grade value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.military_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_614_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.evacuate_lower_districts } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_grade value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.evacuation_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }

fallout_event_614_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_614_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_614_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_614_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_614_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_614_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_614_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_614_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_614_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_614_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_614_selected_branch = fallout_event_614_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_614_snapshot_registry = yes
		fallout_event_614_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_614_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_614_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.metro_republic_below_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.metro_republic_below_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_614_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_614_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_614_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.metro_republic_below_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			fallout_event_614_pay_branch_cost = yes
			set_variable = { fallout_event_614_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_614_result_outcome = fallout_event_614_calculated_outcome }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_614_result_grade = fallout_event_614_grade }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_614_result_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_614_result_day = global.num_days }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_614_chain_committed
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_614_chain_pending
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			fallout_event_614_record_history = yes
		}
		else = {
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			fallout_event_614_clear_state_reservation = yes
			var:fallout_event_614_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_614_registry_committed }
			fallout_event_614_clear_frozen = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_grade = 0 }
}

fallout_event_614_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	fallout_event_614_initialize_ledgers = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_best_score = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_invalid_option }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_surface_priority }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_continuity_bonus } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_surface_cohesion_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_surface_recognition_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_continuity_bonus } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.scavenger_syndicate } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.nomad_convoy } } check_variable = { var = fallout_metro_salvage_access_current value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_surface_recognition_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_scavenger_bonus } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_ai_score value = fallout_event_614_ai_best_score compare = greater_than } fallout_event_614_surface_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_best_score = fallout_event_614_ai_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_614_branch.surface_council } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_tunnel_priority }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.bunker_authority } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_bunker_bonus } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_shelter_capacity value = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_tunnel_shelter_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.ai_continuity_bonus } }
		}
	}

			add_to_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.callback_partial_shelter }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.callback_partial_reclamation }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_614_memory_review_partial
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_614_timing.callback_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_metro_republic_reviewed_partial days = fallout_event_614_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.callback_failure_cohesion }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		var:fallout_event_614_target_state_id = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.callback_failure_supply }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_shelter_capacity = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.callback_failure_shelter }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_614_threshold.callback_failure_exposure }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_614_memory_review_failure
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_614_timing.callback_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_metro_republic_reviewed_failed days = fallout_event_614_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
		fallout_event_614_apply_callback_failure_deaths = yes
	}
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = 0 }
}

fallout_event_614_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_614_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.metro_republic_below_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.metro_republic_below_ai }
			}
		}
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_614_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_614_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_614_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_614_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_614_log.cancelled_stage }
				fallout_event_614_record_history = yes
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_614_refund_branch_cost = yes }
				fallout_event_614_clear_state_reservation = yes
				var:fallout_event_614_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_614_registry_committed }
				fallout_event_614_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
	}
	clear_variable = fallout_event_614_opening_target_is_current
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_generation NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_generation } has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_cost_paid }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_614_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		fallout_event_614_clear_state_reservation = yes
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_614_target_state_id } var:fallout_event_614_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_614_registry_committed } }
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_chain_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_chain_pending
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_callback_scheduled
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_cost_paid
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_choice_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_result_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_callback_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_cancellation_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_target_invalidated
		fallout_event_614_clear_frozen = yes
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_owner
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_candidate_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_target_type
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_target
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_target_state_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_selected_branch
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_result_outcome
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_callback_outcome
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_result_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_result_day
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_result_cleanup_ticket
		clear_variable = fallout_event_614_callback_cleanup_ticket
	}
}

fallout_event_614_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_614_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_614_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_614_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_614_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_614_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_614_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_chain_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_callback_cleanup_released
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_614_target_state_id }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_614_target_invalidated } var:fallout_event_614_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_614_registry_committed } }
				else = { var:fallout_event_614_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_614_registry_committed } }
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_614_target_invalidated
			fallout_event_614_clear_state_reservation = yes
			fallout_event_614_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_callback_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_614_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_614_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_642_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.trade_mineral_shares } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.trade_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.trade_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.trade_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.conscript_labor_shift } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.labor_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.labor_fuel }
			add_command_power = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.labor_command_power_negative
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.engineer_rule } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.engineer_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.engineer_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.engineer_recognition }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.evacuation_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.evacuation_shelter }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_642_cost.evacuation_medicine }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_branch_component = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_maximum }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_branch_component = fallout_mine_food_debt }

	else = {

		divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_component = constant:fallout_event_runtime.three }

fallout_event_642_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	fallout_event_642_calculate_grade = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.trade_mineral_shares } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_grade value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.trade_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.conscript_labor_shift } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_grade value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.labor_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.engineer_rule } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_grade value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.engineer_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.evacuate_works } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_grade value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.evacuation_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.trade_mineral_shares } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_grade value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.trade_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.conscript_labor_shift } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_grade value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.labor_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.engineer_rule } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_grade value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.engineer_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.evacuate_works } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_grade value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.evacuation_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
	}
}

# Apply the branch's durable policy direction before the frozen grade is
# calculated. These ledgers persist through cleanup and are never a deposit
# substitute.
fallout_event_642_apply_branch_settlement_ledgers = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.trade_mineral_shares } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_extraction_continuity = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.trade_extraction_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_food_debt = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.trade_food_debt_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_worker_trust = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.trade_worker_trust_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_foreign_concession_pressure = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.trade_concession_settlement }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.conscript_labor_shift } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_extraction_continuity = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.labor_extraction_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_food_debt = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.labor_food_debt_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_worker_trust = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.labor_worker_trust_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_labor_coercion = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.labor_coercion_settlement }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.engineer_rule } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_extraction_continuity = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.engineer_extraction_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_food_debt = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.engineer_food_debt_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_worker_trust = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.engineer_worker_trust_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_engineer_authority = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.engineer_authority_settlement }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_extraction_continuity = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.evacuation_extraction_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_food_debt = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.evacuation_food_debt_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_worker_trust = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.evacuation_worker_trust_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_evacuation_readiness = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.evacuation_readiness_settlement }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_mine_foreign_concession_pressure = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.evacuation_concession_settlement }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mine_extraction_continuity min = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mine_food_debt min = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mine_worker_trust min = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mine_labor_coercion min = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mine_engineer_authority min = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mine_evacuation_readiness min = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mine_foreign_concession_pressure min = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ledger_maximum }
}

fallout_event_642_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_642_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_state_death_request = state_population_k }

			if = {

fallout_event_642_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	fallout_event_642_initialize_ledgers = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_best_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_invalid_option }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_candidate_exposure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_candidate_disease = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_candidate_exposure = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_exposure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_candidate_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}

	# Trade is the first tie-break lane and the default for continuity, food,
	# nomad, or maritime governments.
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_trade_priority }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.food_compact } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.nomad_convoy } } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_food_compact_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant } fallout_event_642_trade_branch_affordable = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_food_compact_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_ai_score value = fallout_event_642_ai_best_score compare = greater_than } fallout_event_642_trade_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_best_score = fallout_event_642_ai_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.trade_mineral_shares } }

	# Engineers are the second deterministic tie lane.
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_engineer_priority }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.technate } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.machine_protocol } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.scavenger_syndicate } } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_food_compact_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant } NOT = { fallout_event_642_trade_branch_affordable = yes } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_maritime_fallback_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_ai_score value = fallout_event_642_ai_best_score compare = greater_than } fallout_event_642_engineer_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_best_score = fallout_event_642_ai_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.engineer_rule } }

	# Evacuation follows Engineers in ties and rises with exposed or diseased
	# candidate states, Nomad Convoy also keeps it as the second safe lane.
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_evacuation_priority }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.quarantine_state } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.religious_refuge } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.mutant_polity } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.bunker_authority } check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.nomad_convoy } } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_food_compact_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_ai_candidate_exposure value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_high_exposure_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_exposure_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_ai_candidate_disease value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_high_disease_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_exposure_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_ai_score value = fallout_event_642_ai_best_score compare = greater_than } fallout_event_642_evacuation_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_best_score = fallout_event_642_ai_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.evacuate_works } }

	# Labor is last in tie order and is preferred by Warlord Command in war,
	# low-food, or low-cohesion conditions.
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_labor_priority }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.warlord_command } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_coercion_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.warlord_command } has_war = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_coercion_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.warlord_command } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_low_food_threshold compare = less_than } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_exposure_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.warlord_command } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_low_cohesion_threshold compare = less_than } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_642_threshold.ai_coercion_factor } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_ai_score value = fallout_event_642_ai_best_score compare = greater_than } fallout_event_642_labor_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_best_score = fallout_event_642_ai_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_642_branch.conscript_labor_shift } }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_642_branch.none } } fallout_event_642_schedule_result = yes }
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
		fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_best_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_candidate_exposure = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_ai_candidate_disease = 0 }
}

fallout_event_642_resolve_result_and_schedule_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }

	if = {

fallout_event_642_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_642_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_642_target_state_id }
		var:fallout_event_642_target_state_id = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_642_state_receipt_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_642_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = fallout_event_642_registry_generation NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_642_registry_generation } has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cost_paid }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_chain_pending NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_ai }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_642_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_642_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_642_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_642_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_642_log.cancelled_stage }
				fallout_event_642_record_history = yes
				fallout_event_642_revert_branch_settlement_ledgers = yes
				fallout_event_642_refund_branch_cost = yes
				fallout_event_642_clear_state_reservation = yes
				var:fallout_event_642_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_642_registry_committed }
				fallout_event_642_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_642_opening_target_is_current
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_result_effects_committed } }
			fallout_event_642_revert_branch_settlement_ledgers = yes
			fallout_event_642_refund_branch_cost = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_stale_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_result_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_callback }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_callback_ai }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_stale_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_delayed_result = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_642_stale_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_cleanup }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_chain_pending
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued }
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
						NOT = {
							OR = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_result }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_result_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_callback }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_callback_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_cleanup }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_ticket }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_642_callback_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_stale_ticket = fallout_event_642_callback_cleanup_ticket }
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_ticket } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_stale_ticket = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_ticket } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_stale_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_642_stale_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_cleanup }
				fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_cleanup }
				fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cancellation_history_recorded } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_642_log.cancelled_stage }
			fallout_event_642_record_history = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_human }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_result_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_callback }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_callback_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mine_generator_cleanup }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_642_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_642_target_state_id } var:fallout_event_642_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_642_registry_reserved clr_state_flag = fallout_event_642_registry_committed } }
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_chain_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_cleanup_released
			fallout_event_642_clear_frozen = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_stale_ticket = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_clear_allowed = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_abort_required = 0 }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_642_target_is_current
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_642_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_642_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_642_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_chain_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_642_callback_cleanup_released
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_642_target_state_id }
				var:fallout_event_642_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_642_registry_committed }
			}
			fallout_event_642_clear_state_reservation = yes
			fallout_event_642_clear_frozen = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_642_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT THE MISSING PATROL EFFECTS
