# This dormant chain resolves one missing winter patrol through a frozen state
# receipt, durable cause-memory ledgers, one delayed result, one callback, and
# exact cleanup. Human and hidden-AI lanes share the same effects.

fallout_event_527_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_527_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_527_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_527_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_527_death_request = constant:fallout_event_527_threshold.failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_527_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_527_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_527_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_527_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes

		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_527_callback_history_recorded }

fallout_event_887_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_887_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_887_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_887_branch.equal_citizenship compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_887_log.choice_equal_citizenship } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_887_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_887_branch.separate_districts compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_887_log.choice_separate_districts } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_887_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_887_branch.supervised_integration compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_887_log.choice_supervised_integration } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_887_log.choice_refuse_settlement } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_887_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_887_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_887_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_cleanup_released }

			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_887_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_887_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_cleanup_released
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_result_cleanup_released }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_887_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_scheduled }

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_scheduled } }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_887_memory_opened
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_887_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_887_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_887_memory_closed } }
			fallout_event_887_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_registry_target

			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_callback_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_grade
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_887_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_frozen_medicine value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.local_medicine_bonus_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_grade = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.local_medicine_bonus } }
	}

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.return_plan } }

	else = {

	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_grade = fallout_event_635_component }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade min = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero max = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_maximum }
}

fallout_event_635_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	fallout_event_635_calculate_grade = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.local_citizenship } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.local_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.return_plan } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.return_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.military_colony } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.military_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.open_pass_community } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.open_pass_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.local_citizenship } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.local_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.return_plan } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.return_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.military_colony } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.military_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.open_pass_community } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_grade value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.open_pass_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
	}
}

fallout_event_635_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_635_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_635_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_635_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_635_apply_result_ledgers = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.local_citizenship } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_census_completeness = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.census_completeness_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_census_completeness = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.census_completeness_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_partial } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_census_completeness = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.census_completeness_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_failure } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.return_plan } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_return_readiness = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.return_readiness_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_open_pass_access = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.open_pass_success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_return_readiness = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.return_readiness_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_open_pass_access = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.open_pass_partial } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_return_readiness = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.return_readiness_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_open_pass_access = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.open_pass_failure } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.military_colony } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_route_strain = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.route_strain_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_military_settlement = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.military_settlement_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_route_strain = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.route_strain_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_military_settlement = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.military_settlement_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_partial } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_route_strain = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.route_strain_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_military_settlement = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.military_settlement_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.exclusion_grievance_failure } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_household_trust = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.household_trust_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_open_pass_access = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.open_pass_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_census_completeness = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.census_completeness_partial } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_household_trust = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.household_trust_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_open_pass_access = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.open_pass_partial } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_household_trust = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.household_trust_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_open_pass_access = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.open_pass_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_mountain_census_completeness = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.census_completeness_failure } }

	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mountain_census_completeness min = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mountain_return_readiness min = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mountain_exclusion_grievance min = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mountain_route_strain min = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mountain_household_trust min = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_mountain_military_settlement min = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_maximum }

fallout_event_635_apply_result_effects = {
	fallout_event_635_apply_result_ledgers = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_water_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_food_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_fuel_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_medicine_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_shelter_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_recognition_success }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_cohesion_success }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.local_citizenship } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.local_citizenship_cohesion_success } }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_stability_success
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_war_support_success
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_635_timing.result_modifier_days }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.local_citizenship } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_mountain_pass_local_country days = fallout_event_635_modifier_days } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.return_plan } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_mountain_pass_return_country days = fallout_event_635_modifier_days } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_635_branch.military_colony } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_mountain_pass_military_country days = fallout_event_635_modifier_days } }
		else = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_mountain_pass_open_country days = fallout_event_635_modifier_days } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_modifier_days = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_635_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }

		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_water_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_food_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_fuel_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_medicine_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_shelter_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_recognition_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_cohesion_partial }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_stability_partial
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.result_war_support_partial
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_635_timing.result_modifier_days }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_mountain_pass_partial_country days = fallout_event_635_modifier_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_modifier_days = 0 }

	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_callback_score = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.callback_grade_divisor }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_callback_score min = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero max = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.ledger_maximum }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_635_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_635_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_635_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }

}

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_635_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_635_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_635_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {

				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_635_result_cleanup_prepared }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_635_result_cleanup_released }

			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_635_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_635_result_cleanup_prepared }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_635_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_635_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_635_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_635_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_635_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_chain_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_choice_history_recorded

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_result_cleanup_prepared
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_635_callback_outcome_frozen
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_635_target_state_id }

			}
			fallout_event_635_clear_state_reservation = yes
			fallout_event_635_clear_frozen = yes
		}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_635_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_761_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_761_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.open_recognition compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.open_recognition_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.open_recognition_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.open_recognition_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.medical_inspection compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.medical_inspection_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.medical_inspection_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.medical_inspection_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.symbolic_meeting compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.symbolic_meeting_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.symbolic_meeting_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.symbolic_meeting_cohesion }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.refuse_contact_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.refuse_contact_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.refuse_contact_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_761_cost.refuse_contact_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_761_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
}

	}

	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_761_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_761_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_761_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.open_recognition compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.choice_open_recognition } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.medical_inspection compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.choice_medical_inspection } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.symbolic_meeting compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.choice_symbolic_meeting } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.choice_refuse_contact } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.open_recognition compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.open_recognition_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.open_recognition_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.open_recognition_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.medical_inspection compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.medical_inspection_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.medical_inspection_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.medical_inspection_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.symbolic_meeting compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.symbolic_meeting_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.symbolic_meeting_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.symbolic_meeting_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.refuse_contact_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.refuse_contact_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.refuse_contact_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.callback_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.callback_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_761_log.callback_failure } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_761_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_761_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = fallout_event_761_target_state_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_761_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_761_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_761_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }

fallout_event_761_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_761_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_requested_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.none compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_761_requested_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.upper_bound compare = less_than }
			fallout_event_761_country_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_761_opening_target_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_761_requested_branch_is_affordable = yes
		}

		fallout_event_761_pay_branch_cost = yes

		fallout_event_761_calculate_grade = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_761_result_outcome = fallout_event_761_calculated_outcome }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_761_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_761_opening_ticket }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.mutant_envoy_gate_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_761_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {

				set_country_flag = fallout_event_761_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_761_memory_opened
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_761_pending

				fallout_event_761_record_history = yes

			else = {

			fallout_event_761_clear_frozen = yes

		}
		var:fallout_event_761_frozen_neighbor_state_id = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_761_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_state_flag = fallout_event_761_neighbor_result_success }

			else = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_761_neighbor_result_failure }
		}
		var:fallout_event_761_frozen_neighbor_owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_761_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_mutant_envoy_gate_register_failure }

			else_if = {

			}

				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.medical_inspection compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_mutant_envoy_gate_medical_inspection }

			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_761_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_761_branch.symbolic_meeting compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_mutant_envoy_gate_symbolic_meeting }

		}
	}

				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_269_log.secrecy_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_269_log.secrecy_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.permit_community_memorials } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_269_log.memorial_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_269_log.clerks_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_269_log.clerks_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_269_log.clerks_failure } }
			}
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_269_log.callback_success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_269_log.callback_partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_269_log.history_id }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_269_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes

		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_history_should_record = 0 }

fallout_event_269_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability_component = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.recognition_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability = fallout_event_269_viability_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability_component = fallout_event_269_frozen_cohesion }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.cohesion_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability = fallout_event_269_viability_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_death_component = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.deaths_score_cap }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_death_component = fallout_event_269_frozen_deaths }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_death_component value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = less_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_death_component = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_death_component = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.deaths_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_death_component = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.deaths_score_cap }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability = fallout_event_269_death_component }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_event_269_viability
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability min = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.maximum_viability }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.publish_names } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.publish_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.publish_success_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.publish_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.publish_partial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.maintain_military_secrecy } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.secrecy_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.secrecy_success_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.secrecy_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.secrecy_partial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.permit_community_memorials } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.memorial_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.memorial_success_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.memorial_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.memorial_partial_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.clerks_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.clerks_success_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_viability value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.clerks_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.clerks_partial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_viability_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_death_component = 0 }
}

fallout_event_269_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_269_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.publish_names } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.publish_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.publish_power }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.maintain_military_secrecy } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.secrecy_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.secrecy_power }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.permit_community_memorials } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.memorial_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.memorial_scrap }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.clerks_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.clerks_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_269_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

fallout_event_269_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_269_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_269_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_269_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_269_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_269_frozen_deaths = chaos_meter_deaths_country_civilian_total }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_269_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_269_intelligence_exposure } set_variable = { fallout_event_269_frozen_exposure = fallout_event_269_intelligence_exposure } }
		else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_269_frozen_exposure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		fallout_event_269_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_269_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_269_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_269_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_publish_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_publish_result_ai }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.maintain_military_secrecy } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_secrecy_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_secrecy_result_ai } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.permit_community_memorials } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_memorial_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_memorial_result_ai } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.delegate_to_local_clerks } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_clerks_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_clerks_result_ai } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_269_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_269_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_269_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_269_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_269_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.names_missing_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_269_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				clear_variable = fallout_event_269_callback_cleanup_ticket
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_selected_branch = fallout_event_269_requested_branch }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_outcome = fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_registry_owner = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.names_missing_candidate_id }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_269_registry_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_269_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_269_memory_opened
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_269_schedule_error
				clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_deaths
				clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition
				clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_cohesion
				clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_exposure
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_269_schedule_error
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_deaths
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_exposure
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_opening_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = 0 }
}

fallout_event_269_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.delegate_to_local_clerks }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.ai_high_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.publish_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.publish_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.publish_names }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { has_government = fascism has_government = neutrality }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.secrecy_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.secrecy_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.maintain_military_secrecy }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_269_threshold.ai_memorial_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.memorial_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.memorial_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.permit_community_memorials }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.clerks_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.clerks_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.delegate_to_local_clerks }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.publish_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.publish_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.publish_names }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.secrecy_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_269_cost.secrecy_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_269_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_269_branch.maintain_military_secrecy }

				has_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_cleanup_released

			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_269_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_269_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_269_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_269_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_deaths
			clear_variable = fallout_event_269_frozen_recognition

fallout_event_541_apply_failure_deaths = {
	every_owned_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_541_threshold.failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_541_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_541_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_541_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_viability = fallout_event_541_viability_component }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_event_541_viability
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_541_viability min = constant:fallout_event_541_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_541_threshold.maximum_viability }

fallout_event_541_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_541_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_541_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.common_civic_rite } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.civic_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.civic_power }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_541_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.separate_rites } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.separate_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.separate_power }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_541_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.state_ceremony } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.ceremony_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.ceremony_scrap }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.burial_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.burial_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_541_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

fallout_event_541_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {

			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_541_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_541_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_541_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_541_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }

		set_variable = { fallout_event_541_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_541_intelligence_exposure } set_variable = { fallout_event_541_frozen_exposure = fallout_event_541_intelligence_exposure } }
		else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_541_frozen_exposure = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_541_frozen_disease_pressure = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_541_frozen_family_trust = fallout_new_funeral_family_trust_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_541_frozen_religious_tension = fallout_new_funeral_religious_tension_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_541_frozen_public_health = fallout_new_funeral_public_health_current }
		fallout_event_541_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_541_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_541_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_funeral_civic_result_ai }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.separate_rites } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_funeral_separate_rites_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_funeral_separate_rites_result_ai } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.state_ceremony } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_funeral_state_ceremony_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_funeral_state_ceremony_result_ai } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.rapid_burial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_funeral_rapid_burial_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_funeral_rapid_burial_result_ai } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_541_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_541_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_541_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_541_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_541_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_funeral_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_541_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_callback_cleanup_ticket
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_selected_branch = fallout_event_541_requested_branch }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_result_outcome = fallout_event_541_calculated_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_registry_owner = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.new_funeral_candidate_id }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_541_registry_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_541_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_541_memory_opened
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_541_schedule_error
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_deaths
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_recognition
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_cohesion
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_exposure
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_disease_pressure
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_family_trust
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_religious_tension
				clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_public_health
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_541_schedule_error
			clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_deaths
			clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_disease_pressure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_family_trust
			clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_religious_tension
			clear_variable = fallout_event_541_frozen_public_health
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_opening_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = 0 }
}

fallout_event_541_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.rapid_burial }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_541_threshold.ai_high_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.civic_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.civic_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.common_civic_rite }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { has_government = fascism has_government = neutrality }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.separate_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.separate_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.separate_rites }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_541_threshold.ai_ceremony_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.ceremony_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.ceremony_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.state_ceremony }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.burial_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.burial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.rapid_burial }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.civic_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.civic_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.common_civic_rite }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.separate_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_541_cost.separate_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}

	else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_541_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_541_branch.state_ceremony } }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_541_callback_cleanup_released

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_649_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_649_log.callback_failure }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_649_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_649_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_649_branch.quiet_remembrance } }

			else_if = {

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_649_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_649_log.military_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_649_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_649_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_649_log.festivals_success } }

fallout_event_649_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_649_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_649_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_649_branch.quiet_remembrance } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.quiet_recognition }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.quiet_shelter }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.quiet_medicine }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_649_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_649_branch.ration_feast } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.feast_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.feast_clean_water }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.feast_fuel }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_649_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_649_branch.military_ceremony } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.military_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.military_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { command_power = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.military_command_power }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.festivals_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.festivals_recognition }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_649_cost.festivals_scrap }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_649_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

# Called before a Fallout runtime generation is rebuilt. This country-only row
# has no state reservation, so the stale path only refunds an uncommitted
# branch, terminalizes issued result or callback receipts, and removes its
# cleanup tombstones before the runtime arrays are cleared.
fallout_event_649_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_649_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = fallout_event_649_registry_generation NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_649_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_649_registry_generation } has_country_flag = fallout_event_649_cost_paid }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_649_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_result }
