				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_cleanup }
			}
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_649_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_649_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_human }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_649_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_649_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_649_result_effects_committed } } fallout_event_649_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_649_stale_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_result_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_callback }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.new_year_without_fireworks_callback_ai }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_649_stale_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }

							OR = {

				OR = {

fallout_event_579_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_579_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.public_pump_board } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_579_cost.public_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_579_cost.public_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_579_cost.public_recognition }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_579_cost.public_water }
		}

fallout_event_579_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	fallout_event_579_calculate_grade = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.public_pump_board } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_viability value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.public_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.upstream_command } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_viability value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.command_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.river_cooperatives } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_viability value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.cooperative_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.emergency_hold } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_viability value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.hold_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.public_pump_board } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_viability value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.public_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.upstream_command } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_viability value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.command_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.river_cooperatives } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_viability value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.cooperative_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.emergency_hold } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_viability value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.hold_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}

	}

fallout_event_579_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_579_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_579_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_579_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_579_country_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_579_target_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target value = fallout_event_579_candidate_state_id compare = equals }
			fallout_event_579_requested_branch_affordable = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = fallout_event_579_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_579_pay_branch_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_opening_target_type = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_opening_target = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_579_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_579_selected_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.nile_pump_congress_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.nile_pump_congress_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_579_selected_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_579_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_579_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_579_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = fallout_event_579_opening_target_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = fallout_event_579_opening_target }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.nile_pump_congress_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_579_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_579_target_state_id = fallout_event_579_opening_target }
				fallout_event_579_snapshot_registry = yes
				fallout_event_579_calculate_outcome = yes
				set_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = fallout_event_579_calculated_outcome }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_579_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_nile_pump_congress_pending
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				fallout_event_579_record_history = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				fallout_event_579_refund_branch_cost = yes
			}
		}
		else = { fallout_event_579_refund_branch_cost = yes }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes } fallout_event_579_cancel_opening_receipt = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_calculated_outcome = 0 }
}

	fallout_event_579_schedule_result = yes

fallout_event_579_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.none }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.ai_low_water_threshold compare = less_than } fallout_event_579_command_branch_affordable = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.upstream_command }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_government = democratic has_government = communism } fallout_event_579_public_branch_affordable = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.public_pump_board }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { fallout_event_579_ai_winter_pressure = yes fallout_event_579_cooperative_branch_affordable = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.river_cooperatives }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = war_support value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.ai_high_war_support_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } fallout_event_579_command_branch_affordable = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.upstream_command }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_579_cooperative_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.river_cooperatives } }
	else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_579_public_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.public_pump_board } }
	else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_579_command_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.upstream_command } }
	else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_579_hold_branch_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.emergency_hold } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_579_branch.none } } fallout_event_579_choose_branch = yes }
	else = { fallout_event_579_cancel_opening_receipt = yes }
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_579_target_is_current = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled } }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_579_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
	fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_579_log.cancelled_stage }
		fallout_event_579_record_history = yes
		clear_variable = fallout_event_579_target_state_id
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = 0 }
}

		if = {

			else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.command_supply_failure } }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_579_result_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_579_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_579_log.cancelled_stage } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_579_cancellation_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.cancelled }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.river_cooperatives } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.choice_cooperative } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.choice_hold } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.public_pump_board } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.public_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.public_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.public_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_579_branch.upstream_command } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.command_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.command_partial } }

				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.cooperative_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.cooperative_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.cooperative_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.hold_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_579_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.hold_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_579_log.hold_failure } }

	var:fallout_event_579_target_state_id = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current } }

		if = { limit = { has_variable = air_winter_exposure } subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_579_callback_score = air_winter_exposure } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_579_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_579_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_579_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }

		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_food_reserve min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }

	}

	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.grade_divisor }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.civil_air_service } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.civil_cohesion_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.branch_civil_grade_bonus } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.military_network } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_frozen_high_war_support } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.branch_military_grade_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.private_couriers } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_frozen_scrap value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.courier_scrap_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.branch_courier_grade_bonus } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_old_airfield_smuggling_pressure_current value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.courier_smuggling_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.branch_courier_grade_penalty } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.international_consortium } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.consortium_recognition_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.branch_consortium_grade_bonus } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_frozen_power value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.consortium_power_threshold compare = less_than } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.branch_consortium_grade_penalty } }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade min = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero max = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.grade_maximum }
}

fallout_event_586_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	fallout_event_586_calculate_grade = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.civil_air_service } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.civil_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.military_network } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.military_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.private_couriers } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.courier_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.international_consortium } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.consortium_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.civil_air_service } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.civil_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.military_network } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.military_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.private_couriers } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.courier_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.international_consortium } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_grade value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.consortium_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
	}

fallout_event_586_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_586_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_586_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_586_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_586_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_586_country_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_586_target_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target value = fallout_event_586_candidate_state_id compare = equals }
			fallout_event_586_requested_branch_affordable = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = fallout_event_586_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_586_pay_branch_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_opening_target_type = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_opening_target = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_586_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_586_selected_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.old_airfield_chain_result }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.old_airfield_chain_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_586_selected_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_586_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_586_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_586_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = fallout_event_586_opening_target_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = fallout_event_586_opening_target }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.old_airfield_chain_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_586_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_586_target_state_id = fallout_event_586_opening_target }
				fallout_event_586_snapshot_registry = yes
				fallout_event_586_calculate_outcome = yes
				set_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_outcome = fallout_event_586_calculated_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_old_airfield_selected_branch_memory = fallout_event_586_selected_branch }
				set_variable = { fallout_old_airfield_result_grade = fallout_event_586_grade }
				set_variable = { fallout_old_airfield_target_route_type = fallout_event_586_selected_branch }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_586_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_chain_pending
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				fallout_event_586_record_history = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				fallout_event_586_refund_branch_cost = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_586_opening_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			fallout_event_586_refund_branch_cost = yes
			fallout_event_586_clear_state_reservation = yes
			fallout_event_586_clear_frozen = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_586_log.cancelled_stage } fallout_event_586_record_history = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes } fallout_event_586_cancel_opening_receipt = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_calculated_outcome = 0 }
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = 0 }

fallout_event_586_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_choice_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_result_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_586_log.cancelled_stage } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_cancellation_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.civil_air_service } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.choice_civil } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.military_network } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.choice_military } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.private_couriers } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.choice_courier } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.choice_consortium } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.civil_air_service } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.civil_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.civil_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.civil_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.military_network } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.military_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_586_log.military_partial } }

	var:fallout_event_586_target_state_id = {

			limit = { check_variable = { state_population_k > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }

			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_death_request = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_586_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_586_death_request }

			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		}
	}

}

fallout_event_586_apply_target_state_effects = {
	var:fallout_event_586_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_supply_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_supply_partial } }
			else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_supply_failure } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.military_network } check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_military_supply_success } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = air_winter_reclamation }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_reclamation_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_reclamation_partial } }
			else = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_reclamation_failure } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = air_winter_exposure }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_exposure_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_exposure_partial } }
			else = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.result_exposure_failure } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } check_variable = { var = building_level@air_base value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.maximum_air_base compare = less_than } }
			add_building_construction = { type = air_base level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@air_base value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.minimum_air_base compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			damage_building = { type = air_base damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_586_THRESHOLD_BUILDING_DAMAGE_FAILURE }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.civil_air_service } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_civil_corridor } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.military_network } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_military_corridor } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.private_couriers } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_courier_corridor } }
		else = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_consortium_corridor } }
		clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = air_winter_reclamation } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = air_winter_exposure } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } }
		set_state_flag = fallout_old_airfield_chain_state_memory
	}
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_result_modifier_days = 0 }

fallout_event_586_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_old_airfield_route_reliability_current }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_old_airfield_flight_safety_current }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_old_airfield_intelligence_reach_current }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade_component = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade_component = fallout_old_airfield_smuggling_pressure_current }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_event_586_grade_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade_component = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade_component = fallout_old_airfield_external_dependency_current }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_event_586_grade_component }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_586_branch.military_network } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_old_airfield_military_control_current }
	}
	else = { add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_old_airfield_trade_access_current } }
	var:fallout_event_586_target_state_id = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = air_winter_reclamation } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = air_winter_exposure } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade_component = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.ledger_maximum } subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_grade_component = air_winter_exposure } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = fallout_event_586_grade_component } }
	}
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_score = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.grade_divisor }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	else = { set_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }
	set_variable = { fallout_old_airfield_callback_grade = fallout_event_586_callback_score }
	set_variable = { fallout_old_airfield_final_quality = fallout_event_586_callback_outcome }
}

fallout_event_586_apply_callback_state_effects = {
	var:fallout_event_586_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_supply_partial } }
			else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_supply_failure } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = air_winter_reclamation }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_reclamation_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_reclamation_partial } }
			else = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_reclamation_failure } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = air_winter_exposure }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_exposure_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_exposure_partial } }
			else = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.callback_exposure_failure } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@air_base value = constant:fallout_event_586_threshold.minimum_air_base compare = greater_than_or_equals } } damage_building = { type = air_base damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_586_THRESHOLD_BUILDING_DAMAGE_FAILURE } }
		clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = air_winter_reclamation } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = air_winter_exposure } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } }
	}
}

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_local_air_service }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_grounded_public_route }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_contested_air_command }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_garrison_route_failed }
	}
	else_if = {

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_licensed_courier_network }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_courier_network }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_smuggling_network }
	}
	else = {

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_dependent_consortium }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_consortium_collapse }

	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes

fallout_event_586_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_586_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.old_airfield_chain_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.old_airfield_chain_ai }
			}
		}
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_586_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_586_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_586_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_586_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_586_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_586_log.cancelled_stage }
				fallout_event_586_record_history = yes
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_586_refund_branch_cost = yes }
				var:fallout_event_586_target_state_id = {
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_586_registry_reserved
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_586_registry_committed
				}
				fallout_event_586_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
	}
	clear_variable = fallout_event_586_opening_target_is_current
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = fallout_event_586_registry_generation
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_586_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_586_registry_generation }
					has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_cost_paid
				}
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_586_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_586_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_586_target_state_id }
			var:fallout_event_586_target_state_id = {
				clr_state_flag = fallout_event_586_registry_reserved
				clr_state_flag = fallout_event_586_registry_committed
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_civil_corridor }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_military_corridor }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_courier_corridor }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_consortium_corridor }
			}
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_result_success }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_result_partial }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_result_failed }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_callback_success }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_callback_partial }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_callback_failed }
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_chain_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_old_airfield_chain_pending
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_callback_scheduled
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_target_invalidated
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_callback_outcome_locked
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_cost_paid
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_memory_closed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_choice_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_result_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_callback_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_cancellation_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_result_cleanup_released
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_586_callback_cleanup_released
		fallout_event_586_clear_frozen = yes
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_registry_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_registry_owner
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_candidate_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_registry_target_type
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_registry_target
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_target_state_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_candidate_state_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_selected_branch
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_result_outcome
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_callback_outcome
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_result_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_result_day
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_result_cleanup_ticket
		clear_variable = fallout_event_586_callback_cleanup_ticket
	}

	var:fallout_event_586_target_state_id = {
		clr_state_flag = fallout_event_586_registry_reserved

		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_old_airfield_civil_corridor }

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_viability value = constant:fallout_event_901_threshold.public_trial_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_viability value = constant:fallout_event_901_threshold.public_trial_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_viability value = constant:fallout_event_901_threshold.truth_commission_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }

	else_if = {

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_viability value = constant:fallout_event_901_threshold.pardon_for_knowledge_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_viability value = constant:fallout_event_901_threshold.pardon_for_knowledge_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {

fallout_event_901_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_901_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_901_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_901_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.public_trial compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.choice_public_trial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.truth_commission compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.choice_truth_commission } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.pardon_for_knowledge compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.choice_pardon_for_knowledge } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.choice_secret_retention } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.public_trial compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.public_trial_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.public_trial_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.public_trial_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.truth_commission compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.truth_commission_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.truth_commission_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.truth_commission_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.pardon_for_knowledge compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.pardon_for_knowledge_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.pardon_for_knowledge_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.pardon_for_knowledge_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.secret_retention_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.secret_retention_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.secret_retention_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.callback_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.callback_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_901_log.callback_failure } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_901_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_901_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = fallout_event_901_target_state_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_901_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_901_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_901_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
}

fallout_event_901_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {


		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_901_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_requested_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.none compare = greater_than }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_requested_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.upper_bound compare = less_than }
			fallout_event_901_country_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_901_opening_target_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_901_requested_branch_is_affordable = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_901_selected_branch = fallout_event_901_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_901_pay_branch_cost = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_901_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		fallout_event_901_snapshot_registry = yes
		fallout_event_901_calculate_grade = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_outcome = fallout_event_901_calculated_outcome }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_901_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_901_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_901_selected_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.old_doctor_trial_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.old_doctor_trial_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_901_selected_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_901_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_901_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_opening_mode value = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_901_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.old_doctor_trial_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_901_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_901_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_901_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_901_memory_opened
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_901_pending
				var:fallout_event_901_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_901_registry_committed }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
				fallout_event_901_record_history = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_history_stage = 0 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				fallout_event_901_refund_branch_cost = yes
				var:fallout_event_901_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_901_registry_reserved }
				fallout_event_901_clear_frozen = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_901_schedule_error
			}
		}
		else = {
			fallout_event_901_refund_branch_cost = yes
			var:fallout_event_901_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_901_registry_reserved }
			fallout_event_901_clear_frozen = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_901_schedule_error
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_opening_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_requested_branch = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_901_calculated_outcome = 0 }
}

fallout_event_901_apply_neighbor_diplomacy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_event_901_frozen_neighbor_state_id
			check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_frozen_neighbor_state_id value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than }
		}
		var:fallout_event_901_frozen_neighbor_state_id = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_901_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_state_flag = fallout_event_901_neighbor_result_success }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_901_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial compare = equals } } set_state_flag = fallout_event_901_neighbor_result_partial }
			else = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_901_neighbor_result_failure }
		}
		var:fallout_event_901_frozen_neighbor_owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_901_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_old_doctor_trial_register_failure }
			}

		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.public_trial compare = equals } }

			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_old_doctor_trial_public_trial_memory
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_old_doctor_trial_public_trial_contested }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.truth_commission compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_old_doctor_trial_truth_commission_memory }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_old_doctor_trial_truth_commission_contested }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_901_branch.pardon_for_knowledge compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_old_doctor_trial_pardon_for_knowledge_memory }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_old_doctor_trial_pardon_for_knowledge_contested }
	}
	else = {

fallout_event_901_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_old_doctor_trial_trial_legitimacy_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_old_doctor_trial_medicine_trust }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_old_doctor_trial_witness_confidence_fund }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_old_doctor_trial_trial_cause_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_old_doctor_trial_atrocity_pressure_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_old_doctor_trial_refugee_pressure }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_old_doctor_trial_doctor_fatigue }
	var:fallout_event_901_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_901_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_901_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_901_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_901_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_901_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_901_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_901_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_901_callback_score
}

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_901_callback_cleanup_released

			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_373_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_373_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_373_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_373_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_373_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_373_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_373_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_373_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_373_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_373_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_373_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_373_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_registry_target
			fallout_event_373_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_result_day

			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_373_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_373_cleanup_ticket = 0 }

	else_if = {

fallout_event_740_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_740_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_740_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_740_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_740_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_740_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_740_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_740_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_740_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_740_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_740_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_740_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_740_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_740_selected_branch = fallout_event_740_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_740_snapshot_registry = yes
		fallout_event_740_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_740_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_740_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.open_the_sealed_city_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.open_the_sealed_city_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_740_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_740_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_740_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.open_the_sealed_city_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			fallout_event_740_pay_branch_cost = yes
			set_variable = { fallout_event_740_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_740_result_outcome = fallout_event_740_calculated_outcome }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_740_result_grade = fallout_event_740_grade }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_740_result_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_740_result_day = global.num_days }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_740_chain_committed
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_740_chain_pending
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			fallout_event_740_record_history = yes
		}
		else = {
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			fallout_event_740_clear_state_reservation = yes
			var:fallout_event_740_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_740_registry_committed }
			fallout_event_740_clear_frozen = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_grade = 0 }
}
