fallout_event_740_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	fallout_event_740_initialize_ledgers = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_740_branch.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_ai_best_score = constant:fallout_event_740_threshold.ai_invalid_option }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_740_threshold.ai_surface_priority }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_ai_score = constant:fallout_event_740_threshold.ai_continuity_bonus } }

fallout_event_740_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_740_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_740_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.open_the_sealed_city_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.open_the_sealed_city_ai }
			}
		}
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_740_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_740_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_740_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_740_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_740_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_740_log.cancelled_stage }
				fallout_event_740_record_history = yes
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_740_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_740_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_740_refund_branch_cost = yes }
				fallout_event_740_clear_state_reservation = yes
				var:fallout_event_740_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_740_registry_committed }
				fallout_event_740_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
	}
	clear_variable = fallout_event_740_opening_target_is_current
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_generation NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_740_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_generation } has_country_flag = fallout_event_740_cost_paid }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_740_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_740_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_740_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		fallout_event_740_clear_state_reservation = yes
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_740_target_state_id } var:fallout_event_740_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_740_registry_committed } }
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_chain_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_chain_pending
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_callback_scheduled
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_cost_paid
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_choice_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_result_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_callback_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_cancellation_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_target_invalidated
		fallout_event_740_clear_frozen = yes
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_owner
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_candidate_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_target_type
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_target
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_target_state_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_selected_branch
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_result_outcome
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_callback_outcome
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_result_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_result_day
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_result_cleanup_ticket
		clear_variable = fallout_event_740_callback_cleanup_ticket
	}

fallout_event_740_cleanup = {

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_740_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_740_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_740_callback_cleanup_released }

			set_country_flag = fallout_event_740_memory_closed

			}

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_chain_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_result_history_recorded

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_cancellation_history_recorded

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_callback_cleanup_released
			if = {

				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_740_target_invalidated } var:fallout_event_740_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_740_registry_committed } }
				else = { var:fallout_event_740_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_740_registry_committed } }
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_740_target_invalidated
			fallout_event_740_clear_state_reservation = yes
			fallout_event_740_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_callback_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_740_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}

fallout_event_408_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_408_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_death_request = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_408_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_408_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_408_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_408_log.scientist_control_partial } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_408_log.callback_success } }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_408_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_408_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
}

fallout_event_408_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = fallout_event_408_frozen_food }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.food_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_viability = fallout_event_408_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = fallout_event_408_frozen_adaptation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.adaptation_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_viability = fallout_event_408_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = fallout_event_408_frozen_reclamation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.reclamation_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_viability = fallout_event_408_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = fallout_event_408_frozen_seed_memory }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.seed_memory_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_viability = fallout_event_408_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = fallout_event_408_frozen_cohesion }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.cohesion_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_viability = fallout_event_408_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = fallout_event_408_frozen_recognition }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.recognition_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_viability = fallout_event_408_component }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability min = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.maximum_viability }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.harvest_early } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.harvest_early_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.harvest_early_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.preserve_seed } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.preserve_seed_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.preserve_seed_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.open_festival } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.open_festival_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.open_festival_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.scientist_control_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_408_viability value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.scientist_control_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_viability = 0 }
}

fallout_event_408_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.harvest_early } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.harvest_early_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.harvest_early_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.harvest_early_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.preserve_seed } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.preserve_seed_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.preserve_seed_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.preserve_seed_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.open_festival } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.open_festival_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.open_festival_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.open_festival_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	else = { subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.scientist_control_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.scientist_control_medicine } set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_408_cost.scientist_control_cohesion } fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes }
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_408_cost_paid
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
}

fallout_event_408_clear_frozen = {
	clear_variable = fallout_event_408_frozen_food
	clear_variable = fallout_event_408_frozen_medicine
	clear_variable = fallout_event_408_frozen_cohesion
	clear_variable = fallout_event_408_frozen_adaptation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_408_frozen_reclamation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_408_frozen_seed_memory
	clear_variable = fallout_event_408_frozen_recognition
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Capture the major ticket before the delayed result
# is reserved. The opening envelope remains at the opening stage until the
# authored event consumes it.
fallout_event_408_open_major_arc_stages = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.major_arc_stage } }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Advance through conflict and choice after the
# major opening envelope has been consumed.
fallout_event_408_advance_arc_opening_to_choice = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.conflict }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.choice }
			fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The delayed result is the fourth authored arc
# position after the opening, conflict, and choice stages.
fallout_event_408_advance_arc_to_delayed_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.delayed_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_408_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The callback occupies consequence and callback
# stages before delayed cleanup is released.
fallout_event_408_advance_arc_to_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.consequence }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_408_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.callback }
			fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Cleanup advances the authored arc to its terminal
# stage and releases the exact identity and cleanup token.
fallout_event_408_close_major_arc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.cleanup }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_408_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.orchard_flowers_candidate_id }
			fallout_event_release_major_arc = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A failed delayed-row reservation cancels and
# releases the major identity instead of leaving an opening slot orphaned.
fallout_event_408_cancel_major_arc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
		fallout_event_cancel_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.orchard_flowers_candidate_id }
			fallout_event_release_major_arc = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket
	}
}

fallout_event_408_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
				fallout_event_issued_major_arc_stage_is_current = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_408_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_408_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_408_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_408_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_408_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_408_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		fallout_event_408_open_major_arc_stages = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_408_frozen_food = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_408_frozen_medicine = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_408_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_408_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_408_frozen_adaptation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_adaptation }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_408_frozen_reclamation = fallout_pretransition_air_winter_reclamation }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_orchard_seed_memory_current } } set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orchard_seed_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.initial_seed_memory } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_orchard_reserve_current } } set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_orchard_reserve_current = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.initial_orchard_reserve } }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_408_frozen_seed_memory = ROOT.fallout_orchard_seed_memory_current }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_408_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_408_selected_branch = fallout_event_408_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_408_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_408_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_408_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_408_requested_branch }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = fallout_event_408_major_arc_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.orchard_flowers_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.orchard_flowers_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_408_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_408_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_408_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_408_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.orchard_flowers_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_408_opening_event_token }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.major_arc_stage } }
				fallout_event_consume_issued_major_arc_stage = yes
			}
			else = {
				fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				fallout_event_408_advance_arc_opening_to_choice = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_result_outcome = fallout_event_408_calculated_outcome }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_result_day = global.num_days }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_registry_owner = ROOT }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.orchard_flowers_candidate_id }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_408_registry_target = fallout_event_408_target_state_id }
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_408_chain_committed
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_408_memory_opened
					var:fallout_event_408_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_408_orchard_registry_committed set_variable = { fallout_event_408_orchard_reserve = ROOT.fallout_orchard_reserve_current } }
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
					fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
					fallout_event_408_cancel_major_arc = yes
					fallout_event_408_clear_frozen = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				fallout_event_408_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			fallout_event_408_cancel_major_arc = yes

		}

fallout_event_408_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.harvest_early }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.ai_scientist_control_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.scientist_control } }
	fallout_event_408_schedule_result = yes

	if = {

		var:fallout_event_408_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.result_reclamation_success }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_408_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.preserve_seed } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_orchard_flowers_seed_guard days = fallout_event_408_modifier_days } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_408_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_408_branch.open_festival } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_orchard_flowers_public_bloom days = fallout_event_408_modifier_days } }
			else = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_orchard_flowers_science_plot days = fallout_event_408_modifier_days } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_408_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_408_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.result_food_partial }

		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.result_war_support_partial
		add_to_variable = { fallout_orchard_seed_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_408_threshold.result_seed_memory_partial }

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source: common/scripted_effects/fallout_world_end_orientation_event_log_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT ASH-WEEK ORIENTATION EVENT LOG EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Dormant, receipt-authenticated event-log writer for the five Ash-week
# orientation components. It appends one Fallout memory row only for a newly
# applied result. The payload preserves component, branch, and outcome in a
# fixed numeric matrix so the Event Log can render concrete text without
# borrowing ordinary event identifiers.
#
# Scope: COUNTRY.
# Inputs: fallout_orientation_transaction_component,
# fallout_orientation_transaction_branch, fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome.
# The caller supplies fallout_orientation_history_should_record as one only
# when the result was newly applied.
# ============================================================================

fallout_orientation_record_history = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_should_record = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component > constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_component < constant:fallout_event_orientation_component.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_transaction_branch < constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome > constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
			check_variable = { fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome < constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_payload = fallout_orientation_transaction_component }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_payload = constant:fallout_orientation_log.component_multiplier }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_branch_payload = fallout_orientation_transaction_branch }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_branch_payload = constant:fallout_orientation_log.branch_multiplier }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_payload = fallout_orientation_history_branch_payload }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_payload = fallout_orientation_frozen_outcome }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_orientation_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_orientation_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.zero }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
		set_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_component = fallout_orientation_transaction_component }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_payload = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_branch_payload = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_orientation_history_should_record = 0 }
}

fallout_event_817_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_817_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_817_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_817_branch.public_domain compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_817_cost.public_domain_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_817_cost.public_domain_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_817_cost.public_domain_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_817_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_817_branch.inventor_rights compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_817_cost.inventor_rights_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_817_cost.inventor_rights_recognition }

			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_817_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_817_branch.state_secrecy compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_817_cost.state_secrecy_scrap }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_817_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_817_log.public_domain_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_817_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_817_branch.inventor_rights compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_817_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_817_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_817_log.inventor_rights_success } }

	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_817_callback_score = fallout_patent_after_end_patent_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_817_callback_score = fallout_patent_after_end_market_pressure_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_817_callback_score = fallout_patent_after_end_production_capacity }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_817_callback_score = fallout_patent_after_end_licensing_pool }
	var:fallout_event_817_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_817_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_817_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_817_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_817_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_817_callback_history_recorded

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_817_callback_cleanup_released

fallout_event_698_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_698_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_698_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_698_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_698_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_698_branch.issue_local_passes compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.choice_issue } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_698_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_698_branch.audit_registry compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.choice_audit } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_698_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_698_branch.delegate_wards compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.choice_delegate } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.choice_sell } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_698_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_698_branch.issue_local_passes compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.issue_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.issue_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.issue_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_698_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_698_branch.audit_registry compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.audit_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.audit_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.audit_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_698_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_698_branch.delegate_wards compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.delegate_success } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.delegate_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.sell_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.sell_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.sell_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_698_log.callback_success } }

		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_698_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_698_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_698_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_698_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_789_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_789_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_789_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_789_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_789_branch.amnesty compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_789_log.choice_amnesty } }

			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_789_log.choice_exile } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_789_log.amnesty_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_789_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_789_branch.privateer_service compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_789_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_789_log.privateer_service_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_789_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_789_log.privateer_service_partial } }

			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_789_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_789_branch.public_trial compare = equals } }

		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_789_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_789_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_789_callback_history_recorded }

		}

			set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.technate }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_866_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_866_branch.grid_empire compare = equals } }
			set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.continuity_government }

		set_variable = { fallout_government_archetype_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }

fallout_event_866_calculate_callback_outcome = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_power_citizenship_public_service_access_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_power_citizenship_grid_integration }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_power_citizenship_civic_education }
	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_power_citizenship_identity_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_power_citizenship_engineer_authority_current }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_power_citizenship_machine_trust }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_power_citizenship_citizenship_legitimacy }
	var:fallout_event_866_target_state_id = {
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_866_callback_score = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_866_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_866_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }
	}
	set_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_866_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_866_threshold.callback_success_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_866_callback_score value = constant:fallout_event_866_threshold.callback_partial_score compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_866_callback_score
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_866_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_866_apply_result_effects = yes
		fallout_event_866_calculate_callback_outcome = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_866_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_866_result_ticket }
		fallout_event_866_schedule_callback = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_866_callback_scheduled
			set_variable = { fallout_event_866_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_866_result_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_866_callback_schedule_error
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_866_result_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_866_result_mode = 0 }
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_929_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_929_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_929_result_cleanup_released }

			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_929_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_929_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_929_callback_cleanup_released

				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_929_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_929_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_929_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_929_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_929_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_929_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_929_registry_reserved clr_state_flag = fallout_event_929_registry_committed } }

fallout_event_600_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_600_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_600_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.radio_island_chain_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.radio_island_chain_ai }
			}
		}
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_600_radio_station_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_600_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_600_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_600_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_600_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.three }
				fallout_event_600_record_history = yes
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_600_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_600_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_600_refund_branch_cost = yes }
				var:fallout_event_600_target_state_id = {
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_600_registry_reserved
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_600_registry_committed
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_public_relay }
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_maritime_defense_net }
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_harbor_subscription }
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_partial }
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_unsafe }
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_island_federation }
				}
				fallout_event_600_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
	}
	clear_variable = fallout_event_600_opening_target_is_current
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = fallout_event_600_registry_generation
					NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_600_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_600_registry_generation }
					has_country_flag = fallout_event_600_cost_paid
				}
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_600_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_600_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_600_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_600_target_state_id }
			var:fallout_event_600_target_state_id = {
				clr_state_flag = fallout_event_600_registry_reserved
				clr_state_flag = fallout_event_600_registry_committed
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_public_relay }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_maritime_defense_net }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_harbor_subscription }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_partial }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_unsafe }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_radio_island_chain_island_federation }
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_chain_committed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_callback_scheduled
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_memory_opened
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_memory_closed
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_result_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_callback_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_cancellation_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_result_cleanup_released
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_600_callback_cleanup_released
		fallout_event_600_clear_frozen = yes
		clear_variable = fallout_event_600_registry_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_600_registry_owner
		clear_variable = fallout_event_600_candidate_id
		clear_variable = fallout_event_600_registry_target_type
		clear_variable = fallout_event_600_registry_target
		clear_variable = fallout_event_600_candidate_state_id

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT RAIL CREW TWENTY-SEVEN EFFECTS

# Dormant receipt-authenticated transport chain. The opening request consumes

	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_death_percent = constant:fallout_event_114_threshold.abandon_failure_death_percent }

	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_death_percent = constant:fallout_event_114_threshold.neighbor_failure_death_percent }

			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_death_request = fallout_event_114_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_114_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_114_death_request }

			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		}

fallout_event_114_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_114_branch.send_protected_crews }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^5 value = constant:fallout_event_114_threshold.fuel_partial compare = less_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_114_branch.abandon_line }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_government = fascism
				has_government = neutrality
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_114_branch.use_forced_labor }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_114_threshold.recognition_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_114_threshold.power_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_114_branch.request_neighbor_access }
	}
	fallout_event_114_schedule_result = yes
}

fallout_event_114_choose_branch = {
	fallout_event_114_schedule_result = yes
}

fallout_event_114_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_114_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_114_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_114_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_114_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_114_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_114_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_114_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_114_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_scheduled
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_114_result_cleanup_released
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_cleanup_released
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_114_result_cleanup_released
						NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_scheduled }
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_114_callback_cleanup_released
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_114_corridor_state_id } var:fallout_event_114_corridor_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_114_rail_registry_committed clear_variable = fallout_event_114_registry_generation clear_variable = fallout_event_114_registry_owner } }
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_corridor_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_rail_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_rail_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_114_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_114_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}
