		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_route_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_route_trust }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_depot_autonomy_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_depot_autonomy }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_timetable_compliance_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_timetable }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_security_control_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_security }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_merchant_access_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_merchant }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_representation_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_representation }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_faction_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_faction }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_621_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_route_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_route_trust }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_depot_autonomy_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_depot_autonomy }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_timetable_compliance_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_timetable }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_security_control_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_security }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_merchant_access_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_merchant }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_representation_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_representation }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_faction_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_faction }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_route_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_route_trust }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_depot_autonomy_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_depot_autonomy }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_timetable_compliance_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_timetable }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_security_control_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_security }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_merchant_access_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_merchant }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_representation_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_representation }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_rail_faction_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_faction }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_rail_route_trust_current min = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_rail_depot_autonomy_current min = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_rail_timetable_compliance_current min = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_rail_security_control_current min = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_rail_merchant_access_current min = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_rail_representation_current min = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_rail_faction_pressure_current min = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.ledger_maximum }
}

fallout_event_621_apply_callback_effects = {
	fallout_event_621_apply_callback_ledgers = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_621_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_recognition }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_cohesion }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		var:fallout_event_621_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_supply }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_reclamation }
			set_variable = { fallout_rail_spine_route_status = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_success_railway }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_621_memory_review_success
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_621_timing.callback_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_reviewed days = fallout_event_621_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_621_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_route_trust }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		var:fallout_event_621_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_supply }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_partial_reclamation }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_621_memory_review_partial
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_621_timing.callback_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_reviewed_partial days = fallout_event_621_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_cohesion }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		var:fallout_event_621_target_state_id = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_supply }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_621_threshold.callback_failure_exposure }
			damage_building = { type = rail_way damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_621_THRESHOLD_CALLBACK_RAIL_DAMAGE }
			damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_621_THRESHOLD_CALLBACK_INFRASTRUCTURE_DAMAGE }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_621_memory_review_failure
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_621_timing.callback_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_reviewed_failed days = fallout_event_621_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
		fallout_event_621_apply_callback_failure_deaths = yes
	}
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = 0 }
}

fallout_event_621_resolve_callback_and_prepare_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_callback_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_621_calculate_callback_outcome = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_621_callback_outcome }
	fallout_event_resolve_issued_delayed_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_621_apply_callback_effects = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two }
		fallout_event_621_record_history = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_621_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_621_callback_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_621_callback_ticket }
		fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_callback_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_621_clear_state_reservation = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_621_target_state_id }
		var:fallout_event_621_target_state_id = {
			clr_state_flag = fallout_event_621_registry_reserved
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_central }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_depot }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_military }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_merchant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_partial }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_failed }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_reviewed }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_reviewed_partial }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_rail_spine_reviewed_failed }
		}
	}
}

# Called before a Fallout runtime generation is rebuilt. This state-bound row
# cancels an unconsumed opening, refunds a branch that never settled, terminalizes
# issued result or callback receipts, and removes cleanup tombstones before the
# country runtime arrays are cleared.
fallout_event_621_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_621_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_621_target_state_id }
		var:fallout_event_621_target_state_id = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_621_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_621_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = fallout_event_621_registry_generation NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_621_registry_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } } }
				AND = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_event_621_registry_generation } has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_cost_paid }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_chain_committed NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_621_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_result }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_result_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_callback }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_callback_ai }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_cleanup }
			}
			has_variable = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation value = global.fallout_transition_generation compare = equals } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_ai }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_621_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_621_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_621_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_621_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_621_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_621_log.cancelled_stage }
				fallout_event_621_record_history = yes
				fallout_event_621_clear_state_reservation = yes
				var:fallout_event_621_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_621_registry_committed }
				fallout_event_621_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_621_opening_target_is_current
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_621_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_621_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_stale_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_result_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_callback }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_callback_ai }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_stale_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
			fallout_event_cancel_issued_delayed_result = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_621_stale_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_cleanup }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_chain_committed
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued }
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
						NOT = {
							OR = {
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_result }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_result_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_callback }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_callback_ai }
								check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_cleanup }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_621_result_cleanup_ticket }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_621_callback_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_stale_ticket = fallout_event_621_callback_cleanup_ticket }
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_621_result_cleanup_ticket } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_stale_ticket = fallout_event_621_result_cleanup_ticket } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_621_stale_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_621_stale_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.aborted_after_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_cleanup }
				fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_callback_scheduled has_variable = fallout_event_621_result_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_621_result_cleanup_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_cleanup }
				fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_release_delayed_result = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_621_cancellation_history_recorded } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_621_log.cancelled_stage }
			fallout_event_621_record_history = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
				OR = {
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_human }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_result }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_result_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_callback }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_callback_ai }
					check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.rail_spine_vote_cleanup }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_621_clear_allowed = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_621_target_state_id } var:fallout_event_621_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_621_registry_committed } }
			fallout_event_621_clear_state_reservation = yes
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_chain_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_621_target_invalidated
			fallout_event_621_clear_frozen = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_stale_ticket = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_clear_allowed = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_abort_required = 0 }
	clear_variable = fallout_event_621_target_is_current
}

fallout_event_621_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_621_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_621_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_621_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_621_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_621_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_621_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_621_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_499_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_499_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_499_callback_cleanup_released }

		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_499_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_499_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_499_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_499_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_499_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_499_chain_committed

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_499_cost_paid

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_499_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_499_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_499_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_499_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_499_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_499_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_499_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_499_registry_target
			fallout_event_499_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_499_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_499_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_499_result_generation

# ============================================================================
# Manchurian Reactor Keeps chain. Operators must decide whether to negotiate a
# safe roster, compel duty, cool the reactor, or recruit a foreign team. The effects own branch costs,
# immutable state and neighbor receipts, deterministic grading,
# Deaths requests, delayed result and callback scheduling, Event Log memory,
# and idempotent cleanup. The Fallout consequence remains a separate system.

fallout_event_810_clear_frozen = {
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_generation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_owner
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_controller
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_shelter
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_supply
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_adaptation
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_exposure
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_disease
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_state_id
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_owner
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_controller
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_shelter
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_supply
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_disease
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_safety_legitimacy
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_fatigue
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_trust
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_power_reserve
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_capacity
	clear_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_spare_parts
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_target_state_id = 0 }
}
fallout_event_810_initialize_ledgers = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_reactor_shift_safety_legitimacy_current } } set_variable = { fallout_reactor_shift_safety_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.initial_safety_legitimacy } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_fatigue_current } } set_variable = { fallout_reactor_shift_operator_fatigue_current = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.initial_operator_fatigue } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_trust } } set_variable = { fallout_reactor_shift_operator_trust = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.initial_operator_trust } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_reactor_shift_power_reserve } } set_variable = { fallout_reactor_shift_power_reserve = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.initial_power_reserve } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_capacity } } set_variable = { fallout_reactor_shift_operator_capacity = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.initial_operator_capacity } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_reactor_shift_spare_parts } } set_variable = { fallout_reactor_shift_spare_parts = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.initial_spare_parts } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_reactor_shift_safety_memory } } set_variable = { fallout_reactor_shift_safety_memory = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.initial_safety_memory } }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_reactor_shift_safety_legitimacy_current min = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_fatigue_current min = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_trust min = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_reactor_shift_power_reserve min = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_capacity min = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_reactor_shift_spare_parts min = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_reactor_shift_safety_memory min = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.ledger_maximum }
}
fallout_event_810_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_810_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.negotiate_safe_roster compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.negotiate_safe_roster_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.negotiate_safe_roster_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.negotiate_safe_roster_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.compel_duty_roster compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.compel_duty_roster_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.compel_duty_roster_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.compel_duty_roster_cohesion }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.cooldown_shutdown compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.cooldown_shutdown_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.cooldown_shutdown_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.cooldown_shutdown_medicine }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.recruit_foreign_team_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.recruit_foreign_team_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.recruit_foreign_team_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_810_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
}

fallout_event_810_refund_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_810_cost_paid }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.negotiate_safe_roster compare = equals } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.negotiate_safe_roster_food }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.negotiate_safe_roster_medicine }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.negotiate_safe_roster_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.compel_duty_roster compare = equals } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.compel_duty_roster_fuel }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.compel_duty_roster_recognition }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.compel_duty_roster_cohesion }
			fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.cooldown_shutdown compare = equals } }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.cooldown_shutdown_scrap }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.cooldown_shutdown_power }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.cooldown_shutdown_medicine }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.recruit_foreign_team_food }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.recruit_foreign_team_fuel }
			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_810_cost.recruit_foreign_team_recognition }
		}
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	}
}

fallout_event_810_snapshot_registry = {
	fallout_event_810_initialize_ledgers = yes
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_registry_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_registry_owner = ROOT }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.reactor_shift_candidate_id }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_registry_target = fallout_event_810_target_state_id }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_frozen_generation = global.fallout_transition_generation }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_frozen_safety_legitimacy = fallout_reactor_shift_safety_legitimacy_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_fatigue = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_fatigue_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_trust = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_trust }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_frozen_power_reserve = fallout_reactor_shift_power_reserve }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_capacity = fallout_reactor_shift_operator_capacity }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_frozen_spare_parts = fallout_reactor_shift_spare_parts }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_state_id = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	var:fallout_event_810_target_state_id = {
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_owner = OWNER }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_controller = CONTROLLER }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_supply = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_adaptation = air_winter_adaptation }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_exposure = air_winter_exposure }
		set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		every_neighbor_state = {
			limit = {
				always = yes
				NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
				owner = { exists = yes }
				fallout_survival_state_identity_row_is_current = yes
				OR = {
					check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_state_id value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = equals }
					check_variable = { var = THIS.id value = ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_state_id compare = less_than }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_state_id = THIS.id }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_owner = OWNER }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_controller = CONTROLLER }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_shelter = air_winter_shelter_capacity }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_supply = fallout_state_supply_access_current }
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_disease = air_winter_disease_pressure }
		}
		set_state_flag = fallout_event_810_registry_reserved
	}
	var:fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_state_id = {
		set_state_flag = fallout_event_810_neighbor_reserved
	}
}

fallout_event_810_calculate_grade = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_supply }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.state_supply_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_shelter }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.state_shelter_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_adaptation }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.state_adaptation_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.maximum_viability }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_disease }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.state_disease_relief_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.maximum_viability }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_exposure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.state_exposure_relief_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.medicine_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.recognition_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_safety_legitimacy }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.safety_legitimacy_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.maximum_viability }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_fatigue }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.operator_fatigue_relief_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_trust }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.operator_trust_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.maximum_viability }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = fallout_event_810_frozen_operator_capacity }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.operator_capacity_relief_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = fallout_event_810_component }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_government_archetype value = constant:fallout_government_archetype.technate compare = equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_viability = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.technical_government_bonus } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability min = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.maximum_viability }
	round_temp_variable = fallout_event_810_viability
	set_variable = { fallout_event_810_grade = fallout_event_810_viability }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.negotiate_safe_roster compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability value = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.negotiate_safe_roster_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability value = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.negotiate_safe_roster_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.compel_duty_roster compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability value = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.compel_duty_roster_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability value = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.compel_duty_roster_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.cooldown_shutdown compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability value = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.cooldown_shutdown_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability value = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.cooldown_shutdown_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability value = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.recruit_foreign_team_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_viability value = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.recruit_foreign_team_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_component = 0 }
}

fallout_event_810_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_810_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_death_request = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_810_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_810_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_810_apply_callback_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_810_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_death_request = constant:fallout_event_810_threshold.callback_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_810_death_request

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_810_log.negotiate_safe_roster_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.compel_duty_roster compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_810_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_810_log.compel_duty_roster_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_810_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_810_log.compel_duty_roster_partial } }

			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_810_branch.cooldown_shutdown compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_810_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_810_log.cooldown_shutdown_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_810_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_810_log.cooldown_shutdown_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_810_log.cooldown_shutdown_failure } }

fallout_event_810_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_810_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_810_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_810_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_810_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_810_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_810_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_cleanup_released
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_810_result_cleanup_released }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_810_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_810_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_810_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_810_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_810_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_810_registry_reserved clr_state_flag = fallout_event_810_registry_committed } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_state_id } var:fallout_event_810_frozen_neighbor_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_810_neighbor_reserved } }
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_810_memory_opened
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_810_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_810_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_810_memory_closed } }
			fallout_event_810_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_callback_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_grade

			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_810_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}

		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_history_recorded }

			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_415_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_415_branch.upper_bound }

		}

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.refugee_train_result }

		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_415_timing.result_delay_days }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }

			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes

				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				fallout_event_415_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
		else = { fallout_event_415_clear_frozen = yes }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_opening_ticket = 0 }

fallout_event_415_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_415_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_415_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_415_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_415_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_415_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_415_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_415_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_cleanup_released }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_415_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_415_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_registry_target
			fallout_event_415_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_bilateral_opening_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_bilateral_result_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value > constant:fallout_event_415_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value < constant:fallout_event_415_branch.upper_bound }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_partner_id > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.choice_admit_families }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.redirect_column } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.choice_redirect_column } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.quarantine_train } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.choice_quarantine_train } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.recruit_specialists } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.choice_recruit_specialists } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.admit_families } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.admit_families_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.admit_families_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.admit_families_failure } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.redirect_column } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.redirect_column_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.redirect_column_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.redirect_column_failure } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.quarantine_train } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.quarantine_train_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.quarantine_train_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.quarantine_train_failure } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.recruit_specialists_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.recruit_specialists_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.recruit_specialists_failure } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_415_bilateral_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = fallout_event_415_bilateral_partner_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_415_bilateral_opening_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_415_bilateral_result_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Finds the reviewed Refugee Train target owned by
# this participant without relying on a mutable last-selection variable.
fallout_event_415_find_bilateral_candidate_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_candidate_state = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_candidate_row = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = fallout_event_candidate_id_entries
		value = fallout_event_415_candidate_loop_id
		index = fallout_event_415_candidate_loop_index
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_415_candidate_loop_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.refugee_train_candidate_id }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_transaction_key_entries^fallout_event_415_candidate_loop_index = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.refugee_train_transaction_key }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_target_type_entries^fallout_event_415_candidate_loop_index = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_candidate_target_entries^fallout_event_415_candidate_loop_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_candidate_state = fallout_event_candidate_target_entries^fallout_event_415_candidate_loop_index }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_candidate_row = fallout_event_415_candidate_loop_index }
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The bilateral row is unique while the pair is
# live, so this lookup remains generation bound through the row shape trigger.
fallout_event_415_find_bilateral_ticket = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_row = constant:fallout_event_runtime.first_array_index }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = fallout_event_bilateral_key_entries
		value = fallout_event_415_bilateral_key_loop
		index = fallout_event_415_bilateral_key_index
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_key_loop = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.refugee_train_transaction_key }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_bilateral_ticket_entries^fallout_event_415_bilateral_key_index > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_ticket = fallout_event_bilateral_ticket_entries^fallout_event_415_bilateral_key_index }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_row = fallout_event_415_bilateral_key_index }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_415_pay_bilateral_initiator_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.admit_families } }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.admit_families_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.admit_families_recognition }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.admit_families_cohesion }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.redirect_column } }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.redirect_column_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.redirect_column_recognition }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.redirect_column_cohesion }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.quarantine_train } }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.quarantine_train_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.quarantine_train_recognition }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.quarantine_train_cohesion }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.recruit_specialists_food }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.recruit_specialists_recognition }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.recruit_specialists_cohesion }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
	}
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_415_bilateral_opening_cost_paid
}

fallout_event_415_choose_bilateral_opening = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_415_bilateral_opening_dispatch_is_current = yes
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_415_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_415_branch.upper_bound }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_415_bilateral_opening_cost_paid }
		}
		set_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_selected_branch = fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_branch }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_generation = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_generation }
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_415_bilateral_partner_id = id }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		fallout_event_mark_issued_bilateral_opening_response_pending = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			fallout_event_415_pay_bilateral_initiator_cost = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_415_bilateral_memory_opened
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = fallout_event_415_bilateral_selected_branch }
			fallout_event_415_record_bilateral_history = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_stage = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_bilateral_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_bilateral_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_bilateral_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_415_bilateral_partner_id
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_415_choose_bilateral_ai_opening = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.recruit_specialists }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { has_government = democratic has_government = neutrality }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.admit_families_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.admit_families_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.admit_families }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { has_government = fascism has_government = communism }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.redirect_column_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.redirect_column_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.redirect_column }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.quarantine_train_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_415_branch.quarantine_train }
	}
	fallout_event_415_choose_bilateral_opening = yes
}

fallout_event_415_pay_bilateral_response_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.admit_families_food }

	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_415_cost.recruit_specialists_cohesion }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
