fallout_event_415_apply_bilateral_country_outcome = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_refugee_family_memory_current } }
		set_variable = { fallout_refugee_family_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.initial_family_memory }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_refugee_border_legitimacy_current } }
		set_variable = { fallout_refugee_border_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.initial_border_legitimacy }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_refugee_integration_cohesion_current } }
		set_variable = { fallout_refugee_integration_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.initial_integration_cohesion }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_refugee_bilateral_trust_current } }
		set_variable = { fallout_refugee_bilateral_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.initial_bilateral_trust }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_outcome_to_apply = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_food_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_recognition_success }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_cohesion_success }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_stability_success
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_war_support_success
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_family_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_memory_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_border_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_legitimacy_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_integration_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_cohesion_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_bilateral_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_trust_admit }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_outcome_to_apply = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_food_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_recognition_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_cohesion_partial }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_stability_partial
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_war_support_partial
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_family_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_memory_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_border_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_legitimacy_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_integration_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_cohesion_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_bilateral_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_trust_partial }
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_food_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_recognition_failure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_cohesion_failure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = -1 }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_stability_failure
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_war_support_failure
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_family_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_memory_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_border_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_legitimacy_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_integration_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_cohesion_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_refugee_bilateral_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_trust_failure }
	}
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_refugee_family_memory_current min = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_refugee_border_legitimacy_current min = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_refugee_integration_cohesion_current min = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_refugee_bilateral_trust_current min = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	fallout_event_415_find_bilateral_candidate_state = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_candidate_state > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_415_timing.result_modifier_days }
		var:fallout_event_415_bilateral_candidate_state = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_outcome_to_apply = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
				add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_reclamation_success }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_supply_success } }
				subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_exposure_success }
				set_state_flag = fallout_event_415_memory_refugee_success
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_refugee_train_families days = fallout_event_415_bilateral_modifier_days }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_outcome_to_apply = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
				add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_reclamation_partial }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_supply_partial } }
				subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_exposure_partial }
				set_state_flag = fallout_event_415_memory_refugee_partial
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_refugee_train_frayed days = fallout_event_415_bilateral_modifier_days }
			}
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_reclamation_failure }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_supply_failure } }
				add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_415_threshold.result_exposure_failure }
				set_state_flag = fallout_event_415_memory_refugee_failed
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_refugee_train_broken days = fallout_event_415_bilateral_modifier_days }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }

	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_415_bilateral_response_dispatch_is_current = yes

					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_ticket > constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket } }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_415_bilateral_ticket }
					fallout_event_load_current_bilateral_pair = yes
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_outcome_to_apply = fallout_event_bilateral_outcome_entries^fallout_event_bilateral_origin_row_index }
					fallout_event_415_apply_bilateral_country_outcome = yes

				clear_variable = fallout_event_415_bilateral_selected_branch
				clear_variable = fallout_event_415_bilateral_ticket

				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_415_bilateral_memory_opened
				clear_variable = fallout_event_415_bilateral_partner_id
			}

			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch_value = fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_outcome = fallout_event_415_bilateral_requested_outcome }
		fallout_event_415_record_bilateral_history = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_415_bilateral_history_stage = 0 }

		}
	}
}

fallout_event_754_pay_branch_cost = {

		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_754_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_754_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_754_branch.shared_register compare = equals } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_754_cost.shared_register_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_754_cost.shared_register_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_754_cost.shared_register_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {

fallout_event_859_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_choice_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_result_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_history_recorded } } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.cancelled }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.open_charter compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.choice_open_charter } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.licensed_houses compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.choice_licensed_houses } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.council_charter compare = equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.choice_council_charter } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.choice_perimeter_corps } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.open_charter compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.open_charter_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.open_charter_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.open_charter_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.licensed_houses compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.licensed_houses_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.licensed_houses_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.licensed_houses_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.council_charter compare = equals } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.council_charter_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.council_charter_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.council_charter_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.perimeter_corps_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.perimeter_corps_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.perimeter_corps_failure } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_859_log.callback_success } }

		}
		var:fallout_event_859_frozen_neighbor_state_id = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_859_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_state_flag = fallout_event_859_neighbor_result_success }

			else = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_859_neighbor_result_failure }
		}
		var:fallout_event_859_frozen_neighbor_owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_859_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_repair_charter_failure }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.open_charter compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_repair_charter_open_charter }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.licensed_houses compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_repair_charter_licensed_houses }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = ROOT.fallout_event_859_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_859_branch.council_charter compare = equals } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_repair_charter_council_charter }
			}
			else = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = fallout_repair_charter_perimeter_corps } }
		}
	}

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_859_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_859_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_859_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_859_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_859_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_cleanup_released
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_result_cleanup_released }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_859_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_859_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_859_registry_reserved clr_state_flag = fallout_event_859_registry_committed } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_859_frozen_neighbor_state_id } var:fallout_event_859_frozen_neighbor_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_859_neighbor_reserved } }
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_859_memory_opened
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_859_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_859_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_859_memory_closed } }
			fallout_event_859_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_callback_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_grade
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_859_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_859_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_712_cost.lock_down_recognition }

			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_712_cost.targeted_response_recognition }

fallout_event_712_apply_branch_memory = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure compare = equals } }
		set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_outbreak_uncontained
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_712_branch.lock_down compare = equals } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_lockdown_memory
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_lockdown_contested }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_712_branch.targeted_response compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_targeted_response_memory }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_targeted_response_contested }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_selected_branch value = constant:fallout_event_712_branch.request_aid compare = equals } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_aid_compact_memory }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_aid_compact_contested }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_result_outcome value = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_concealment_memory }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_returning_disease_concealment_contested }
	}
}

	set_variable = { fallout_event_712_callback_score = fallout_first_red_line_public_health }

	add_to_variable = { fallout_event_712_callback_score = fallout_returning_disease_cause_memory }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_712_callback_score = fallout_first_red_line_grievance }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_712_callback_score = fallout_returning_disease_aid_dependence }
	subtract_from_variable = { fallout_event_712_callback_score = fallout_returning_disease_concealment_pressure }

		add_to_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_712_callback_score = air_winter_reclamation }
		subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_712_callback_score = air_winter_disease_pressure }

	set_variable = { fallout_event_712_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }

fallout_event_712_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_712_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_712_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_712_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_712_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_712_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_712_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_cleanup_released
				NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_712_result_cleanup_released }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_712_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_712_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_712_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_712_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_712_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_712_registry_reserved clr_state_flag = fallout_event_712_registry_committed } }
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_pending
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_712_memory_opened
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_712_target_state_id > 0 } } var:fallout_event_712_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_712_memory_closed } }
			fallout_event_712_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_callback_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_grade
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_712_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_712_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_565_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_565_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_565_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_565_branch.joint_barge_law } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.barge_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.barge_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.barge_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_565_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_565_branch.upstream_priority } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.upstream_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.upstream_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.upstream_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_565_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_565_branch.armed_customs } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.customs_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.customs_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.customs_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_565_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_565_branch.flood_authority } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.flood_clean_water }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_565_cost.flood_scrap }

		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_565_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

fallout_event_565_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_565_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_565_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_565_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_565_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_565_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_565_country_is_current = yes
			fallout_event_565_target_is_current = yes
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_565_candidate_state_id value = fallout_event_565_downstream_state_id compare = equals } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_565_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_565_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_565_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_565_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_565_selected_branch = fallout_event_565_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_565_pay_branch_cost = yes
		fallout_event_565_snapshot_registry = yes
		fallout_event_565_calculate_grade = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_565_result_grade = fallout_event_565_calculated_grade }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_565_result_outcome = fallout_event_565_calculated_outcome }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_565_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_565_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_565_selected_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_ration_league_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_ration_league_result_ai }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_565_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_565_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_565_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_565_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_ration_league_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_565_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_565_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				clear_variable = fallout_event_565_callback_cleanup_ticket
				set_variable = { fallout_event_565_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_565_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_565_chain_committed
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_565_memory_opened
				var:fallout_event_565_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_565_registry_committed }
				var:fallout_event_565_downstream_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_565_registry_committed }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				fallout_event_565_refund_branch_cost = yes
				fallout_event_565_clear_state_reservation = yes
				fallout_event_565_clear_frozen = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_565_schedule_error
			}
		}
		else = {

			fallout_event_565_clear_state_reservation = yes
			fallout_event_565_clear_frozen = yes
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_565_schedule_error
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_565_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_565_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_565_opening_event_token = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_565_calculated_outcome = 0 }
}

	every_owned_state = {

			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }

			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_289_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_289_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_289_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_289_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_289_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_289_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_289_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_289_cost.technical_scrap }
		}

			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_289_cost.history_recognition }
		}

			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_289_cost.civic_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }

fallout_event_289_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_289_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_289_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_289_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_289_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_289_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_289_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_289_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_289_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_289_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_289_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_289_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_289_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_289_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_frozen_food
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_frozen_shelter
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_frozen_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_frozen_education
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_frozen_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_289_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_289_cleanup_ticket = 0 }

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT SEALED WAREHOUSE EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Dormant country-level salvage transaction. The chain freezes post-elevator
# scrap and medicine ledgers, resolves one authored warehouse policy, applies
# Deaths-backed failure, records Event Log memory, and releases exact receipts.

fallout_event_331_apply_failure_deaths = {
	every_owned_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_331_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_331_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_331_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_331_result_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.callback_failure }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.open_immediately } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.open_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.open_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.open_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.inspect_quarantine } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.inspect_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.inspect_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.inspect_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.sell_coordinates } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.sell_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.sell_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.sell_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.leave_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.leave_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.leave_failure } }
			}
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.callback_success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_331_log.callback_partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_331_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_331_history_payload }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_viability_component = fallout_event_331_frozen_scrap }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.scrap_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_viability_component = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_viability = fallout_event_331_viability_component }

	round_temp_variable = fallout_event_331_viability
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_viability min = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.maximum_viability }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.open_immediately } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_viability value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.open_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_frozen_scrap value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.open_partial_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.inspect_quarantine } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_viability value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.inspect_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_frozen_medicine value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.inspect_success_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_viability value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.inspect_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_frozen_medicine value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.inspect_partial_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.sell_coordinates } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_viability value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.sell_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.sell_success_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_viability value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.sell_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.sell_partial_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_viability value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.leave_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.leave_success_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_viability value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.leave_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.leave_partial_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_viability_component = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_viability = 0 }
}

fallout_event_331_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_331_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.open_immediately } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.open_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.open_food }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.inspect_quarantine } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.inspect_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.inspect_filters }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.inspect_power }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.sell_coordinates } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.sell_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.sell_recognition }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_shelter }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_filters }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_scrap }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_331_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.sealed_warehouse_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_331_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_331_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_331_transaction.visible_budget_cost }

fallout_event_331_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.none }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.ai_inspect_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.inspect_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.inspect_filters compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.inspect_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.inspect_quarantine }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.ai_open_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.open_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.open_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.open_immediately }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.ai_sell_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.sell_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.sell_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.sell_coordinates }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_331_threshold.ai_leave_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_shelter compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_filters compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.leave_sealed }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.open_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.open_food compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.open_immediately }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.sell_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.sell_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.sell_coordinates }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_shelter compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_filters compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_331_cost.leave_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.leave_sealed }
	}
	fallout_event_331_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_331_pay_branch_cost = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_requested_branch = 0 }
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure } }

		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_sealed_warehouse_failed days = fallout_event_331_modifier_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.open_immediately } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_331_timing.modifier_days }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_sealed_warehouse_open days = fallout_event_331_modifier_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.inspect_quarantine } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_331_timing.modifier_days }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_sealed_warehouse_inspect days = fallout_event_331_modifier_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_331_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_331_branch.sell_coordinates } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_331_timing.modifier_days }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_sealed_warehouse_sell days = fallout_event_331_modifier_days }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_331_timing.modifier_days }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_sealed_warehouse_leave days = fallout_event_331_modifier_days }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_331_modifier_days = 0 }
}

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_331_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_331_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_331_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_cleanup_released }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_331_result_cleanup_ticket }

			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_331_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_331_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_331_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_chain_committed

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_resolved

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_331_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_331_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_331_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_331_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_331_registry_target
			fallout_event_331_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_331_policy
			clear_variable = fallout_event_331_selected_branch

		}
	}

}

fallout_event_656_initialize_ledgers = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_second_dust_bowl_topsoil_retention_current } } set_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_topsoil_retention_current = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.initial_topsoil_retention } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_second_dust_bowl_windbreak_coverage_current } } set_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_windbreak_coverage_current = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.initial_windbreak_coverage } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_second_dust_bowl_farm_mobility_current } } set_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_farm_mobility_current = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.initial_farm_mobility } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_second_dust_bowl_cold_crop_adoption_current } } set_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_cold_crop_adoption_current = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.initial_cold_crop_adoption } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_second_dust_bowl_displacement_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_displacement_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.initial_displacement_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_second_dust_bowl_rural_trust_current } } set_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_rural_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.initial_rural_trust } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_second_dust_bowl_dust_load_current } } set_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_dust_load_current = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.initial_dust_load } }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_second_dust_bowl_topsoil_retention_current min = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.maximum_ledger }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_second_dust_bowl_windbreak_coverage_current min = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.maximum_ledger }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_second_dust_bowl_farm_mobility_current min = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.maximum_ledger }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_second_dust_bowl_cold_crop_adoption_current min = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.maximum_ledger }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_second_dust_bowl_displacement_pressure_current min = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.maximum_ledger }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_second_dust_bowl_rural_trust_current min = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.maximum_ledger }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_second_dust_bowl_dust_load_current min = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.maximum_ledger }
}

fallout_event_656_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_656_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { state_population_k > constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_656_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_656_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_656_cancel_opening_receipt = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.target_lost }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_target_is_current = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled } }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_656_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
	fallout_event_cancel_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_656_log.cancelled_stage }
		fallout_event_656_record_history = yes
		clear_variable = fallout_event_656_target_state_id
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_656_cancellation_history_recorded
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = 0 }
}

fallout_event_656_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_656_choice_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_656_result_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_656_callback_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_656_log.cancelled_stage }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_656_cancellation_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.callback_failure }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.shelter_fields } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.choice_shelter } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.move_farms } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.choice_move } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.seed_cold_crops } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.choice_seed } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.choice_abandon } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.shelter_fields } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.shelter_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.shelter_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.shelter_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.move_farms } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.move_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.move_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.move_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.seed_cold_crops } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.seed_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.seed_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.seed_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.abandon_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.abandon_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.abandon_failure } }
			}
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_656_log.cancelled_stage } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.cancelled } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.callback_success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_656_log.callback_partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_656_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_656_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = fallout_event_656_target_state_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_656_choice_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_656_result_history_recorded }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_656_log.cancelled_stage } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_656_cancellation_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_656_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_history_stage = 0 }
}

fallout_event_656_pay_branch_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = fallout_event_656_selected_branch }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_656_cost_paid } fallout_event_656_requested_branch_is_affordable = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.shelter_fields } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.shelter_scrap } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.shelter_fuel } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.shelter_capacity } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.move_farms } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.move_fuel } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.move_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.move_capacity } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.seed_cold_crops } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.seed_food } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.seed_scrap } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.seed_power } }
		else = { subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.abandon_fuel } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.abandon_capacity } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_656_cost.abandon_medicine } }
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_656_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = 0 }
}
