	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_stability = constant:fallout_event_656_result.stability_partial add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_656_result.war_support_partial }
	else = { add_stability = constant:fallout_event_656_result.stability_failure add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_656_result.war_support_failure fallout_event_656_apply_failure_deaths = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.shelter_fields } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_topsoil_retention_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.topsoil_shelter_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_windbreak_coverage_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.windbreak_shelter_success } } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_topsoil_retention_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.topsoil_shelter_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_windbreak_coverage_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.windbreak_shelter_partial } } else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_topsoil_retention_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.topsoil_shelter_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_windbreak_coverage_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.windbreak_shelter_failure } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.move_farms } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_farm_mobility_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.farm_move_success } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_farm_mobility_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.farm_move_partial } else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_farm_mobility_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.farm_move_failure } } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.seed_cold_crops } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_cold_crop_adoption_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.cold_crop_seed_success } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_cold_crop_adoption_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.cold_crop_seed_partial } else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_cold_crop_adoption_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.cold_crop_seed_failure } } } } }
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_displacement_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.displacement_abandon_success } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_displacement_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.displacement_abandon_partial } else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_displacement_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.displacement_abandon_failure } } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_656_result.abandon_shelter_success } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_656_result.abandon_shelter_partial } else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_656_result.abandon_shelter_failure } } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_rural_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.rural_trust_success } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_dust_load_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.dust_load_success } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_rural_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.rural_trust_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_dust_load_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.dust_load_partial } }
	else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_rural_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.rural_trust_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_dust_load_current = constant:fallout_event_656_result.dust_load_failure } }
	fallout_event_656_initialize_ledgers = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.shelter_fields } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_656_timing.result_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_second_dust_bowl_sheltered_country days = fallout_event_656_modifier_days } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.move_farms } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_656_timing.result_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_second_dust_bowl_moved_country days = fallout_event_656_modifier_days } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } check_variable = { fallout_event_656_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.seed_cold_crops } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_656_timing.result_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_second_dust_bowl_seeded_country days = fallout_event_656_modifier_days } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_656_timing.result_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_second_dust_bowl_abandoned_country days = fallout_event_656_modifier_days } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_656_timing.result_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_second_dust_bowl_partial_country days = fallout_event_656_modifier_days } }
	else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_656_timing.result_modifier_days } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_second_dust_bowl_failed_country days = fallout_event_656_modifier_days } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_modifier_days = 0 }
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_656_result_effects_committed
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_food_delta = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_supply_delta = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_adaptation_delta = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_reclamation_delta = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_exposure_delta = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_state_disease_delta = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_country_cohesion_delta = 0 }
}

		}

		set_variable = { fallout_event_656_frozen_farm_mobility = fallout_second_dust_bowl_farm_mobility_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_656_frozen_cold_crops = fallout_second_dust_bowl_cold_crop_adoption_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_656_frozen_displacement = fallout_second_dust_bowl_displacement_pressure_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_656_frozen_rural_trust = fallout_second_dust_bowl_rural_trust_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_656_frozen_dust = fallout_second_dust_bowl_dust_load_current }
	fallout_event_656_snapshot_target = yes
	fallout_event_656_prepare_branch_grade = yes
	fallout_event_656_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_656_selected_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_656_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_656_transaction.visible_budget_cost }

			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				set_variable = { fallout_event_656_registry_target = fallout_event_656_target_state_id }

fallout_event_656_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	fallout_event_656_initialize_ledgers = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_shelter_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.invalid_option }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_seed_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.invalid_option }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_move_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.invalid_option }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_abandon_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.invalid_option }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_shelter_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_shelter_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.shelter_priority } }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_seed_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_seed_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.seed_priority } }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_move_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_move_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.move_priority } }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_abandon_affordable = yes } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_abandon_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.abandon_priority } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_government_archetype
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.quarantine_state }
				check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.religious_refuge }
				check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.mutant_polity }
			}
			fallout_event_656_state_pressure_is_high = yes
			fallout_event_656_abandon_affordable = yes
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_abandon_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.high_pressure_abandon }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_government_archetype
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.food_compact }
				check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.technate }
				check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.machine_protocol }
			}
			fallout_event_656_seed_affordable = yes
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ai_strong_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_656_threshold.ai_strong_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_seed_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.food_power_seed }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = fallout_government_archetype
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.nomad_convoy }
				check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.maritime_remnant }
			}
			fallout_event_656_move_affordable = yes
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_move_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.nomad_move }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_government_archetype check_variable = { fallout_government_archetype = constant:fallout_government_archetype.warlord_command } has_war = yes fallout_event_656_move_affordable = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_move_score = constant:fallout_event_656_ai.warlord_move }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.shelter_fields }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_best_score = fallout_event_656_ai_shelter_score }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_seed_affordable = yes check_variable = { var = fallout_event_656_ai_seed_score value = fallout_event_656_ai_best_score compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_best_score = fallout_event_656_ai_seed_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.seed_cold_crops } }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_move_affordable = yes check_variable = { var = fallout_event_656_ai_move_score value = fallout_event_656_ai_best_score compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_best_score = fallout_event_656_ai_move_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.move_farms } }
	if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_abandon_affordable = yes check_variable = { var = fallout_event_656_ai_abandon_score value = fallout_event_656_ai_best_score compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_best_score = fallout_event_656_ai_abandon_score } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.abandon_open_plains } }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch_is_affordable = yes } }
		if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_shelter_affordable = yes } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.shelter_fields }
		else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_seed_affordable = yes } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.seed_cold_crops }
		else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_move_affordable = yes } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.move_farms }
		else_if = { limit = { fallout_event_656_abandon_affordable = yes } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_656_branch.abandon_open_plains }
	}
	fallout_event_656_set_ai_priority = yes
	fallout_event_656_choose_branch = yes
	clear_variable = fallout_event_656_ai_priority
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_shelter_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_seed_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_move_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_abandon_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_ai_best_score = 0 }
}

		else = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_food_reserve = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.food_failure } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.supply_failure } add_to_variable = { air_winter_adaptation = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.adaptation_failure } add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.reclamation_failure } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.exposure_failure } add_to_variable = { air_winter_disease_pressure = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.disease_failure } }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_food_reserve min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_adaptation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_reclamation min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
		clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_disease_pressure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }

		else = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_second_dust_bowl_callback_failed_state days = fallout_event_656_modifier_days } }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_656_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_topsoil_retention_current = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.topsoil_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_cold_crop_adoption_current = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.cold_crop_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_rural_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.rural_trust_partial } add_to_variable = { fallout_second_dust_bowl_dust_load_current = constant:fallout_event_656_callback.dust_load_partial } }

# Called before a Fallout runtime generation is rebuilt. This is the
# generation-bound stale path for the Second Dust Bowl row. It cancels an
# unconsumed opening, refunds a branch that never settled, terminalizes any
# issued result or callback, and removes its cleanup tombstone before the
# country runtime arrays are cleared.
fallout_event_656_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_656_abort_required = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_656_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_656_target_state_id }
		var:fallout_event_656_target_state_id = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_656_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_656_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = global.fallout_transition_generation
			OR = {

fallout_event_188_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_188_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_188_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_188_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_188_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_188_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_188_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_188_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_188_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_188_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_188_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_188_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_188_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_callback_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_result_state_id
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_188_seed_state_id }
				var:fallout_event_188_seed_state_id = {
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_188_seed_registry_committed
					clear_variable = fallout_event_188_seed_registry_generation
					clear_variable = fallout_event_188_seed_registry_owner
					clear_variable = fallout_event_188_seed_reserve
				}
			}
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_seed_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_seed_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_188_seed_registry_owner
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_188_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_303_apply_failure_deaths = {
	every_owned_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_303_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_303_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_303_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_303_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

			check_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_303_result_history_recorded }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}

			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_303_branch.civil_marriage } }

				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_303_log.civil_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_303_log.civil_failure } }

				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_303_log.religious_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_303_log.religious_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_303_log.leave_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_303_log.leave_partial } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_303_log.callback_partial } }

		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_history_recorded }

fallout_event_303_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_303_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_303_branch.civil_marriage } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.civil_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.civil_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.civil_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_303_branch.communal_contract } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.communal_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.communal_shelter }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.communal_scrap }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_303_branch.religious_authority } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.religious_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.religious_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.religious_recognition }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.leave_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.leave_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.leave_power }

		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}

fallout_event_303_schedule_result = {

			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_303_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_303_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_303_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_303_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_303_branch.upper_bound }

		}

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.shelter_marriage_law_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_303_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_303_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_303_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_303_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.shelter_marriage_law_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				set_variable = { fallout_event_303_registry_owner = ROOT }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_303_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.shelter_marriage_law_candidate_id }

				clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_shelter
				clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_recognition
				clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_generation
				clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_legitimacy
				clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_integration
				clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_fertility
				clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_exposure
			}
		}
		else = {

			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_food
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_shelter

			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_exposure

			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_303_cost.religious_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_303_branch.communal_contract } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_shelter_marriage_communal days = fallout_event_303_modifier_days } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_303_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_303_branch.religious_authority } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_shelter_marriage_religious days = fallout_event_303_modifier_days } }

fallout_event_303_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_303_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_303_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_303_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_303_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_303_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_303_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_303_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_303_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_303_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_303_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_303_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_303_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_303_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_registry_target
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_cohesion
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_food
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_shelter
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_recognition
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_legitimacy
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_integration
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_fertility
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_frozen_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_303_result_day

	var:fallout_event_422_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_422_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_422_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_422_death_request = constant:fallout_event_422_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_422_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_422_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_422_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_422_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_422_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_422_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_422_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_422_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_422_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_422_callback_cleanup_released }

			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_422_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_422_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_422_callback_cleanup_released }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_422_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_422_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_422_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_422_callback_scheduled } } } }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_422_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_422_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_422_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_422_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_422_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_422_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_422_callback_cleanup_released

			clear_variable = fallout_event_422_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_422_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_422_registry_target_type

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_429_branch.disperse_roster } check_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_429_log.disperse_roster_partial } }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_429_branch.form_guild } check_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_429_log.form_guild_success } }

		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_history_recorded }

	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_should_record = 0 }

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Capture the major ticket before the delayed result
# is reserved. Ordinary callers do not create or retain this variable.

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.major_arc_stage } }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Advance through conflict and choice after the
# major opening envelope has been consumed.
fallout_event_429_advance_arc_opening_to_choice = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.conflict }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.choice }
			fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The delayed result is the fourth authored arc
# position after the opening, conflict, and choice stages.

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_429_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. The callback occupies consequence and callback
# stages before delayed cleanup is released.
fallout_event_429_advance_arc_to_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.consequence }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_429_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.callback }
			fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Cleanup advances the authored arc to its terminal
# stage and releases the exact identity and cleanup token.
fallout_event_429_close_major_arc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.cleanup }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_429_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.skilled_list_candidate_id }
			fallout_event_release_major_arc = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A failed delayed-row reservation cancels and
# releases the major identity instead of leaving an opening slot orphaned.
fallout_event_429_cancel_major_arc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
		fallout_event_cancel_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.skilled_list_candidate_id }
			fallout_event_release_major_arc = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket
	}
}

fallout_event_429_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
				fallout_event_issued_major_arc_stage_is_current = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_429_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_429_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_429_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_429_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_429_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_429_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		fallout_event_429_open_major_arc_stages = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_frozen_food = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_frozen_medicine = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_skilled_roster_memory_current } } set_variable = { fallout_skilled_roster_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.initial_roster } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_skilled_guild_cohesion_current } } set_variable = { fallout_skilled_guild_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.initial_guild_cohesion } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current } } set_variable = { fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.initial_service_loyalty } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current } } set_variable = { fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.initial_charter_legitimacy } }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_frozen_roster = fallout_skilled_roster_memory_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_frozen_guild = fallout_skilled_guild_cohesion_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_frozen_service = fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_frozen_charter = fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_429_selected_branch = fallout_event_429_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_429_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_429_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_429_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_429_requested_branch }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = fallout_event_429_major_arc_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.skilled_list_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.skilled_list_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_429_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_429_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_429_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_429_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.skilled_list_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_429_opening_event_token }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.major_arc_stage } }
				fallout_event_consume_issued_major_arc_stage = yes
			}
			else = {
				fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				fallout_event_429_advance_arc_opening_to_choice = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_outcome = fallout_event_429_calculated_outcome }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_day = global.num_days }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_registry_owner = ROOT }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.skilled_list_candidate_id }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_429_registry_target = fallout_event_429_target_state_id }
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_chain_committed
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_memory_opened
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
					fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
					fallout_event_429_cancel_major_arc = yes
					fallout_event_429_clear_frozen = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				fallout_event_429_cancel_major_arc = yes
				fallout_event_429_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			fallout_event_429_cancel_major_arc = yes
			fallout_event_429_clear_frozen = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_opening_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = 0 }
}

fallout_event_429_choose_branch = {
	fallout_event_429_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_429_pay_branch_cost = yes }
}

fallout_event_429_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_429_branch.disperse_roster }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_skilled_guild_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ai_guild_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_429_branch.form_guild } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current value = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ai_state_service_loyalty compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_429_branch.bind_state_service } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current value = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ai_self_government_charter compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_429_branch.allow_self_government } }
	fallout_event_429_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_429_pay_branch_cost = yes }
}

			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_exposure_success }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }

			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_429_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_429_branch.disperse_roster } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_skilled_dispersed days = fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days } }

			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_429_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_429_branch.bind_state_service } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_skilled_state_service days = fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days } }

		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_war_support_partial

		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_service_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_charter_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_429_timing.result_modifier_days }

			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_reclamation_partial }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_supply_partial } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_exposure_partial }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }

		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_medicine_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_recognition_failure }

		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_guild_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_guild_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_service_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_charter_failure }

			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_exposure_failure }

	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current min = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ledger_maximum }

	}

	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_429_timing.callback_delay_days }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_429_result_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.callback_scheduled }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.skilled_list_cleanup }
	fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes

fallout_event_429_resolve_result_and_schedule_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_429_result_outcome }
	fallout_event_resolve_issued_delayed_result = yes

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }

			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			fallout_event_429_schedule_callback = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_scheduled set_variable = { fallout_event_429_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket } }

			fallout_event_429_cancel_major_arc = yes

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_arc_stage_transition_accepted = 0 }

	if = {

		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_medicine_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_recognition_success }

		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes

		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_doctors_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.result_doctors_success }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_429_timing.callback_modifier_days }
		var:fallout_event_429_target_state_id = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_reclamation_success } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_supply_success } } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } } subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_exposure_success } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } set_state_flag = fallout_event_429_roster_review_honored add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_skilled_callback_success days = fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_429_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_food_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_medicine_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_recognition_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_cohesion_partial }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_stability_partial
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_war_support_partial
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_roster_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_roster_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_guild_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_guild_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_service_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_charter_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_429_timing.callback_modifier_days }
		var:fallout_event_429_target_state_id = { add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_reclamation_partial } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_supply_partial } } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_exposure_partial } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } set_state_flag = fallout_event_429_roster_review_frayed add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_skilled_callback_partial days = fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_food_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_medicine_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_recognition_failure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_cohesion_failure }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes

		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_war_support_failure
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_roster_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_roster_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_guild_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_guild_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_service_loyalty_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_service_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_charter_failure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_429_timing.callback_modifier_days }
		var:fallout_event_429_target_state_id = { subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_reclamation_failure } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_supply_failure } } if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } } add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.callback_exposure_failure } clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum } set_state_flag = fallout_event_429_roster_review_broken add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_skilled_callback_failure days = fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_state_modifier_days = 0 }
		fallout_event_429_apply_callback_failure_deaths = yes
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_skilled_roster_memory_current min = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_skilled_guild_cohesion_current min = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ledger_maximum }

	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_skilled_charter_legitimacy_current min = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_429_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_memory_closed
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_callback_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }

		fallout_event_429_record_history = yes
		fallout_event_429_advance_arc_to_callback = yes

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_429_callback_ticket }
		fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes

fallout_event_429_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_429_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_429_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_429_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_429_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_429_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_429_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_cleanup_released }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_429_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_429_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_429_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_429_memory_closed
			fallout_event_429_close_major_arc = yes
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_429_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_429_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_429_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_429_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_429_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_registry_target
			fallout_event_429_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_429_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_429_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

# This file owns the technology consequence of Fallout. Every surviving tag is
# reduced to a practical survival floor before successor allocation. Majors
# and special Chaos countries receive the small emergency support floor. The
# effect never loads an Independence Wave focus tree and is generation-bound.
# ============================================================================

# unresearch a technology. Mutually exclusive technologies and technologies
# that unlock database objects remain an engine-sensitive review surface.

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT THAW WATER EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# This chain uses a state-owned thaw-water receipt. The watercourse and its
# disease risks are fictional Fallout survival content. The effects never
# claim that ordinary radiation creates real hydrology or disease science.

fallout_event_457_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_457_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_death_request = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_457_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_457_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}
