fallout_event_457_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_457_result_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_457_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.drain_settlement } check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.drain_settlement_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.drain_settlement } check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.drain_settlement_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.drain_settlement } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.drain_settlement_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.evacuate_low_ground } check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.evacuate_low_ground_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.evacuate_low_ground } check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.evacuate_low_ground_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.evacuate_low_ground } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.evacuate_low_ground_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.rebuild_channels } check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.rebuild_channels_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.rebuild_channels } check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.rebuild_channels_partial } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.rebuild_channels } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.rebuild_channels_failure } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.use_floodwater_fields_success } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.use_floodwater_fields_partial } }
			else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.use_floodwater_fields_failure } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.callback_success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.callback_partial } }

		else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_457_log.callback_failure } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_457_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_457_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_457_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_457_callback_history_recorded }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_payload = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_history_should_record = 0 }
}

fallout_event_457_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = fallout_event_457_frozen_water_safety }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.water_safety_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = fallout_event_457_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = fallout_event_457_frozen_channel_trust }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.channel_trust_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = fallout_event_457_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = fallout_event_457_frozen_disease_control }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.disease_control_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = fallout_event_457_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = fallout_event_457_frozen_thaw_memory }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.thaw_memory_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = fallout_event_457_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = fallout_event_457_frozen_flood_pressure }

	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.flood_pressure_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = fallout_event_457_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = fallout_event_457_frozen_food }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.food_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = fallout_event_457_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = fallout_event_457_frozen_recognition }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.recognition_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = fallout_event_457_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = fallout_event_457_frozen_cohesion }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.cohesion_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_component = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_viability = fallout_event_457_component }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_457_viability min = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.maximum_viability }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.drain_settlement } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_457_viability value = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.branch_drain_success compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_457_frozen_flood_pressure value = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.drain_flood_pressure_cap compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_457_viability value = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.branch_drain_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.evacuate_low_ground } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_457_viability value = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.branch_evacuate_success compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_457_frozen_water_safety value = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.evacuate_water_safety_floor compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_457_viability value = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.branch_evacuate_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_457_branch.rebuild_channels } }

	}
	else = {

fallout_event_457_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_457_chain_committed } check_variable = { fallout_event_457_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_457_branch.none } check_variable = { fallout_event_457_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_457_branch.upper_bound } fallout_event_457_target_is_current = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_food = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_medicine = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_thaw_water_flood_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_thaw_water_flood_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.initial_flood_pressure } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_thaw_water_water_safety_current } } set_variable = { fallout_thaw_water_water_safety_current = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.initial_water_safety } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_thaw_water_channel_trust_current } } set_variable = { fallout_thaw_water_channel_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.initial_channel_trust } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_thaw_water_disease_control_current } } set_variable = { fallout_thaw_water_disease_control_current = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.initial_disease_control } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_thaw_water_thaw_memory_current } } set_variable = { fallout_thaw_water_thaw_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_457_threshold.initial_thaw_memory } }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_flood_pressure = fallout_thaw_water_flood_pressure_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_water_safety = fallout_thaw_water_water_safety_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_channel_trust = fallout_thaw_water_channel_trust_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_disease_control = fallout_thaw_water_disease_control_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_frozen_thaw_memory = fallout_thaw_water_thaw_memory_current }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
	set_variable = { fallout_event_457_selected_branch = fallout_event_457_requested_branch }
	fallout_event_457_calculate_outcome = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_457_opening_ticket }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_457_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_457_requested_branch }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.thaw_water_result }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.thaw_water_result_ai }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_457_requested_branch }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_457_timing.result_delay_days }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_457_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_457_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_457_opening_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.thaw_water_cleanup }
	fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_457_opening_event_token }
		fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_outcome = fallout_event_457_calculated_outcome }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_result_day = global.num_days }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_registry_owner = ROOT }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.thaw_water_candidate_id }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_457_registry_target = fallout_event_457_target_state_id }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_457_chain_committed
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_457_memory_opened
			var:fallout_event_457_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_457_registry_committed }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice } fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes fallout_event_457_clear_frozen = yes }
	}
	else = { fallout_event_457_clear_frozen = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_opening_ticket = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_457_opening_event_token = 0 }
}

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT TRIAGE WALL EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Dormant first-season medicine chain. A produced Air Winter shelter state
# below the reviewed medicine pressure becomes a state-owned triage ledger.

			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_175_threshold.workers_success_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_175_target_reclamation value = constant:fallout_event_175_threshold.workers_success_reclamation compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_175_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_175_threshold.partial_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_175_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_175_threshold.soldiers_success_medicine compare = greater_than_or_equals }

			}

fallout_event_175_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_175_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_175_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_175_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_175_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_175_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_175_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_175_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_175_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_175_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_175_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_175_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_175_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_callback_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_result_state_id
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_175_triage_state_id }
				var:fallout_event_175_triage_state_id = {
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_175_triage_registry_committed
					clear_variable = fallout_event_175_triage_registry_generation
					clear_variable = fallout_event_175_triage_registry_owner
					clear_variable = fallout_event_175_triage_shelter
				}
			}
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_triage_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_triage_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_175_triage_registry_owner
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_175_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_607_initialize_ledgers = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_tunnel_committee_trust_current } } set_variable = { fallout_tunnel_committee_trust_current = constant:fallout_event_607_ledger.initial_committee_trust } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_tunnel_central_capacity_current } } set_variable = { fallout_tunnel_central_capacity_current = constant:fallout_event_607_ledger.initial_central_capacity } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_tunnel_ward_autonomy_current } } set_variable = { fallout_tunnel_ward_autonomy_current = constant:fallout_event_607_ledger.initial_ward_autonomy } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_tunnel_security_control_current } } set_variable = { fallout_tunnel_security_control_current = constant:fallout_event_607_ledger.initial_security_control } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_tunnel_representation_current } } set_variable = { fallout_tunnel_representation_current = constant:fallout_event_607_ledger.initial_representation } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_tunnel_refugee_integration_current } } set_variable = { fallout_tunnel_refugee_integration_current = constant:fallout_event_607_ledger.initial_refugee_integration } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_tunnel_faction_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_tunnel_faction_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_607_ledger.initial_faction_pressure } }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_committee_trust_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_central_capacity_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_ward_autonomy_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_security_control_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_representation_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_refugee_integration_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_faction_pressure_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
}

fallout_event_607_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.recognize_councils } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.recognize_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.recognize_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.recognize_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.centralize_appointments } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.centralize_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.centralize_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.centralize_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.centralize_recognition }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.military_wards } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.military_food }
			set_temp_variable = { equipment_stockpile_removal_amount = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.military_equipment } remove_support_equipment_from_stockpile = yes
			add_command_power = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.military_command_power_negative
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.rotate_leadership } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.rotate_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.rotate_medicine }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.rotate_power }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.rotate_recognition }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_607_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.rotate_leadership } }

			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_607_cost.rotate_recognition }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_shelter }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.component_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_supply }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_reclamation }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_infrastructure }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.infrastructure_score_factor }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_food }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_medicine }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_power }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_recognition }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_cohesion }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_exposure }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = fallout_event_607_frozen_disease }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.signal_divisor }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = fallout_event_607_component }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.recognize_councils } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_recognize_cohesion_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_recognize_bonus } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.centralize_appointments } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_frozen_power value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_centralize_power_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_centralize_recognition_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_centralize_bonus } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_centralize_low_cohesion_threshold compare = less_than } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_centralize_low_cohesion_penalty } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.military_wards } }
		if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_military_war_bonus } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_war_support < constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_military_war_support_threshold } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_military_war_support_bonus } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_military_low_cohesion_threshold compare = less_than } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_military_low_cohesion_penalty } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.rotate_leadership } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_frozen_cohesion value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_rotate_cohesion_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_frozen_shelter value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_rotate_shelter_threshold compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_rotate_bonus } }
		if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_grade = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.branch_rotate_war_penalty } }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade min = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.grade_maximum }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.recognize_councils } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.recognize_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.centralize_appointments } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.centralize_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.military_wards } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.military_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.rotate_leadership } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.rotate_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.recognize_councils } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.recognize_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.centralize_appointments } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.centralize_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.military_wards } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.military_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				AND = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_607_branch.rotate_leadership } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_grade value = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.rotate_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_component = 0 }
}

			add_to_variable = { fallout_tunnel_faction_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.result_military_success_faction }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { fallout_tunnel_representation_current = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.result_rotate_success_representation }

		else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_tunnel_representation_current = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.callback_failure_primary } }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_committee_trust_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_central_capacity_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_ward_autonomy_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_security_control_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_representation_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_tunnel_refugee_integration_current min = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_607_threshold.ledger_maximum }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_callback_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }

fallout_event_607_abort_on_generation_change = {
	set_variable = { fallout_event_607_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = fallout_event_dispatch_issued
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_chain_committed }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.tunnel_ward_committees_human }
				check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.tunnel_ward_committees_ai }
			}
		}
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes owner = { tag = ROOT } is_controlled_by = ROOT fallout_event_607_state_is_current = yes }
				set_variable = { ROOT.fallout_event_607_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { fallout_event_607_opening_target_is_current = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } }
			set_variable = { fallout_event_607_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }

				fallout_event_607_record_history = yes
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_607_refund_branch_cost = yes }
				fallout_event_607_clear_state_reservation = yes

			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_cost_paid NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_result_history_recorded } } fallout_event_607_refund_branch_cost = yes }
		fallout_event_607_clear_state_reservation = yes
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_607_target_state_id } var:fallout_event_607_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_607_registry_committed } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_recognized }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_centralized }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_military }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_rotating }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_partial }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_failed }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_reviewed }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_reviewed_partial }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_tunnel_ward_committees_reviewed_failed }
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_chain_committed

		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_cost_paid
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_choice_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_result_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_callback_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_cancellation_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_target_invalidated
		fallout_event_607_clear_frozen = yes
		clear_variable = fallout_event_607_registry_generation
		clear_variable = fallout_event_607_registry_owner

fallout_event_607_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_607_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_607_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_607_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_607_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_chain_committed

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_callback_scheduled

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_choice_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_callback_cleanup_released
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_607_target_state_id }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_607_target_invalidated }
					var:fallout_event_607_target_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_607_registry_committed }
				}
				else = { var:fallout_event_607_target_state_id = { set_state_flag = fallout_event_607_registry_committed } }
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_607_target_invalidated
			fallout_event_607_clear_state_reservation = yes
			fallout_event_607_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_registry_target_type

			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_target_state_id

			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_callback_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_607_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_607_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_359_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_359_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_359_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_359_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_359_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_359_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_359_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_359_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_359_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_359_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_359_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_359_threshold.result_power_success }

		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_359_threshold.result_medicine_success }

		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_359_threshold.result_war_support_success
		var:fallout_event_359_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_359_threshold.state_reclamation_success }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_359_threshold.state_supply_success } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_359_threshold.state_exposure_success }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_359_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_359_timing.result_modifier_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_359_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_359_branch.preserve } }

				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_vault_of_voices_preserved days = fallout_event_359_state_modifier_days }

			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_359_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_359_branch.curate } }
				set_state_flag = fallout_event_359_memory_archive_curated
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_vault_of_voices_curated days = fallout_event_359_state_modifier_days }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_359_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_359_branch.weaponize } }

				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_vault_of_voices_weaponized days = fallout_event_359_state_modifier_days }
			}
			else = {

# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT RIVER INTAKE AT DAWN EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Dormant receipt-authenticated water-security chain. The opening coordinator
# consumes one exact ordinary receipt, records a state-owned intake registry,
# schedules one branch-specific delayed result, and later schedules one
# callback before releasing the cleanup row. Human and hidden-AI results share
# the same scoring, resource effects, state consequences, memory, and cleanup.
# No scheduler activation flag is written here.
# ============================================================================

fallout_event_107_apply_failure_deaths = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_state_id > 0 }
			fallout_event_107_intake_registry_is_current = yes
		}
		var:fallout_event_107_result_state_id = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_death_request = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_107_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_107_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_orientation_runtime.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		}
	}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.callback_failure }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.close_intake } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.close_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.close_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.close_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.ration_filters } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.ration_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.ration_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.ration_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.seize_upstream_pumps } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.seizure_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.seizure_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.seizure_failure } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.foreign_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.foreign_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.foreign_failure } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.callback_success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_107_log.callback_partial }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_107_log.history_id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = constant:event_system_event_type.fallout_country_memory }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = fallout_event_107_history_payload }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		record_events_log_system_history_entry = yes
		refresh_events_log_system_history_views = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_107_result_history_recorded }
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_history_recorded }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_should_record = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_payload = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_has_secondary_actor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_history_stage = 0 }
}

fallout_event_107_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.close_intake } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.water_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_107_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.state_water_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_107_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.state_water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.ration_filters } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.filters_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.filters_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_107_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.state_water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.seize_upstream_pumps } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				OR = {
					has_government = fascism
					has_government = neutrality
					check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.recognition_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_107_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.state_water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.medicine_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^3 value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.medicine_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_107_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_107_threshold.state_water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_107_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_107_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_107_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_107_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_107_opening_intake_target_is_current = yes
		}
		var:fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_target_water = air_winter_water_security } }
		fallout_event_107_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_target_type = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_target = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_107_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_107_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_close_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_close_result_ai }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.ration_filters } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_ration_result }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_ration_result_ai }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.seize_upstream_pumps } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_seizure_result }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_seizure_result_ai }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_107_branch.accept_foreign_testing } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_foreign_testing_result }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_foreign_testing_result_ai }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_107_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_107_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_107_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_107_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = fallout_event_107_opening_target_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = fallout_event_107_opening_target }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.river_intake_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_107_opening_event_token }
			fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_released
				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_released
				clear_variable = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_ticket
				set_variable = { fallout_event_107_selected_branch = fallout_event_107_requested_branch }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_outcome = fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_107_result_day = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_107_intake_state_id = fallout_event_107_opening_target }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_107_intake_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_107_intake_registry_owner = ROOT }
				var:fallout_event_107_opening_target = {
					set_state_flag = fallout_event_107_intake_registry_committed
					set_variable = { fallout_event_107_intake_registry_generation = ROOT.fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_107_intake_registry_owner = ROOT }
				}
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_107_chain_committed
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				set_country_flag = fallout_event_107_schedule_error
			}
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_107_schedule_error }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_target_water = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_target_type = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_target = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_opening_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_requested_branch = 0 }
}

			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^3 = constant:fallout_event_107_result.ration_success_medicine }

			add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_107_result.ration_partial_water }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_107_result.ration_partial_filters }

fallout_event_107_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_107_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_107_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_107_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_scheduled
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_released
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_released
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_released
						NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_scheduled }
					}
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_107_contamination_memory
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_107_intake_state_id } var:fallout_event_107_intake_state_id = { clr_state_flag = fallout_event_107_intake_registry_committed } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_107_intake_state_id } var:fallout_event_107_intake_state_id = { clear_variable = fallout_event_107_intake_registry_generation clear_variable = fallout_event_107_intake_registry_owner } }
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_intake_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_intake_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_intake_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_107_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_107_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

	var:fallout_event_513_target_state_id = {

			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }

			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_513_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_513_death_request = constant:fallout_event_513_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_513_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_513_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_513_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_513_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_513_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_513_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_513_callback_cleanup_released }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_513_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_513_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_513_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_513_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_513_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_513_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_513_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_513_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_513_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_513_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_513_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_513_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_513_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_513_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_registry_target
			fallout_event_513_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_513_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_513_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT THE WELL QUEUE EFFECTS

# Dormant receipt-authenticated state survival chain. The opening consumes one

fallout_event_153_apply_failure_deaths = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_153_result_state_id > 0 }
			fallout_event_153_well_registry_is_current = yes
		}
		var:fallout_event_153_result_state_id = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_death_request = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_153_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_153_death_request }

			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }

			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_153_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }

		}

	}
	else_if = {

		if = {

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.public_queue } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_153_log.public_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_153_log.public_partial } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_153_log.ration_failure } }

				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_153_log.guard_failure } }
			}
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_153_log.callback_success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_153_log.callback_partial } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_system_event_id = constant:fallout_event_153_log.history_id }

		else = { set_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_history_recorded }
