			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.water_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.state_water_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.state_water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.ration_cards } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.filters_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.state_water_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.filters_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.state_water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.state_water_success compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				OR = { has_government = fascism has_government = neutrality has_war = yes }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_target_water value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.state_water_partial compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
}

	if = {

			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_153_chain_committed }

		}
		fallout_event_153_calculate_outcome = yes

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.ration_cards } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.well_queue_ration_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.well_queue_ration_result_ai } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.guarded_queue } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.well_queue_guard_result } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.well_queue_guard_result_ai } }

		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = fallout_event_153_opening_target_type }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = fallout_event_153_opening_target }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.well_queue_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }

				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_variable = { fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_released
				clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_released
				clear_variable = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_ticket

fallout_event_153_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.public_queue }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^7 value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.filters_partial compare = less_than } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.guarded_queue }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { command_power < constant:fallout_event_153_cost.guard_command_power_minimum }
			OR = { has_government = fascism has_government = neutrality has_war = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.guarded_queue }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_153_threshold.water_success compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.ration_cards } }
	fallout_event_153_schedule_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_153_pay_branch_cost = yes
	}
}

fallout_event_153_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_153_cost_paid } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.public_queue } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_153_cost.public_water } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_153_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_153_branch.ration_cards } } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^7 = constant:fallout_event_153_cost.ration_filters } }
		else = { add_command_power = constant:fallout_event_153_cost.guard_command_power_spend }
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_153_cost_paid
	}
}

fallout_event_153_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_153_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_callback_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_result_state_id
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_153_well_state_id }
				var:fallout_event_153_well_state_id = {
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_153_well_registry_committed
					clear_variable = fallout_event_153_well_registry_generation
					clear_variable = fallout_event_153_well_registry_owner
				}
			}
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_well_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_well_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_153_well_registry_owner
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_153_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

fallout_event_670_apply_failure_deaths = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { fallout_event_670_result_state_id > 0 }
			fallout_event_670_labor_registry_is_current = yes
		}
		var:fallout_event_670_result_state_id = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_670_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_670_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_670_death_request = constant:fallout_event_670_threshold.failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_670_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_670_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_670_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_670_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_670_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_670_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_670_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_670_result_cleanup_released
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_670_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_670_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_cleanup_released
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = fallout_event_670_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_670_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals }
				has_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_cleanup_released
			}
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_670_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_670_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_cleanup_released }
					AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_670_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_scheduled } }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_resolved
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_schedule_error
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_cost_paid
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_choice_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_result_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_history_recorded
		clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_cancellation_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_670_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_callback_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_result_state_id
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_670_harvest_state_id }
				var:fallout_event_670_harvest_state_id = {
					clr_state_flag = fallout_event_670_labor_registry_committed
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_labor_registry_generation
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_labor_registry_owner
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_harvest_reserve
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_supply
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_disease
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_population
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_exposure
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_adaptation
					clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_reclamation
				}
			}
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_harvest_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_labor_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_labor_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_supply
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_disease
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_population
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_exposure
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_adaptation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_670_frozen_reclamation
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_670_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT WORKING ELEVATOR EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Dormant country-level food-storage recovery transaction. The chain freezes
# post-streetlight food and logistics ledgers, resolves one authored grain-store
# policy, applies Deaths-backed failure, records Event Log memory, and cleans up
# exact delayed receipts.
# ============================================================================

fallout_event_324_apply_failure_deaths = {
	every_owned_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_324_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_324_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_324_record_history = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_324_result_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two } NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_324_callback_history_recorded } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_should_record = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_324_log.callback_failure }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_324_branch.public_granary } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_324_log.granary_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_324_log.granary_partial } }
				else = { set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_324_log.granary_failure } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_324_branch.military_depot } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_324_log.military_success } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_history_payload = constant:fallout_event_324_log.military_partial } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_324_branch.military_depot } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_324_viability value = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.military_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_324_frozen_power value = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.military_success_power compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }

	}
	else_if = {

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_324_viability value = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.merchant_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_event_324_frozen_recognition value = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.merchant_success_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }

fallout_event_324_pay_branch_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_324_cost_paid } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_324_branch.public_granary } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.granary_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.granary_scrap }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_324_branch.military_depot } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.military_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^5 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.military_fuel }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^6 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.military_power }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_324_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_324_branch.merchant_exchange } }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.merchant_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^4 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.merchant_scrap }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.merchant_recognition }
		}
		else = {
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.refugee_food }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^2 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.refugee_water }
			subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^8 = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.refugee_shelter }
		}
		set_country_flag = fallout_event_324_cost_paid
		fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.ai_granary_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }

		}

	else_if = {

			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^5 value = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.military_fuel compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^6 value = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.military_power compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_324_branch.military_depot }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.ai_merchant_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.merchant_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^4 value = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.merchant_scrap compare = greater_than_or_equals }

		}

	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_324_threshold.ai_refugee_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 value = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.refugee_food compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^2 value = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.refugee_water compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^8 value = constant:fallout_event_324_cost.refugee_shelter compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_324_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_324_branch.refugee_ration_center }

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_324_callback_cleanup_released

			clear_variable = fallout_event_324_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_324_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_324_registry_target

# CHAOS REDUX - FALLOUT THE WORKING MACHINE EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Dormant country-owned technical-facility protocol chain. The selected native
# state, frozen resources, delayed receipts, and cleanup tickets are all bound
# to the Fallout transition generation and the owning country.

fallout_event_352_apply_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_352_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.result_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_352_state_death_request
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = fallout_event_352_state_death_request }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.fallout_aftermath }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = OWNER }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_state_death_request = 0 }
		}
	}
}

fallout_event_352_apply_callback_failure_deaths = {
	var:fallout_event_352_target_state_id = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = state_population_k value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_state_death_request = state_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_state_death_request = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.people_per_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_state_death_request = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.callback_failure_death_percent }
			round_temp_variable = fallout_event_352_state_death_request

fallout_event_352_calculate_outcome = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_viability = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = fallout_event_352_frozen_power }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.power_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_viability = fallout_event_352_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = fallout_event_352_frozen_scrap }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.scrap_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_viability = fallout_event_352_component }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = fallout_event_352_frozen_medicine }
	multiply_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.medicine_weight }
	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_viability = fallout_event_352_component }

	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.weight_divisor }

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = fallout_event_352_frozen_recognition }

	divide_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_component = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.weight_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_viability = fallout_event_352_component }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = fallout_event_352_viability min = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.minimum_viability max = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.maximum_viability }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.failure }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_352_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_352_branch.integrate } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_352_viability value = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.integration_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_352_viability value = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.integration_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_352_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_352_branch.dismantle } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_352_viability value = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.dismantle_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_352_viability value = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.dismantle_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_352_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_352_branch.venerate } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_352_viability value = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.venerate_success_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_352_viability value = constant:fallout_event_352_threshold.venerate_partial_viability compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_352_calculated_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
	}
	else = {

			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_352_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_352_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_352_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_352_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_352_memory_closed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_352_chain_committed

			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_352_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_352_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_352_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_352_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_352_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_352_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_352_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_352_candidate_id

# is reserved. The opening envelope must remain at the opening stage until it

	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Advance through conflict and choice after the
# major opening envelope has been consumed.
fallout_event_401_advance_arc_opening_to_choice = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.conflict }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.none }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.choice }
			fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
	}
}

			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. Cleanup advances the authored arc to its terminal
# stage and releases the same identity and cleanup token that was reserved.
fallout_event_401_close_major_arc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_arc_stage = constant:fallout_event_arc_stage.cleanup }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_401_result_outcome }
		fallout_event_advance_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.year_zero_candidate_id }
			fallout_event_release_major_arc = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_scheduler_error_to_register = constant:fallout_event_scheduler_error.arc_receipt_mismatch }
			fallout_event_register_scheduler_error_if_unowned = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket
	}
}

# Supported scope: COUNTRY. A failed delayed-row reservation cancels and
# releases the major identity instead of leaving an opening slot orphaned.
fallout_event_401_cancel_major_arc = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
		fallout_event_cancel_major_arc = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.year_zero_candidate_id }
			fallout_event_release_major_arc = yes
		}
		clear_variable = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket
	}
}

fallout_event_401_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				fallout_event_issued_ordinary_receipt_is_current = yes
				fallout_event_issued_major_arc_stage_is_current = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_401_chain_committed }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_401_requested_branch > constant:fallout_event_401_branch.none }
			check_variable = { fallout_event_401_requested_branch < constant:fallout_event_401_branch.upper_bound }
			fallout_event_401_opening_target_is_current = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_opening_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_opening_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_opening_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
		fallout_event_401_open_major_arc_stages = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_frozen_food = fallout_survival_current_entries^1 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_frozen_recognition = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_frozen_cohesion = fallout_survival_cohesion_current }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_calendar_memory_current } } set_variable = { fallout_calendar_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.initial_calendar_memory } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current } } set_variable = { fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.initial_legitimacy } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current } } set_variable = { fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.initial_anniversary_cohesion } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current } } set_variable = { fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.initial_ideology_pressure } }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_frozen_memory = fallout_calendar_memory_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_frozen_legitimacy = fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_frozen_anniversary = fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_frozen_ideology = fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_target_state_id = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_target }
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_selected_branch = fallout_event_401_requested_branch }
		fallout_event_401_calculate_outcome = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_401_opening_ticket }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_401_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_401_requested_branch }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.year_zero_result }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.year_zero_result_ai }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_401_requested_branch }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = constant:fallout_event_401_timing.result_delay_days }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_401_transaction.visible_budget_cost }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_opening_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_401_opening_mode }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.result_scheduled }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.year_zero_cleanup }
		fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_401_opening_event_token }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_dispatch_issued_source = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_source.major_arc_stage } }
				fallout_event_consume_issued_major_arc_stage = yes
			}
			else = {
				fallout_event_consume_issued_ordinary_receipt = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
				fallout_event_401_advance_arc_opening_to_choice = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_outcome = fallout_event_401_calculated_outcome }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_day = global.num_days }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_registry_generation = fallout_event_runtime_generation }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_registry_owner = ROOT }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_candidate_id = constant:fallout_event_candidate_pilot.year_zero_candidate_id }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_registry_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.state }
					set_variable = { fallout_event_401_registry_target = fallout_event_401_target_state_id }
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_401_chain_committed
					set_country_flag = fallout_event_401_memory_opened
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cancellation_reason = constant:fallout_event_cancellation_reason.caller_cancelled }
					set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
					fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
					fallout_event_401_cancel_major_arc = yes
					fallout_event_401_clear_frozen = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket }
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.cancelled_before_choice }
				fallout_event_cancel_delayed_result = yes
				fallout_event_401_clear_frozen = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			fallout_event_401_cancel_major_arc = yes
			fallout_event_401_clear_frozen = yes
		}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_calculated_outcome = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_opening_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_opening_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_opening_event_token = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = 0 }
}

fallout_event_401_choose_branch = {
	fallout_event_401_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_401_pay_branch_cost = yes }
}

fallout_event_401_choose_ai_branch_and_schedule_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.old_calendar }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current value = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ai_year_zero_legitimacy compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_401_cost.year_zero_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.year_zero } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ai_regional_calendar_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_cohesion_current value = constant:fallout_event_401_cost.regional_calendar_cohesion compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.regional_calendar } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_calendar_memory_current value = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ai_religious_calendar_memory compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_401_cost.religious_calendar_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.religious_calendar } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_survival_current_entries^9 value = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ai_old_calendar_recognition compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_requested_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.old_calendar } }
	fallout_event_401_schedule_result = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } fallout_event_401_pay_branch_cost = yes }
}

fallout_event_401_apply_result_effects = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_food_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_recognition_success }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_cohesion_success }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_stability_success
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_war_support_success
		add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_memory_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_legitimacy_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_cohesion_success }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.old_calendar } } add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_ideology_old } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.year_zero } } add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_ideology_year_zero } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.regional_calendar } } add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_ideology_regional } }
		else = { add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_ideology_religious } }
		var:fallout_event_401_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_reclamation_success }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_supply_success } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_exposure_success }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_401_memory_calendar_success
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_401_timing.result_modifier_days }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.old_calendar } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_year_zero_old_calendar days = fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.year_zero } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_year_zero_new_epoch days = fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_selected_branch = constant:fallout_event_401_branch.regional_calendar } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_year_zero_regional_count days = fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days } }
			else = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_year_zero_sacred_calendar days = fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days } }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_food_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_recognition_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_cohesion_partial }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_stability_partial
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_war_support_partial
		add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_memory_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_legitimacy_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_cohesion_partial }
		var:fallout_event_401_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_reclamation_partial }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_supply_partial } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_exposure_partial }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_401_memory_calendar_partial
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_401_timing.result_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_year_zero_calendar_frayed days = fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_food_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_recognition_failure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_cohesion_failure }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_stability_failure
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_war_support_failure
		add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_memory_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_legitimacy_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_cohesion_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_ideology_year_zero }
		var:fallout_event_401_target_state_id = {
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_reclamation_failure }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_supply_failure } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.result_exposure_failure }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = non_damaged_building_level@infrastructure value = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero compare = greater_than } } damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_401_THRESHOLD_BUILDING_DAMAGE_FAILURE } }
			else = { damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = @CR_SC_FALLOUT_EVENT_401_THRESHOLD_BUILDING_DAMAGE_FAILURE } }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_401_memory_calendar_failed
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_401_timing.result_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_year_zero_calendar_broken days = fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
		fallout_event_401_apply_failure_deaths = yes
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_calendar_memory_current min = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current min = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current min = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	clamp_variable = { var = fallout_calendar_ideology_pressure_current min = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ledger_minimum max = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.ledger_maximum }
	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
}

fallout_event_401_schedule_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_ticket }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = constant:fallout_event_401_transaction.result_transaction_key_offset }
	add_to_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_transaction_key = fallout_event_401_selected_branch }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = fallout_event_401_major_arc_ticket }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_parent_arc_ticket = constant:fallout_event_runtime.no_ticket }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_human_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.year_zero_callback }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ai_event_token = constant:fallout_event_id.year_zero_callback_ai }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_branch = fallout_event_401_selected_branch }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_due_day = global.num_days }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_mode = constant:fallout_event_dispatch_mode.hidden_ai } } set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_visible_budget_cost = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_control_mode = fallout_event_401_result_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_queue_status = constant:fallout_event_queue_status.callback_scheduled }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target_type = constant:fallout_event_subject_type.none }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_target = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_cleanup_token = constant:fallout_event_id.year_zero_cleanup }
	fallout_event_schedule_delayed_result = yes

fallout_event_401_resolve_result_and_schedule_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_mode = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_mode }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_401_result_outcome }
	fallout_event_resolve_issued_delayed_result = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_401_apply_result_effects = yes
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one }
		fallout_event_401_record_history = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_401_result_ticket }
		fallout_event_401_advance_arc_to_delayed_result = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
			fallout_event_401_schedule_callback = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_scheduled set_variable = { fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_transaction_ticket } }
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_401_result_ticket }
				fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
				fallout_event_401_cancel_major_arc = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_401_result_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			fallout_event_401_cancel_major_arc = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_mode = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = 0 }
}

fallout_event_401_apply_callback_effects = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.success } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_food_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_recognition_success }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_cohesion_success }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_stability_success
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_war_support_success

		add_to_variable = { fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_legitimacy_success }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_cohesion_success }
		var:fallout_event_401_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_reclamation_success }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_supply_success } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_exposure_success }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_401_memory_anniversary_honored
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_401_timing.callback_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_year_zero_anniversary_honored days = fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_result_outcome = constant:fallout_event_outcome_type.partial } }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_food_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_recognition_partial }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_cohesion_partial }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_stability_partial
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_war_support_partial
		add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_memory_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_legitimacy_partial }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_cohesion_partial }
		var:fallout_event_401_target_state_id = {
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_reclamation_partial }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } add_to_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_supply_partial } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } clamp_variable = { var = fallout_state_supply_access_current min = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.minimum max = constant:fallout_survival_numeric.maximum } }
			add_to_variable = { air_winter_exposure = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_exposure_partial }
			clamp_variable = { var = air_winter_exposure min = constant:air_winter_ledger.minimum max = constant:air_winter_ledger.maximum }
			set_state_flag = fallout_event_401_memory_anniversary_frayed
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = constant:fallout_event_401_timing.callback_modifier_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = fallout_year_zero_anniversary_frayed days = fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_state_modifier_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^1 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_food_failure }
		subtract_from_variable = { fallout_survival_current_entries^9 = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_recognition_failure }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_survival_cohesion_delta = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_cohesion_failure }
		fallout_survival_apply_cohesion_delta = yes
		add_stability = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_stability_failure
		add_war_support = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_war_support_failure
		add_to_variable = { fallout_calendar_memory_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_memory_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_year_zero_legitimacy_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_legitimacy_failure }
		add_to_variable = { fallout_anniversary_cohesion_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_cohesion_failure }
		var:fallout_event_401_target_state_id = {
			subtract_from_variable = { air_winter_reclamation = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_reclamation_failure }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = fallout_state_supply_access_current } subtract_from_variable = { fallout_state_supply_access_current = constant:fallout_event_401_threshold.callback_supply_failure } }

	fallout_orientation_clamp_resources = yes

	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_callback_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_outcome = fallout_event_401_result_outcome }
	fallout_event_resolve_issued_delayed_result = yes

		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		fallout_event_401_apply_callback_effects = yes
		set_variable = { fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_401_callback_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_history_stage = constant:fallout_event_runtime.two }
		fallout_event_401_record_history = yes
		fallout_event_401_advance_arc_to_callback = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.zero } } fallout_event_401_cancel_major_arc = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_401_callback_ticket }
		fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_callback_ticket = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_arc_stage_transition_accepted = 0 }
}

fallout_event_401_cleanup = {
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_cleanup_ticket = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_ticket }
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_event_token = fallout_event_dispatch_issued_event_token }
	fallout_event_release_issued_delayed_cleanup = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_401_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_released }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_401_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } } set_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_released }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = fallout_event_401_cleanup_ticket value = fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_ticket compare = equals } has_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_released }
			set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_requested_ticket = fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_ticket }
			fallout_event_prepare_delayed_cleanup = yes
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { fallout_event_transaction_accepted = constant:fallout_event_runtime.one } } clr_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_scheduled }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_released has_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_released } AND = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_released NOT = { has_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_scheduled } } } }
			set_country_flag = fallout_event_401_memory_closed
			fallout_event_401_close_major_arc = yes
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_401_chain_committed
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_scheduled
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_401_cost_paid
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_401_result_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_history_recorded
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_released
			clr_country_flag = fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_released
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_registry_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_registry_owner
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_candidate_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_registry_target_type
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_registry_target
			fallout_event_401_clear_frozen = yes
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_selected_branch
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_result_outcome
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_result_generation
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_result_day
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_target_state_id
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_result_cleanup_ticket
			clear_variable = fallout_event_401_callback_cleanup_ticket
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fallout_event_401_cleanup_ticket = 0 }
}
